===== verge-protocol/NOTES.md =====
Controls: drag the left stick or use WASD to steer Rook; tap a road node to build/upgrade; 1–4 select turrets.
Loop: survive 25 authored waves, use the preview to prepare, choose one tech pick between waves, and collect scrap.
Turrets: gun (direct), slow field (stacking), mortar (blast), tesla (chain); tap BARRIER to redirect a split.
Lose when the core breaks; win after wave 25; tap RESTART or press R to run again. Best score is device-local.
===== warring-banners/NOTES.md =====
# Warring Banners
Controls: tap your banner, then tap a lit hex to march (2 move points) or a red-ringed foe to open the full battle math before committing. Drag to pan, pinch/wheel to zoom. Recruit chips + End Turn sit at the bottom. Keyboard: arrows move the cursor, Enter acts, Space ends turn, 1/2/3 recruit Spear/Cavalry/Bow, +/- zoom, F refits, Esc deselects.
Loop: one 40-hex valley, a season of 12 turns against three AI warlords (Korrund raids, Sethmoor turtles, Vaelin expands) who fight you and each other. Spear beats Cavalry beats Bow beats Spear; forest/hill give cover, rivers are impassable except at fords, and keep walls give x1.90.
Supply: hexes you walk on become yours; any banner not connected back to your keep through your own territory is CUT OFF — drawn dashed and dimmed, fighting at x0.70 and losing 2 strength a turn.
Win/lose: most territory at turn 12 wins the season (taking every rival keep wins outright); losing your own keep is instant defeat. Territory banks a gold legacy into the next seeded season, persisted locally.
===== aegis-line/NOTES.md =====
Controls: tap a mech to target; tap glowing weak points for crits; swipe from a portrait to a mech; tap portraits 1-2-3 (breaker, sustain, burst) for a chain.
Keyboard: arrows select a lane/target; 1-3 trigger bursts; R retries or opens roster; Enter deploys.
Loop: clear 12 advancing stages, bosses every 4; unlock squadmates at milestones and skins through achievements.
Progress, best score, unlocked pilots, and skins persist locally; no network, currency, ads, or energy.
===== silkwind/NOTES.md =====
# Silkwind
Touch: swipe up/down = high/low strike, swipe right = air-dash in (20 breath), swipe left = evade, tap = parry, hold = grab; chips swap stance, BURST spends 50 breath.
Keys: arrows = strike/dash/evade, J parry, K grab, Space burst, 1-3 stance, R restart, L ladder, Enter confirm.
Loop: read the master's tell — parry strikes, evade grabs and burst arts, then punish the recovery; clean hits knock you apart so dash back in.
Stances beat each other crane > tiger > serpent > crane (1.5x / 0.65x damage); duels are best-of-3, eight masters, rank persists to localStorage.
===== lantern-bingo/NOTES.md =====
Controls: tap the glowing called number on any card; keys 1-4 daub cards; tap chips; V opens bot cards.
Loop: clear the room goal before 75 calls; daub streaks charge Auto, Double, and Peek chips.
Rooms: four rooms add cards and speed; wins unlock the next room; blackout wins earn crowns.
Free by design: infinite sparks, no gates, no purchases, no network.
===== carnival-reels/NOTES.md =====
# Carnival Reels
Controls: tap SPIN (or space) to play; tap a machine tab (or 1-4) to switch; -/+ (or arrow left/right) sets bet; RST resets the bank free at any time (or R); the speaker button mutes (M); drag the lower panel or use arrow up/down to scroll it.
Loop: pick one of four original machines, set a bet, spin. Every spin updates the live math panel underneath - exact or simulated RTP, house edge, volatility, the full outcome table with real frequencies, and your own observed return - plus a session bank curve, a goal ladder to beat your session high, and oddity badges for rare lines with their true odds shown.
No fail state, no real money, no currencies for sale: the bank is play money and resets free, forever. Best peak, lifetime per-machine results and badges persist locally.
===== pennant-nine/NOTES.md =====
Controls: landscape; drag during the pre-pitch window to guess the zone, then tap SWING. Pitch with a type button and tap STOP in the zone; tap DIVE when prompted.
Keyboard: Space swings/stops/dives; arrows pick pitch type or move the batting guess.
Loop: play 3 innings against four original AI clubs across a 9-game pennant; top the standings to win.
Free: no currencies, gates, ads, accounts, cookies, or network calls; record is local only.
===== driftwood-cove/NOTES.md =====
Drag two matching tiles together to merge; tap a tide pool or wreck crate to add pieces.
Match chains clear mist: driftwood > planks > furniture, shells > tools, herbs > remedies.
Tap the gold note pins to read 12 notes; three restored landmarks move the story through chapters.
Generators rest after five taps and visibly recover after four merges made elsewhere on the board.
Arrows move the keyboard cursor; Space selects/merges. The cove saves automatically; New Cove restarts.
===== meadow-solitaire/NOTES.md =====
# Meadow Solitaire
Controls: tap a peak card one rank above/below the big waste card; tap DRAW for a new waste card; tap WILD then any uncovered card. Keyboard: left/right select, space play, down draw, up wild, R restart, Esc menu.
Loop: 40 authored tri-peaks deals, each solver-checked and labelled FAIR (a full clear provably exists) or GAMBLE (none does - wilds are the only shot), with real clear odds shown up front.
Chains of matches build a score multiplier; clearing a peak top pays +100 and banks a WILD (max 3, persists across deals).
Winning a deal pays coins (gamble deals pay triple); coins grow 12 plantings through 3 visible stages until the meadow blooms. Failing costs nothing - retry is always free, no energy, no purchases.
===== willowmere/NOTES.md =====
# Willowmere
Controls: tap to walk, tap anything to use it, drag furniture in Decorate mode; WASD/arrows to move, E/space to use, I bag, C bench, Esc back.
Loop: fish off the dock (tap on the bite, then tap when the marker is in the green), forage 21 nodes across summer/autumn and day/night, craft 12 recipes at the cottage bench, decorate with 16 furniture pieces.
Friends: 6 townsfolk keep daily routines and have gift tastes; 2 hearts opens story scene 1, 4 hearts opens scene 2, whose reward is furniture or a wall/floor style.
Win: all 6 stories seen lights the Lantern Festival ending, then play continues. No fail state, no currency, no timers; world auto-saves to localStorage.

  function edgeKey(a, b) { return a < b ? `${a}~${b}` : `${b}~${a}`; }

  function isBlocked(a, b) {
    for (const splitId of Object.keys(SPLITS)) {
      const split = SPLITS[splitId];
      if (state.barriers[splitId] && edgeKey(a, b) === edgeKey(splitId, split.branches[0])) return true;
    }
    return false;
  }

  function findRoute(start) {
    if (start === CORE_ID) return [CORE_ID];
    const queue = [start];
    const previous = Object.create(null);
    previous[start] = null;
    while (queue.length) {
      const current = queue.shift();
      if (current === CORE_ID) break;
      for (const next of neighbors[current]) {
        if (isBlocked(current, next) || Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(previous, next)) continue;
        previous[next] = current;
        queue.push(next);
      }
    }
    if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(previous, CORE_ID)) return [start, CORE_ID];
    const path = [];
    let node = CORE_ID;
    while (node !== null) { path.unshift(node); node = previous[node]; }
    return path;
  }

  function createWavePlan(wave) {
    const counts = {
      shambler: Math.min(7 + Math.floor(wave * .76), 26),
      runner: wave >= 2 ? Math.min(1 + Math.floor(wave / 3), 9) : 0,
      brute: wave >= 4 ? Math.min(1 + Math.floor((wave - 4) / 5), 5) : 0,
      splitter: wave >= 8 ? Math.min(1 + Math.floor((wave - 8) / 5), 4) : 0,
      carrier: wave >= 14 ? Math.min(1 + Math.floor((wave - 14) / 5), 3) : 0
    };
    const labels = [];
    for (const type of Object.keys(counts)) if (counts[type]) labels.push({ type, count: counts[type] });
    return { wave, counts, labels, total: Object.values(counts).reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0) };
  }

  function seededShuffle(items, seed) {
    let value = (seed * 1103515245 + 12345) >>> 0;
    for (let i = items.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
      value = (value * 1664525 + 1013904223) >>> 0;
      const j = value % (i + 1);
      [items[i], items[j]] = [items[j], items[i]];
    }
    return items;
  }

  function startWave(wave) {
    state.wave = wave;
    state.wavePlan = createWavePlan(wave);

    for (const entry of state.wavePlan.labels) {
      for (let i = 0; i < entry.count; i++) types.push(entry.type);
    }
    seededShuffle(types, wave * 47 + 9);
    state.spawnQueue = types.map((type, index) => ({ type, lane: ['left', 'center', 'right'][index % 3], delay: index === 0 ? .65 : .42 + (type === 'brute' ? .12 : 0) }));

    state.waveStartedAt = state.elapsed;

    notify(`WAVE ${String(wave).padStart(2, '0')} INBOUND`);

  }

  function beginGame() {

  function finishWave() {
    if (state.waveCleared) return;
    state.waveCleared = true;
    state.scrap = Math.min(99, state.scrap + 3 + Math.floor(state.wave / 5));
    state.score += state.wave * 40;
    if (state.score > state.best) { state.best = state.score; safeSaveBest(state.best); }
    if (state.wave >= 25) {
      state.phase = 'win';

      tone(660, .14, 'sine');
      schedule(() => tone(880, .16, 'sine'), 120);

      return;

    state.techChoices = pickTechChoices(state.wave);
    state.phase = 'between';
    tone(440, .1, 'triangle');
    announce(`Wave ${state.wave} clear. Choose one upgrade.`, false);
  }

  function finishLoss() {
    if (state.phase === 'over' || state.phase === 'win') return;
    state.phase = 'over';
    if (state.score > state.best) { state.best = state.score; safeSaveBest(state.best); }
    state.flash = .9;
    addBurst(NODE_DATA.core.x, NODE_DATA.core.y, '#ff766a', 40);
    tone(110, .22, 'sawtooth');
    announce(`Core breached on wave ${state.wave}. Score ${state.score}.`, true);
  }

  function pickTechChoices(wave) {
    const first = TECHS[(wave * 2 + state.kills) % TECHS.length];
    let second = TECHS[(wave * 3 + state.scrap + 1) % TECHS.length];
    if (second.id === first.id) second = TECHS[(TECHS.indexOf(second) + 1) % TECHS.length];
    return [first, second];
  }

  function applyTech(tech) {
    switch (tech.id) {
      case 'overclock': state.tech.fireMult *= 1.14; break;
      case 'reinforced': state.tech.coreBonus += 35; state.coreMax += 35; state.coreHp = Math.min(state.coreMax, state.coreHp + 20); break;
      case 'salvage': state.tech.rewardBonus += 1; break;
      case 'kinetic': state.tech.heroDamage *= 1.28; break;
      case 'relay': state.tech.heroRate *= 1.22; break;
      case 'wideband': state.tech.field *= 1.18; break;
    }
    state.score += state.wave * 12;
    notify(`${tech.name} ONLINE`);
    tone(520, .08, 'triangle');
    startWave(state.wave + 1);
  }

  function notify(message) {

  function announce(message, important) {

    if (important) srStatus.dataset.important = 'true';

  function unlockAudio() {
    if (audioReady) {
      if (audioContext && audioContext.state === 'suspended') audioContext.resume().catch(() => {});
      return;
    }
    try {
      const AudioCtor = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
      if (!AudioCtor) return;
      audioContext = new AudioCtor();
      audioReady = true;
      if (audioContext.state === 'suspended') audioContext.resume().catch(() => {});
    } catch (_) {
      audioContext = null;
    }
  }

  function tone(frequency, duration, wave) {
    if (!audioReady || !audioContext) return;
    try {
      const now = audioContext.currentTime;
      const oscillator = audioContext.createOscillator();
      const gain = audioContext.createGain();
      oscillator.type = wave || 'sine';
      oscillator.frequency.setValueAtTime(frequency, now);
      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(.0001, now);
      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.045, now + .008);
      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.0001, now + duration);
      oscillator.connect(gain).connect(audioContext.destination);
      oscillator.start(now);
      oscillator.stop(now + duration + .02);
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  function addParticle(x, y, color, count) {
    if (state.particles.length >= MAX_PARTICLES) return;
    const amount = Math.min(count || 1, MAX_PARTICLES - state.particles.length);
    for (let i = 0; i < amount; i++) {
      const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
      const speed = 18 + Math.random() * 86;
      state.particles.push({ x, y, vx: Math.cos(angle) * speed, vy: Math.sin(angle) * speed - 22, life: .35 + Math.random() * .45, max: .8, size: 1.5 + Math.random() * 2.5, color });
    }
  }

  function addBurst(x, y, color, count) {
    addParticle(x, y, color, count);
    if (state.fx.length < MAX_FX) state.fx.push({ type: 'ring', x, y, radius: 4, life: .46, color });
  }

  function addZap(a, b, color) {
    if (state.fx.length < MAX_FX) state.fx.push({ type: 'zap', a: { x: a.x, y: a.y }, b: { x: b.x, y: b.y }, life: .16, color });
  }

  function spawnEnemy(type, lane, startNode) {
    if (state.enemies.length >= MAX_ENEMIES) return;
    const data = ENEMY_TYPES[type];
    const currentNode = startNode || LANE_SPAWNS[lane];
    const path = findRoute(currentNode);
    if (!data || path.length < 2) return;
    const point = NODE_DATA[currentNode];
    state.enemies.push({
      id: state.nextId++, type, lane, x: point.x, y: point.y, currentNode, path, pathIndex: 1,
      toNode: path[1], hp: data.hp * (1 + Math.max(0, state.wave - 1) * .018), maxHp: data.hp * (1 + Math.max(0, state.wave - 1) * .018),
      speed: data.speed, radius: data.radius, slow: 1, hit: 0, dead: false
    });
  }

  function repath(enemy) {
    const path = findRoute(enemy.currentNode);
    if (path.length < 2) return false;
    enemy.path = path;
    enemy.pathIndex = 1;
    enemy.toNode = path[1];
    return true;
  }

  function enemyDistanceToCore(enemy) {
    const target = NODE_DATA[enemy.toNode];
    if (!target) return 0;
    let total = Math.hypot(target.x - enemy.x, target.y - enemy.y);
    for (let i = enemy.pathIndex; i < enemy.path.length - 1; i++) {
      const a = NODE_DATA[enemy.path[i]];
      const b = NODE_DATA[enemy.path[i + 1]];
      total += Math.hypot(b.x - a.x, b.y - a.y);
    }
    return total;
  }

  function updateEnemy(enemy, dt) {
    enemy.hit = Math.max(0, enemy.hit - dt);
    enemy.slow = 1;
    for (const nodeId of BUILD_NODES) {
      const turret = state.nodes[nodeId].turret;
      if (!turret || turret.type !== 'slow') continue;
      const node = NODE_DATA[nodeId];
      const range = TURRETS.slow.range * state.tech.field + turret.level * 5;
      if (Math.hypot(enemy.x - node.x, enemy.y - node.y) <= range) enemy.slow = Math.min(enemy.slow, Math.max(.42, 1 - .22 * Math.min(3, 1 + turret.level * .12)));
    }
    let remaining = enemy.speed * enemy.slow * dt;
    let hops = 0;
    while (remaining > 0 && hops < 4) {
      const target = NODE_DATA[enemy.toNode];
      if (!target) return false;
      const dx = target.x - enemy.x;
      const dy = target.y - enemy.y;
      const distance = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
      if (distance <= remaining) {
        enemy.x = target.x;
        enemy.y = target.y;
        remaining -= distance;
        enemy.currentNode = enemy.toNode;
        if (enemy.currentNode === CORE_ID) return damageCore(enemy);
        if (!repath(enemy)) return false;
        hops++;
      } else {
        enemy.x += dx / distance * remaining;
        enemy.y += dy / distance * remaining;
        remaining = 0;
      }
    }
    return true;
  }

  function damageCore(enemy) {
    state.coreHp = Math.max(0, state.coreHp - ENEMY_TYPES[enemy.type].damage);
    state.shake = Math.max(state.shake, 8);
    state.flash = .24;
    addBurst(NODE_DATA.core.x, NODE_DATA.core.y, '#ff766a', 9);
    tone(86, .04, 'sawtooth');
    if (state.coreHp <= 0) finishLoss();
    return false;
  }

  function killEnemy(enemy, source) {
    if (!enemy || enemy.dead) return;
    enemy.dead = true;
    const data = ENEMY_TYPES[enemy.type];
    state.kills++;
    state.score += 8 + (source === 'hero' ? 2 : 0);
    const drops = Math.min(3, data.reward + state.tech.rewardBonus);
    for (let i = 0; i < drops; i++) {
      if (state.scraps.length >= MAX_SCRAP) break;
      state.scraps.push({ x: enemy.x + (Math.random() - .5) * 12, y: enemy.y + (Math.random() - .5) * 12, value: 1, spin: Math.random() * 6.28, life: 18 });
    }
    addBurst(enemy.x, enemy.y, data.color, enemy.type === 'brute' ? 16 : 8);
    if (enemy.type === 'splitter' && state.enemies.length < MAX_ENEMIES - 2 && enemy.currentNode !== CORE_ID) {
      spawnEnemy('runner', enemy.lane, enemy.currentNode);
      spawnEnemy('runner', enemy.lane, enemy.currentNode);
    }
    tone(source === 'hero' ? 520 : 310, .025, 'square');
  }

  function damageEnemy(enemy, amount, source) {
    if (!enemy || enemy.dead) return;
    enemy.hp -= amount;
    enemy.hit = .11;
    if (enemy.hp <= 0) killEnemy(enemy, source);
  }

  function nearestEnemy(x, y, range) {
    let found = null;
    let best = Infinity;
    for (const enemy of state.enemies) {
      if (enemy.dead) continue;
      const distance = Math.hypot(enemy.x - x, enemy.y - y);
      if (distance <= range && distance < best) { best = distance; found = enemy; }
    }
    return found;
  }

  function fireProjectile(x, y, target, damage, speed, color, aoe, radius, source) {
    if (!target || state.projectiles.length >= MAX_PROJECTILES) return;
    state.projectiles.push({ x, y, target, damage, speed, color, aoe: aoe || 0, radius: radius || 0, source: source || 'turret', life: 4 });
  }

  function updateTurrets(dt) {
    for (const nodeId of BUILD_NODES) {
      const mounted = state.nodes[nodeId].turret;
      if (!mounted) continue;
      mounted.cooldown -= dt;
      const node = NODE_DATA[nodeId];
      const spec = TURRETS[mounted.type];
      const range = spec.range * (mounted.type === 'slow' || mounted.type === 'mortar' ? state.tech.field : 1) + mounted.level * 5;
      if (mounted.type === 'slow') continue;
      if (mounted.cooldown > 0) continue;
      const target = nearestEnemy(node.x, node.y, range);
      if (!target) continue;
      if (mounted.type === 'gun') {
        fireProjectile(node.x, node.y, target, 12 + mounted.level * 7, 310, spec.color, 0, 0, 'turret');
        mounted.cooldown = .48 / state.tech.fireMult;
      } else if (mounted.type === 'mortar') {
        fireProjectile(node.x, node.y, target, 26 + mounted.level * 10, 172, spec.color, 1, 30 + mounted.level * 6, 'turret');
        mounted.cooldown = 1.48 / state.tech.fireMult;
      } else if (mounted.type === 'tesla') {
        const chain = [target];
        for (const other of state.enemies) {
          if (other.dead || other === target || chain.length >= 3) continue;
          if (Math.hypot(other.x - target.x, other.y - target.y) < 53 + mounted.level * 4) chain.push(other);
        }
        let previous = { x: node.x, y: node.y };
        for (const victim of chain) {
          damageEnemy(victim, 10 + mounted.level * 5, 'turret');
          addZap(previous, victim, spec.color);
          previous = victim;
        }
        mounted.cooldown = .86 / state.tech.fireMult;
        state.flash = Math.max(state.flash, .04);
      }
    }
  }

  function updateProjectiles(dt) {
    for (let i = state.projectiles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const shot = state.projectiles[i];
      shot.life -= dt;
      if (shot.life <= 0 || !shot.target || shot.target.dead) { state.projectiles.splice(i, 1); continue; }
      const dx = shot.target.x - shot.x;
      const dy = shot.target.y - shot.y;
      const distance = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
      const step = shot.speed * dt;
      if (distance <= step + 2) {
        shot.x = shot.target.x;
        shot.y = shot.target.y;
        if (shot.aoe) {
          addBurst(shot.x, shot.y, shot.color, 7);
          for (const enemy of state.enemies) {
            if (!enemy.dead && Math.hypot(enemy.x - shot.x, enemy.y - shot.y) <= shot.radius) damageEnemy(enemy, shot.damage, shot.source);
          }
        } else {
          damageEnemy(shot.target, shot.damage, shot.source);
          addParticle(shot.x, shot.y, shot.color, 3);
        }
        state.projectiles.splice(i, 1);
      } else {
        shot.x += dx / distance * step;
        shot.y += dy / distance * step;
      }
    }
  }

  function updateHero(dt) {
    const hero = state.hero;
    let x = (input.keys.has('d') || input.keys.has('arrowright') ? 1 : 0) - (input.keys.has('a') || input.keys.has('arrowleft') ? 1 : 0) + input.stick.x;
    let y = (input.keys.has('s') || input.keys.has('arrowdown') ? 1 : 0) - (input.keys.has('w') || input.keys.has('arrowup') ? 1 : 0) + input.stick.y;
    const magnitude = Math.hypot(x, y);
    if (magnitude > 1) { x /= magnitude; y /= magnitude; }
    const speed = 148;
    hero.x = Math.max(22, Math.min(368, hero.x + x * speed * dt));
    hero.y = Math.max(MAP_TOP + 20, Math.min(535, hero.y + y * speed * dt));
    if (magnitude > .08) hero.facing = Math.atan2(y, x);
    hero.fire -= dt;
    if (hero.fire <= 0) {
      const target = nearestEnemy(hero.x, hero.y, 158);
      if (target) {
        fireProjectile(hero.x, hero.y, target, 15 * state.tech.heroDamage, 350, '#8ce3c4', 0, 0, 'hero');
        hero.facing = Math.atan2(target.y - hero.y, target.x - hero.x);
        hero.fire = .3 / state.tech.heroRate;
      } else hero.fire = .08;
    }
    for (let i = state.scraps.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const scrap = state.scraps[i];
      scrap.life -= dt;
      scrap.spin += dt * 4;
      const distance = Math.hypot(scrap.x - hero.x, scrap.y - hero.y);
      if (distance < 28) {
        state.scrap = Math.min(99, state.scrap + scrap.value);
        state.score += 2;
        addParticle(scrap.x, scrap.y, '#f4c86b', 4);
        state.scraps.splice(i, 1);
      } else if (scrap.life <= 0) state.scraps.splice(i, 1);
    }
  }

  function updateParticles(dt) {
    for (let i = state.particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const particle = state.particles[i];
      particle.life -= dt;
      particle.x += particle.vx * dt;
      particle.y += particle.vy * dt;
      particle.vy += 72 * dt;
      if (particle.life <= 0) state.particles.splice(i, 1);
    }
    for (let i = state.fx.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const effect = state.fx[i];
      effect.life -= dt;
      if (effect.type === 'ring') effect.radius += 110 * dt;
      if (effect.life <= 0) state.fx.splice(i, 1);
    }
  }

  function update(dt) {
    state.elapsed += dt;
    state.noticeTime = Math.max(0, state.noticeTime - dt);
    state.shake = Math.max(0, state.shake - dt * 18);
    state.flash = Math.max(0, state.flash - dt * 1.8);
    if (state.phase === 'playing') {
      state.spawnTimer -= dt;
      while (state.spawnQueue.length && state.spawnTimer <= 0) {
        const next = state.spawnQueue.shift();
        spawnEnemy(next.type, next.lane);
        state.spawnTimer += next.delay;
        if (state.spawnQueue.length > MAX_ENEMIES) state.spawnQueue.length = MAX_ENEMIES;
      }
      updateHero(dt);
      updateTurrets(dt);
      updateProjectiles(dt);
      for (let i = state.enemies.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        const enemy = state.enemies[i];
        if (enemy.dead || !updateEnemy(enemy, dt)) state.enemies.splice(i, 1);
      }
      if (!state.spawnQueue.length && !state.enemies.length) finishWave();
    }
    updateParticles(dt);
  }

  function processQueue() {
    if (orientationPaused || !input.queue.length) return;
    while (input.queue.length) {
      const action = input.queue.shift();
      if (action.kind === 'start' && state.phase === 'start') beginGame();
      else if (action.kind === 'restart' && (state.phase === 'over' || state.phase === 'win')) restartGame();
      else if (action.kind === 'select' && state.phase === 'playing') { input.selectedType = action.type; input.mode = 'turret'; notify(`${TURRETS[action.type].name} SELECTED`); }
      else if (action.kind === 'barrier' && state.phase === 'playing') { input.mode = 'barrier'; notify('BARRIER MODE: tap a split node'); }
      else if (action.kind === 'node' && state.phase === 'playing') handleNodeAction(action.id);
      else if (action.kind === 'tech' && state.phase === 'between') chooseTech(action.index);
      else if (action.kind === 'button' && state.phase === 'playing') handleButtonAction(action.id);
    }
  }

  function handleButtonAction(id) {
    if (id === 'barrier') { input.mode = 'barrier'; notify('BARRIER MODE: tap a split node'); return; }
    if (TURRETS[id]) { input.selectedType = id; input.mode = 'turret'; notify(`${TURRETS[id].name} SELECTED`); }
  }

  function chooseTech(index) {
    const tech = state.techChoices[index];
    if (!tech) return;
    applyTech(tech);
  }

  function handleNodeAction(nodeId) {
    const node = state.nodes[nodeId];
    if (!node) return;
    if (input.mode === 'barrier') {
      if (!SPLITS[nodeId]) { notify('BARRIERS ONLY FIT SPLIT NODES'); return; }
      if (!state.barriers[nodeId]) {
        if (state.scrap < 3) { notify('NEED 3 SCRAP FOR A BARRIER'); return; }
        state.scrap -= 3;
        state.barriers[nodeId] = true;
        for (const enemy of state.enemies) if (enemy.currentNode === nodeId) repath(enemy);
        addBurst(NODE_DATA[nodeId].x, NODE_DATA[nodeId].y, '#ffad72', 12);
        notify(`${SPLITS[nodeId].label}-SPLIT REDIRECTED`);
        tone(180, .06, 'square');
      } else {
        state.barriers[nodeId] = false;
        for (const enemy of state.enemies) if (enemy.currentNode === nodeId) repath(enemy);
        notify(`${SPLITS[nodeId].label}-SPLIT OPEN`);
        tone(260, .05, 'triangle');
      }
      return;
    }
    const existing = node.turret;
    const type = existing ? existing.type : input.selectedType;
    const cost = existing ? 4 + existing.level * 3 : TURRETS[type].cost;
    if (state.scrap < cost) { notify(`NEED ${cost} SCRAP`); return; }
    state.scrap -= cost;
    if (existing) existing.level = Math.min(4, existing.level + 1);
    else node.turret = { type, level: 1, cooldown: .12 };
    addBurst(NODE_DATA[nodeId].x, NODE_DATA[nodeId].y, TURRETS[type].color, 10);
    notify(existing ? `${TURRETS[type].name} UPGRADED` : `${TURRETS[type].name} DEPLOYED`);
    tone(existing ? 460 : 380, .05, 'triangle');
  }

  function controlButtons() {
    return [
      { id: 'gun', x: 126, y: 605, w: 48, h: 48 }, { id: 'slow', x: 180, y: 605, w: 48, h: 48 },
      { id: 'mortar', x: 234, y: 605, w: 48, h: 48 }, { id: 'tesla', x: 288, y: 605, w: 48, h: 48 },
      { id: 'barrier', x: 342, y: 605, w: 48, h: 48 }
    ];
  }

  function hitRect(point, rect, pad) {
    const extra = pad || 0;
    return point.x >= rect.x - extra && point.x <= rect.x + rect.w + extra && point.y >= rect.y - extra && point.y <= rect.y + rect.h + extra;
  }

  function pointerPoint(event) {
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    return { x: (event.clientX - rect.left - viewport.ox) / viewport.scale, y: (event.clientY - rect.top - viewport.oy) / viewport.scale };
  }

  function inStick(point) { return Math.hypot(point.x - 62, point.y - 644) <= 72; }

  function updateStick(point) {
    const dx = point.x - 62;
    const dy = point.y - 644;
    const distance = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
    const radius = 48;
    const amount = Math.min(1, distance / radius);
    input.stick.x = distance ? dx / distance * amount : 0;
    input.stick.y = distance ? dy / distance * amount : 0;
  }

  function queueAction(action) {
    if (input.queue.length < 32) input.queue.push(action);
  }

  function onPointerDown(event) {
    event.preventDefault();
    unlockAudio();
    if (orientationPaused) return;
    if (input.pointers.size >= MAX_POINTERS) return;
    const point = pointerPoint(event);
    const record = { x: point.x, y: point.y, originX: point.x, originY: point.y, control: 'none', id: null };
    if (state.phase === 'playing' && input.stickPointerId === null && inStick(point)) {
      record.control = 'stick';
      input.stickPointerId = event.pointerId;
      updateStick(point);
    } else if (state.phase === 'playing') {
      const button = controlButtons().find(item => hitRect(point, item, 4));
      if (button) { record.control = 'button'; record.id = button.id; }
      else {
        const nodeId = BUILD_NODES.find(id => Math.hypot(point.x - NODE_DATA[id].x, point.y - NODE_DATA[id].y) <= 29);
        if (nodeId) { record.control = 'node'; record.id = nodeId; }
      }
    } else if (state.phase === 'start') record.control = 'start';
    else if (state.phase === 'over' || state.phase === 'win') record.control = 'restart';
    else if (state.phase === 'between') {
      const index = techCardAt(point);
      if (index >= 0) { record.control = 'tech'; record.id = index; }
    }
    input.pointers.set(event.pointerId, record);
    try { canvas.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId); } catch (_) {}
  }

  function onPointerMove(event) {
    event.preventDefault();
    const record = input.pointers.get(event.pointerId);
    if (!record) return;
    const point = pointerPoint(event);
    record.x = point.x;
    record.y = point.y;
    if (record.control === 'stick' && input.stickPointerId === event.pointerId) updateStick(point);
  }

  function onPointerUp(event) {
    event.preventDefault();
    const record = input.pointers.get(event.pointerId);
    if (!record) return;
    const point = pointerPoint(event);
    if (record.control === 'stick' && input.stickPointerId === event.pointerId) {
      input.stickPointerId = null;
      input.stick.x = 0;
      input.stick.y = 0;
    } else if (record.control === 'button' && Math.hypot(point.x - record.originX, point.y - record.originY) < 30) queueAction({ kind: 'button', id: record.id });
    else if (record.control === 'node' && Math.hypot(point.x - record.originX, point.y - record.originY) < 30) queueAction({ kind: 'node', id: record.id });
    else if (record.control === 'start') queueAction({ kind: 'start' });
    else if (record.control === 'restart') queueAction({ kind: 'restart' });
    else if (record.control === 'tech' && techCardAt(point) === record.id) queueAction({ kind: 'tech', index: record.id });
    input.pointers.delete(event.pointerId);
    try { canvas.releasePointerCapture(event.pointerId); } catch (_) {}
  }

  function onPointerCancel(event) {
    event.preventDefault();
    const record = input.pointers.get(event.pointerId);
    if (record && record.control === 'stick' && input.stickPointerId === event.pointerId) {
      input.stickPointerId = null;
      input.stick.x = 0;
      input.stick.y = 0;
    }
    input.pointers.delete(event.pointerId);
  }

  function onKeyDown(event) {
    unlockAudio();
    const key = event.key.toLowerCase();
    if (['w', 'a', 's', 'd', 'arrowup', 'arrowdown', 'arrowleft', 'arrowright', '1', '2', '3', '4', 'b', 'r', 'enter', ' '].includes(key)) event.preventDefault();
    if (TRACKED_KEYS.has(key)) input.keys.add(key);
    if (event.repeat) return;
    if (state.phase === 'start' && (key === 'enter' || key === ' ')) queueAction({ kind: 'start' });
    else if ((state.phase === 'over' || state.phase === 'win') && (key === 'r' || key === 'enter' || key === ' ')) queueAction({ kind: 'restart' });
    else if (state.phase === 'between' && (key === '1' || key === '2')) queueAction({ kind: 'tech', index: Number(key) - 1 });
    else if (state.phase === 'playing' && key >= '1' && key <= '4') queueAction({ kind: 'select', type: TURRET_KEYS[Number(key) - 1] });
    else if (state.phase === 'playing' && key === 'b') queueAction({ kind: 'barrier' });
  }

  function onKeyUp(event) { input.keys.delete(event.key.toLowerCase()); }

  function techCardAt(point) {
    if (point.y < 270 || point.y > 540) return -1;
    if (point.x >= 20 && point.x <= 185) return 0;
    if (point.x >= 205 && point.x <= 370) return 1;
    return -1;
  }

  function handleOrientation() {
    const wasPaused = orientationPaused;
    orientationPaused = window.innerWidth > window.innerHeight;
    rotateOverlay.classList.toggle('show', orientationPaused);
    if (!wasPaused && orientationPaused) clearInput();
    lastFrame = performance.now();
    resizeCanvas();
  }

  function resizeCanvas() {
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    viewport.cssW = rect.width;
    viewport.cssH = rect.height;
    viewport.scale = Math.min(rect.width / DESIGN_W, rect.height / DESIGN_H);
    viewport.ox = (rect.width - DESIGN_W * viewport.scale) / 2;
    viewport.oy = (rect.height - DESIGN_H * viewport.scale) / 2;
    viewport.pixelScale = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2, 960 / Math.max(1, rect.width), 960 / Math.max(1, rect.height));
    canvas.width = Math.max(1, Math.round(rect.width * viewport.pixelScale));
    canvas.height = Math.max(1, Math.round(rect.height * viewport.pixelScale));
  }

  function withWorldTransform() {
    ctx.setTransform(viewport.scale * viewport.pixelScale, 0, 0, viewport.scale * viewport.pixelScale, viewport.ox * viewport.pixelScale, viewport.oy * viewport.pixelScale);
  }

  function roundedRect(x, y, w, h, r) {
    const radius = Math.min(r, w / 2, h / 2);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x + radius, y);
    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, radius);
    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, radius);
    ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, radius);
    ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, radius);
    ctx.closePath();
  }

  function drawBackground() {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#08111d';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, DESIGN_W, DESIGN_H);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#0b1927';
    ctx.fillRect(0, MAP_TOP, DESIGN_W, MAP_BOTTOM - MAP_TOP);
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(104, 153, 171, .065)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    for (let x = 8; x < DESIGN_W; x += 24) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x, MAP_TOP); ctx.lineTo(x, MAP_BOTTOM); ctx.stroke(); }
    for (let y = MAP_TOP; y < MAP_BOTTOM; y += 24) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0, y); ctx.lineTo(DESIGN_W, y); ctx.stroke(); }
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(20, 52, 62, .18)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, MAP_BOTTOM - 42, DESIGN_W, 42);
  }

  function drawRoads() {
    for (const [aId, bId] of EDGES) {
      const a = NODE_DATA[aId];
      const b = NODE_DATA[bId];
      const blocked = isBlocked(aId, bId);
      ctx.lineCap = 'round';
      ctx.strokeStyle = blocked ? '#4a2930' : '#223949';
      ctx.lineWidth = 18;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(a.x, a.y); ctx.lineTo(b.x, b.y); ctx.stroke();
      ctx.strokeStyle = blocked ? '#9b5554' : '#45687a';
      ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      ctx.setLineDash(blocked ? [5, 5] : []);
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(a.x, a.y); ctx.lineTo(b.x, b.y); ctx.stroke();
      ctx.setLineDash([]);
    }
    for (const splitId of Object.keys(SPLITS)) {
      const split = NODE_DATA[splitId];
      const branch = NODE_DATA[SPLITS[splitId].branches[0]];
      if (state.barriers[splitId]) {
        const angle = Math.atan2(branch.y - split.y, branch.x - split.x);
        ctx.save();
        ctx.translate(split.x + (branch.x - split.x) * .34, split.y + (branch.y - split.y) * .34);
        ctx.rotate(angle);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#ffad72';
        ctx.fillRect(-11, -3, 22, 6);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#ffdc9b';
        ctx.fillRect(-8, -3, 4, 6); ctx.fillRect(2, -3, 4, 6);
        ctx.restore();
      }
    }
  }

  function drawCore() {
    const core = NODE_DATA.core;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(core.x, core.y);
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(140, 227, 196, .18)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, 0, 34 + Math.sin(state.elapsed * 2) * 2, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#102b35';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, 0, 25, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#8ce3c4'; ctx.lineWidth = 3; ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#8ce3c4';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-9, -13); ctx.lineTo(12, 0); ctx.lineTo(-9, 13); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#d9f5ec'; ctx.font = '800 8px Arial'; ctx.textAlign = 'center'; ctx.fillText('CORE', 0, 43);
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawBuildNodes() {
    for (const id of BUILD_NODES) {
      const data = NODE_DATA[id];
      const mounted = state.nodes[id].turret;
      const isSplit = Boolean(SPLITS[id]);
      const selected = input.mode === 'barrier' ? isSplit : Boolean(mounted && mounted.type === input.selectedType);
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(data.x, data.y);
      ctx.fillStyle = selected ? 'rgba(244, 200, 107, .16)' : 'rgba(7, 17, 27, .76)';
      ctx.strokeStyle = mounted ? TURRETS[mounted.type].color : (isSplit ? '#ffad72' : '#7da7b7');
      ctx.lineWidth = selected ? 3 : 2;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, 0, mounted ? 16 : 13, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill(); ctx.stroke();
      if (mounted) {
        ctx.fillStyle = TURRETS[mounted.type].color;
        ctx.font = '800 12px Arial'; ctx.textAlign = 'center'; ctx.textBaseline = 'middle'; ctx.fillText(TURRETS[mounted.type].short, 0, 0);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#07111b'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(11, -11, 7, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = '#f4f7f5'; ctx.font = '800 8px Arial'; ctx.fillText(mounted.level, 11, -11.5);
        if (mounted.type === 'slow') {
          ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(114, 214, 255, .13)'; ctx.lineWidth = 1; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, 0, TURRETS.slow.range * state.tech.field + mounted.level * 5, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
        }
      } else if (isSplit && state.barriers[id]) {
        ctx.fillStyle = '#ffad72'; ctx.font = '800 11px Arial'; ctx.textAlign = 'center'; ctx.textBaseline = 'middle'; ctx.fillText('↗', 0, 0);
      } else {
        ctx.fillStyle = '#8daab6'; ctx.font = '800 13px Arial'; ctx.textAlign = 'center'; ctx.textBaseline = 'middle'; ctx.fillText(isSplit ? '◆' : '+', 0, 0);
      }
      ctx.restore();
    }
  }

  function drawEnemies() {
    for (const enemy of state.enemies) {
      if (enemy.dead) continue;
      const data = ENEMY_TYPES[enemy.type];
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(enemy.x, enemy.y);

  function render() {
    resizeCanvasIfNeeded();
    ctx.setTransform(viewport.pixelScale, 0, 0, viewport.pixelScale, 0, 0);
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width / viewport.pixelScale, canvas.height / viewport.pixelScale);
    withWorldTransform();
    ctx.save();
    if (state.shake > 0) ctx.translate((Math.random() - .5) * state.shake, (Math.random() - .5) * state.shake);
    drawBackground();
    drawRoads();
    drawCore();
    drawScraps();
    drawBuildNodes();
    drawEnemies();
    drawProjectiles();
    drawHero();
    drawEffects();
    ctx.restore();
    withWorldTransform();
    drawHud();
    drawControls();
    if (state.phase === 'start') drawStartPanel();
    else if (state.phase === 'between') drawTechPanel();
    else if (state.phase === 'over' || state.phase === 'win') drawEndPanel();
    if (state.flash > 0) { ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 240, 210, ${Math.min(.22, state.flash * .22)})`; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, DESIGN_W, DESIGN_H); }
  }

  function resizeCanvasIfNeeded() {
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    if (Math.abs(rect.width - viewport.cssW) > .5 || Math.abs(rect.height - viewport.cssH) > .5) resizeCanvas();
  }

  function frame(now) {
    const dt = Math.min(.05, Math.max(0, (now - lastFrame) / 1000));
    lastFrame = now;
    processQueue();
    if (!orientationPaused) update(dt);
    render();
    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  }

  canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown', onPointerDown, { passive: false });
  canvas.addEventListener('pointermove', onPointerMove, { passive: false });
  canvas.addEventListener('pointerup', onPointerUp, { passive: false });
  canvas.addEventListener('pointercancel', onPointerCancel, { passive: false });
  window.addEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown, { passive: false });
  window.addEventListener('keyup', onKeyUp, { passive: false });
  window.addEventListener('blur', clearInput);
  window.addEventListener('resize', handleOrientation);
  window.addEventListener('orientationchange', handleOrientation);

  resetGame(true);
  handleOrientation();
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
})();

   586	        hero.facing = Math.atan2(target.y - hero.y, target.x - hero.x);
   587	        hero.fire = .3 / state.tech.heroRate;
   588	      } else hero.fire = .08;
   589	    }
   590	    for (let i = state.scraps.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
   591	      const scrap = state.scraps[i];
   592	      scrap.life -= dt;
   593	      scrap.spin += dt * 4;
   594	      const distance = Math.hypot(scrap.x - hero.x, scrap.y - hero.y);
   595	      if (distance < 28) {
   596	        state.scrap = Math.min(99, state.scrap + scrap.value);
   597	        state.score += 2;
   598	        addParticle(scrap.x, scrap.y, '#f4c86b', 4);
   599	        state.scraps.splice(i, 1);
   600	      } else if (scrap.life <= 0) state.scraps.splice(i, 1);
   601	    }
   602	  }
   603	
   604	  function updateParticles(dt) {
   605	    for (let i = state.particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
   606	      const particle = state.particles[i];
   607	      particle.life -= dt;
   608	      particle.x += particle.vx * dt;
   609	      particle.y += particle.vy * dt;
   610	      particle.vy += 72 * dt;
   611	      if (particle.life <= 0) state.particles.splice(i, 1);
   612	    }
   613	    for (let i = state.fx.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
   614	      const effect = state.fx[i];
   615	      effect.life -= dt;
   616	      if (effect.type === 'ring') effect.radius += 110 * dt;
   617	      if (effect.life <= 0) state.fx.splice(i, 1);
   618	    }
   619	  }
   620	
   621	  function update(dt) {
   622	    state.elapsed += dt;
   623	    state.noticeTime = Math.max(0, state.noticeTime - dt);
   624	    state.shake = Math.max(0, state.shake - dt * 18);
   625	    state.flash = Math.max(0, state.flash - dt * 1.8);
   626	    if (state.phase === 'playing') {
   627	      state.spawnTimer -= dt;
   628	      while (state.spawnQueue.length && state.spawnTimer <= 0) {
   629	        const next = state.spawnQueue.shift();
   630	        spawnEnemy(next.type, next.lane);
   631	        state.spawnTimer += next.delay;
   632	        if (state.spawnQueue.length > MAX_ENEMIES) state.spawnQueue.length = MAX_ENEMIES;
   633	      }
   634	      updateHero(dt);
   635	      updateTurrets(dt);
   636	      updateProjectiles(dt);
   637	      for (let i = state.enemies.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
   638	        const enemy = state.enemies[i];
   639	        if (enemy.dead || !updateEnemy(enemy, dt)) state.enemies.splice(i, 1);
   640	      }
   641	      if (!state.spawnQueue.length && !state.enemies.length) finishWave();
   642	    }
   643	    updateParticles(dt);
   644	  }
   645	
   646	  function processQueue() {
   647	    if (orientationPaused || !input.queue.length) return;
   648	    while (input.queue.length) {
   649	      const action = input.queue.shift();
   650	      if (action.kind === 'start' && state.phase === 'start') beginGame();
   651	      else if (action.kind === 'restart' && (state.phase === 'over' || state.phase === 'win')) restartGame();
   652	      else if (action.kind === 'select' && state.phase === 'playing') { input.selectedType = action.type; input.mode = 'turret'; notify(`${TURRETS[action.type].name} SELECTED`); }
   653	      else if (action.kind === 'barrier' && state.phase === 'playing') { input.mode = 'barrier'; notify('BARRIER MODE: tap a split node'); }
   654	      else if (action.kind === 'node' && state.phase === 'playing') handleNodeAction(action.id);
   655	      else if (action.kind === 'tech' && state.phase === 'between') chooseTech(action.index);
   656	      else if (action.kind === 'button' && state.phase === 'playing') handleButtonAction(action.id);
   657	    }
   658	  }
   659	
   660	  function handleButtonAction(id) {
   661	    if (id === 'barrier') { input.mode = 'barrier'; notify('BARRIER MODE: tap a split node'); return; }
   662	    if (TURRETS[id]) { input.selectedType = id; input.mode = 'turret'; notify(`${TURRETS[id].name} SELECTED`); }
   663	  }
   664	
   665	  function chooseTech(index) {
   666	    const tech = state.techChoices[index];
   667	    if (!tech) return;
   668	    applyTech(tech);
   669	  }
   670	
   671	  function handleNodeAction(nodeId) {
   672	    const node = state.nodes[nodeId];
   673	    if (!node) return;
   674	    if (input.mode === 'barrier') {
   675	      if (!SPLITS[nodeId]) { notify('BARRIERS ONLY FIT SPLIT NODES'); return; }
   676	      if (!state.barriers[nodeId]) {
   677	        if (state.scrap < 3) { notify('NEED 3 SCRAP FOR A BARRIER'); return; }
   678	        state.scrap -= 3;
   679	        state.barriers[nodeId] = true;
   680	        for (const enemy of state.enemies) if (enemy.currentNode === nodeId) repath(enemy);
   681	        addBurst(NODE_DATA[nodeId].x, NODE_DATA[nodeId].y, '#ffad72', 12);
   682	        notify(`${SPLITS[nodeId].label}-SPLIT REDIRECTED`);
   683	        tone(180, .06, 'square');
   684	      } else {
   685	        state.barriers[nodeId] = false;
   686	        for (const enemy of state.enemies) if (enemy.currentNode === nodeId) repath(enemy);
   687	        notify(`${SPLITS[nodeId].label}-SPLIT OPEN`);
   688	        tone(260, .05, 'triangle');
   689	      }
   690	      return;
   691	    }
   692	    const existing = node.turret;
   693	    const type = existing ? existing.type : input.selectedType;
   694	    const cost = existing ? 4 + existing.level * 3 : TURRETS[type].cost;
   695	    if (state.scrap < cost) { notify(`NEED ${cost} SCRAP`); return; }
   696	    state.scrap -= cost;
   697	    if (existing) existing.level = Math.min(4, existing.level + 1);
   698	    else node.turret = { type, level: 1, cooldown: .12 };
   699	    addBurst(NODE_DATA[nodeId].x, NODE_DATA[nodeId].y, TURRETS[type].color, 10);
   700	    notify(existing ? `${TURRETS[type].name} UPGRADED` : `${TURRETS[type].name} DEPLOYED`);
   701	    tone(existing ? 460 : 380, .05, 'triangle');
   702	  }

   712	  function hitRect(point, rect, pad) {
   713	    const extra = pad || 0;
   714	    return point.x >= rect.x - extra && point.x <= rect.x + rect.w + extra && point.y >= rect.y - extra && point.y <= rect.y + rect.h + extra;
   715	  }

   717	  function pointerPoint(event) {
   718	    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
   719	    return { x: (event.clientX - rect.left - viewport.ox) / viewport.scale, y: (event.clientY - rect.top - viewport.oy) / viewport.scale };
   720	  }
   721	
   722	  function inStick(point) { return Math.hypot(point.x - 62, point.y - 644) <= 72; }
   723	
   724	  function updateStick(point) {
   725	    const dx = point.x - 62;
   726	    const dy = point.y - 644;
   727	    const distance = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
   728	    const radius = 48;
   729	    const amount = Math.min(1, distance / radius);
   730	    input.stick.x = distance ? dx / distance * amount : 0;
   731	    input.stick.y = distance ? dy / distance * amount : 0;
   732	  }

   734	  function queueAction(action) {
   735	    if (input.queue.length < 32) input.queue.push(action);
   736	  }
   737	
   738	  function onPointerDown(event) {
   739	    event.preventDefault();
   740	    unlockAudio();
   741	    if (orientationPaused) return;
   742	    if (input.pointers.size >= MAX_POINTERS) return;
   743	    const point = pointerPoint(event);
   744	    const record = { x: point.x, y: point.y, originX: point.x, originY: point.y, control: 'none', id: null };
   745	    if (state.phase === 'playing' && input.stickPointerId === null && inStick(point)) {
   746	      record.control = 'stick';
   747	      input.stickPointerId = event.pointerId;
   748	      updateStick(point);
   749	    } else if (state.phase === 'playing') {
   750	      const button = controlButtons().find(item => hitRect(point, item, 4));
   751	      if (button) { record.control = 'button'; record.id = button.id; }
   752	      else {
   753	        const nodeId = BUILD_NODES.find(id => Math.hypot(point.x - NODE_DATA[id].x, point.y - NODE_DATA[id].y) <= 29);
   754	        if (nodeId) { record.control = 'node'; record.id = nodeId; }
   755	      }
   756	    } else if (state.phase === 'start') record.control = 'start';
   757	    else if (state.phase === 'over' || state.phase === 'win') record.control = 'restart';
   758	    else if (state.phase === 'between') {
   759	      const index = techCardAt(point);
   760	      if (index >= 0) { record.control = 'tech'; record.id = index; }
   761	    }
   762	    input.pointers.set(event.pointerId, record);
   763	    try { canvas.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId); } catch (_) {}
   764	  }
   765	
   766	  function onPointerMove(event) {
   767	    event.preventDefault();
   768	    const record = input.pointers.get(event.pointerId);
   769	    if (!record) return;
   770	    const point = pointerPoint(event);
   771	    record.x = point.x;
   772	    record.y = point.y;
   773	    if (record.control === 'stick' && input.stickPointerId === event.pointerId) updateStick(point);
   774	  }
   775	
   776	  function onPointerUp(event) {
   777	    event.preventDefault();
   778	    const record = input.pointers.get(event.pointerId);
   779	    if (!record) return;
   780	    const point = pointerPoint(event);
   781	    if (record.control === 'stick' && input.stickPointerId === event.pointerId) {
   782	      input.stickPointerId = null;
   783	      input.stick.x = 0;
   784	      input.stick.y = 0;
   785	    } else if (record.control === 'button' && Math.hypot(point.x - record.originX, point.y - record.originY) < 30) queueAction({ kind: 'button', id: record.id });
   786	    else if (record.control === 'node' && Math.hypot(point.x - record.originX, point.y - record.originY) < 30) queueAction({ kind: 'node', id: record.id });
   787	    else if (record.control === 'start') queueAction({ kind: 'start' });
   788	    else if (record.control === 'restart') queueAction({ kind: 'restart' });
   789	    else if (record.control === 'tech' && techCardAt(point) === record.id) queueAction({ kind: 'tech', index: record.id });
   790	    input.pointers.delete(event.pointerId);
   791	    try { canvas.releasePointerCapture(event.pointerId); } catch (_) {}
   792	  }
   793	
   794	  function onPointerCancel(event) {
   795	    event.preventDefault();
   796	    const record = input.pointers.get(event.pointerId);
   797	    if (record && record.control === 'stick' && input.stickPointerId === event.pointerId) {
   798	      input.stickPointerId = null;
   799	      input.stick.x = 0;
   800	      input.stick.y = 0;
   801	    }
   802	    input.pointers.delete(event.pointerId);
   803	  }
   804	
   805	  function onKeyDown(event) {
   806	    unlockAudio();
   807	    const key = event.key.toLowerCase();
   808	    if (['w', 'a', 's', 'd', 'arrowup', 'arrowdown', 'arrowleft', 'arrowright', '1', '2', '3', '4', 'b', 'r', 'enter', ' '].includes(key)) event.preventDefault();
   809	    if (TRACKED_KEYS.has(key)) input.keys.add(key);
   810	    if (event.repeat) return;
   811	    if (state.phase === 'start' && (key === 'enter' || key === ' ')) queueAction({ kind: 'start' });
   812	    else if ((state.phase === 'over' || state.phase === 'win') && (key === 'r' || key === 'enter' || key === ' ')) queueAction({ kind: 'restart' });
   813	    else if (state.phase === 'between' && (key === '1' || key === '2')) queueAction({ kind: 'tech', index: Number(key) - 1 });
   814	    else if (state.phase === 'playing' && key >= '1' && key <= '4') queueAction({ kind: 'select', type: TURRET_KEYS[Number(key) - 1] });
   815	    else if (state.phase === 'playing' && key === 'b') queueAction({ kind: 'barrier' });
   816	  }
   817	
   818	  function onKeyUp(event) { input.keys.delete(event.key.toLowerCase()); }

   820	  function techCardAt(point) {
   821	    if (point.y < 270 || point.y > 540) return -1;
   822	    if (point.x >= 20 && point.x <= 185) return 0;
   823	    if (point.x >= 205 && point.x <= 370) return 1;
   824	    return -1;
   825	  }

   827	  function handleOrientation() {
   828	    const wasPaused = orientationPaused;
   829	    orientationPaused = window.innerWidth > window.innerHeight;
   830	    rotateOverlay.classList.toggle('show', orientationPaused);
   831	    if (!wasPaused && orientationPaused) clearInput();

   836	  function resizeCanvas() {
   837	    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
   838	    viewport.cssW = rect.width;
   839	    viewport.cssH = rect.height;
   840	    viewport.scale = Math.min(rect.width / DESIGN_W, rect.height / DESIGN_H);
   841	    viewport.ox = (rect.width - DESIGN_W * viewport.scale) / 2;
   842	    viewport.oy = (rect.height - DESIGN_H * viewport.scale) / 2;
   843	    viewport.pixelScale = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2, 960 / Math.max(1, rect.width), 960 / Math.max(1, rect.height));
   844	    canvas.width = Math.max(1, Math.round(rect.width * viewport.pixelScale));
   845	    canvas.height = Math.max(1, Math.round(rect.height * viewport.pixelScale));
   846	  }

   164	           ' · ' + G.TERR[h.terr].name + ' (x' + G.TERR[h.terr].def.toFixed(2) + ' def)');
   165	      SFX.tap(); deselect(); return;
   166	    }
   167	    hint(G.TERR[h.terr].name + ' · def x' + G.TERR[h.terr].def.toFixed(2) +
   168	         ' · move cost ' + (h.terr === 'water' ? '—' : G.TERR[h.terr].cost) +
   169	         (h.owner >= 0 ? ' · ' + (h.owner === 0 ? 'yours' : G.FACTIONS[h.owner].name) : ' · unclaimed'));
   170	    SFX.tap();
   171	    deselect();
   172	  }

   174	  // instant-defeat stakes deserve an explicit warning
   175	  function keepWarning() {
   176	    var S = G.state, kq = G.KEEPS[0][0], kr = G.KEEPS[0][1];
   177	    var near = 0, garrison = 0;
   178	    for (var i = 0; i < S.armies.length; i++) {
   179	      var a = S.armies[i], d = HEX.dist(a.q, a.r, kq, kr);
   180	      if (a.owner === 0) { if (d <= 1) garrison++; }
   181	      else if (d <= 2) near++;
   182	    }
   183	    if (!near) return null;
   184	    if (!garrison) return '! YOUR KEEP IS UNDEFENDED and ' + near + ' enemy banner(s) are within reach.';
   185	    return '! ' + near + ' enemy banner(s) closing on your keep (walls give x1.90 defence).';
   186	  }
   187	
   188	  function autoHint() {
   189	    var S = G.state, ready = 0;
   190	    for (var i = 0; i < S.armies.length; i++) {
   191	      if (S.armies[i].owner === 0 && S.armies[i].mp > 0) ready++;
   192	    }
   193	    if (ready) return ready + ' banner(s) still ready. Claim hexes to grow income.';
   194	    return 'All banners moved — recruit or End Turn.';
   195	  }

   197	  // ---------- attack modal (all math shown) ----------
   198	  function openAttack(a, d) {
   199	    var pv = G.preview(a, d);
   200	    pendingAttack = pv;
   201	    $('atkTitle').textContent = G.UNITS[a.type].name + ' → ' + G.FACTIONS[d.owner].name + ' ' + G.UNITS[d.type].name;
   202	    var mu = pv.m === 1.5 ? 'counters (x1.50)' : pv.m === 0.75 ? 'countered (x0.75)' : 'even (x1.00)';
   203	    var rows = '';
   204	    function row(l, v, cls) { rows += '<div class="r"><span>' + l + '</span><span class="' + (cls || '') + '">' + v + '</span></div>'; }
   205	    row('Your strength', a.str);
   206	    row('Matchup', mu);
   207	    row('Your supply', pv.supA === 1 ? 'x1.00' : 'CUT OFF x0.70', pv.supA === 1 ? '' : 'lose');
   208	    rows += '<hr>';
   209	    row('Attack power', pv.A.toFixed(2), 'win');
   210	    rows += '<hr>';
   211	    row('Their strength', d.str);
   212	    row(G.TERR[pv.hex.terr].name + ' cover', 'x' + pv.terr.toFixed(2));
   213	    row('Keep walls', 'x' + pv.keepB.toFixed(2));
   214	    row('Their supply', pv.supD === 1 ? 'x1.00' : 'CUT OFF x0.70');
   215	    rows += '<hr>';
   216	    row('Defence power', pv.D.toFixed(2), 'lose');
   217	    rows += '<hr>';
   218	    row('Outcome', pv.win ? 'YOU WIN' : 'YOU LOSE', pv.win ? 'win' : 'lose');
   219	    row(pv.win ? 'Survivors' : 'They keep', pv.surv + ' str', pv.win ? 'win' : 'lose');
   220	    $('mathbox').innerHTML = rows;
   221	    $('btnAtk').textContent = pv.win ? 'Commit Attack' : 'Attack Anyway';
   222	    ovAttack.classList.add('on');
   223	  }
   224	  function doAttack() {
   225	    var pv = pendingAttack;
   226	    ovAttack.classList.remove('on');
   227	    if (!pv) return;
   228	    pendingAttack = null;
   229	    var S = G.state;
   230	    if (!G.armyById(pv.atk.id) || !G.armyById(pv.def.id)) { deselect(); refresh(); return; }
   231	    var tq = pv.def.q, tr = pv.def.r;
   232	    FX.clash(tq, tr, pv);
   233	    G.resolve(pv);
   234	    if (pv.win) {
   235	      R.say(tq, tr, 'ROUTED', '#8fd6a0');
   236	      if (pv.hex.keep >= 0 && pv.hex.keep !== 0) { R.kick(16, 'rgba(255,220,140,.6)'); R.say(tq, tr, 'KEEP TAKEN', '#f0d68a'); }
   237	    } else {
   238	      R.say(tq, tr, 'LOST', '#e88b8b');
   239	      R.kick(10, 'rgba(220,90,80,.45)');
   240	    }
   241	    S.sel = null; S.reach = null;
   242	    if (checkOver()) return;
   243	    refresh(); hint(autoHint());
   244	  }

   246	  // ---------- turn flow ----------
   247	  function endTurn() {
   248	    var S = G.state;
   249	    if (!S || S.over || S.phase !== 'player' || paused) return;
   250	    deselect();
   251	    S.phase = 'ai';
   252	    aiQueue.length = 0;
   253	    for (var f = 1; f < 4; f++) {
   254	      if (!S.alive[f]) continue;
   255	      aiQueue.push({ kind: 'begin', f: f });
   256	      var plan = AI.plan(f);
   257	      for (var i = 0; i < plan.length; i++) aiQueue.push(plan[i]);
   258	    }
   259	    if (aiQueue.length > 400) aiQueue.length = 400;
   260	    aiQueue.push({ kind: 'endround' });
   261	    aiTimer = 0;
   262	    SFX.turn();
   263	    refresh();
   264	    hint('Rival warlords are marching…');
   265	  }
   266	
   267	  // returns true when the action deserves a visible beat, false when it is instant
   268	  function aiStep() {
   269	    var S = G.state;
   270	    if (!aiQueue.length) { finishRound(); return true; }
   271	    var act = aiQueue.shift();
   272	    if (act.kind === 'begin') {
   273	      if (!S.alive[act.f]) return false;
   274	      G.recomputeSupply();
   275	      G.startTurnFor(act.f);
   276	      aiBanner = G.FACTIONS[act.f].name + ' moves';
   277	      aiBannerT = 0.45;
   278	      return true;
   279	    }
   280	    if (act.kind === 'recruit') {
   281	      if (S.alive[act.f] && G.recruit(act.f, act.type)) {
   282	        var kq = G.KEEPS[act.f][0], kr = G.KEEPS[act.f][1];
   283	        R.burst(kq, kr, G.FACTIONS[act.f].col, 8, 40);
   284	      }
   285	      return false;
   286	    }
   287	    if (act.kind === 'act') {
   288	      if (!S.alive[act.f]) return false;
   289	      var moved = AI.actArmy(act.f, act.id, FX);
   290	      var a = G.armyById(act.id);
   291	      if (moved && a && a.mp > 0 && (act.tries || 0) < 1) {
   292	        aiQueue.unshift({ kind: 'act', f: act.f, id: act.id, tries: (act.tries || 0) + 1 });
   293	      }
   294	      checkOver();
   295	      refresh();
   296	      return moved;
   297	    }
   298	    if (act.kind === 'done') { aiBanner = null; return false; }
   299	    if (act.kind === 'endround') { finishRound(); return true; }
   300	    return false;
   301	  }
   302	
   303	  function finishRound() {
   304	    var S = G.state;
   305	    aiQueue.length = 0; aiBanner = null;
   306	    if (S.over) { showOver(); return; }
   307	    S.turn++;
   308	    if (S.turn > G.TURNS) { seasonEnd(); return; }
   309	    G.beginPlayerTurn(false);
   310	    if (S.log) { R.kick(5, 'rgba(220,90,80,.3)'); SFX.starve(); }
   311	    refresh();
   312	    var warn = keepWarning();
   313	    if (warn) R.kick(6, 'rgba(220,120,80,.35)');
   314	    hint(warn || (S.log ? S.log : 'Turn ' + S.turn + ' — ' + G.income(0) + 'g collected. Push out or dig in.'));
   315	  }
   316	
   317	  function checkOver() {
   318	    var S = G.state;
   319	    if (S.over) { showOver(); return true; }
   320	    return false;
   321	  }

   323	  function showOver() {
   324	    var S = G.state;
   325	    var res = G.seasonResult();
   326	    if (S.over === 'defeat') {
   327	      var l = G.bankDefeat();
   328	      $('endTitle').textContent = 'Ashvale Has Fallen';
   329	      $('endTitle').className = 'lose';
   330	      $('endSub').textContent = 'Your keep was taken on turn ' + S.turn + '. Rally what legacy remains and take the field again.';
   331	      $('btnNext').textContent = 'Rally Again';
   332	      SFX.lose();
   333	    } else {
   334	      var l2 = G.bankSeason(res);
   335	      $('endTitle').textContent = 'The Valley Is Yours';
   336	      $('endTitle').className = 'win';
   337	      $('endSub').textContent = 'Every rival keep has fallen. Legacy carried: ' + l2.carry + 'g into Season ' + l2.season + '.';
   338	      $('btnNext').textContent = 'Season ' + l2.season;
   339	      SFX.win();
   340	    }
   341	    fillScores(res);
   342	    S.phase = 'over';
   343	    refresh();
   344	    ovEnd.classList.add('on');
   345	  }

   347	  function seasonEnd() {
   348	    var S = G.state;
   349	    var res = G.seasonResult();
   350	    var l = G.bankSeason(res);
   351	    $('endTitle').textContent = res.won ? 'Season Won' : 'Season Lost';
   352	    $('endTitle').className = res.won ? 'win' : 'lose';
   353	    $('endSub').textContent = (res.won
   354	        ? 'Ashvale holds the most ground.'
   355	        : G.FACTIONS[res.bestF].name + ' holds the most ground.') +
   356	      ' Best ever: ' + l.best + ' hexes. Legacy carried: ' + l.carry + 'g into Season ' + l.season + '.';
   357	    $('btnNext').textContent = 'Season ' + l.season;
   358	    fillScores(res);
   359	    S.phase = 'over'; S.over = res.won ? 'won' : 'lost';
   360	    if (res.won) { SFX.win(); R.kick(8, 'rgba(140,220,160,.4)'); } else SFX.lose();
   361	    refresh();
   362	    ovEnd.classList.add('on');
   363	  }

   378	  // ---------- pointer input (own id per pointer, hardening #3) ----------
   379	  function cssPos(e) {
   380	    var r = cv.getBoundingClientRect();
   381	    return { x: e.clientX - r.left, y: e.clientY - r.top };
   382	  }
   383	  function down(e) {
   384	    if (paused || !started) return;
   385	    e.preventDefault();
   386	    var p = cssPos(e);
   387	    pointers[e.pointerId] = { x: p.x, y: p.y, sx: p.x, sy: p.y, moved: false };
   388	    if (pointerOrder.indexOf(e.pointerId) < 0) pointerOrder.push(e.pointerId);
   389	    if (pointerOrder.length === 2) startPinch();
   390	    try { cv.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId); } catch (err) {}
   391	  }
   392	  function move(e) {
   393	    var pt = pointers[e.pointerId];
   394	    if (!pt) return;
   395	    e.preventDefault();
   396	    var p = cssPos(e);
   397	    var dx = p.x - pt.x, dy = p.y - pt.y;
   398	    pt.x = p.x; pt.y = p.y;
   399	    if (Math.abs(p.x - pt.sx) > 10 || Math.abs(p.y - pt.sy) > 10) pt.moved = true;
   400	    if (pointerOrder.length >= 2) { updatePinch(); return; }
   401	    if (pt.moved) R.panBy(dx, dy);
   402	  }
   403	  function up(e) {
   404	    var pt = pointers[e.pointerId];
   405	    if (!pt) return;
   406	    e.preventDefault();
   407	    var wasPinch = pointerOrder.length >= 2;
   408	    release(e.pointerId);
   409	    if (!wasPinch && !pt.moved) {
   410	      showCursor = false;
   411	      var h = R.pick(pt.x, pt.y);
   412	      onHex(h.q, h.r);
   413	    }
   414	    if (pointerOrder.length === 2) startPinch();
   415	  }
   416	  function cancel(e) { release(e.pointerId); }
   417	  function release(id) {
   418	    delete pointers[id];
   419	    var i = pointerOrder.indexOf(id);
   420	    if (i >= 0) pointerOrder.splice(i, 1);
   421	    if (pointerOrder.length < 2) { pinchDist = 0; pinchMid = null; }
   422	    try { cv.releasePointerCapture(id); } catch (err) {}
   423	  }
   424	  function startPinch() {
   425	    var a = pointers[pointerOrder[0]], b = pointers[pointerOrder[1]];
   426	    if (!a || !b) return;
   427	    pinchDist = Math.hypot(a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y) || 1;
   428	    pinchMid = { x: (a.x + b.x) / 2, y: (a.y + b.y) / 2 };
   429	  }
   430	  function updatePinch() {
   431	    var a = pointers[pointerOrder[0]], b = pointers[pointerOrder[1]];
   432	    if (!a || !b || !pinchMid) return;
   433	    var d = Math.hypot(a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y) || 1;
   434	    var mid = { x: (a.x + b.x) / 2, y: (a.y + b.y) / 2 };
   435	    if (pinchDist > 0) R.zoomAt(d / pinchDist, mid.x, mid.y);
   436	    R.panBy(mid.x - pinchMid.x, mid.y - pinchMid.y);
   437	    pinchDist = d; pinchMid = mid;
   438	  }
   439	
   440	  cv.addEventListener('pointerdown', down, { passive: false });
   441	  cv.addEventListener('pointermove', move, { passive: false });
   442	  cv.addEventListener('pointerup', up, { passive: false });
   443	  cv.addEventListener('pointercancel', cancel, { passive: false });
   444	  cv.addEventListener('pointerleave', cancel, { passive: false });
   445	  cv.addEventListener('wheel', function (e) {
   446	    e.preventDefault();
   447	    var p = cssPos(e);
   448	    R.zoomAt(e.deltaY < 0 ? 1.12 : 0.89, p.x, p.y);
   449	  }, { passive: false });
   450	  cv.addEventListener('touchstart', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); }, { passive: false });
   451	  cv.addEventListener('contextmenu', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); });

   453	  // ---------- keyboard ----------
   454	  var ARROW = { ArrowLeft: [-1, 0], ArrowRight: [1, 0], ArrowUp: [0, -1], ArrowDown: [0, 1] };
   455	  window.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
   456	    if (!started) {
   457	      if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') { e.preventDefault(); start(); }
   458	      return;
   459	    }
   460	    keys[e.key] = 1;
   461	    if (ovAttack.classList.contains('on')) {
   462	      if (e.key === 'Enter') { e.preventDefault(); doAttack(); }
   463	      if (e.key === 'Escape') { e.preventDefault(); pendingAttack = null; ovAttack.classList.remove('on'); }
   464	      return;
   465	    }
   466	    if (ovEnd.classList.contains('on')) {
   467	      if (e.key === 'Enter') { e.preventDefault(); $('btnNext').click(); }
   468	      return;
   469	    }
   470	    if (paused) return;
   471	    var S = G.state;
   472	    if (!S) return;
   473	    if (ARROW[e.key]) {
   474	      e.preventDefault();
   475	      showCursor = true;
   476	      var d = ARROW[e.key], nq = S.cursor.q + d[0], nr = S.cursor.r + d[1];
   477	      if (G.hexAt(nq, nr)) { S.cursor = { q: nq, r: nr }; SFX.tap(); }
   478	      else {
   479	        // slide along the hex diagonal so every cell is reachable with 4 keys
   480	        var alt = e.key === 'ArrowUp' ? [1, -1] : e.key === 'ArrowDown' ? [-1, 1] : null;
   481	        if (alt && G.hexAt(S.cursor.q + alt[0], S.cursor.r + alt[1])) {
   482	          S.cursor = { q: S.cursor.q + alt[0], r: S.cursor.r + alt[1] }; SFX.tap();
   483	        }
   484	      }
   485	      return;
   486	    }
   487	    if (e.key === 'Enter') { e.preventDefault(); showCursor = true; onHex(S.cursor.q, S.cursor.r); return; }
   488	    if (e.key === 'Escape') { deselect(); return; }
   489	    if (e.key === ' ') { e.preventDefault(); endTurn(); return; }
   490	    if (e.key === '1') { tryRecruit('spear'); return; }
   491	    if (e.key === '2') { tryRecruit('cav'); return; }
   492	    if (e.key === '3') { tryRecruit('bow'); return; }
   493	    if (e.key === '+' || e.key === '=') { R.zoomAt(1.15, cv.clientWidth / 2, cv.clientHeight / 2); return; }
   494	    if (e.key === '-' || e.key === '_') { R.zoomAt(0.87, cv.clientWidth / 2, cv.clientHeight / 2); return; }
   495	    if (e.key === 'f' || e.key === 'F') { R.fit(); return; }
   496	  });
   497	  window.addEventListener('keyup', function (e) { delete keys[e.key]; });
   498	  window.addEventListener('blur', function () {
   499	    clearInput();
   500	    for (var k in keys) delete keys[k];
   501	  });
   502	  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', function () {
   503	    if (document.hidden) clearInput();
   504	  });

   506	  // ---------- buttons ----------
   507	  function tryRecruit(type) {
   508	    var S = G.state;
   509	    if (!S || S.over || S.phase !== 'player' || paused) return;
   510	    if (!G.canRecruit(0, type)) {
   511	      SFX.deny();
   512	      hint(S.gold[0] < G.UNITS[type].cost ? 'Not enough gold — claim more hexes for income.'
   513	        : G.countArmies(0) >= G.ARMY_CAP ? 'Banner limit reached (' + G.ARMY_CAP + ').'
   514	        : 'No free space at your keep.');
   515	      return;
   516	    }
   517	    var a = G.recruit(0, type);
   518	    if (a) {
   519	      SFX.recruit();
   520	      R.burst(a.q, a.r, G.FACTIONS[0].col, 12, 55);
   521	      R.say(a.q, a.r, '+' + G.UNITS[type].name, '#cfe2ff');
   522	      refresh();
   523	      hint('Recruited a ' + G.UNITS[type].name + '. It marches next turn.');
   524	    }
   525	  }

   528	  $('cBow').addEventListener('click', function () { tryRecruit('bow'); });

   544	  function start() {
   545	    if (started) return;
   546	    started = true;
   547	    SFX.unlock();
   548	    ovStart.classList.remove('on');
   549	    R.resize(); R.fit();
   550	    refresh();
   551	  }
