   553	  // ---------- orientation (hardening #1: pauses the sim) ----------
   554	  function checkOrient() {
   555	    var landscape = window.innerWidth > window.innerHeight && window.innerHeight < 480;
   556	    if (landscape !== rotBlocked) {
   557	      rotBlocked = landscape;
   558	      paused = landscape;
   559	      if (landscape) { ovRot.classList.add('on'); clearInput(); }
   560	      else {
   561	        ovRot.classList.remove('on');
   562	        lastTs = 0;
   563	        R.resize(); R.fit();
   564	      }
   565	    }
   566	  }
   567	
   568	  // ---------- loop ----------
   569	  function frame(ts) {
   570	    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
   571	    var dt = lastTs ? (ts - lastTs) / 1000 : 0;
   572	    lastTs = ts;
   573	    if (dt > 0.05) dt = 0.05;
   574	    if (dt < 0) dt = 0;
   575	
   576	    if (!paused) {
   577	      R.step(dt);
   578	      var S = G.state;
   579	      if (started && S && S.phase === 'ai' && !S.over && !ovEnd.classList.contains('on')) {
   580	        if (aiBannerT > 0) aiBannerT -= dt;
   581	        aiTimer += dt;
   582	        var budget = 24;
   583	        while (aiBannerT <= 0 && aiTimer >= AI_STEP && budget > 0 && S.phase === 'ai') {
   584	          aiTimer -= AI_STEP;
   585	          // instant bookkeeping actions resolve for free; only real moves cost a beat
   586	          var slow = aiStep(); budget--;
   587	          while (!slow && budget > 0 && S.phase === 'ai' && aiQueue.length) { slow = aiStep(); budget--; }
   588	        }
   589	      }
   590	    }
   591	    R.draw({
   592	      cursor: G.state ? G.state.cursor : null,
   593	      showCursor: showCursor && G.state && G.state.phase === 'player',
   594	      banner: (aiBannerT > 0 && aiBanner) ? aiBanner : null,
   595	      bannerCol: '#e8eef8'
   596	    });
   597	  }
   598	
   599	  window.addEventListener('resize', function () {
   600	    R.resize(); R.clampCam(); checkOrient();
   601	  });
   602	  window.addEventListener('orientationchange', function () {
   603	    later(function () { R.resize(); R.fit(); checkOrient(); }, 260);
   604	  });
   605	
   606	  boot();
   607	  checkOrient();
   608	  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
   609	})();
     1	// Warring Banners - canvas renderer, camera, particles. Greybox but readable.
     2	var R = (function () {
     3	  var cv, ctx, W = 1, H = 1, dpr = 1;
     4	  var cam = { x: 0, y: 0, z: 1, minZ: 0.55, maxZ: 2.4 };
     5	  var HS = 34;                       // world hex size
     6	  var parts = [], PART_CAP = 180;
     7	  var floats = [], FLOAT_CAP = 20;
     8	  var shake = 0, flash = 0, flashCol = '#fff';
     9	  var anims = [], ANIM_CAP = 12;
    10	  var t0 = 0;
    11	
    12	  function init(canvas) {
    13	    cv = canvas; ctx = cv.getContext('2d', { alpha: false });
    14	    resize();
    15	  }
    16	  function resize() {
    17	    if (!cv) return;
    18	    var rect = cv.getBoundingClientRect();
    19	    var cssW = Math.max(1, rect.width), cssH = Math.max(1, rect.height);
    20	    dpr = Math.min(2, window.devicePixelRatio || 1);
    21	    var longCss = Math.max(cssW, cssH);
    22	    var scale = Math.min(dpr, 960 / Math.max(1, longCss));
    23	    if (scale < 0.5) scale = 0.5;
    24	    W = Math.round(cssW * scale); H = Math.round(cssH * scale);
    25	    cv.width = W; cv.height = H;
    26	    cv.__scale = scale; cv.__cssW = cssW; cv.__cssH = cssH;
    27	  }
    28	  function sc() { return (cv && cv.__scale) || 1; }
    29	
    30	  function fit() {
    31	    var S = G.state;
    32	    if (!S) return;
    33	    var minX = 1e9, maxX = -1e9, minY = 1e9, maxY = -1e9;
    34	    for (var i = 0; i < S.list.length; i++) {
    35	      var p = HEX.toPix(S.list[i].q, S.list[i].r, HS);
    36	      if (p.x < minX) minX = p.x; if (p.x > maxX) maxX = p.x;
    37	      if (p.y < minY) minY = p.y; if (p.y > maxY) maxY = p.y;
    38	    }
    39	    cam.x = (minX + maxX) / 2; cam.y = (minY + maxY) / 2;
    40	    var mw = (maxX - minX) + HS * 2.4, mh = (maxY - minY) + HS * 2.6;
    41	    var z = Math.min(W / mw, H / mh);
    42	    cam.minZ = z * 0.8; cam.maxZ = z * 3.0;
    43	    cam.z = z;
    44	    clampCam();
    45	  }
    46	  function clampCam() {
    47	    var S = G.state;
    48	    if (!S) return;
    49	    if (cam.z < cam.minZ) cam.z = cam.minZ;
    50	    if (cam.z > cam.maxZ) cam.z = cam.maxZ;
    51	    var lim = HS * 6.4;
    52	    if (cam.x < -lim) cam.x = -lim; if (cam.x > lim) cam.x = lim;
    53	    if (cam.y < -lim) cam.y = -lim; if (cam.y > lim) cam.y = lim;
    54	  }
    55	  function w2s(x, y) { return { x: (x - cam.x) * cam.z + W / 2, y: (y - cam.y) * cam.z + H / 2 }; }
    56	  function s2w(x, y) { return { x: (x - W / 2) / cam.z + cam.x, y: (y - H / 2) / cam.z + cam.y }; }
    57	  // css px -> hex
    58	  function pick(cssX, cssY) {
    59	    var s = sc(), w = s2w(cssX * s, cssY * s);
    60	    return HEX.fromPix(w.x, w.y, HS);
    61	  }
    62	  function panBy(dxCss, dyCss) {
    63	    var s = sc();
    64	    cam.x -= dxCss * s / cam.z; cam.y -= dyCss * s / cam.z; clampCam();
    65	  }
    66	  function zoomAt(mul, cssX, cssY) {
    67	    var s = sc(), bx = cssX * s, by = cssY * s;
    68	    var before = s2w(bx, by);
    69	    cam.z *= mul; clampCam();
    70	    var after = s2w(bx, by);
    71	    cam.x += before.x - after.x; cam.y += before.y - after.y; clampCam();
    72	  }
    73	
    74	  // ---- fx (all capped: hardening #5) ----
    75	  function burst(q, r, col, n, pow) {
    76	    var p = HEX.toPix(q, r, HS);
    77	    n = Math.min(n || 10, 26);
    78	    for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    79	      if (parts.length >= PART_CAP) parts.shift();
    80	      var a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2, sp = (0.35 + Math.random()) * (pow || 60);
    81	      parts.push({ x: p.x, y: p.y, vx: Math.cos(a) * sp, vy: Math.sin(a) * sp - 20,
    82	                   life: 0.45 + Math.random() * 0.4, max: 0.85, col: col, r: 2 + Math.random() * 2.5 });
    83	    }
    84	  }
    85	  function say(q, r, txt, col) {
    86	    var p = HEX.toPix(q, r, HS);
    87	    if (floats.length >= FLOAT_CAP) floats.shift();
    88	    floats.push({ x: p.x, y: p.y - HS * 0.5, txt: txt, col: col || '#fff', life: 1.0, max: 1.0 });
    89	  }
    90	  function kick(m, col) { shake = Math.min(18, shake + m); if (col) { flash = 0.28; flashCol = col; } }
    91	  function march(a, q, r) {
    92	    var from = HEX.toPix(a.q, a.r, HS);
    93	    if (anims.length >= ANIM_CAP) anims.shift();
    94	    anims.push({ id: a.id, x: from.x, y: from.y, t: 0, dur: 0.22 });
    95	    burst(a.q, a.r, '#c9cfd8', 6, 34);
    96	  }
    97	  function clearFx() { parts.length = 0; floats.length = 0; anims.length = 0; shake = 0; flash = 0; }
    98	
    99	  function step(dt) {
   100	    var i;
   101	    for (i = parts.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
   102	      var p = parts[i];
   103	      p.life -= dt;
   104	      if (p.life <= 0) { parts.splice(i, 1); continue; }
   105	      p.x += p.vx * dt; p.y += p.vy * dt; p.vy += 150 * dt; p.vx *= 0.96;
   106	    }
   107	    for (i = floats.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
   108	      var f = floats[i]; f.life -= dt * 0.9; f.y -= 22 * dt;
   109	      if (f.life <= 0) floats.splice(i, 1);
   110	    }
   111	    for (i = anims.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
   112	      anims[i].t += dt;
   113	      if (anims[i].t >= anims[i].dur) anims.splice(i, 1);
   114	    }
   115	    if (shake > 0) { shake -= dt * 46; if (shake < 0) shake = 0; }
   116	    if (flash > 0) { flash -= dt * 1.6; if (flash < 0) flash = 0; }
   117	    t0 += dt;
   118	  }
   119	
   120	  // ---- drawing ----
   121	  function hexPath(cx, cy, s) {
   122	    ctx.beginPath();
   123	    for (var i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
   124	      var a = Math.PI / 180 * (60 * i - 30);
   125	      var x = cx + s * Math.cos(a), y = cy + s * Math.sin(a);
   126	      if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(x, y); else ctx.lineTo(x, y);
   127	    }
   128	    ctx.closePath();
   129	  }
   130	
   131	  function draw(view) {
   132	    if (!ctx) return;
   133	    var S = G.state;
   134	    ctx.setTransform(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0);
   135	    ctx.fillStyle = '#14171d';
   136	    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
   137	    if (!S) return;
   138	
   139	    var sh = shake > 0 ? shake : 0;
   140	    var ox = sh ? (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * sh : 0;
   141	    var oy = sh ? (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * sh : 0;
   142	    ctx.save();
   143	    ctx.translate(ox, oy);
   144	
   145	    var z = cam.z, s = HS * z;
   146	    var sel = S.sel != null ? G.armyById(S.sel) : null;
   147	    var reach = S.reach ? S.reach.reach : null;
   148	    var targets = S.reach ? S.reach.targets : null;
   149	    var pulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(t0 * 4.2);
   150	
   151	    // hexes
   152	    for (var i = 0; i < S.list.length; i++) {
   153	      var h = S.list[i];
   154	      var wp = HEX.toPix(h.q, h.r, HS), sp = w2s(wp.x, wp.y);
   155	      if (sp.x < -s * 2 || sp.x > W + s * 2 || sp.y < -s * 2 || sp.y > H + s * 2) continue;
   156	      var T = G.TERR[h.terr];
   157	      hexPath(sp.x, sp.y, s * 0.96);
   158	      ctx.fillStyle = ((h.q + h.r) & 1) ? T.col : T.col2;
   159	      ctx.fill();
   160	
   161	      if (h.owner >= 0) {
   162	        ctx.save(); ctx.clip();
   163	        ctx.globalAlpha = 0.30;
   164	        ctx.fillStyle = G.FACTIONS[h.owner].col;
   165	        ctx.fillRect(sp.x - s, sp.y - s, s * 2, s * 2);
   166	        ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
   167	        ctx.restore();
   168	      }
   169	      // terrain hatch marks
   170	      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,.30)';
   171	      ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1, 1.2 * z);
   172	      hexPath(sp.x, sp.y, s * 0.96); ctx.stroke();
   173	      if (h.owner >= 0) {
   174	        ctx.strokeStyle = G.FACTIONS[h.owner].col;
   175	        ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1.4, 2.2 * z);
   176	        hexPath(sp.x, sp.y, s * 0.86); ctx.stroke();
   177	      }
   178	      drawTerrainMark(sp.x, sp.y, s, h.terr);
   179	      if (h.keep >= 0) drawKeep(sp.x, sp.y, s, h.keep, S.alive[h.keep]);
   180	
   181	      // move / attack overlays
   182	      var k = HEX.key(h.q, h.r);
   183	      if (reach && reach[k] !== undefined) {
   184	        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(232,238,248,' + (0.13 + pulse * 0.10) + ')';
   185	        hexPath(sp.x, sp.y, s * 0.90); ctx.fill();
   186	        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,.75)';
   187	        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(sp.x, sp.y + s * 0.42, Math.max(2, 3 * z), 0, 6.29); ctx.fill();
   188	      }
   189	      if (targets && targets[k]) {
   190	        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(240,90,80,' + (0.6 + pulse * 0.4) + ')';
   191	        ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(2, 3.2 * z);
   192	        hexPath(sp.x, sp.y, s * 0.82); ctx.stroke();
   193	      }
   194	      if (view.cursor && view.showCursor && h.q === view.cursor.q && h.r === view.cursor.r) {
   195	        ctx.strokeStyle = '#f0e08a'; ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(2, 2.6 * z);
   196	        ctx.setLineDash([Math.max(3, 5 * z), Math.max(3, 4 * z)]);
   197	        hexPath(sp.x, sp.y, s * 0.74); ctx.stroke();
   198	        ctx.setLineDash([]);
   199	      }
   200	    }
   201	
   202	    // armies
   203	    for (i = 0; i < S.armies.length; i++) {
   204	      var a = S.armies[i];
   205	      var wp2 = HEX.toPix(a.q, a.r, HS);
   206	      var an = null;
   207	      for (var j = 0; j < anims.length; j++) if (anims[j].id === a.id) an = anims[j];
   208	      if (an) {
   209	        var u = Math.min(1, an.t / an.dur); u = u * u * (3 - 2 * u);
   210	        wp2 = { x: an.x + (wp2.x - an.x) * u, y: an.y + (wp2.y - an.y) * u };
   211	      }
   212	      var ap = w2s(wp2.x, wp2.y);
   213	      drawArmy(ap.x, ap.y, s, a, sel && sel.id === a.id, pulse);
   214	    }
   215	
   216	    // particles
   217	    for (i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) {
   218	      var pt = parts[i], pp = w2s(pt.x, pt.y);
   219	      ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, pt.life / pt.max);
   220	      ctx.fillStyle = pt.col;
   221	      ctx.fillRect(pp.x - pt.r * z, pp.y - pt.r * z, pt.r * 2 * z, pt.r * 2 * z);
   222	    }
   223	    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
   224	
   225	    // floating text
   226	    ctx.textAlign = 'center'; ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
   227	    for (i = 0; i < floats.length; i++) {
   228	      var fl = floats[i], fp = w2s(fl.x, fl.y);
   229	      ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, fl.life / fl.max));
   230	      ctx.font = 'bold ' + Math.round(15 * Math.max(0.7, z)) + 'px ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif';
   231	      ctx.lineWidth = 3; ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,.75)';
   232	      ctx.strokeText(fl.txt, fp.x, fp.y);
   233	      ctx.fillStyle = fl.col; ctx.fillText(fl.txt, fp.x, fp.y);
   234	    }
   235	    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
   236	    ctx.restore();
   237	
   238	    if (flash > 0) {
   239	      ctx.globalAlpha = Math.min(0.45, flash);
   240	      ctx.fillStyle = flashCol; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
   241	      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
   242	    }
   243	
   244	    // turn banner for AI phase
   245	    if (view.banner) {
   246	      var bh = Math.round(30 * sc());
   247	      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(12,14,19,.78)';
   248	      ctx.fillRect(0, H / 2 - bh, W, bh * 2);
   249	      ctx.fillStyle = view.bannerCol || '#fff';
   250	      ctx.font = 'bold ' + Math.round(19 * sc()) + 'px ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif';
   251	      ctx.fillText(view.banner, W / 2, H / 2);
   252	    }
   253	  }
   254	
   255	  function drawTerrainMark(x, y, s, terr) {
   256	    ctx.save();
   257	    if (terr === 'forest') {
   258	      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(20,42,24,.85)';
   259	      for (var i = -1; i <= 1; i++) {
   260	        var tx = x + i * s * 0.34, ty = y + (i === 0 ? -s * 0.06 : s * 0.10);
   261	        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(tx, ty - s * 0.30);
   262	        ctx.lineTo(tx + s * 0.16, ty + s * 0.12); ctx.lineTo(tx - s * 0.16, ty + s * 0.12);
   263	        ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
   264	      }
   265	    } else if (terr === 'hill') {
   266	      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(30,26,16,.75)'; ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1.5, s * 0.07);
   267	      ctx.beginPath();
   268	      ctx.moveTo(x - s * 0.42, y + s * 0.16); ctx.lineTo(x - s * 0.12, y - s * 0.20);
   269	      ctx.lineTo(x + s * 0.12, y + s * 0.10); ctx.lineTo(x + s * 0.42, y - s * 0.22);
   270	      ctx.stroke();
   271	    } else if (terr === 'water') {
   272	      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(150,195,225,.42)'; ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1.2, s * 0.055);
   273	      for (var w = -1; w <= 1; w++) {
   274	        ctx.beginPath();
   275	        ctx.moveTo(x - s * 0.44, y + w * s * 0.26);
   276	        ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y + w * s * 0.26 - s * 0.16, x + s * 0.44, y + w * s * 0.26);
   277	        ctx.stroke();
   278	      }
   279	    } else if (terr === 'ford') {
   280	      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(226,214,180,.72)'; ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1.4, s * 0.08);
   281	      ctx.setLineDash([s * 0.16, s * 0.12]);
   282	      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x - s * 0.46, y); ctx.lineTo(x + s * 0.46, y); ctx.stroke();
   283	      ctx.setLineDash([]);
   284	    }
   285	    ctx.restore();
   286	  }
   287	
   288	  function drawKeep(x, y, s, f, alive) {
   289	    ctx.save();
   290	    var col = alive ? G.FACTIONS[f].col : '#6a6f79';
   291	    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(18,20,26,.80)';
   292	    ctx.fillRect(x - s * 0.34, y - s * 0.40, s * 0.68, s * 0.62);
   293	    ctx.fillStyle = col;
   294	    ctx.fillRect(x - s * 0.34, y - s * 0.52, s * 0.14, s * 0.20);
   295	    ctx.fillRect(x - s * 0.07, y - s * 0.56, s * 0.14, s * 0.24);
   296	    ctx.fillRect(x + s * 0.20, y - s * 0.52, s * 0.14, s * 0.20);
   297	    ctx.strokeStyle = col; ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1.4, s * 0.06);
   298	    ctx.strokeRect(x - s * 0.34, y - s * 0.40, s * 0.68, s * 0.62);
   299	    ctx.restore();
   300	  }
   301	
   302	  function drawArmy(x, y, s, a, isSel, pulse) {
   303	    var F = G.FACTIONS[a.owner];
   304	    var rad = s * 0.42;
   305	    ctx.save();
   306	    if (isSel) {
   307	      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,' + (0.55 + pulse * 0.45) + ')';
   308	      ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(2, s * 0.09);
   309	      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y, rad + s * 0.15, 0, 6.29); ctx.stroke();
   310	    }
   311	    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(10,12,16,.55)';
   312	    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(x, y + rad * 0.85, rad * 0.9, rad * 0.34, 0, 0, 6.29); ctx.fill();
   313	
   314	    ctx.fillStyle = a.sup ? F.col : F.dim;
   315	    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y - s * 0.04, rad, 0, 6.29); ctx.fill();
   316	    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(8,10,14,.9)'; ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1.2, s * 0.05);
   317	    ctx.stroke();
   318	
   319	    if (!a.sup) {
   320	      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(235,90,80,' + (0.6 + pulse * 0.4) + ')';
   321	      ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1.6, s * 0.07);
   322	      ctx.setLineDash([s * 0.14, s * 0.11]);
   323	      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y - s * 0.04, rad + s * 0.10, 0, 6.29); ctx.stroke();
   324	      ctx.setLineDash([]);
   325	    }
   326	    // unit glyph
   327	    ctx.fillStyle = '#10141a';
   328	    ctx.font = 'bold ' + Math.round(s * 0.44) + 'px ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif';
   329	    ctx.textAlign = 'center'; ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
   330	    ctx.fillText(G.UNITS[a.type].glyph, x, y - s * 0.05);
   331	
   332	    // strength pip
   333	    var bw = s * 0.62, bh = s * 0.26, by = y + rad * 0.72;
   334	    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(10,12,16,.88)';
   335	    ctx.fillRect(x - bw / 2, by - bh / 2, bw, bh);
   336	    ctx.fillStyle = a.sup ? '#e8eef8' : '#f0a5a0';
   337	    ctx.font = 'bold ' + Math.round(s * 0.21) + 'px ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif';
   338	    ctx.fillText(String(a.str), x, by);
   339	    if (a.mp > 0 && a.owner === 0) {
   340	      ctx.fillStyle = '#8fd6a0';
   341	      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x + rad * 0.86, y - rad * 0.72, Math.max(2, s * 0.08), 0, 6.29); ctx.fill();
   342	    }
   343	    ctx.restore();
   344	  }
   345	
   346	  return {
   347	    init: init, resize: resize, fit: fit, draw: draw, step: step,
   348	    pick: pick, panBy: panBy, zoomAt: zoomAt, clampCam: clampCam,
   349	    burst: burst, say: say, kick: kick, march: march, clearFx: clearFx,
   350	    get cam() { return cam; }, get HS() { return HS; },
   351	    get w() { return W; }, get h() { return H; }
   352	  };
   353	})();
     1	// Warring Banners - state, map generation and rules. No I/O beyond localStorage (guarded).
     2	var G = (function () {
     3	  var K = HEX.key;
     4	
     5	  var TERR = {
     6	    plain:  { name: 'Plain',  cost: 1, def: 1.00, col: '#4d5b3e', col2: '#57663f' },
     7	    forest: { name: 'Forest', cost: 2, def: 1.35, col: '#2f4a33', col2: '#37563b' },
     8	    hill:   { name: 'Hill',   cost: 2, def: 1.25, col: '#5f5945', col2: '#6b644d' },
     9	    ford:   { name: 'Ford',   cost: 2, def: 0.85, col: '#3a5b70', col2: '#41677e' },
    10	    water:  { name: 'River',  cost: 99, def: 1.00, col: '#22394f', col2: '#22394f' }
    11	  };
    12	  var UNITS = {
    13	    spear: { name: 'Spear',   cost: 5, beats: 'cav',   glyph: 'I' },
    14	    cav:   { name: 'Cavalry', cost: 7, beats: 'bow',   glyph: 'A' },
    15	    bow:   { name: 'Bow',     cost: 6, beats: 'spear', glyph: 'Y' }
    16	  };
    17	  var FACTIONS = [
    18	    { name: 'Ashvale',  col: '#5b9bd5', dim: '#33587a', ai: null },
    19	    { name: 'Korrund',  col: '#d2604f', dim: '#7a382e', ai: 'raider' },
    20	    { name: 'Sethmoor', col: '#d7a94b', dim: '#7c622b', ai: 'turtle' },
    21	    { name: 'Vaelin',   col: '#9b7ad2', dim: '#59477a', ai: 'expander' }
    22	  ];
    23	  var KEEPS = [[0, 3], [0, -3], [3, 0], [-3, 0]];
    24	  var EXTRA = [[4, -2], [-4, 2], [2, 2]];
    25	  var TURNS = 12, ARMY_CAP = 6, MOVE_PTS = 2;
    26	
    27	  var S = null;              // live state
    28	  var nextId = 1;
    29	
    30	  // ---------- persistence (hardening #4) ----------
    31	  var LS_KEY = 'wb.legacy.v1';
    32	  function defLegacy() { return { season: 1, carry: 0, wins: 0, best: 0 }; }
    33	  function num(v, d, lo, hi) {
    34	    var n = typeof v === 'number' ? v : parseFloat(v);
    35	    if (typeof n !== 'number' || !isFinite(n) || isNaN(n)) return d;
    36	    n = Math.floor(n);
    37	    if (n < lo) n = lo; if (n > hi) n = hi;
    38	    return n;
    39	  }
    40	  function loadLegacy() {
    41	    var d = defLegacy();
    42	    try {
    43	      var ls = window.localStorage;
    44	      var raw = ls ? ls.getItem(LS_KEY) : null;
    45	      if (!raw || typeof raw !== 'string') return d;
    46	      var o = JSON.parse(raw);
    47	      if (!o || typeof o !== 'object' || Array.isArray(o)) return d;
    48	      return {
    49	        season: num(o.season, 1, 1, 999),
    50	        carry:  num(o.carry, 0, 0, 20),
    51	        wins:   num(o.wins, 0, 0, 999),
    52	        best:   num(o.best, 0, 0, 40)
    53	      };
    54	    } catch (e) { return d; }
    55	  }
    56	  function saveLegacy(l) {
    57	    try {

    60	      ls.setItem(LS_KEY, JSON.stringify({

    62	        wins: num(l.wins, 0, 0, 999), best: num(l.best, 0, 0, 40)

    67	    try { var ls = window.localStorage; if (ls) ls.removeItem(LS_KEY); } catch (e) {}

    69	
    70	  // ---------- map ----------
    71	  function buildMap(seed) {
    72	    var rnd = HEX.rng(seed);
    73	    var hexes = {}, list = [];
    74	    function add(q, r) {
    75	      var h = { q: q, r: r, terr: 'plain', owner: -1, keep: -1 };
    76	      hexes[K(q, r)] = h; list.push(h);
    77	    }
    78	    for (var q = -3; q <= 3; q++) {
    79	      for (var r = -3; r <= 3; r++) {
    80	        if (HEX.dist(q, r, 0, 0) <= 3) add(q, r);
    81	      }
    82	    }
    83	    for (var i = 0; i < EXTRA.length; i++) add(EXTRA[i][0], EXTRA[i][1]);
    84	
    85	    // terrain: seeded value noise on axial coords
    86	    function nz(h, o) {
    87	      var v = Math.sin((h.q * 12.9898 + h.r * 78.233 + o + seed * 0.317)) * 43758.5453;
    88	      return v - Math.floor(v);
    89	    }
    90	    for (i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
    91	      var h = list[i], n = nz(h, 1.7) * 0.6 + rnd() * 0.4;
    92	      if (n < 0.26) h.terr = 'forest';
    93	      else if (n < 0.44) h.terr = 'hill';
    94	      else h.terr = 'plain';
    95	    }
    96	    // a river band across the map -> chokepoints
    97	    var axis = Math.floor(rnd() * 3);
    98	    for (i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
    99	      var hh = list[i];
   100	      var v = axis === 0 ? hh.q : (axis === 1 ? hh.r : -hh.q - hh.r);
   101	      var d = HEX.dist(hh.q, hh.r, 0, 0);
   102	      if (v === 0 && d > 0 && d < 4) hh.terr = (nz(hh, 5.1) < 0.34) ? 'ford' : 'water';
   103	    }
   104	    // keeps always solid ground
   105	    for (i = 0; i < KEEPS.length; i++) {
   106	      var kh = hexes[K(KEEPS[i][0], KEEPS[i][1])];
   107	      kh.terr = 'plain'; kh.keep = i; kh.owner = i;
   108	    }
   109	    repairConnectivity(hexes, list);
   110	    return { hexes: hexes, list: list };
   111	  }
   112	
   113	  // guarantee every keep can reach every other keep on land (fords added as needed)
   114	  function repairConnectivity(hexes, list) {
   115	    for (var guard = 0; guard < 40; guard++) {
   116	      var seen = {}, stack = [KEEPS[0].slice()], n = 0;
   117	      seen[K(KEEPS[0][0], KEEPS[0][1])] = 1;
   118	      while (stack.length) {
   119	        var c = stack.pop(); n++;
   120	        var nb = HEX.neighbors(c[0], c[1]);
   121	        for (var i = 0; i < nb.length; i++) {
   122	          var k = K(nb[i][0], nb[i][1]), h = hexes[k];
   123	          if (!h || seen[k] || h.terr === 'water') continue;
   124	          seen[k] = 1; stack.push([h.q, h.r]);
   125	        }
   126	      }
   127	      var bad = null;
   128	      for (var j = 0; j < list.length; j++) {
   129	        var t = list[j];
   130	        if (t.terr === 'water') continue;
   131	        if (!seen[K(t.q, t.r)]) { bad = t; break; }
   132	      }
   133	      if (!bad) return;
   134	      // convert the water hex nearest the disconnected region into a ford
   135	      var best = null, bd = 1e9;
   136	      for (j = 0; j < list.length; j++) {
   137	        var w = list[j];
   138	        if (w.terr !== 'water') continue;
   139	        var touchesIn = false, touchesOut = false, nb2 = HEX.neighbors(w.q, w.r);
   140	        for (var m = 0; m < nb2.length; m++) {
   141	          var kk = K(nb2[m][0], nb2[m][1]);
   142	          if (!hexes[kk] || hexes[kk].terr === 'water') continue;
   143	          if (seen[kk]) touchesIn = true; else touchesOut = true;
   144	        }
   145	        if (!touchesIn || !touchesOut) continue;
   146	        var dd = HEX.dist(w.q, w.r, bad.q, bad.r);
   147	        if (dd < bd) { bd = dd; best = w; }
   148	      }
   149	      if (!best) {
   150	        // fall back: dry out the stranded hex's cheapest water neighbour
   151	        var nb3 = HEX.neighbors(bad.q, bad.r);
   152	        for (m = 0; m < nb3.length; m++) {
   153	          var h3 = hexes[K(nb3[m][0], nb3[m][1])];
   154	          if (h3 && h3.terr === 'water') { best = h3; break; }
   155	        }
   156	      }
   157	      if (!best) return;
   158	      best.terr = 'ford';
   159	    }
   160	  }

   162	  // ---------- state ----------
   163	  function newSeason(legacy) {
   164	    var seed = (legacy.season * 7919 + 1013) >>> 0;
   165	    var map = buildMap(seed);
   166	    nextId = 1;
   167	    S = {
   168	      season: legacy.season,
   169	      legacy: legacy,
   170	      turn: 1,
   171	      phase: 'player',
   172	      cur: 0,
   173	      hexes: map.hexes,
   174	      list: map.list,
   175	      armies: [],
   176	      gold: [10 + legacy.carry, 10, 10, 10],
   177	      alive: [true, true, true, true],
   178	      supplied: [{}, {}, {}, {}],
   179	      sel: null,
   180	      cursor: { q: KEEPS[0][0], r: KEEPS[0][1] },
   181	      reach: null,
   182	      log: '',
   183	      over: null
   184	    };
   185	    var bonus = Math.min(3, Math.floor(legacy.wins / 2));
   186	    for (var f = 0; f < 4; f++) {
   187	      var kq = KEEPS[f][0], kr = KEEPS[f][1];
   188	      spawn(f, 'spear', kq, kr, 10 + (f === 0 ? bonus : 0));
   189	      // second banner spawns on the outward flank, never pointing into a rival keep
   190	      var nb = HEX.neighbors(kq, kr), pick = null, pickScore = -1e9;
   191	      for (var i = 0; i < nb.length; i++) {
   192	        var h = S.hexes[K(nb[i][0], nb[i][1])];
   193	        if (!h || !passable(h) || armyAt(h.q, h.r)) continue;
   194	        var sc2 = HEX.dist(h.q, h.r, 0, 0) * 3;
   195	        for (var g = 0; g < 4; g++) {
   196	          if (g === f) continue;
   197	          sc2 += Math.min(6, HEX.dist(h.q, h.r, KEEPS[g][0], KEEPS[g][1]));
   198	        }
   199	        if (sc2 > pickScore) { pickScore = sc2; pick = h; }
   200	      }
   201	      if (pick) {
   202	        pick.owner = f;
   203	        spawn(f, (f % 2) ? 'bow' : 'cav', pick.q, pick.r, 10 + (f === 0 ? bonus : 0));
   204	      }
   205	      // small starting holding
   206	      for (i = 0; i < nb.length; i++) {
   207	        var h2 = S.hexes[K(nb[i][0], nb[i][1])];
   208	        if (h2 && passable(h2) && h2.owner === -1 && h2.keep < 0) { h2.owner = f; break; }
   209	      }
   210	    }
   211	    recomputeSupply();
   212	    beginPlayerTurn(true);
   213	    return S;
   214	  }
   215	
   216	  function spawn(owner, type, q, r, str) {
   217	    if (countArmies(owner) >= ARMY_CAP) return null;
   218	    var a = { id: nextId++, owner: owner, type: type, str: str, q: q, r: r, mp: MOVE_PTS, sup: true };
   219	    S.armies.push(a);
   220	    return a;
   221	  }
   222	  function countArmies(f) {
   223	    var n = 0;
   224	    for (var i = 0; i < S.armies.length; i++) if (S.armies[i].owner === f) n++;
   225	    return n;
   226	  }
   227	  function armyAt(q, r) {
   228	    for (var i = 0; i < S.armies.length; i++) {
   229	      var a = S.armies[i];
   230	      if (a.q === q && a.r === r) return a;
   231	    }
   232	    return null;
   233	  }
   234	  function armyById(id) {
   235	    for (var i = 0; i < S.armies.length; i++) if (S.armies[i].id === id) return S.armies[i];
   236	    return null;
   237	  }
   238	  function hexAt(q, r) { return S.hexes[K(q, r)] || null; }
   239	  function passable(h) { return !!h && h.terr !== 'water'; }
   240	  function territory(f) {
   241	    var n = 0;
   242	    for (var i = 0; i < S.list.length; i++) if (S.list[i].owner === f) n++;
   243	    return n;
   244	  }
   245	
   246	  // ---------- supply ----------
   247	  function recomputeSupply() {
   248	    for (var f = 0; f < 4; f++) {
   249	      var set = {};
   250	      if (S.alive[f]) {
   251	        var kq = KEEPS[f][0], kr = KEEPS[f][1], kk = K(kq, kr);
   252	        var kh = S.hexes[kk];
   253	        if (kh && kh.owner === f) {
   254	          set[kk] = 1;
   255	          var stack = [[kq, kr]];
   256	          while (stack.length) {
   257	            var c = stack.pop(), nb = HEX.neighbors(c[0], c[1]);
   258	            for (var i = 0; i < nb.length; i++) {
   259	              var k2 = K(nb[i][0], nb[i][1]), h = S.hexes[k2];
   260	              if (!h || set[k2] || h.owner !== f || !passable(h)) continue;
   261	              set[k2] = 1; stack.push([h.q, h.r]);
   262	            }
   263	          }
   264	        }
   265	      }
   266	      S.supplied[f] = set;
   267	    }
   268	    for (var j = 0; j < S.armies.length; j++) {
   269	      var a = S.armies[j];
   270	      a.sup = !!S.supplied[a.owner][K(a.q, a.r)];
   271	    }
   272	  }
   273	
   274	  // ---------- movement ----------
   275	  // returns {reach:{key:mpLeft}, targets:{key:1}} for an army
   276	  function computeReach(a) {
   277	    var reach = {}, targets = {};
   278	    var start = K(a.q, a.r);
   279	    reach[start] = a.mp;
   280	    var frontier = [[a.q, a.r]];
   281	    while (frontier.length) {
   282	      var c = frontier.pop();
   283	      var left = reach[K(c[0], c[1])];
   284	      if (left <= 0) continue;
   285	      var nb = HEX.neighbors(c[0], c[1]);
   286	      for (var i = 0; i < nb.length; i++) {
   287	        var h = hexAt(nb[i][0], nb[i][1]);
   288	        if (!passable(h)) continue;
   289	        var k = K(h.q, h.r);
   290	        var occ = armyAt(h.q, h.r);
   291	        if (occ) {
   292	          if (occ.owner !== a.owner && left >= 1) targets[k] = 1;
   293	          continue;                       // cannot move through anyone
   294	        }
   295	        var cost = TERR[h.terr].cost;
   296	        if (cost > left) continue;
   297	        var rem = left - cost;
   298	        if (reach[k] === undefined || reach[k] < rem) { reach[k] = rem; frontier.push([h.q, h.r]); }
   299	      }
   300	    }

    36	      if (p.x < minX) minX = p.x; if (p.x > maxX) maxX = p.x;
    37	      if (p.y < minY) minY = p.y; if (p.y > maxY) maxY = p.y;
    38	    }
    39	    cam.x = (minX + maxX) / 2; cam.y = (minY + maxY) / 2;
    40	    var mw = (maxX - minX) + HS * 2.4, mh = (maxY - minY) + HS * 2.6;
    41	    var z = Math.min(W / mw, H / mh);
    42	    cam.minZ = z * 0.8; cam.maxZ = z * 3.0;
    43	    cam.z = z;
    44	    clampCam();
    45	  }
    46	  function clampCam() {
    47	    var S = G.state;
    48	    if (!S) return;
    49	    if (cam.z < cam.minZ) cam.z = cam.minZ;
    50	    if (cam.z > cam.maxZ) cam.z = cam.maxZ;
    51	    var lim = HS * 6.4;
    52	    if (cam.x < -lim) cam.x = -lim; if (cam.x > lim) cam.x = lim;
    53	    if (cam.y < -lim) cam.y = -lim; if (cam.y > lim) cam.y = lim;
    54	  }
    55	  function w2s(x, y) { return { x: (x - cam.x) * cam.z + W / 2, y: (y - cam.y) * cam.z + H / 2 }; }
    56	  function s2w(x, y) { return { x: (x - W / 2) / cam.z + cam.x, y: (y - H / 2) / cam.z + cam.y }; }
    57	  // css px -> hex
    58	  function pick(cssX, cssY) {
    59	    var s = sc(), w = s2w(cssX * s, cssY * s);
    60	    return HEX.fromPix(w.x, w.y, HS);
    61	  }
    62	  function panBy(dxCss, dyCss) {
    63	    var s = sc();
    64	    cam.x -= dxCss * s / cam.z; cam.y -= dyCss * s / cam.z; clampCam();
    65	  }
    66	  function zoomAt(mul, cssX, cssY) {
    67	    var s = sc(), bx = cssX * s, by = cssY * s;
    68	    var before = s2w(bx, by);
    69	    cam.z *= mul; clampCam();
    70	    var after = s2w(bx, by);
    71	    cam.x += before.x - after.x; cam.y += before.y - after.y; clampCam();
    72	  }

    83	    }

    91	  function march(a, q, r) {

    94	    anims.push({ id: a.id, x: from.x, y: from.y, t: 0, dur: 0.22 });

    99	  function step(dt) {
   100	    var i;
   101	    for (i = parts.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
   102	      var p = parts[i];
   103	      p.life -= dt;
   104	      if (p.life <= 0) { parts.splice(i, 1); continue; }
   105	      p.x += p.vx * dt; p.y += p.vy * dt; p.vy += 150 * dt; p.vx *= 0.96;
   106	    }
   107	    for (i = floats.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
   108	      var f = floats[i]; f.life -= dt * 0.9; f.y -= 22 * dt;
   109	      if (f.life <= 0) floats.splice(i, 1);
   110	    }
   111	    for (i = anims.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
   112	      anims[i].t += dt;
   113	      if (anims[i].t >= anims[i].dur) anims.splice(i, 1);
   114	    }
   115	    if (shake > 0) { shake -= dt * 46; if (shake < 0) shake = 0; }
   116	    if (flash > 0) { flash -= dt * 1.6; if (flash < 0) flash = 0; }
   117	    t0 += dt;
   118	  }

   121	  function hexPath(cx, cy, s) {
   122	    ctx.beginPath();
   123	    for (var i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
   124	      var a = Math.PI / 180 * (60 * i - 30);

   126	      if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(x, y); else ctx.lineTo(x, y);
   127	    }

   305	  function moveArmy(a, q, r, mpLeft) {
   306	    a.q = q; a.r = r; a.mp = mpLeft;
   307	    var h = hexAt(q, r);
   308	    if (h) {
   309	      if (h.keep >= 0 && h.keep !== a.owner) captureKeep(h.keep, a.owner);
   310	      h.owner = a.owner;
   311	    }
   312	    recomputeSupply();
   313	  }

   315	  // ---------- combat (fully deterministic; math is shown pre-attack) ----------
   316	  function matchup(at, dt) {
   317	    if (UNITS[at].beats === dt) return 1.5;
   318	    if (UNITS[dt].beats === at) return 0.75;
   319	    return 1.0;
   320	  }
   321	  function preview(a, d) {
   322	    var dh = hexAt(d.q, d.r);
   323	    var m = matchup(a.type, d.type);
   324	    var supA = a.sup ? 1.0 : 0.7, supD = d.sup ? 1.0 : 0.7;
   325	    var terr = TERR[dh.terr].def;
   326	    var keepB = (dh.keep === d.owner) ? 1.9 : 1.0;
   327	    var A = a.str * m * supA;
   328	    var D = d.str * terr * supD * keepB;
   329	    var win = A > D;
   330	    var surv = win ? Math.max(1, Math.round(a.str * (1 - D / A)))
   331	                   : Math.max(1, Math.round(d.str * (1 - A / D)));
   332	    return {
   333	      atk: a, def: d, hex: dh, m: m, supA: supA, supD: supD,
   334	      terr: terr, keepB: keepB, A: A, D: D, win: win, surv: surv
   335	    };
   336	  }
   337	  function resolve(p) {
   338	    var a = p.atk, d = p.def, q = d.q, r = d.r;
   339	    if (p.win) {
   340	      a.str = p.surv;
   341	      removeArmy(d);
   342	      moveArmy(a, q, r, 0);
   343	    } else {
   344	      d.str = p.surv;
   345	      removeArmy(a);
   346	      recomputeSupply();
   347	    }
   348	    return p;
   349	  }
   350	  function removeArmy(x) {
   351	    for (var i = 0; i < S.armies.length; i++) {
   352	      if (S.armies[i].id === x.id) { S.armies.splice(i, 1); return; }
   353	    }
   354	  }
   355	
   356	  function captureKeep(loser, winner) {
   357	    if (!S.alive[loser]) return;
   358	    S.alive[loser] = false;
   359	    for (var i = S.armies.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
   360	      if (S.armies[i].owner === loser) S.armies.splice(i, 1);
   361	    }
   362	    for (var j = 0; j < S.list.length; j++) {
   363	      if (S.list[j].owner === loser) S.list[j].owner = (S.list[j].keep === loser) ? winner : -1;
   364	    }
   365	    if (loser === 0) S.over = 'defeat';
   366	    else {
   367	      var any = false;
   368	      for (var f = 1; f < 4; f++) if (S.alive[f]) any = true;
   369	      if (!any) S.over = 'conquest';
   370	    }
   371	  }
   372	
   373	  // ---------- turn flow ----------
   374	  function income(f) {
   375	    return 2 + Math.floor(territory(f) / 2);
   376	  }
   377	  function startTurnFor(f) {
   378	    S.gold[f] += income(f);
   379	    if (S.gold[f] > 99) S.gold[f] = 99;
   380	    var starved = 0;
   381	    for (var i = S.armies.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
   382	      var a = S.armies[i];
   383	      if (a.owner !== f) continue;
   384	      a.mp = MOVE_PTS;
   385	      if (!a.sup) {
   386	        a.str -= 2; starved++;
   387	        if (a.str <= 0) S.armies.splice(i, 1);
   388	      }
   389	    }
   390	    return starved;
   391	  }
   392	  function beginPlayerTurn(first) {
   393	    recomputeSupply();
   394	    var st = startTurnFor(0);
   395	    S.phase = 'player'; S.cur = 0; S.sel = null; S.reach = null;
   396	    S.log = first ? '' : (st ? st + ' cut-off army(s) starving!' : '');
   397	    return st;
   398	  }
   399	
   400	  function canRecruit(f, type) {
   401	    if (!S.alive[f]) return false;
   402	    if (S.gold[f] < UNITS[type].cost) return false;
   403	    if (countArmies(f) >= ARMY_CAP) return false;
   404	    var kq = KEEPS[f][0], kr = KEEPS[f][1];
   405	    var kh = hexAt(kq, kr);
   406	    if (!kh || kh.owner !== f) return false;
   407	    if (!armyAt(kq, kr)) return true;
   408	    var nb = HEX.neighbors(kq, kr);
   409	    for (var i = 0; i < nb.length; i++) {
   410	      var h = hexAt(nb[i][0], nb[i][1]);
   411	      if (h && passable(h) && h.owner === f && !armyAt(h.q, h.r)) return true;
   412	    }
   413	    return false;
   414	  }
   415	  function recruit(f, type) {
   416	    if (!canRecruit(f, type)) return null;
   417	    var kq = KEEPS[f][0], kr = KEEPS[f][1], tq = kq, tr = kr;
   418	    if (armyAt(kq, kr)) {
   419	      var nb = HEX.neighbors(kq, kr);
   420	      for (var i = 0; i < nb.length; i++) {
   421	        var h = hexAt(nb[i][0], nb[i][1]);
   422	        if (h && passable(h) && h.owner === f && !armyAt(h.q, h.r)) { tq = h.q; tr = h.r; break; }
   423	      }
   424	    }
   425	    var bonus = (f === 0) ? Math.min(3, Math.floor(S.legacy.wins / 2)) : 0;
   426	    var a = spawn(f, type, tq, tr, 10 + bonus);
   427	    if (a) { a.mp = 0; S.gold[f] -= UNITS[type].cost; recomputeSupply(); }
   428	    return a;
   429	  }
   430	
   431	  function scores() {
   432	    var out = [];
   433	    for (var f = 0; f < 4; f++) {
   434	      out.push({ f: f, name: FACTIONS[f].name, col: FACTIONS[f].col,
   435	                 terr: S.alive[f] ? territory(f) : 0, alive: S.alive[f] });
   436	    }
   437	    return out;
   438	  }
   439	  function seasonResult() {
   440	    var sc = scores(), best = -1, bestF = -1, tie = false;
   441	    for (var i = 0; i < sc.length; i++) {
   442	      if (sc[i].terr > best) { best = sc[i].terr; bestF = sc[i].f; tie = false; }
   443	      else if (sc[i].terr === best) tie = true;
   444	    }
   445	    var won = (bestF === 0 && !tie) || S.over === 'conquest';
   446	    return { sc: sc, won: won, bestF: bestF, mine: sc[0].terr };
   447	  }
   448	  function bankSeason(res) {
   449	    var l = S.legacy;
   450	    l.best = Math.max(l.best, res.mine);
   451	    if (res.won) { l.wins = Math.min(999, l.wins + 1); l.carry = Math.min(20, 4 + Math.floor(res.mine / 3)); }
   452	    else l.carry = Math.min(20, Math.floor(res.mine / 4));
   453	    l.season = Math.min(999, l.season + 1);
   454	    saveLegacy(l);
   455	    return l;
   456	  }
   457	  function bankDefeat() {
   458	    var l = S.legacy;
   459	    l.carry = Math.max(0, Math.floor(l.carry / 2));
   460	    saveLegacy(l);
   461	    return l;
   462	  }
   463	
   464	  return {
   465	    TERR: TERR, UNITS: UNITS, FACTIONS: FACTIONS, KEEPS: KEEPS, TURNS: TURNS,
   466	    ARMY_CAP: ARMY_CAP, MOVE_PTS: MOVE_PTS,
   467	    get state() { return S; },
   468	    newSeason: newSeason, loadLegacy: loadLegacy, saveLegacy: saveLegacy, clearLegacy: clearLegacy,
   469	    defLegacy: defLegacy,
   470	    hexAt: hexAt, armyAt: armyAt, armyById: armyById, passable: passable, territory: territory,
   471	    countArmies: countArmies, computeReach: computeReach, moveArmy: moveArmy,
   472	    preview: preview, resolve: resolve, matchup: matchup, removeArmy: removeArmy,
   473	    recomputeSupply: recomputeSupply, startTurnFor: startTurnFor, beginPlayerTurn: beginPlayerTurn,
   474	    canRecruit: canRecruit, recruit: recruit, income: income, spawn: spawn,
   475	    scores: scores, seasonResult: seasonResult, bankSeason: bankSeason, bankDefeat: bankDefeat
   476	  };
   477	})();

   140	  function resize() {
   141	    var width = Math.max(1, window.innerWidth);
   142	    var height = Math.max(1, window.innerHeight);
   143	    var dpr = Math.min(2, Math.max(1, window.devicePixelRatio || 1));

   190	  function tone(frequency, duration, type, volume) {
   191	    if (!audioReady || !audio) return;
   192	    try {
   193	      var oscillator = audio.createOscillator();
   194	      var gain = audio.createGain();
   195	      oscillator.type = type || "square";
   196	      oscillator.frequency.value = frequency;
   197	      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, audio.currentTime);
   198	      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(volume || 0.035, audio.currentTime + 0.008);
   199	      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, audio.currentTime + duration);
   200	      oscillator.connect(gain);
   201	      gain.connect(audio.destination);
   202	      oscillator.start();
   203	      oscillator.stop(audio.currentTime + duration + 0.02);
   204	    } catch (error) { /* audio is a bonus */ }
   205	  }

   213	    if (kind === "stage") tone(260, 0.18, "triangle", 0.035);

   420	  function damageEnemy(enemy, amount, critical, sourceColor) {
   421	    if (!enemy || enemy.dead) return;
   422	    var value = amount;
   423	    if (critical) {
   424	      if (enemy.armor > 0) enemy.armor -= 1;
   425	      value *= enemy.boss ? 1.8 : 2.5;
   426	      score += 8;
   427	      addFloater(enemy.x, enemy.y - enemyRadius(enemy) - 12, "CRIT", "#ffe7a0");
   428	      burstParticles(enemy.x, enemy.y, "#ffe7a0", 14);
   429	      sound("crit");
   430	      shake = Math.max(shake, 3.5);
   431	    } else {
   432	      value *= enemy.armor > 0 ? 0.58 : 1;
   433	    }
   434	    enemy.hp -= value;
   435	    enemy.flash = 0.12;
   436	    enemy.jolt = critical ? 0.16 : 0.08;
   437	    if (!critical) burstParticles(enemy.x, enemy.y, sourceColor || "#cfe7ff", 3);
   438	    if (enemy.hp <= 0) {
   439	      enemy.dead = true;
   440	      stageKills += 1;
   441	      score += enemy.boss ? 500 : enemy.kind === "brute" ? 90 : 45;
   442	      burstParticles(enemy.x, enemy.y, enemy.boss ? "#ffe7a0" : (sourceColor || "#cfe7ff"), enemy.boss ? 34 : 14);
   443	      addFloater(enemy.x, enemy.y - 45, enemy.boss ? "WARDEN DOWN" : "+" + (enemy.kind === "brute" ? 90 : 45), enemy.boss ? "#ffe7a0" : "#8af6c8");
   444	      if (enemy.boss) {
   445	        if (stage >= 4 && progress.skins.indexOf("aurora") === -1) progress.skins.push("aurora");
   446	        if (stage >= 8 && progress.skins.indexOf("ember") === -1) progress.skins.push("ember");
   447	        if (stage >= 12 && progress.skins.indexOf("chrome") === -1) progress.skins.push("chrome");
   448	        saveProgress();
   449	        shake = Math.max(shake, 9);
   450	      }
   451	    }
   452	  }
   453	
   454	  function damageMember(member, amount) {
   455	    if (!member || member.down) return;
   456	    member.hp = Math.max(0, member.hp - amount);
   457	    member.jolt = 0.2;
   458	    addFloater(75, lanes[squad.indexOf(member)] - 42, "-" + Math.ceil(amount), "#ff6b57");
   459	    burstParticles(75, lanes[squad.indexOf(member)], "#ff6b57", 7);
   460	    shake = Math.max(shake, 5);
   461	    if (member.hp <= 0) {
   462	      member.down = true;
   463	      addFloater(75, lanes[squad.indexOf(member)] - 60, member.name.toUpperCase() + " DOWN", "#ff6b57");
   464	      sound("down");
   465	    } else sound("hit");
   466	    if (squad.every(function (item) { return item.down; })) showState("fail");
   467	  }
   468	
   469	  function fireMember(member, index) {
   470	    var target = pickTarget(member);
   471	    if (!target) return;
   472	    var damage = member.role === "breaker" ? 9 : member.role === "sustain" ? 5.5 : 7;
   473	    if (member.buff > 0) damage *= 1.5;
   474	    addShot(91, lanes[index], target.x, target.y, member.color, false);
   475	    damageEnemy(target, damage, false, member.color);
   476	    if (member.role === "sustain") {
   477	      member.healTimer -= 0.45;
   478	      if (member.healTimer <= 0) {
   479	        member.healTimer = 2.3;
   480	        squad.forEach(function (ally) { if (!ally.down) ally.hp = Math.min(ally.maxHp, ally.hp + 2.5); });
   481	        burstParticles(76, lanes[index], member.color, 4);
   482	      }
   483	    }
   484	  }
   485	
   486	  function applyBurst(member, index) {
   487	    if (!member || member.down) return;
   488	    member.buff = Math.max(member.buff, member.role === "breaker" ? 4 : 3.5);
   489	    if (member.role === "breaker") {
   490	      enemies.forEach(function (enemy) { if (!enemy.dead) { enemy.armor = Math.max(0, enemy.armor - 1); damageEnemy(enemy, 8, false, member.color); } });
   491	      addFloater(195, lanes[index] - 46, "ARMOR BREAK", member.color);
   492	    } else if (member.role === "sustain") {
   493	      squad.forEach(function (ally) { if (!ally.down) ally.hp = Math.min(ally.maxHp, ally.hp + 23); });
   494	      addFloater(195, lanes[index] - 46, "REPAIR PULSE", member.color);
   495	    } else {
   496	      enemies.forEach(function (enemy) { if (!enemy.dead) damageEnemy(enemy, 17, false, member.color); });
   497	      addFloater(195, lanes[index] - 46, "ARC SALVO", member.color);
   498	    }
   499	    burstParticles(91, lanes[index], member.color, 18);
   500	    sound("burst");
   501	  }
   502	
   503	  function triggerBurst(index) {
   504	    if (state !== "play") return;
   505	    if (rosterOpen) {
   506	      if (key.toLowerCase() === "r" || key === "Escape") { rosterOpen = false; clearInput(); }
   507	      return;
   508	    }
   509	    var member = squad[index];
   510	    if (!member || member.down) return;
   511	    var role = member.role;
   512	    var expected = roleOrder[burstIndex];
   513	    if (burstTimer > 0 && role === expected) burstIndex += 1;
   514	    else burstIndex = role === "breaker" ? 1 : 0;
   515	    burstTimer = 2.7;
   516	    applyBurst(member, index);
   517	    if (burstIndex >= roleOrder.length) {
   518	      burstIndex = 0;
   519	      chainTimer = 5.5;
   520	      score += 180;
   521	      squad.forEach(function (ally) { if (!ally.down) ally.buff = Math.max(ally.buff, 5.5); });
   522	      toast = "CHAIN // LINEBREAK PROTOCOL";
   523	      toastColor = "#ffe7a0";
   524	      toastTimer = 2.3;
   525	      burstParticles(195, 335, "#ffe7a0", 28);
   526	      sound("chain");
   527	    } else {
   528	      toast = "BURST " + (burstIndex === 0 ? "RESET" : (burstIndex + 1) + "/3");
   529	      toastColor = member.color;
   530	      toastTimer = 1.2;
   531	    }
   532	  }
   533	
   534	  function cycleTarget(direction) {
   535	    var live = enemies.filter(function (enemy) { return !enemy.dead; }).sort(function (a, b) { return a.x - b.x; });
   536	    if (!live.length || !squad[selectedMember]) return;
   537	    var current = live.findIndex(function (enemy) { return enemy.id === squad[selectedMember].targetId; });
   538	    var next = (current + direction + live.length) % live.length;
   539	    assignTarget(selectedMember, live[next]);
   540	  }
   541	
   542	  function update(dt) {
   543	    if (rotated || rosterOpen) return;
   544	    updateEffects(dt);
   545	    if (toastTimer > 0) toastTimer -= dt;
   546	    if (state !== "play") return;
   547	    runTime += dt;
   548	    if (burstTimer > 0) burstTimer -= dt;
   549	    if (burstTimer <= 0) burstIndex = 0;
   550	    if (chainTimer > 0) chainTimer -= dt;
   551	    shake = Math.max(0, shake - dt * 12);
   552	    squad.forEach(function (member, index) {
   553	      member.buff = Math.max(0, member.buff - dt);
   554	      member.jolt = Math.max(0, member.jolt - dt);
   555	      if (member.down) return;
   556	      member.fireTimer -= dt;
   557	      if (member.fireTimer <= 0) {
   558	        member.fireTimer = member.role === "breaker" ? 0.72 : member.role === "sustain" ? 0.94 : 0.82;
   559	        fireMember(member, index);
   560	      }
   561	    });
   562	    enemies.forEach(function (enemy) {
   563	      if (enemy.dead) return;
   564	      enemy.weakTimer = (enemy.weakTimer + dt) % 2.4;
   565	      enemy.flash = Math.max(0, enemy.flash - dt);
   566	      enemy.jolt = Math.max(0, enemy.jolt - dt);
   567	      if (enemy.x > 116) enemy.x -= enemy.speed * dt;
   568	      else {
   569	        enemy.x = 116;
   570	        enemy.attackTimer -= dt;
   571	        if (enemy.attackTimer <= 0) {
   572	          var target = squad[enemy.lane];
   573	          if (!target || target.down) target = squad.find(function (member) { return !member.down; });
   574	          if (target) damageMember(target, enemy.boss ? 17 : enemy.kind === "brute" ? 10 : 7);
   575	          enemy.attackTimer = enemy.boss ? 1.05 : 1.65;
   576	        }
   577	      }
   578	    });
   579	    for (var i = enemies.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) if (enemies[i].dead) enemies.splice(i, 1);
   580	    if (transition > 0) {
   581	      transition -= dt;
   582	      if (transition <= 0) enterNextStage();
   583	      return;
   584	    }
   585	    if (stageSpawned < stageGoal && spawnTimer <= 0 && enemies.length < MAX_ENEMIES - 2) {
   586	      spawnEnemy();
   587	      spawnTimer = Math.max(0.45, 1.08 - stage * 0.035);
   588	    } else spawnTimer -= dt;
   589	    if (stageSpawned >= stageGoal && enemies.length === 0) {
   590	      transition = 1.15;
   591	      progress.bestStage = Math.max(progress.bestStage, stage);
   592	      saveProgress();
   593	    }
   594	  }
   595	
   596	  function updateEffects(dt) {
   597	    for (var i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
   598	      var p = particles[i];
   599	      p.life -= dt;
   600	      p.x += p.vx * dt;
   601	      p.y += p.vy * dt;
   602	      p.vx *= Math.pow(p.drag, dt * 60);
   603	      p.vy = p.vy * Math.pow(p.drag, dt * 60) + 12 * dt;
   604	      if (p.life <= 0) particles.splice(i, 1);
   605	    }
   606	    for (var j = floaters.length - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
   607	      floaters[j].life -= dt;
   608	      floaters[j].y -= 24 * dt;
   609	      if (floaters[j].life <= 0) floaters.splice(j, 1);
   610	    }
   611	    for (var k = shots.length - 1; k >= 0; k--) {
   612	      shots[k].life -= dt;
   613	      if (shots[k].life <= 0) shots.splice(k, 1);
   614	    }
   615	  }
   616	
   617	  function rr(x, y, width, height, radius, fill, stroke) {
   618	    ctx.beginPath();
   619	    ctx.moveTo(x + radius, y);
   620	    ctx.arcTo(x + width, y, x + width, y + height, radius);
   621	    ctx.arcTo(x + width, y + height, x, y + height, radius);
   622	    ctx.arcTo(x, y + height, x, y, radius);
   623	    ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + width, y, radius);
   624	    ctx.closePath();
   625	    if (fill) { ctx.fillStyle = fill; ctx.fill(); }
   626	    if (stroke) { ctx.strokeStyle = stroke; ctx.stroke(); }
   627	  }

   629	  function label(message, x, y, size, color, align, weight) {
   630	    ctx.font = (weight || "700") + " " + size + "px Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif";
   631	    ctx.fillStyle = color || "#d9efff";
   632	    ctx.textAlign = align || "left";
   633	    ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
   634	    ctx.fillText(message, x, y);
   635	  }

   697	  function drawMember(member, index) {
   698	    var y = laneY(index) + (member.jolt ? Math.sin(member.jolt * 80) * 2 : 0);

   706	    }
   707	    ctx.fillStyle = member.color;

   709	    ctx.fillStyle = "#07101b";
   710	    ctx.fillRect(86, y - 10, 13, 7);
   711	    ctx.fillRect(86, y + 4, 5, 7);
   712	    ctx.fillRect(94, y + 4, 5, 7);

   714	    ctx.fillRect(104, y - 2, 12, 4);

   717	      ctx.lineWidth = 2;

   719	    }

   722	  function drawTargetLines() {
   723	    squad.forEach(function (member, index) {
   724	      var target = findEnemy(member.targetId);
   725	      if (!target || member.down) return;
   726	      ctx.save();
   727	      ctx.setLineDash([4, 6]);
   728	      ctx.strokeStyle = member.color;
   729	      ctx.globalAlpha = 0.27;

   731	      ctx.restore();
   732	    });

   735	  function drawEnemy(enemy) {
   736	    var y = enemy.y + (enemy.jolt ? Math.sin(enemy.jolt * 90) * 2 : 0);
   737	    var r = enemyRadius(enemy);
   738	    var base = enemy.boss ? "#8f5a48" : enemy.kind === "brute" ? "#7a6970" : enemy.kind === "charger" ? "#6f5890" : "#426a7b";
   739	    var edge = enemy.flash > 0 ? "#fff1c1" : enemy.boss ? "#ffc857" : "#9dd4e8";
   740	    ctx.fillStyle = base;
   741	    if (enemy.boss) {
   742	      ctx.beginPath();
   743	      ctx.moveTo(enemy.x - r, y + 22); ctx.lineTo(enemy.x - 34, y - 34); ctx.lineTo(enemy.x - 9, y - 49);
   744	      ctx.lineTo(enemy.x + 28, y - 37); ctx.lineTo(enemy.x + r, y + 11); ctx.lineTo(enemy.x + 16, y + r);
   745	      ctx.lineTo(enemy.x - 26, y + r); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
   746	    } else if (enemy.kind === "charger") {
   747	      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(enemy.x - r, y); ctx.lineTo(enemy.x - 6, y - r); ctx.lineTo(enemy.x + r, y); ctx.lineTo(enemy.x - 6, y + r); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
   748	    } else {
   749	      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(enemy.x, y, r, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
   750	    }
   751	    ctx.strokeStyle = edge;
   752	    ctx.lineWidth = enemy.boss ? 3 : 2;
   753	    ctx.stroke();
   754	    ctx.fillStyle = "#0a1621";
   755	    ctx.fillRect(enemy.x - r * 0.45, y - 5, r * 0.9, 10);
   756	    ctx.fillStyle = enemy.boss ? "#ff916e" : "#a9e9f6";
   757	    ctx.fillRect(enemy.x - r * 0.3, y - 2, r * 0.6, 4);
   758	    if (weakOpen(enemy)) {
   759	      var weak = weakPoint(enemy);
   760	      var pulse = 11 + Math.sin(runTime * 9 + enemy.id) * 3;
   761	      ctx.globalAlpha = 0.2;
   762	      ctx.fillStyle = "#ffe7a0";
   763	      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(weak.x, weak.y, pulse + 8, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
   764	      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
   765	      ctx.fillStyle = "#ffe7a0";
   766	      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(weak.x, weak.y, pulse * 0.48, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
   767	      ctx.strokeStyle = "#fff7d1";
   768	      ctx.lineWidth = 2;
   769	      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(weak.x, weak.y, pulse * 0.8, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
   770	    } else {
   771	      ctx.strokeStyle = "#7593a1";
   772	      ctx.lineWidth = 2;
   773	      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(enemy.x + 11, y - 8, 6, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
   774	    }
   775	    var barWidth = enemy.boss ? 84 : 46;
   776	    ctx.fillStyle = "#1a2935"; rr(enemy.x - barWidth / 2, y - r - 15, barWidth, 5, 3, "#1a2935");
   777	    rr(enemy.x - barWidth / 2, y - r - 15, barWidth * Math.max(0, enemy.hp / enemy.maxHp), 5, 3, enemy.boss ? "#ff916e" : "#7ce0d1");
   778	    if (enemy.armor > 0) label("ARM " + enemy.armor, enemy.x, y + r + 13, 8, "#9eb6c1", "center", "800");
   779	    if (enemy.boss) label("WARDEN", enemy.x, y - r - 25, 9, "#ffe7a0", "center", "900");
   780	  }

   793	      ctx.fillRect(particle.x - particle.size / 2, particle.y - particle.size / 2, particle.size, particle.size);
   794	    });

   798	      label(floater.message, floater.x, floater.y, 11, floater.color, "center", "900");
   799	    });
   800	    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
   801	  }

   836	  function drawOverlay(title, subtitle, button, color) {
   837	    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(3,8,14,0.78)";
   838	    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
   839	    rr(24, 170, 342, 300, 18, "#0d1d2c", color);

   962	  function enemyAt(x, y) {
   963	    var result = null;

   965	    enemies.forEach(function (enemy) {

   968	      if (distance <= enemyRadius(enemy) + 24 && distance < best) { best = distance; result = enemy; }
   969	    });
   970	    return result;
   971	  }

  1022	  function pointerMove(event) {

   599	      p.life -= dt;
   600	      p.x += p.vx * dt;
   601	      p.y += p.vy * dt;
   602	      p.vx *= Math.pow(p.drag, dt * 60);
   603	      p.vy = p.vy * Math.pow(p.drag, dt * 60) + 12 * dt;
   604	      if (p.life <= 0) particles.splice(i, 1);

    79	    if (a.t < a.win + a.act) return 'active';
    80	    return 'rec';
    81	  }
    82	
    83	  /* ---------- fx ---------- */
    84	  function part(x, y, vx, vy, life, col, size, kind) {
    85	    if (parts.length >= MAXP) parts.splice(0, parts.length - MAXP + 1);
    86	    parts.push({ x: x, y: y, vx: vx, vy: vy, l: life, m: life, c: col, s: size, k: kind || 'spark' });
    87	  }
    88	  function burstFx(x, y, n, col, spd) {
    89	    n = Math.min(n, 26);
    90	    for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    91	      var a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2, s = spd * (0.35 + Math.random());
    92	      part(x, y, Math.cos(a) * s, Math.sin(a) * s - 30, 260 + Math.random() * 320, col, 1.4 + Math.random() * 2.4);
    93	    }
    94	  }
    95	  function ring(x, y, col, r) { part(x, y, 0, 0, 300, col, r || 10, 'ring'); }
    96	  function shake(v) { G.shake = Math.min(26, G.shake + v); }
    97	  function flash(c, a) { G.flash = Math.max(G.flash, a); G.flashC = c; }
    98	  function say(f, t) { f.lastMsg = t; f.msgT = 700; }
    99	  function banner(t, sub, ms) { G.banner = t; G.sub = sub || ''; G.bannerT = ms || 1100; }
   100	
   101	  /* ---------- geometry ---------- */
   102	  function groundY() { return H * 0.80; }
   103	  function posP() { return W * (0.30 - 0.13 * rangeV); }
   104	  function posE() { return W * (0.70 + 0.13 * rangeV); }
   105	
   106	  /* ---------- combat ---------- */
   107	  function dealToPlayer(base, kind, mult) {
   108	    var d = base * sf(E.stance, P.stance) * (mult || 1) * (1 + G.mi * 0.035);
   109	    d = Math.max(1, Math.round(d));
   110	    P.hp = Math.max(0, P.hp - d);
   111	    P.flash = 1; P.hurtT = 260;
   112	    setAct(P, 'hurt', 0, 0, kind === 'B' ? 520 : (kind === 'G' ? 420 : 300));
   113	    range = 1; /* every clean hit breaks the measure apart */
   114	    shake(d * 0.55); flash('#ff5a5a', 0.30);
   115	    if (d > 12) G.hitstop = 60;
   116	    burstFx(posP(), groundY() - 70, 12, '#ff7a6a', 130);
   117	    SND.hit(d > 13);
   118	    return d;
   119	  }
   120	  /* damage that does NOT interrupt whatever the enemy is doing */
   121	  function grazeEnemy(base, mult, label) {
   122	    var d = Math.max(1, Math.round(base * sf(P.stance, E.stance) * (mult || 1)));
   123	    E.hp = Math.max(0, E.hp - d);
   124	    E.flash = 0.7; shake(3);
   125	    burstFx(posE(), groundY() - 70, 5, STC[P.stance], 90);
   126	    SND.block();
   127	    if (label) say(E, label);
   128	    return d;
   129	  }
   130	  /* whiffing or bouncing off leaves you rooted */
   131	  function overextend(ms) {
   132	    if (!P.act) return;
   133	    P.act.rec += ms; P.act.total += ms;
   134	  }
   135	  function dealToEnemy(base, mult, label) {
   136	    var d = base * sf(P.stance, E.stance) * (mult || 1);
   137	    d = Math.max(1, Math.round(d));
   138	    E.hp = Math.max(0, E.hp - d);
   139	    E.flash = 1; E.hurtT = 240;
   140	    setAct(E, 'hurt', 0, 0, 280 + Math.min(220, d * 8));
   141	    E.wait = 260;
   142	    range = 1; /* every clean hit breaks the measure apart */
   143	    shake(d * 0.5); flash('#ffffff', 0.22);
   144	    if (d > 12) G.hitstop = 60;
   145	    burstFx(posE(), groundY() - 70, 12, STC[P.stance], 140);
   146	    SND.hit(d > 13);
   147	    if (label) say(E, label);
   148	    return d;
   149	  }
   150	
   151	  /* enemy attack lands */
   152	  function enemyResolve(a) {
   153	    var k = a.kind;
   154	    var pa = P.act, pp = phaseOf(P);
   155	    var base = (k === 'H' || k === 'L') ? 10 : k === 'T' ? 8 : k === 'G' ? 13 : 18;
   156	
   157	    /* evade beats everything */
   158	    if (pa && pa.kind === 'evade' && pp !== 'rec') {
   159	      P.breath = Math.min(100, P.breath + 8);
   160	      say(P, 'EVADE'); SND.whoosh(); ring(posE(), groundY() - 70, '#9fb6ff', 16);
   161	      return;
   162	    }
   163	    /* parry: works on strikes only */
   164	    if (pa && pa.kind === 'parry' && pp === 'active') {
   165	      if (k === 'H' || k === 'L' || k === 'T') {
   166	        P.breath = Math.min(100, P.breath + 25);
   167	        setAct(E, 'stagger', 0, 0, 900); E.wait = 200;
   168	        say(P, 'PERFECT PARRY'); say(E, 'STAGGER');
   169	        SND.parry(); flash('#ffe9a0', 0.42); shake(7);
   170	        ring((posP() + posE()) / 2, groundY() - 72, '#ffe9a0', 12);
   171	        burstFx((posP() + posE()) / 2, groundY() - 72, 16, '#ffe9a0', 150);
   172	        return;
   173	      }
   174	      /* grab / burst break parries */
   175	      dealToPlayer(base, k, 1.25); say(E, k === 'G' ? 'PARRY BROKEN' : 'ART BREAKS GUARD');
   176	      return;
   177	    }
   178	    /* burst super-armour */
   179	    if (pa && pa.kind === 'burst' && pp !== 'rec' && k !== 'B') {
   180	      var dd = Math.max(1, Math.round(base * 0.45));
   181	      P.hp = Math.max(0, P.hp - dd); P.flash = 1; shake(5); SND.block();
   182	      say(P, 'ART HOLDS'); return;
   183	    }
   184	    /* trade with a strike */
   185	    if (pa && pa.kind === 'strike' && pp !== 'rec') {
   186	      if (k === 'G') { say(P, 'STRIKE BEATS GRAB'); E.act.resolved = true; dealToEnemy(11, 1.1, ''); return; }
   187	      if (k === 'B') { dealToPlayer(base, k, 1); say(E, 'ART OVERWHELMS'); return; }
   188	      if (beats(P.stance, E.stance)) {
   189	        E.act.resolved = true; setAct(E, 'hurt', 0, 0, 340);
   190	        say(P, 'STANCE WINS'); dealToEnemy(11, 1.15, ''); return;
   191	      }
   192	      if (beats(E.stance, P.stance)) { dealToPlayer(base, k, 1.1); say(E, 'STANCE WINS'); return; }
   193	      /* mirror clash */
   194	      P.hp = Math.max(0, P.hp - 3); E.hp = Math.max(0, E.hp - 3);
   195	      P.breath = Math.min(100, P.breath + 12);
   196	      setAct(P, 'hurt', 0, 0, 220); setAct(E, 'hurt', 0, 0, 220);
   197	      say(P, 'CLASH'); SND.clash(); shake(6); flash('#cfe6ff', 0.24);
   198	      burstFx((posP() + posE()) / 2, groundY() - 74, 14, '#dff0ff', 170);
   199	      return;
   200	    }
   201	    /* open */
   202	    if (!pa) {
   203	      if (k === 'H' || k === 'L' || k === 'T') {
   204	        var d2 = Math.max(1, Math.round(base * 0.38 * sf(E.stance, P.stance)));
   205	        P.hp = Math.max(0, P.hp - d2); P.flash = 0.7; shake(3.5); SND.block();
   206	        say(P, 'GUARDED'); ring(posP() + 16, groundY() - 74, '#9fb6ff', 8);
   207	        return;
   208	      }
   209	      dealToPlayer(base, k, 1);
   210	      return;
   211	    }
   212	    dealToPlayer(base, k, 1.4); /* caught recovering */
   213	  }
   214	
   215	  /* player action lands */
   216	  function playerResolve(a) {
   217	    var k = a.kind, dir = a.d;
   218	    if (range === 1 && k !== 'burst') { say(P, 'TOO FAR'); SND.whoosh(); overextend(180); return; }
   219	    if (k === 'burst') { range = 0; }
   220	    var ep = phaseOf(E), ek = E.act ? E.act.kind : null;
   221	
   222	    if (k === 'burst') {
   223	      if (E.act) E.act.resolved = true;
   224	      SND.burst(); flash('#ffd76a', 0.5); shake(14);
   225	      burstFx(posE(), groundY() - 74, 24, '#ffd76a', 230);
   226	      ring(posE(), groundY() - 74, '#ffd76a', 26);
   227	      dealToEnemy(24, 1, 'ART LANDS'); return;
   228	    }
   229	    var atk = (ek === 'H' || ek === 'L' || ek === 'T' || ek === 'G' || ek === 'B');
   230	    if (k === 'grab') {
   231	      if (ek === 'P' && ep === 'active') { dealToEnemy(15, 1, 'GRABBED'); SND.grab(); return; }
   232	      if (ep === 'wind' && atk) { say(P, 'WHIFF'); SND.whoosh(); overextend(200); return; }
   233	      if (ep === 'rec' || ek === 'stagger' || ek === 'hurt') { dealToEnemy(11, 1.3, 'GRABBED'); SND.grab(); return; }
   234	      dealToEnemy(8, 1, 'GRABBED'); SND.grab(); return;
   235	    }
   236	    /* strike */
   237	    if (ek === 'P' && ep === 'active') {
   238	      setAct(P, 'stagger', 0, 0, 760); say(E, 'PARRIED'); say(P, 'OPEN');
   239	      SND.parry(); flash('#ffe9a0', 0.3); shake(6); return;
   240	    }
   241	    if (ep === 'wind' && atk) {
   242	      /* a committed form is armoured: swinging into a tell roots you for the hit */
   243	      grazeEnemy(dir === 'T' ? 8 : 10, 0.25, 'ARMOURED');
   244	      overextend(300); return;
   245	    }
   246	    if (ep === 'rec' || ek === 'stagger' || ek === 'hurt') {
   247	      dealToEnemy(dir === 'T' ? 8 : 10, 1.6, 'PUNISH'); return;
   248	    }
   249	    /* guarded idle */
   250	    if (dir === 'T') { dealToEnemy(7, 1, 'THRUST'); return; }
   251	    var gd = (dir === 'H') ? 'high' : 'low';
   252	    if (E.guard === gd) {
   253	      grazeEnemy(2, 1, 'BLOCKED');
   254	      ring(posE() - 16, groundY() - (gd === 'high' ? 96 : 46), '#9fb6ff', 8);
   255	      overextend(200); return;
   256	    }
   257	    dealToEnemy(10, 1.55, 'GUARD BREAK');
   258	  }
   259	
   260	  /* ---------- player inputs ---------- */
   261	  function canAct() {
   262	    if (G.phase !== 'fight' || G.paused || G.rotate || G.freeze > 0 || G.over > 0) return false;
   263	    var p = phaseOf(P);
   264	    if (!P.act) return true;
   265	    if (P.act.kind === 'hurt' || P.act.kind === 'stagger') return false;
   266	    return p === 'rec' && P.act.t > P.act.win + P.act.act + P.act.rec * 0.55;
   267	  }
   268	  function doStrike(dir) {
   269	    if (!canAct()) return;
   270	    setAct(P, 'strike', 150, 90, 300, dir);
   271	    SND.whoosh();
   272	  }
   273	  function doParry() {
   274	    if (!canAct()) return;
   275	    setAct(P, 'parry', 0, 210, 250);
   276	    ring(posP() + 20, groundY() - 74, '#dff0ff', 9);
   277	    SND.ui();
   278	  }
   279	  function doGrab() {
   280	    if (!canAct()) return;
   281	    setAct(P, 'grab', 230, 110, 470);
   282	    SND.whoosh();
   283	  }
   284	  function doEvade() {
   285	    if (!canAct()) return;
   286	    setAct(P, 'evade', 0, 240, 150);
   287	    range = 1;
   288	    P.breath = Math.min(100, P.breath + 4);
   289	    for (var i = 0; i < 6; i++) part(posP(), groundY() - 20 - i * 10, 60 + Math.random() * 60, -10, 260, '#7f8ba8', 2);
   290	    SND.whoosh();
   291	  }
   292	  function doDash() {
   293	    if (!canAct()) return;
   294	    if (range === 0) { doStrike('T'); return; }
   295	    if (P.breath < DASH_COST) { say(P, 'NO BREATH'); return; }
   296	    P.breath -= DASH_COST;
   297	    range = 0;
   298	    setAct(P, 'dash', 0, 200, 70);
   299	    for (var i = 0; i < 8; i++) part(posP() - i * 6, groundY() - 30 - Math.random() * 60, -80, -20, 300, '#9fd6ff', 2.2);
   300	    SND.dash();
   301	  }
   302	  function doBurst() {
   303	    if (!canAct()) return;
   304	    if (P.breath < BURST_COST) { say(P, 'NEED 50 BREATH'); SND.block(); return; }
   305	    P.breath -= BURST_COST;
   306	    setAct(P, 'burst', 260, 120, 360);
   307	    ring(posP(), groundY() - 74, STC[P.stance], 14);
   308	    SND.gong();
   309	  }
   310	  function setStance(i) {
   311	    if (G.phase !== 'fight' || G.paused) return;
   312	    if (P.stance === i) return;
   313	    P.stance = i;
   314	    for (var k = 0; k < 3; k++) chips[k].classList.toggle('on', k === i);
   315	    ring(posP(), groundY() - 74, STC[i], 10);
   316	    SND.stance(i);
   317	  }
   318	
   319	  /* ---------- enemy ai ---------- */
   320	  function nextToken() {
   321	    var s = M.seq;
   322	    var tk = s[E.si % s.length];
   323	    E.si++;
   324	    if (Math.random() < M.loose) tk = s[(Math.random() * s.length) | 0];
   325	    /* never retreat when already far */
   326	    if (tk === 'R' && range === 1) tk = 'H';
   327	    return tk;
   328	  }
   329	  function enemyStanceLogic(tk) {
   330	    if (M.stanceMode === 'cycle') { if (tk === 'S' || Math.random() < 0.22) E.stance = (E.stance + 1) % 3; }
   331	    else if (M.stanceMode === 'counter') {
   332	      if (tk === 'S' || Math.random() < 0.30) E.stance = (P.stance + 2) % 3;
   333	    }
   334	  }
   335	  function enemyStart() {
   336	    var tk = nextToken();
   337	    enemyStanceLogic(tk);
   338	    var tell = M.tell;
   339	    if (tk === 'S') { setAct(E, 'S', 0, 200, 80); ring(posE(), groundY() - 74, STC[E.stance], 12); SND.stance(E.stance); return; }
   340	    if (tk === 'R') { setAct(E, 'R', 0, 240, 140); range = 1; SND.whoosh(); return; }
   341	    if (tk === 'P') { setAct(E, 'P', 70, 620, 240); return; }
   342	    if (tk === 'G') { setAct(E, 'G', tell * 1.12, 100, 340); }
   343	    else if (tk === 'B') { setAct(E, 'B', tell * 1.5, 120, 430); SND.gong(); }
   344	    else {
   345	      if (M.guardMode === 'alt') E.guard = (E.guard === 'high') ? 'low' : 'high';
   346	      else if (M.guardMode === 'rand') E.guard = Math.random() < 0.5 ? 'high' : 'low';
   347	      setAct(E, tk, tell, 90, 280);
   348	    }
   349	    if (range === 1) range = 0; /* closes in as it commits */
   350	    SND.whoosh();
   351	  }
   352	
   353	  /* ---------- round / match ---------- */
   354	  function startMatch(mi) {
   355	    clearTimers(); resetInput();
   356	    G.mi = clamp(mi | 0, 0, MASTERS.length - 1);
   357	    M = MASTERS[G.mi];
   358	    G.rp = 0; G.re = 0; G.roundNo = 1;
   359	    G.phase = 'fight'; G.paused = false;
   360	    hideAll();
   361	    startRound(true);
   362	  }
   363	  function startRound(first) {
   364	    clearTimers();
   365	    var st = P ? P.stance : 0;
   366	    P = mkP(); P.stance = first ? 0 : st;
   367	    for (var k = 0; k < 3; k++) chips[k].classList.toggle('on', k === P.stance);
   368	    E = mkE(M);
   369	    range = 0; rangeV = 0;
   370	    parts.length = 0;
   371	    G.over = 0; G.overKind = ''; G.time = 60;
   372	    G.freeze = 1200; G.shake = 0; G.flash = 0; G.hitstop = 0;
   373	    banner('ROUND ' + G.roundNo, M.name, 1200);
   374	    resetInput();
   375	  }
   376	  function endRound(who) {
   377	    if (G.over) return;
   378	    G.over = 1700; G.overKind = who;
   379	    if (who === 'p') { G.rp++; SND.win(); banner('ROUND WON', '', 1500); }
   380	    else if (who === 'e') { G.re++; SND.ko(); banner('ROUND LOST', '', 1500); }
   381	    else {
   382	      if (P.hp >= E.hp) { G.rp++; banner('TIME - ROUND WON', '', 1500); SND.win(); }
   383	      else { G.re++; banner('TIME - ROUND LOST', '', 1500); SND.ko(); }
   384	    }
   385	    shake(16); flash('#ffffff', 0.4);
   386	    burstFx(who === 'p' ? posE() : posP(), groundY() - 70, 24, '#ffffff', 220);
   387	  }
   388	  function afterRound() {
   389	    if (G.rp >= 2) return matchEnd(true);
   390	    if (G.re >= 2) return matchEnd(false);
   391	    G.roundNo++;
   392	    startRound(false);
   393	  }
   394	  function matchEnd(won) {
   395	    G.phase = 'over';
   396	    resetInput(); clearTimers();
   397	    if (won) {
   398	      SAVE.wins++;
   399	      if (G.mi + 1 > SAVE.rank) SAVE.rank = G.mi + 1;
   400	      saveNow();
   401	      if (SAVE.rank >= MASTERS.length && G.mi === MASTERS.length - 1) {
   402	        elEndT.textContent = 'GRANDMASTER';
   403	        elEndP.innerHTML = 'The Silkwind bows. All eight gates are open to you.<br>Ladder cleared &mdash; duels ' + SAVE.wins + ' won.';
   404	        SND.gong(); SND.win();
   405	      } else {
   406	        elEndT.textContent = 'MASTER DEFEATED';
   407	        var nm = MASTERS[Math.min(SAVE.rank, MASTERS.length - 1)];
   408	        elEndP.innerHTML = M.name + ' yields ' + G.rp + '&ndash;' + G.re + '.<br>Rank ' + SAVE.rank + ' of 8. Next: ' + nm.name + '.';
   409	        SND.win();
   410	      }
   411	    } else {
   412	      SAVE.losses++; saveNow();
   413	      elEndT.textContent = 'DEFEATED';
   414	      elEndP.innerHTML = M.name + ' wins ' + G.re + '&ndash;' + G.rp + '.<br><i style="color:#ffd76a">' + M.tip + '</i>';
   415	      SND.lose();
   416	    }
   417	    var nxt = document.getElementById('bNext');
   418	    if (won && SAVE.rank < MASTERS.length) { nxt.style.display = ''; nxt.textContent = 'NEXT MASTER'; }
   419	    else if (won) { nxt.style.display = ''; nxt.textContent = 'OPEN THE LADDER'; }
   420	    else { nxt.style.display = 'none'; }
   421	    ovEnd.classList.add('show');
   422	  }
   423	
   424	  /* ---------- overlays ---------- */
   425	  function hideAll() {
   426	    ovBoot.classList.remove('show'); ovEnd.classList.remove('show'); ovLad.classList.remove('show');
   427	  }
   428	  function buildLadder() {
   429	    elLadList.innerHTML = '';
   430	    ladRels.length = 0;
   431	    for (var i = 0; i < MASTERS.length; i++) {
   432	      (function (i) {
   433	        var m = MASTERS[i], b = document.createElement('button');
   434	        b.className = 'lrow' + (i > SAVE.rank ? ' lock' : '');
   435	        var st = i < SAVE.rank ? 'DEFEATED' : (i === SAVE.rank ? 'NEXT' : 'LOCKED');
   436	        b.innerHTML = '<div><b>' + (i + 1) + '. ' + m.name + '</b><span>' + m.title + '</span></div><i>' + st + '</i>';
   437	        if (i <= SAVE.rank) bindBtn(b, function () { SND.ui(); startMatch(i); }, ladRels);
   438	        elLadList.appendChild(b);
   439	      })(i);
   440	    }
   441	  }

   443	  /* ---------- input ---------- */
   444	  var keys = Object.create(null);
   445	  var pt = { id: null, x0: 0, y0: 0, x: 0, y: 0, t0: 0, fired: false };
   446	  var btnRels = [], ladRels = [];
   447	  function resetInput() {
   448	    pt.id = null; pt.fired = false; pt.x0 = pt.y0 = pt.x = pt.y = 0; pt.t0 = 0;
   449	    for (var k in keys) delete keys[k];
   450	    for (var i = 0; i < btnRels.length; i++) btnRels[i]();
   451	    for (var j = 0; j < ladRels.length; j++) ladRels[j]();
   452	  }
   453	  function bindBtn(el, fn, list) {
   454	    var pid = null;
   455	    el.addEventListener('pointerdown', function (e) {
   456	      e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation();
   457	      if (pid !== null) return;
   458	      pid = e.pointerId; el.classList.add('dn');
   459	      try { el.setPointerCapture(pid); } catch (_) {}
   460	      unlockAudio(); fn();
   461	    }, { passive: false });
   462	    function rel(e) {
   463	      if (pid === null) return;
   464	      if (e && typeof e.pointerId === 'number' && e.pointerId !== pid) return;
   465	      pid = null; el.classList.remove('dn');
   466	    }
   467	    el.addEventListener('pointerup', rel);
   468	    el.addEventListener('pointercancel', rel);
   469	    el.addEventListener('lostpointercapture', rel);
   470	    el.addEventListener('pointerleave', rel);
   471	    (list || btnRels).push(function () { pid = null; el.classList.remove('dn'); });
   472	  }
   473	  function anyOverlay() {
   474	    return ovBoot.classList.contains('show') || ovEnd.classList.contains('show') ||
   475	           ovLad.classList.contains('show') || G.rotate;
   476	  }
   477	  function menuRect() { return { x: W - 54, y: 6, w: 48, h: 48 }; }
   478	  function inRect(r, x, y) { return x >= r.x && x <= r.x + r.w && y >= r.y && y <= r.y + r.h; }
   479	
   480	  stage.addEventListener('pointerdown', function (e) {
   481	    e.preventDefault();
   482	    unlockAudio();
   483	    if (G.phase !== 'fight' || anyOverlay()) return;
   484	    var r = cv.getBoundingClientRect(), x = e.clientX - r.left, y = e.clientY - r.top;
   485	    if (inRect(menuRect(), x, y)) { SND.ui(); buildLadder(); ovLad.classList.add('show'); G.paused = true; resetInput(); return; }
   486	    if (pt.id !== null) return;
   487	    pt.id = e.pointerId; pt.x0 = pt.x = x; pt.y0 = pt.y = y; pt.t0 = performance.now(); pt.fired = false;
   488	    try { stage.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId); } catch (_) {}
   489	  }, { passive: false });
   490	
   491	  stage.addEventListener('pointermove', function (e) {
   492	    if (pt.id !== e.pointerId) return;
   493	    e.preventDefault();
   494	    var r = cv.getBoundingClientRect();
   495	    pt.x = e.clientX - r.left; pt.y = e.clientY - r.top;
   496	    if (pt.fired) return;
   497	    var dx = pt.x - pt.x0, dy = pt.y - pt.y0;
   498	    if (dx * dx + dy * dy > 26 * 26) {
   499	      pt.fired = true;
   500	      if (Math.abs(dx) > Math.abs(dy)) { if (dx > 0) doDash(); else doEvade(); }
   501	      else { if (dy < 0) doStrike('H'); else doStrike('L'); }
   502	    }
   503	  }, { passive: false });
   504	
   505	  function ptEnd(e, up) {
   506	    if (pt.id !== e.pointerId) return;
   507	    e.preventDefault();
   508	    if (up && !pt.fired) {
   509	      var dt = performance.now() - pt.t0;
   510	      var dx = pt.x - pt.x0, dy = pt.y - pt.y0;
   511	      if (dt < 300 && dx * dx + dy * dy < 26 * 26) doParry();
   512	    }
   513	    pt.id = null; pt.fired = false;
   514	  }
   515	  stage.addEventListener('pointerup', function (e) { ptEnd(e, true); }, { passive: false });
   516	  stage.addEventListener('pointercancel', function (e) { ptEnd(e, false); }, { passive: false });
   517	  stage.addEventListener('contextmenu', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); });

   522	    else if (!ovLad.classList.contains('show') && !G.rotate) G.paused = false;

   533	    if (ovLad.classList.contains('show')) { if (k === 'Escape' || k === 'l' || k === 'L') closeLadder(); return; }
   534	    if (G.phase === 'over') {
   535	      if (k === 'Enter') { var n = document.getElementById('bNext'); if (n.style.display !== 'none') n.click(); else document.getElementById('bAgain').click(); }
   536	      if (k === 'r' || k === 'R') document.getElementById('bAgain').click();
   537	      if (k === 'l' || k === 'L') document.getElementById('bLad').click();
   538	      return;

   541	    else if (k === 'ArrowDown') doStrike('L');
   542	    else if (k === 'ArrowRight') doDash();
   543	    else if (k === 'ArrowLeft') doEvade();

   545	    else if (k === 'k' || k === 'K') doGrab();
   546	    else if (k === ' ') doBurst();
   547	    else if (k === '1') setStance(0);
   548	    else if (k === '2') setStance(1);

   550	    else if (k === 'r' || k === 'R') startMatch(G.mi);
   551	    else if (k === 'l' || k === 'L') { buildLadder(); ovLad.classList.add('show'); G.paused = true; resetInput(); }
   552	  });
