   577	  /* ---------- resize ---------- */
   578	  function resize() {
   579	    var r = stage.getBoundingClientRect();
   580	    W = Math.max(200, Math.round(r.width)); H = Math.max(200, Math.round(r.height));
   581	    var dpr = Math.min(2, window.devicePixelRatio || 1);
   582	    var s = dpr, lng = Math.max(W, H) * s;
   583	    if (lng > 960) s = s * 960 / lng;
   584	    SCALE = s;
   585	    cv.width = Math.round(W * s); cv.height = Math.round(H * s);
   586	    cv.style.width = W + 'px'; cv.style.height = H + 'px';
   587	    ctx.setTransform(s, 0, 0, s, 0, 0);
   588	    bamboo.length = 0;
   589	    var n = Math.min(16, Math.round(W / 26));
   590	    for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) {
   591	      bamboo.push({ x: (i + 0.5) / n * W + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 14, w: 3 + Math.random() * 5,
   592	                    h: 0.35 + Math.random() * 0.42, d: 0.3 + Math.random() * 0.7, ph: Math.random() * 6.28 });
   593	    }
   594	    checkRotate();
   595	  }
   596	  function checkRotate() {
   597	    var land = window.innerWidth > window.innerHeight * 1.05 && window.innerHeight < 560;
   598	    if (land !== G.rotate) {
   599	      G.rotate = land;
   600	      ovRot.classList.toggle('show', land);
   601	      if (land) resetInput();
   602	    }
   603	  }
   604	  window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
   605	  window.addEventListener('orientationchange', function () { later(resize, 120); });

   607	  /* ---------- update ---------- */
   608	  function stepFighter(f, dt, isP) {
   609	    f.flash = Math.max(0, f.flash - dt * 0.005);
   610	    f.hurtT = Math.max(0, f.hurtT - dt);
   611	    f.msgT = Math.max(0, f.msgT - dt);
   612	    f.bob += dt * 0.004;
   613	    var a = f.act; if (!a) return;
   614	    a.t += dt;
   615	    if (!a.resolved && a.t >= a.win) {
   616	      a.resolved = true;
   617	      if (isP) { if (a.kind === 'strike' || a.kind === 'grab' || a.kind === 'burst') playerResolve(a); }
   618	      else { if (a.kind === 'H' || a.kind === 'L' || a.kind === 'T' || a.kind === 'G' || a.kind === 'B') enemyResolve(a); }
   619	    }
   620	    if (a.t >= a.total) f.act = null;
   621	  }
   622	
   623	  function update(dt) {
   624	    /* HARDENING 1: rotate overlay freezes the whole simulation */
   625	    if (G.rotate) return;
   626	    G.shake = Math.max(0, G.shake - dt * 0.045);
   627	    G.flash = Math.max(0, G.flash - dt * 0.004);
   628	    G.bannerT = Math.max(0, G.bannerT - dt);
   629	    for (var i = parts.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
   630	      var p = parts[i]; p.l -= dt;
   631	      if (p.l <= 0) { parts.splice(i, 1); continue; }
   632	      p.x += p.vx * dt * 0.001; p.y += p.vy * dt * 0.001;
   633	      if (p.k !== 'ring') { p.vy += dt * 0.35; }
   634	    }
   635	    if (parts.length > MAXP) parts.splice(0, parts.length - MAXP);
   636	
   637	    if (G.phase !== 'fight' || G.paused) return;
   638	
   639	    rangeV += (range - rangeV) * Math.min(1, dt * 0.009);
   640	
   641	    if (G.over > 0) {
   642	      G.over -= dt;
   643	      if (G.over <= 0) { G.over = 0; afterRound(); }
   644	      return;
   645	    }
   646	    if (G.freeze > 0) { G.freeze -= dt; return; }
   647	    if (G.hitstop > 0) { G.hitstop -= dt; return; }
   648	
   649	    G.time = Math.max(0, G.time - dt * 0.001);
   650	
   651	    P.breath = Math.min(100, P.breath + dt * 0.006);
   652	    elBurst.classList.toggle('off', P.breath < BURST_COST);
   653	
   654	    stepFighter(P, dt, true);
   655	    stepFighter(E, dt, false);
   656	
   657	    /* hold-to-grab */
   658	    if (pt.id !== null && !pt.fired) {
   659	      var dx = pt.x - pt.x0, dy = pt.y - pt.y0;
   660	      if (dx * dx + dy * dy < 26 * 26 && performance.now() - pt.t0 >= 300) { pt.fired = true; doGrab(); }
   661	    }
   662	
   663	    /* enemy brain */
   664	    if (!E.act) {
   665	      E.wait -= dt;
   666	      if (E.wait <= 0) { enemyStart(); E.wait = M.gap * (0.85 + Math.random() * 0.3); }
   667	    }
   668	
   669	    /* mist */
   670	    if (Math.random() < dt * 0.004) {
   671	      part(Math.random() * W, groundY() - Math.random() * 40, (Math.random() - 0.5) * 20, -6, 1600, 'rgba(150,175,210,0.16)', 8 + Math.random() * 14, 'mist');
   672	    }
   673	
   674	    if (P.hp <= 0) endRound('e');
   675	    else if (E.hp <= 0) endRound('p');
   676	    else if (G.time <= 0) endRound('t');
   677	
   678	    updateHint();
   679	  }
   680	
   681	  function updateHint() {
   682	    var h;
   683	    var ek = E.act ? E.act.kind : null, ep = phaseOf(E);
   684	    if (ek === 'B' && ep === 'wind') h = 'BURST ART — SWIPE ◀ TO EVADE';
   685	    else if (ek === 'G' && ep === 'wind') h = 'GRAB — SWIPE ◀ TO EVADE';
   686	    else if ((ek === 'H' || ek === 'L' || ek === 'T') && ep === 'wind') h = 'STRIKE INCOMING — TAP TO PARRY';
   687	    else if (ek === 'P') h = 'THEY WAIT — HOLD TO GRAB';
   688	    else if (range === 1) h = 'TOO FAR — SWIPE ▶ TO DASH IN (' + DASH_COST + ')';
   689	    else if (ek === 'stagger' || ek === 'hurt' || ep === 'rec') h = 'OPENING — SWIPE ▲ / ▼ TO STRIKE';
   690	    else if (beats(E.stance, P.stance)) h = 'STANCE LOSS — TAP ' + STN[(E.stance + 2) % 3];
   691	    else if (P.breath >= BURST_COST) h = 'BREATH FULL — BURST ART READY';
   692	    else h = 'STRIKE ' + (E.guard === 'high' ? '▼ LOW' : '▲ HIGH') + ' — THEY GUARD ' + E.guard.toUpperCase();
   693	    if (h !== G.hint) { G.hint = h; hintEl.textContent = h; }
   694	  }

   696	  /* ---------- render ---------- */
   697	  function bar(x, y, w, h, v, col, bg) {
   698	    ctx.fillStyle = bg || '#1a2032'; ctx.fillRect(x, y, w, h);
   699	    ctx.fillStyle = col; ctx.fillRect(x, y, w * clamp(v, 0, 1), h);
   700	    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,.15)'; ctx.lineWidth = 1;
   701	    ctx.strokeRect(x + .5, y + .5, w - 1, h - 1);
   702	  }
   703	
   704	  function drawFighter(f, x, isP) {
   705	    var gy = groundY(), a = f.act, ph = phaseOf(f), col = STC[f.stance];
   706	    var face = isP ? 1 : -1;
   707	    var lean = 0, reach = 0, crouch = 0, ry = -74, sink = 0;
   708	    if (a) {
   709	      var k = a.kind, t = a.t;
   710	      if (k === 'strike' || k === 'burst') {
   711	        var w = a.win, tot = a.win + a.act;
   712	        reach = t < w ? -0.35 * (t / w) : (t < tot ? 1 : Math.max(0, 1 - (t - tot) / a.rec));
   713	        lean = reach * 10;
   714	        ry = (a.d === 'L') ? -46 : (a.d === 'T' ? -70 : -96);
   715	        if (k === 'burst') { ry = -70; reach *= 1.25; }
   716	      } else if (k === 'grab') {
   717	        reach = t < a.win ? 0.2 : 0.9; ry = -70; lean = 6;
   718	      } else if (k === 'parry') { reach = 0.35; ry = -76; lean = -3; }
   719	      else if (k === 'evade') { lean = -12; sink = 6; }
   720	      else if (k === 'dash') { lean = 14; }
   721	      else if (k === 'hurt') { lean = -10; sink = 4; }
   722	      else if (k === 'stagger') { lean = -14; sink = 8; crouch = 6; }
   723	      else if (k === 'H' || k === 'L' || k === 'T' || k === 'G' || k === 'B') {
   724	        var w2 = a.win, tot2 = a.win + a.act;
   725	        reach = t < w2 ? -0.4 * (t / w2) : (t < tot2 ? 1 : Math.max(0, 1 - (t - tot2) / a.rec));
   726	        lean = reach * 10;
   727	        ry = (k === 'L') ? -46 : (k === 'T' ? -70 : -96);
   728	        if (k === 'G') { ry = -70; }
   729	        if (k === 'B') { ry = -70; reach *= 1.2; }
   730	      } else if (k === 'R') { lean = -12; }
   731	    }
   732	    var bobY = Math.sin(f.bob) * 2;
   733	    var hipY = gy - 40 + sink + bobY, shY = gy - 84 + sink + crouch + bobY;
   734	    var sx = x + lean * face;
   735	
   736	    /* shadow */
   737	    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,.42)';
   738	    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(x, gy + 3, 24, 6, 0, 0, 6.3); ctx.fill();
   739	
   740	    /* stance aura */
   741	    ctx.save();
   742	    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.28 + 0.12 * Math.sin(f.bob * 1.4);
   743	    ctx.strokeStyle = col; ctx.lineWidth = 2;
   744	    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, gy - 52, 32, f.bob * 0.6, f.bob * 0.6 + 2.1); ctx.stroke();
   745	    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, gy - 52, 26, f.bob * -0.5 + 3, f.bob * -0.5 + 4.6); ctx.stroke();
   746	    ctx.restore();
   747	
   748	    var body = f.flash > 0.05 ? '#ffffff' : (isP ? '#dfe6f2' : '#c3ccdd');
   749	    ctx.lineCap = 'round';
   750	    /* legs */
   751	    ctx.strokeStyle = body; ctx.lineWidth = 5;
   752	    ctx.beginPath();
   753	    ctx.moveTo(x - 2, hipY); ctx.lineTo(x - 13 - crouch * 0.5, gy);
   754	    ctx.moveTo(x + 2, hipY); ctx.lineTo(x + 13 + crouch * 0.5, gy);
   755	    ctx.stroke();
   756	    /* torso */
   757	    ctx.lineWidth = 9;
   758	    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x, hipY); ctx.lineTo(sx, shY); ctx.stroke();
   759	    /* head */
   760	    ctx.fillStyle = body;
   761	    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(sx + face * 2, shY - 13, 9, 0, 6.3); ctx.fill();
   762	    /* sash */
   763	    ctx.strokeStyle = col; ctx.lineWidth = 3; ctx.globalAlpha = .85;
   764	    ctx.beginPath();
   765	    ctx.moveTo(sx - face * 4, shY + 4);
   766	    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x - face * 22, hipY + 4 + Math.sin(f.bob * 2) * 5, x - face * 34, hipY + 16 + Math.cos(f.bob * 1.7) * 6);
   767	    ctx.stroke(); ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
   768	
   769	    /* arms + blade */
   770	    var ax = sx + face * (10 + 34 * Math.max(0, reach));
   771	    var ay = gy + ry + sink + bobY * .5;
   772	    ctx.strokeStyle = body; ctx.lineWidth = 5;
   773	    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(sx, shY + 4); ctx.lineTo(ax, ay); ctx.stroke();
   774	    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(sx, shY + 6); ctx.lineTo(sx - face * 12, shY + 20); ctx.stroke();
   775	
   776	    /* ribbon blade */
   777	    if (a && (a.kind === 'strike' || a.kind === 'burst' || a.kind === 'H' || a.kind === 'L' || a.kind === 'T' || a.kind === 'B')) {
   778	      ctx.strokeStyle = col; ctx.lineWidth = (a.kind === 'burst' || a.kind === 'B') ? 5 : 3;
   779	      ctx.globalAlpha = ph === 'active' ? 1 : 0.5;
   780	      ctx.beginPath();
   781	      ctx.moveTo(ax, ay);
   782	      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(ax + face * 26, ay - 12, ax + face * 40, ay + (ry < -70 ? 14 : -14));
   783	      ctx.stroke();
   784	      if (ph === 'active') {
   785	        ctx.globalAlpha = .5; ctx.lineWidth = 10;
   786	        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(sx, shY, 46, face > 0 ? -0.9 : 2.2, face > 0 ? 0.9 : 4.1); ctx.stroke();
   787	      }
   788	      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
   789	    }
   790	    /* guard bracket */
   791	    if (!isP) {
   792	      var gyy = E.guard === 'high' ? gy - 96 : gy - 48;
   793	      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(160,190,255,.75)'; ctx.lineWidth = 2;
   794	      ctx.beginPath();
   795	      ctx.moveTo(x - 24, gyy - 8); ctx.lineTo(x - 30, gyy); ctx.lineTo(x - 24, gyy + 8);
   796	      ctx.stroke();
   797	      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(160,190,255,.55)'; ctx.font = '8px ui-monospace,monospace'; ctx.textAlign = 'right';
   798	      ctx.fillText('GUARD', x - 34, gyy + 3);
   799	    }
   800	    /* parry glow */
   801	    if (a && a.kind === 'parry' && ph === 'active') {
   802	      ctx.strokeStyle = '#dff0ff'; ctx.lineWidth = 3; ctx.globalAlpha = .9;
   803	      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x + face * 16, gy - 70, 22, -1.1, 1.1); ctx.stroke(); ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
   804	    }
   805	    /* float msg */
   806	    if (f.msgT > 0 && f.lastMsg) {
   807	      ctx.globalAlpha = Math.min(1, f.msgT / 300);
   808	      ctx.fillStyle = isP ? '#9fe0ff' : '#ffd0c0';
   809	      ctx.font = 'bold 11px ui-monospace,monospace'; ctx.textAlign = 'center';
   810	      ctx.fillText(f.lastMsg, x, gy - 118 - (700 - f.msgT) * 0.03);
   811	      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
   812	    }
   813	  }
   814	
   815	  var TELLTXT = { H: 'HIGH', L: 'LOW', T: 'THRUST', G: 'GRAB', B: 'BURST ART', P: 'GUARD', R: 'STEP BACK', S: 'SHIFT' };
   816	  function drawTell(x) {
   817	    var a = E.act; if (!a) return;
   818	    var txt = TELLTXT[a.kind]; if (!txt) return;
   819	    var showing = (a.kind === 'P' || a.kind === 'R' || a.kind === 'S') ? true : (a.t < a.win);
   820	    if (!showing) return;
   821	    var w = 96, h = 30, bx = x - w / 2, by = groundY() - 172;
   822	    bx = clamp(bx, 4, W - w - 4);
   823	    var danger = a.kind === 'B' ? '#ff8a5a' : (a.kind === 'G' ? '#ffd76a' : '#9fd8ff');
   824	    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(8,10,18,.85)'; ctx.fillRect(bx, by, w, h);
   825	    ctx.strokeStyle = danger; ctx.lineWidth = 1.5; ctx.strokeRect(bx + .5, by + .5, w - 1, h - 1);
   826	    ctx.fillStyle = danger; ctx.font = 'bold 12px ui-monospace,monospace'; ctx.textAlign = 'center';
   827	    ctx.fillText(txt, bx + w / 2, by + 14);
   828	    var pr = a.win > 0 ? clamp(a.t / a.win, 0, 1) : clamp(a.t / (a.act || 1), 0, 1);
   829	    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,.14)'; ctx.fillRect(bx + 6, by + 20, w - 12, 5);
   830	    ctx.fillStyle = danger; ctx.fillRect(bx + 6, by + 20, (w - 12) * pr, 5);
   831	    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(bx + w / 2 - 5, by + h); ctx.lineTo(bx + w / 2 + 5, by + h); ctx.lineTo(bx + w / 2, by + h + 7);
   832	    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(8,10,18,.85)'; ctx.fill();
   833	  }

   835	  function drawHUD() {

   842	
   843	    ctx.textAlign = 'right';
   844	    ctx.fillStyle = '#9fb0cc'; ctx.fillText(M.name, W - pad - 52, 14);
   845	    bar(pad * 2 + bw, 18, bw - 52, 9, E.hp / E.max, E.hp / E.max < 0.28 ? '#ff6a5a' : (M.hue || '#ff8a6a'));
   846	    ctx.fillStyle = STC[E.stance]; ctx.fillText(STN[E.stance], W - pad - 52, 39);
   847	
   848	    /* breath */

   960	    requestAnimationFrame(frame);

   965	    perf = ts;
   966	    update(dt);
   967	    render();

    68	  function loadSave() {
    69	    var fresh = defaultSave();
    70	    try {
    71	      var raw = localStorage.getItem(STORE_KEY);
    72	      if (typeof raw !== "string" || raw.length > 20000) return fresh;
    73	      var parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
    74	      if (!parsed || typeof parsed !== "object" || Array.isArray(parsed)) return fresh;
    75	      var unlocked = Number(parsed.unlockedRoom);
    76	      fresh.unlockedRoom = Number.isFinite(unlocked) ? clampInt(unlocked, 0, 3) : 0;
    77	      if (Array.isArray(parsed.crowns)) {
    78	        for (var i = 0; i < 4; i++) fresh.crowns[i] = parsed.crowns[i] === true;
    79	      }
    80	      if (Array.isArray(parsed.best)) {
    81	        for (var j = 0; j < 4; j++) {
    82	          var score = Number(parsed.best[j]);
    83	          fresh.best[j] = Number.isFinite(score) && score >= 0 ? Math.min(99999999, Math.floor(score)) : 0;
    84	        }
    85	      }
    86	    } catch (error) {
    87	      return defaultSave();
    88	    }
    89	    return fresh;
    90	  }

   122	  function shuffled(values) {
   123	    var result = values.slice();
   124	    for (var i = result.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
   125	      var j = randomInt(i + 1);
   126	      var temp = result[i];
   127	      result[i] = result[j];
   128	      result[j] = temp;
   129	    }
   130	    return result;
   131	  }

   133	  function makeCard() {
   134	    var cells = [];
   135	    for (var column = 0; column < 5; column++) {
   136	      var start = column * 15 + 1;
   137	      var values = shuffled(Array.from({ length: 15 }, function (_, i) { return start + i; })).slice(0, 5).sort(function (a, b) { return a - b; });
   138	      for (var row = 0; row < 5; row++) {
   139	        var free = row === 2 && column === 2;
   140	        cells.push({ value: free ? 0 : values[row], marked: free, free: free });
   141	      }
   142	    }

   144	  }

   214	  function finish(result, reason) {

   239	  function cardHasLine(card) {
   240	    for (var row = 0; row < 5; row++) {
   241	      var completeRow = true;
   242	      for (var col = 0; col < 5; col++) if (!card.cells[col * 5 + row].marked) completeRow = false;
   243	      if (completeRow) return true;
   244	    }
   245	    for (var column = 0; column < 5; column++) {
   246	      var completeColumn = true;
   247	      for (var row2 = 0; row2 < 5; row2++) if (!card.cells[column * 5 + row2].marked) completeColumn = false;
   248	      if (completeColumn) return true;
   249	    }
   250	    return false;
   251	  }
   252	
   253	  function lineCount(card) {
   254	    var count = 0;
   255	    for (var row = 0; row < 5; row++) {
   256	      var rowDone = true;
   257	      for (var col = 0; col < 5; col++) if (!card.cells[col * 5 + row].marked) rowDone = false;
   258	      if (rowDone) count++;
   259	    }
   260	    for (var column = 0; column < 5; column++) {
   261	      var columnDone = true;
   262	      for (var row2 = 0; row2 < 5; row2++) if (!card.cells[column * 5 + row2].marked) columnDone = false;
   263	      if (columnDone) count++;
   264	    }
   265	    return count;
   266	  }

   272	  function cardBlackout(card) {

   277	  function cardProgress(card) {
   278	    var marked = 0;
   279	    for (var i = 0; i < card.cells.length; i++) if (card.cells[i].marked) marked++;
   280	    return marked;
   281	  }

   283	  function cardGoal(card) {
   284	    if (state.roomIndex === 0) return cardHasLine(card);
   285	    if (state.roomIndex === 1) return cardHasCorners(card);
   286	    if (state.roomIndex === 2) return lineCount(card) >= 2;
   287	    return cardBlackout(card);
   288	  }

   290	  function playerWon() {
   291	    return state.cards.some(cardGoal);
   292	  }

   294	  function botWon(bot) {

   298	  function playerProgress() {
   299	    var best = 0;
   300	    state.cards.forEach(function (card) {
   301	      if (state.roomIndex === 0) best = Math.max(best, cardHasLine(card) ? 5 : cardProgress(card));
   302	      else if (state.roomIndex === 1) best = Math.max(best, [0, 4].filter(function (i) { return card.cells[i].marked; }).length + [20, 24].filter(function (i) { return card.cells[i].marked; }).length);
   303	      else if (state.roomIndex === 2) best = Math.max(best, lineCount(card));
   304	      else best = Math.max(best, cardProgress(card));
   305	    });
   306	    return best;
   307	  }
   308	
   309	  function botProgress(bot) {
   310	    var card = bot.card;
   311	    if (state.roomIndex === 0) return cardHasLine(card) ? 5 : cardProgress(card);
   312	    if (state.roomIndex === 1) return [0, 4, 20, 24].filter(function (i) { return card.cells[i].marked; }).length;
   313	    if (state.roomIndex === 2) return lineCount(card);
   314	    return cardProgress(card);
   315	  }

   317	  function markPlayerCell(cardIndex, cellIndex) {
   318	    if (!state.started || state.ended || !state.callLive) {
   319	      setFeedback("That glow is gone. Watch the next call.");
   320	      return;
   321	    }
   322	    var card = state.cards[cardIndex];
   323	    var cell = card && card.cells[cellIndex];
   324	    if (!cell || cell.free || cell.marked) return;
   325	    if (cell.value !== state.currentCall) {
   326	      setFeedback("Not this flare — keep your eyes on the caller.");
   327	      tone(110, 0.04, "square", 0.012);
   328	      return;
   329	    }
   330	    cell.marked = true;
   331	    state.daubedThisCall++;
   332	    var firstForCall = state.daubedThisCall === 1;
   333	    if (firstForCall) {
   334	      state.streak++;
   335	      state.charge++;
   336	      if (state.charge >= 3) {
   337	        state.charge -= 3;
   338	        state.powerCounts[state.powerTurn] = Math.min(3, state.powerCounts[state.powerTurn] + 1);
   339	        state.powerTurn = (state.powerTurn + 1) % 3;
   340	        setFeedback(POWER_NAMES[(state.powerTurn + 2) % 3] + " chip charged.");
   341	      }
   342	    }
   343	    var multiplier = state.doubleTimer > 0 ? 2 : 1;
   344	    state.score += (100 + Math.min(300, state.streak * 25)) * multiplier;
   345	    state.flash = Math.max(state.flash, 0.18);
   346	    state.shake = Math.max(state.shake, 3.5);
   347	    burst(cellCenterX(cardIndex, cellIndex), cellCenterY(cardIndex, cellIndex), THEMES[state.roomIndex].glow, 8);
   348	    tone(420 + state.streak * 25, 0.06, "triangle", 0.03);
   349	    if (playerWon()) finish("win", "Your lantern pattern reached the room goal.");
   350	  }

   352	  function autoDaub() {
   353	    if (!state.callLive || state.currentCall === null) {
   354	      setFeedback("Auto waits for the next live flare.");
   355	      return;
   356	    }
   357	    var hits = 0;
   358	    state.cards.forEach(function (card, cardIndex) {
   359	      card.cells.forEach(function (cell, cellIndex) {
   360	        if (!cell.free && !cell.marked && cell.value === state.currentCall) {
   361	          markPlayerCell(cardIndex, cellIndex);
   362	          hits++;
   363	        }
   364	      });
   365	    });
   366	    setFeedback(hits ? "Auto-daub caught " + hits + " glow" + (hits === 1 ? "" : "s") + "." : "Auto-daub found no matching glow.");
   367	  }

   369	  function usePower(index) {
   370	    if (!state.started || state.ended || state.powerCounts[index] <= 0) return;
   371	    state.powerCounts[index]--;
   372	    if (index === 0) autoDaub();
   373	    if (index === 1) {
   374	      state.doubleTimer = 8;
   375	      setFeedback("Double score: eight seconds of bright work.");
   376	      tone(650, 0.12, "sine", 0.04);
   377	    }
   378	    if (index === 2) {
   379	      state.peekTimer = 4.5;
   380	      state.peekNumbers = state.sequence.slice(state.callCursor, state.callCursor + 3);
   381	      setFeedback("Peeked at the next three flares.");
   382	      tone(720, 0.1, "sine", 0.035);
   383	    }
   384	  }

   386	  function updateBots() {
   387	    if (!state.callLive || state.currentCall === null) return;
   388	    state.bots.forEach(function (bot) {
   389	      if (bot.lastCall === state.callSerial || state.callElapsed < bot.delay) return;
   390	      bot.lastCall = state.callSerial;
   391	      bot.card.cells.forEach(function (cell) {
   392	        if (!cell.free && !cell.marked && cell.value === state.currentCall) cell.marked = true;
   393	      });
   394	      if (botWon(bot)) bot.finished = true;
   395	    });
   396	    if (state.bots.some(function (bot) { return bot.finished; })) finish("fail", "A bot lantern solved the room first.");
   397	  }
   398	
   399	  function update(dt) {
   400	    if (state.orientationLocked || !state.started || state.ended) {
   401	      lastFrame = performance.now();
   402	      return;
   403	    }
   404	    state.timer += dt;
   405	    state.callElapsed += dt;
   406	    if (state.callElapsed >= state.callInterval) nextCall();
   407	    else if (state.callElapsed >= state.callInterval * 0.78) state.callLive = false;
   408	    state.doubleTimer = Math.max(0, state.doubleTimer - dt);
   409	    state.peekTimer = Math.max(0, state.peekTimer - dt);
   410	    state.feedbackTimer = Math.max(0, state.feedbackTimer - dt);
   411	    state.flash = Math.max(0, state.flash - dt * 0.9);
   412	    state.shake = Math.max(0, state.shake - dt * 10);
   413	    updateBots();
   414	    for (var i = state.particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
   415	      var particle = state.particles[i];
   416	      particle.life -= dt;
   417	      particle.x += particle.vx * dt;
   418	      particle.y += particle.vy * dt;
   419	      particle.vy += 28 * dt;
   420	      if (particle.life <= 0) state.particles.splice(i, 1);
   421	    }
   422	    processQueuedActions();
   423	  }
   424	
   425	  function processQueuedActions() {
   426	    var count = Math.min(queuedActions.length, 12);
   427	    for (var i = 0; i < count; i++) {
   428	      var action = queuedActions.shift();
   429	      if (action.type === "card" && action.card < state.cards.length) {
   430	        var match = -1;
   431	        state.cards[action.card].cells.some(function (cell, index) {
   432	          if (!cell.free && !cell.marked && cell.value === state.currentCall) { match = index; return true; }
   433	          return false;
   434	        });
   435	        if (match >= 0) markPlayerCell(action.card, match);
   436	        else setFeedback("That card has no live match for this flare.");
   437	      }
   438	    }
   439	    if (queuedActions.length > 32) queuedActions.splice(0, queuedActions.length - 32);
   440	  }
   441	
   442	  function setFeedback(message) {
   443	    state.feedback = String(message).slice(0, 80);
   444	    state.feedbackTimer = 2.4;
   445	  }

   447	  function burst(x, y, color, amount) {
   448	    var cap = 120;
   449	    var room = cap - state.particles.length;
   450	    var count = Math.min(amount, Math.max(0, room));
   451	    for (var i = 0; i < count; i++) {
   452	      var angle = Math.random() * TAU;
   453	      var speed = 20 + Math.random() * 95;
   454	      state.particles.push({ x: x, y: y, vx: Math.cos(angle) * speed, vy: Math.sin(angle) * speed - 18, life: 0.45 + Math.random() * 0.55, size: 2 + Math.random() * 3, color: color });
   455	    }
   456	  }
   457	
   458	  function later(callback, delay) {
   459	    if (pendingTimeouts.size >= 16) {
   460	      pendingTimeouts.forEach(function (timer) { clearTimeout(timer); });
   461	      pendingTimeouts.clear();
   462	    }
   463	    var timer = setTimeout(function () {
   464	      pendingTimeouts.delete(timer);
   465	      callback();
   466	    }, delay);
   467	    pendingTimeouts.add(timer);
   468	    return timer;
   469	  }
   470	
   471	  function clearInput() {
   472	    pointerMap.clear();
   473	    heldKeys.clear();
   474	    queuedActions.length = 0;
   475	    pendingTimeouts.forEach(function (timer) { clearTimeout(timer); });
   476	    pendingTimeouts.clear();
   477	  }
   478	
   479	  function unlockAudio() {
   480	    try {
   481	      if (!audioContext) {
   482	        var AudioCtor = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
   483	        if (AudioCtor) audioContext = new AudioCtor();
   484	      }
   485	      if (audioContext && audioContext.state === "suspended") audioContext.resume();
   486	    } catch (error) {
   487	      audioContext = null;
   488	    }
   489	  }
   490	
   491	  function tone(frequency, duration, type, volume) {
   492	    if (!audioContext) return;
   493	    try {
   494	      var now = audioContext.currentTime;
   495	      var oscillator = audioContext.createOscillator();
   496	      var gain = audioContext.createGain();
   497	      oscillator.type = type || "sine";
   498	      oscillator.frequency.setValueAtTime(frequency, now);
   499	      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, now);
   500	      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(Math.max(0.0001, volume || 0.025), now + 0.008);
   501	      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, now + duration);
   502	      oscillator.connect(gain);
   503	      gain.connect(audioContext.destination);
   504	      oscillator.start(now);
   505	      oscillator.stop(now + duration + 0.02);
   506	    } catch (error) {
   507	      /* Audio is decorative and can be unavailable in a locked-down browser. */
   508	    }
   509	  }
   510	
   511	  function rounded(x, y, w, h, radius) {
   512	    var r = Math.min(radius, w * 0.5, h * 0.5);
   513	    ctx.beginPath();
   514	    ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
   515	    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
   516	    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
   517	    ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
   518	    ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
   519	    ctx.closePath();
   520	  }
   521	
   522	  function fillRound(x, y, w, h, radius, color) {
   523	    rounded(x, y, w, h, radius);
   524	    ctx.fillStyle = color;
   525	    ctx.fill();
   526	  }
   527	
   528	  function strokeRound(x, y, w, h, radius, color, lineWidth) {
   529	    rounded(x, y, w, h, radius);
   530	    ctx.strokeStyle = color;
   531	    ctx.lineWidth = lineWidth || 1;
   532	    ctx.stroke();
   533	  }
   534	
   535	  function label(text, x, y, size, color, align, weight) {
   536	    ctx.fillStyle = color || "#f6f8fb";
   537	    ctx.font = (weight || 600) + " " + size + "px system-ui, sans-serif";
   538	    ctx.textAlign = align || "left";
   539	    ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
   540	    ctx.fillText(text, x, y);
   541	  }

   543	  function resize() {
   544	    width = Math.max(1, window.innerWidth || 390);
   545	    height = Math.max(1, window.innerHeight || 700);
   546	    var longAxis = Math.max(width, height);
   547	    var dpr = Math.min(2, window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 960 / longAxis);
   548	    canvas.width = Math.floor(width * dpr);
   549	    canvas.height = Math.floor(height * dpr);
   550	    canvas.style.width = width + "px";
   551	    canvas.style.height = height + "px";
   552	    ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
   553	    var locked = width > height;
   554	    if (locked !== state.orientationLocked) {
   555	      state.orientationLocked = locked;
   556	      if (locked) clearInput();
   557	      lastFrame = performance.now();
   558	    }
   559	    orientationCover.hidden = !locked;
   560	  }

   562	  function computeLayout() {
   563	    layout.cards = [];
   564	    layout.cells = [];
   565	    layout.chips = [];
   566	    layout.bot = { x: width - 104, y: 8, w: 92, h: 48 };
   567	    var cardSize = Math.min(190, Math.floor((width - 32) / 2));
   568	    var rows = Math.ceil(state.cards.length / 2);
   569	    var cardY = Math.min(270, height - rows * cardSize - 42);
   570	    cardY = Math.max(232, cardY);
   571	    var gap = 8;
   572	    var gridInset = 6;
   573	    var gridTop = 24;
   574	    for (var i = 0; i < state.cards.length; i++) {
   575	      var x = 12 + (i % 2) * (cardSize + gap);
   576	      var y = cardY + Math.floor(i / 2) * (cardSize + gap);
   577	      var rect = { x: x, y: y, w: cardSize, h: cardSize, gridX: x + gridInset, gridY: y + gridTop, cell: (cardSize - gridInset * 2) / 5, index: i };
   578	      layout.cards.push(rect);
   579	      for (var cell = 0; cell < 25; cell++) {
   580	        var col = Math.floor(cell / 5);
   581	        var row = cell % 5;
   582	        layout.cells.push({ x: rect.gridX + col * rect.cell, y: rect.gridY + row * rect.cell, w: rect.cell, h: rect.cell, card: i, index: cell });
   583	      }
   584	    }
   585	    var chipWidth = (width - 40) / 3;
   586	    for (var chip = 0; chip < 3; chip++) layout.chips.push({ x: 12 + chip * (chipWidth + 8), y: 164, w: chipWidth, h: 48, index: chip });
   587	    layout.start = { x: 20, y: height * 0.5 - 92, w: width - 40, h: 184 };
   588	    layout.end = { x: 28, y: height * 0.5 + 54, w: width - 56, h: 56 };
   589	  }
   590	
   591	  function cellCenter(cardIndex, cellIndex) {
   592	    var rect = layout.cells.find(function (entry) { return entry.card === cardIndex && entry.index === cellIndex; });
   593	    return rect ? { x: rect.x + rect.w * 0.5, y: rect.y + rect.h * 0.5 } : { x: width * 0.5, y: height * 0.5 };
   594	  }

   605	      ctx.beginPath();

   608	    }
   609	    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
   610	    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,.16)";
   611	    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, 58);
   612	  }

   683	  function drawCards() {
   684	    var theme = THEMES[state.roomIndex];
   685	    state.cards.forEach(function (card, cardIndex) {
   686	      var rect = layout.cards[cardIndex];
   687	      fillRound(rect.x, rect.y, rect.w, rect.h, 15, "rgba(17,27,41,.94)");
   688	      strokeRound(rect.x, rect.y, rect.w, rect.h, 15, "#344860", 1);
   689	      label("LANTERN " + String.fromCharCode(65 + cardIndex), rect.x + 9, rect.y + 13, 10, "#b3c1d1", "left", 800);
   690	      label("tap the flare", rect.x + rect.w - 9, rect.y + 13, 9, "#6f8298", "right", 600);
   691	      for (var i = 0; i < 25; i++) {
   692	        var cellRect = layout.cells.find(function (entry) { return entry.card === cardIndex && entry.index === i; });
   693	        var cell = card.cells[i];
   694	        var live = !cell.free && !cell.marked && state.callLive && cell.value === state.currentCall;
   695	        var color = cell.free ? "#2c5660" : cell.marked ? theme.glow : live ? "#4f4f32" : "#1d2b3d";
   696	        fillRound(cellRect.x + 1, cellRect.y + 1, cellRect.w - 2, cellRect.h - 2, 6, color);
   697	        if (live) {
   698	          strokeRound(cellRect.x + 1, cellRect.y + 1, cellRect.w - 2, cellRect.h - 2, 6, "#fff0a8", 2);
   699	          ctx.globalAlpha = 0.18 + (Math.sin(state.callElapsed * 11) + 1) * 0.08;
   700	          fillRound(cellRect.x - 1, cellRect.y - 1, cellRect.w + 2, cellRect.h + 2, 7, theme.glow);
   701	          ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
   702	        }
   703	        if (cell.marked && !cell.free) {
   704	          ctx.globalAlpha = 0.23;
   705	          fillRound(cellRect.x, cellRect.y, cellRect.w, cellRect.h, 7, "#fff4b5");
   706	          ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
   707	        }
   708	        label(cell.free ? "✦" : String(cell.value), cellRect.x + cellRect.w / 2, cellRect.y + cellRect.h / 2 + 1, Math.max(11, Math.min(16, cellRect.w * 0.43)), cell.free ? "#d4f0e4" : cell.marked ? "#111923" : live ? "#fff0ad" : "#d8e1ed", "center", 800);
   709	      }
   710	    });
   711	    var hintY = Math.min(height - 17, layout.cards.length ? layout.cards[layout.cards.length - 1].y + layout.cards[layout.cards.length - 1].h + 22 : height - 17);
   712	    label(state.feedbackTimer > 0 ? state.feedback : "Tap the called number • keys 1–4 daub cards", width / 2, hintY, 10, state.feedbackTimer > 0 ? theme.glow : "#7e8fa5", "center", 700);
   713	  }

   721	    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
   722	  }

   724	  function formatTime(seconds) {
   725	    var whole = Math.max(0, Math.floor(seconds));
   726	    var mins = Math.floor(whole / 60);
   727	    var secs = String(whole % 60).padStart(2, "0");
   728	    return mins + ":" + secs;
   729	  }

   802	  function drawMiniCard(card, x, y, size, theme) {
   803	    var cell = size / 5;
   804	    strokeRound(x, y, size, size, 5, "#435970", 1);
   805	    for (var i = 0; i < 25; i++) {
   806	      var col = Math.floor(i / 5);
   807	      var row = i % 5;
   808	      var entry = card.cells[i];
   809	      ctx.fillStyle = entry.marked ? theme.glow : "#1c2b3d";
   810	      ctx.fillRect(x + col * cell + 1, y + row * cell + 1, cell - 2, cell - 2);
   811	    }
   812	  }
   813	
   814	  function draw() {
   815	    computeLayout();
   816	    drawBackground();
   817	    ctx.save();
   818	    if (state.shake > 0 && !state.orientationLocked) ctx.translate((Math.random() - 0.5) * state.shake, (Math.random() - 0.5) * state.shake);
   819	    drawHeader();
   820	    drawCaller();
   821	    state.chips = layout.chips;
   822	    layout.chips.forEach(function (rect, index) { drawChip(rect, index); });
   823	    drawStatus();
   824	    drawCards();
   825	    drawParticles();
   826	    if (state.flash > 0) {
   827	      ctx.globalAlpha = state.flash;
   828	      ctx.fillStyle = THEMES[state.roomIndex].glow;
   829	      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
   830	      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
   831	    }

   833	    if (state.botView) drawBotView();
   834	    else if (!state.started) drawStartOverlay();
   835	    else if (state.ended) drawEndOverlay();

   838	  function inside(point, rect) {
   839	    return point.x >= rect.x && point.x <= rect.x + rect.w && point.y >= rect.y && point.y <= rect.y + rect.h;
   840	  }
   841	
   842	  function toLocal(event) {
   843	    var rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
   844	    return { x: (event.clientX - rect.left) * (width / rect.width), y: (event.clientY - rect.top) * (height / rect.height) };
   845	  }
   846	
   847	  function hitTest(point) {
   848	    if (state.orientationLocked) return null;
   849	    if (state.botView) {
   850	      var close = { x: width - 80, y: 72, w: 66, h: 58 };
   851	      return inside(point, close) ? { kind: "closeBots" } : null;
   852	    }
   853	    if (!state.started) return inside(point, layout.start) ? { kind: "start" } : null;
   854	    if (state.ended) return inside(point, layout.end) ? { kind: "end" } : null;
   855	    if (inside(point, layout.bot)) return { kind: "bots" };
   856	    for (var i = 0; i < layout.chips.length; i++) if (inside(point, layout.chips[i])) return { kind: "chip", index: i };
   857	    for (var c = 0; c < layout.cells.length; c++) {
   858	      var cell = layout.cells[c];
   859	      if (inside(point, cell)) return { kind: "cell", card: cell.card, index: cell.index };
   860	    }
   861	    return null;
   862	  }
   863	
   864	  function sameHit(a, b) {
   865	    if (!a || !b || a.kind !== b.kind) return false;
   866	    if (a.kind === "cell") return a.card === b.card && a.index === b.index;
   867	    if (a.kind === "chip") return a.index === b.index;
   868	    return true;
   869	  }
   870	
   871	  function invokeHit(hit) {
   872	    if (!hit) return;
   873	    if (hit.kind === "start") beginRun(state.roomIndex);
   874	    if (hit.kind === "end") {
   875	      var next = state.result === "win" && state.roomIndex < 3 ? state.roomIndex + 1 : state.roomIndex;
   876	      beginRun(next);
   877	    }
   878	    if (hit.kind === "bots") state.botView = true;
   879	    if (hit.kind === "closeBots") state.botView = false;
   880	    if (hit.kind === "chip") usePower(hit.index);
   881	    if (hit.kind === "cell") markPlayerCell(hit.card, hit.index);
   882	  }

   884	  function onPointerDown(event) {
   885	    event.preventDefault();
   886	    unlockAudio();
   887	    if (state.orientationLocked) return;
   888	    var id = event.pointerId;
   889	    var point = toLocal(event);
   890	    var hit = hitTest(point);
   891	    if (hit) {
   892	      if (pointerMap.size >= 16) pointerMap.clear();
   893	      pointerMap.set(id, hit);
   894	    }
   895	    if (canvas.setPointerCapture) {
   896	      try { canvas.setPointerCapture(id); } catch (error) { /* pointer may already be gone */ }
   897	    }
   898	  }
   899	
   900	  function onPointerUp(event) {
   901	    event.preventDefault();
   902	    var id = event.pointerId;
   903	    var down = pointerMap.get(id);
   904	    pointerMap.delete(id);
   905	    if (!down || state.orientationLocked) return;
   906	    var up = hitTest(toLocal(event));
   907	    if (sameHit(down, up)) invokeHit(down);
   908	  }
   909	
   910	  function onPointerCancel(event) {
   911	    event.preventDefault();
   912	    pointerMap.delete(event.pointerId);
   913	  }
   914	
   915	  function onKeyDown(event) {
   916	    unlockAudio();
   917	    if (state.orientationLocked) return;
   918	    if (heldKeys.has(event.key)) return;
   919	    if (heldKeys.size >= 64) heldKeys.clear();
   920	    heldKeys.add(event.key);
   921	    var key = event.key.toLowerCase();
   922	    if (key === " " || key === "enter") {
   923	      event.preventDefault();
   924	      if (!state.started) beginRun(state.roomIndex);
   925	      else if (state.ended) invokeHit({ kind: "end" });
   926	    } else if (key === "v") {
   927	      event.preventDefault();
   928	      state.botView = !state.botView;
   929	    } else if (key === "escape" && state.botView) {
   930	      event.preventDefault();
   931	      state.botView = false;
   932	    } else if (key === "r") {
   933	      event.preventDefault();
   934	      if (state.started) beginRun(state.roomIndex);
   935	    } else if (state.started && !state.ended && /^[1-4]$/.test(event.key)) {
   936	      event.preventDefault();
   937	      queuedActions.push({ type: "card", card: Number(event.key) - 1 });
   938	      if (queuedActions.length > 32) queuedActions.shift();
   939	    }
   940	  }

   946	  function loop(now) {
   947	    var dt = lastFrame ? Math.min(0.05, Math.max(0, (now - lastFrame) / 1000)) : 0;
   948	    lastFrame = now;
   949	    update(dt);
   950	    draw();
   951	    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
   952	  }

   491	  function tone(frequency, duration, type, volume) {
   492	    if (!audioContext) return;
   493	    try {
   494	      var now = audioContext.currentTime;
   495	      var oscillator = audioContext.createOscillator();
   496	      var gain = audioContext.createGain();
   497	      oscillator.type = type || "sine";
   498	      oscillator.frequency.setValueAtTime(frequency, now);
   499	      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, now);
   500	      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(Math.max(0.0001, volume || 0.025), now + 0.008);
   501	      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, now + duration);
   502	      oscillator.connect(gain);
   503	      gain.connect(audioContext.destination);
   504	      oscillator.start(now);
   505	      oscillator.stop(now + duration + 0.02);
   506	    } catch (error) {
   507	      /* Audio is decorative and can be unavailable in a locked-down browser. */
   508	    }
   509	  }

   512	    var r = Math.min(radius, w * 0.5, h * 0.5);

     8	  U.easeOut = function (t) { return 1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 3); };
     9	  U.easeInOut = function (t) { return t < 0.5 ? 4 * t * t * t : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * t + 2, 3) / 2; };

    14	    return String(n).replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, ',');

   148	  function Input(canvas, toVirtual) {
   149	    this.canvas = canvas; this.toVirtual = toVirtual;
   150	    this.keys = Object.create(null);
   151	    this.pointers = Object.create(null);   // pointerId -> {x,y,btn}
   152	    this.pressed = null;                   // currently visually-pressed control id
   153	    this.queue = [];                       // action queue
   154	    this.controls = [];                    // hit rects, rebuilt per frame
   155	    this.onAction = null;
   156	    this.enabled = true;
   157	    var self = this;
   158	
   159	    function down(e) {
   160	      if (!self.enabled) return;
   161	      e.preventDefault();
   162	      var pts = e.changedTouches ? e.changedTouches : [e];
   163	      for (var i = 0; i < pts.length; i++) {
   164	        var p = pts[i], id = p.identifier !== undefined ? 't' + p.identifier : 'p' + (p.pointerId || 0);
   165	        var v = self.toVirtual(p.clientX, p.clientY);
   166	        var btn = self.hit(v.x, v.y);
   167	        self.pointers[id] = { x: v.x, y: v.y, btn: btn ? btn.id : null };
   168	        if (btn) self.pressed = btn.id;
   169	      }
   170	    }
   171	    function move(e) {
   172	      if (!self.enabled) return;
   173	      e.preventDefault();
   174	      var pts = e.changedTouches ? e.changedTouches : [e];
   175	      for (var i = 0; i < pts.length; i++) {
   176	        var p = pts[i], id = p.identifier !== undefined ? 't' + p.identifier : 'p' + (p.pointerId || 0);
   177	        var rec = self.pointers[id]; if (!rec) continue;
   178	        var v = self.toVirtual(p.clientX, p.clientY);
   179	        rec.x = v.x; rec.y = v.y;
   180	        var btn = self.hit(v.x, v.y);
   181	        if (!btn || btn.id !== rec.btn) { if (self.pressed === rec.btn) self.pressed = null; }
   182	        else self.pressed = rec.btn;
   183	      }
   184	    }
   185	    function up(e, cancel) {
   186	      if (!self.enabled) { self.releaseAll(); return; }
   187	      if (e.preventDefault) e.preventDefault();
   188	      var pts = e.changedTouches ? e.changedTouches : [e];
   189	      for (var i = 0; i < pts.length; i++) {
   190	        var p = pts[i], id = p.identifier !== undefined ? 't' + p.identifier : 'p' + (p.pointerId || 0);
   191	        var rec = self.pointers[id]; if (!rec) continue;
   192	        delete self.pointers[id];
   193	        if (self.pressed === rec.btn) self.pressed = null;
   194	        if (!cancel && rec.btn) {
   195	          var v = self.toVirtual(p.clientX, p.clientY);
   196	          var btn = self.hit(v.x, v.y);
   197	          if (btn && btn.id === rec.btn) self.fire(rec.btn);
   198	        }
   199	      }
   200	    }
   201	    this._handlers = [];
   202	    function on(t, ev, fn, opt) { t.addEventListener(ev, fn, opt); self._handlers.push([t, ev, fn]); }
   203	
   204	    if (root.PointerEvent) {
   205	      on(canvas, 'pointerdown', down, { passive: false });
   206	      on(canvas, 'pointermove', move, { passive: false });
   207	      on(root, 'pointerup', function (e) { up(e, false); }, { passive: false });
   208	      on(root, 'pointercancel', function (e) { up(e, true); }, { passive: false });
   209	    } else {
   210	      on(canvas, 'touchstart', down, { passive: false });
   211	      on(canvas, 'touchmove', move, { passive: false });
   212	      on(root, 'touchend', function (e) { up(e, false); }, { passive: false });
   213	      on(root, 'touchcancel', function (e) { up(e, true); }, { passive: false });
   214	      on(canvas, 'mousedown', down, { passive: false });
   215	      on(canvas, 'mousemove', move, { passive: false });
   216	      on(root, 'mouseup', function (e) { up(e, false); }, { passive: false });
   217	    }
   218	    on(canvas, 'contextmenu', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); });
   219	
   220	    on(root, 'keydown', function (e) {
   221	      if (!self.enabled) return;
   222	      var k = e.key;
   223	      if (k === ' ' || k === 'Spacebar' || k === 'ArrowLeft' || k === 'ArrowRight' ||
   224	        k === 'ArrowUp' || k === 'ArrowDown' || k === 'Enter') e.preventDefault();
   225	      if (self.keys[k]) return;
   226	      self.keys[k] = 1;
   227	      var a = self.keyMap(k);
   228	      if (a) self.fire(a);
   229	    });
   230	    on(root, 'keyup', function (e) { delete self.keys[e.key]; });
   231	    on(root, 'blur', function () { self.releaseAll(); });
   232	    on(document, 'visibilitychange', function () { if (document.hidden) self.releaseAll(); });
   233	  }
   234	  Input.prototype.keyMap = function (k) {
   235	    if (k === ' ' || k === 'Spacebar' || k === 'Enter') return 'spin';
   236	    if (k === 'ArrowRight' || k === '+' || k === '=') return 'betUp';
   237	    if (k === 'ArrowLeft' || k === '-' || k === '_') return 'betDown';
   238	    if (k === '1') return 'm0'; if (k === '2') return 'm1';
   239	    if (k === '3') return 'm2'; if (k === '4') return 'm3';
   240	    if (k === 'ArrowDown') return 'panelNext';
   241	    if (k === 'ArrowUp') return 'panelPrev';
   242	    if (k === 'r' || k === 'R') return 'reset';
   243	    if (k === 'm' || k === 'M') return 'mute';
   244	    if (k === 'h' || k === 'H' || k === '?') return 'help';
   245	    return null;
   246	  };
   247	  Input.prototype.hit = function (x, y) {
   248	    for (var i = this.controls.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
   249	      var c = this.controls[i];
   250	      if (c.disabled) continue;
   251	      if (x >= c.x && x <= c.x + c.w && y >= c.y && y <= c.y + c.h) return c;
   252	    }
   253	    return null;
   254	  };
   255	  Input.prototype.fire = function (id) {
   256	    if (this.queue.length > 12) return;
   257	    this.queue.push(id);
   258	  };
   259	  Input.prototype.drain = function (fn) {
   260	    var q = this.queue; this.queue = [];
   261	    for (var i = 0; i < q.length; i++) fn(q[i]);
   262	  };
   263	  Input.prototype.releaseAll = function () {
   264	    this.pointers = Object.create(null);
   265	    this.keys = Object.create(null);
   266	    this.pressed = null;
   267	    this.queue.length = 0;
   268	  };
   269	  Input.prototype.reset = function () { this.releaseAll(); this.controls.length = 0; };
   270	
   271	  /* ---------------- particles (capped, hardening #5) ---------------- */
   272	  function Particles(cap) {
   273	    this.cap = cap || 200; this.list = [];
   274	  }
   275	  Particles.prototype.burst = function (x, y, n, color, spd, life) {
   276	    for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) {
   277	      if (this.list.length >= this.cap) this.list.shift();
   278	      var a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2, s = (spd || 120) * (0.35 + Math.random() * 0.9);
   279	      this.list.push({
   280	        x: x, y: y, vx: Math.cos(a) * s, vy: Math.sin(a) * s - 40,
   281	        life: life || 0.7, max: life || 0.7, c: color || '#ffd36b', r: 2 + Math.random() * 3
   282	      });
   283	    }
   284	  };
   285	  Particles.prototype.update = function (dt) {
   286	    var l = this.list;
   287	    for (var i = l.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
   288	      var p = l[i];
   289	      p.life -= dt;
   290	      if (p.life <= 0) { l.splice(i, 1); continue; }
   291	      p.vy += 620 * dt; p.x += p.vx * dt; p.y += p.vy * dt; p.vx *= 0.99;
   292	    }
   293	    if (l.length > this.cap) l.splice(0, l.length - this.cap);
   294	  };
   295	  Particles.prototype.draw = function (g) {
   296	    var l = this.list;
   297	    for (var i = 0; i < l.length; i++) {
   298	      var p = l[i], a = p.life / p.max;
   299	      g.globalAlpha = a < 0 ? 0 : a;
   300	      g.fillStyle = p.c;
   301	      g.fillRect(p.x - p.r, p.y - p.r, p.r * 2, p.r * 2);
   302	    }
   303	    g.globalAlpha = 1;
   304	  };
   305	  Particles.prototype.clear = function () { this.list.length = 0; };
   306	
   307	  /* ---------------- draw helpers ---------------- */
   308	  var D = {};
   309	  D.rr = function (g, x, y, w, h, r) {
   310	    r = Math.min(r, w / 2, h / 2);
   311	    g.beginPath();
   312	    g.moveTo(x + r, y);
   313	    g.lineTo(x + w - r, y); g.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + r);
   314	    g.lineTo(x + w, y + h - r); g.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y + h, x + w - r, y + h);
   315	    g.lineTo(x + r, y + h); g.quadraticCurveTo(x, y + h, x, y + h - r);
   316	    g.lineTo(x, y + r); g.quadraticCurveTo(x, y, x + r, y);
   317	    g.closePath();
   318	  };
   319	  D.text = function (g, s, x, y, size, color, align, weight) {
   320	    g.font = (weight || '600') + ' ' + size + 'px ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace';
   321	    g.textAlign = align || 'left';
   322	    g.textBaseline = 'middle';
   323	    g.fillStyle = color;
   324	    g.fillText(s, x, y);
   325	  };
   326	  D.star = function (g, x, y, r, pts, inner) {
   327	    g.beginPath();
   328	    for (var i = 0; i < pts * 2; i++) {
   329	      var rad = i % 2 ? r * inner : r, a = (i / (pts * 2)) * Math.PI * 2 - Math.PI / 2;
   330	      g[i ? 'lineTo' : 'moveTo'](x + Math.cos(a) * rad, y + Math.sin(a) * rad);
   331	    }
   332	    g.closePath();
   333	  };

    52	  /* ---------------- persistence (hardening #4) ---------------- */
    53	  function load() {
    54	    var d = Store.read();
    55	    G.betIdx = Store.num(d.betIdx, 2, 0, BETS.length - 1) | 0;
    56	    G.mi = Store.num(d.mi, 0, 0, 3) | 0;
    57	    G.panel = Store.num(d.panel, 0, 0, 2) | 0;
    58	    Audio.muted = Store.bool(d.muted, false);
    59	    G.bestPeak = Store.num(d.bestPeak, START_BANK, 0, 1e12);
    60	    var b = Store.obj(d.badges); G.badges = {};
    61	    for (var i = 0; i < BADGE_IDS.length; i++) if (b[BADGE_IDS[i]] === true) G.badges[BADGE_IDS[i]] = true;
    62	    var bs = Store.obj(d.best), lf = Store.obj(d.life);
    63	    G.best = {}; G.life = {};
    64	    M.MACHINES.forEach(function (m) {
    65	      var o = Store.obj(bs[m.id]);
    66	      G.best[m.id] = { peak: Store.num(o.peak, START_BANK, 0, 1e12), big: Store.num(o.big, 0, 0, 1e9) };
    67	      var l = Store.obj(lf[m.id]);
    68	      G.life[m.id] = {
    69	        spins: Store.num(l.spins, 0, 0, 1e9) | 0,
    70	        wagered: Store.num(l.wagered, 0, 0, 1e12),
    71	        won: Store.num(l.won, 0, 0, 1e12)
    72	      };
    73	    });
    74	  }
    75	  function save() {
    76	    Store.write({
    77	      v: 1, betIdx: G.betIdx, mi: G.mi, panel: G.panel, muted: Audio.muted,
    78	      bestPeak: G.bestPeak, badges: G.badges, best: G.best, life: G.life
    79	    });
    80	  }

    84	  function resize() {
    85	    var iw = root.innerWidth, ih = root.innerHeight;
    86	    G.rotate = iw > ih * 1.25;
    87	    var fit = Math.min(iw / VW, ih / VH);
    88	    cssW = Math.floor(VW * fit); cssH = Math.floor(VH * fit);
    89	    var dpr = Math.min(root.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
    90	    if (cssH * dpr > 960) dpr = 960 / cssH;
    91	    canvas.style.width = cssW + 'px';
    92	    canvas.style.height = cssH + 'px';
    93	    canvas.width = Math.max(1, Math.round(cssW * dpr));
    94	    canvas.height = Math.max(1, Math.round(cssH * dpr));
    95	    scale = canvas.width / VW;
    96	    var r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    97	    offX = r.left; offY = r.top;
    98	    g.setTransform(scale, 0, 0, scale, 0, 0);

   101	  function toVirtual(cx, cy) {
   102	    var r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();

   106	  /* ---------------- analysis engine ---------------- */
   107	  function analyseBoot() {
   108	    M.MACHINES.forEach(function (m) {
   109	      if (m.enumerate) m.enumerate(m.an);
   110	    });
   111	  }
   112	  function analyseChunk(budgetMs) {
   113	    if (budgetMs <= 0) return;
   114	    var t0 = root.performance ? performance.now() : Date.now();
   115	    for (var k = 0; k < M.MACHINES.length; k++) {
   116	      var m = M.MACHINES[k];
   117	      if (m.an.done) continue;
   118	      while (m.an.n < m.simTarget) {
   119	        for (var i = 0; i < 150; i++) m.an.add(m.spin(true), 1);
   120	        var t1 = root.performance ? performance.now() : Date.now();
   121	        if (t1 - t0 > budgetMs) return;
   122	      }
   123	      m.an.done = true;
   124	    }
   125	  }

   127	  /* ---------------- helpers ---------------- */
   128	  function machine() { return M.MACHINES[G.mi]; }
   129	  function view() { return [V.A, V.B, V.C, V.D][G.mi]; }
   130	  function bet() { return BETS[G.betIdx]; }
   131	  function tagProb(mi, tag) {
   132	    var an = M.MACHINES[mi].an;
   133	    if (!an.n || !an.tags[tag]) return 0;
   134	    return an.tags[tag].n / an.n;
   135	  }
   136	  function pushCurve(v) {
   137	    var c = G.session.curve;
   138	    c.push(v);
   139	    if (c.length > CURVE_CAP) {
   140	      var out = [], i;
   141	      for (i = 0; i < c.length; i += 2) out.push(c[i]);
   142	      out.push(c[c.length - 1]);
   143	      G.session.curve = out.slice(-CURVE_CAP);
   144	    }
   145	  }
   146	  function toast(text) { G.toast = text; G.toastT = 2.6; }
   147	  function award(id) {
   148	    if (G.badges[id]) return;
   149	    G.badges[id] = true;
   150	    var b = null;
   151	    for (var i = 0; i < BADGES.length; i++) if (BADGES[i].id === id) b = BADGES[i];
   152	    toast('BADGE  ' + (b ? b.name : id));
   153	    Audio.badge();
   154	    parts.burst(VW / 2, L.view.y + L.view.h / 2, 26, '#ffd76b', 190, 1.0);
   155	    save();
   156	  }

   158	  /* ---------------- actions ---------------- */
   159	  function resetBank(quiet) {
   160	    G.bank = START_BANK;
   161	    G.session = { spins: 0, wagered: 0, won: 0, peak: START_BANK, low: START_BANK, curve: [START_BANK], goal: 0 };
   162	    if (!quiet) { G.msg = 'Bank reset - free, always.'; G.msgT = 2.5; Audio.click(); }
   163	    hardReset();
   164	  }
   165	  // hardening #2: clear ALL transient state
   166	  function hardReset() {
   167	    Timers.clearAll();
   168	    input.releaseAll();
   169	    parts.clear();
   170	    dragId = null; dragMoved = 0;
   171	    G.spinning = false; G.res = null; G.flash = 0; G.shake = 0; G.shakeT = 0;
   172	    V.A.reset(); V.B.reset(); V.C.reset(); V.D.reset();
   173	  }
   174	  function selectMachine(i) {
   175	    if (i === G.mi || G.spinning) return;
   176	    G.mi = i; G.panelScroll = 0;
   177	    hardReset();
   178	    Audio.click();
   179	    G.msg = machine().blurb; G.msgT = 2.6;
   180	    save();
   181	  }
   182	  function changeBet(d) {
   183	    var n = U.clamp(G.betIdx + d, 0, BETS.length - 1);
   184	    if (n === G.betIdx) return;
   185	    G.betIdx = n; Audio.click(); save();
   186	  }
   187	  function doSpin() {
   188	    if (G.spinning || G.paused) return;
   189	    var b = bet();
   190	    if (G.bank < b) {
   191	      G.msg = 'Bank too small - tap RESET (free)'; G.msgT = 2.6;
   192	      Audio.lose();
   193	      return;
   194	    }
   195	    G.hint = false;
   196	    G.bank -= b;
   197	    var m = machine();
   198	    var res = m.spin(false);
   199	    G.res = res;
   200	    G.spinning = true;
   201	    G.flash = 0;
   202	    G.msg = ''; G.msgT = 0;
   203	    view().begin(res, FX);
   204	    G.session.spins++;
   205	    G.session.wagered += b;
   206	    var lf = G.life[m.id];
   207	    lf.spins++; lf.wagered += b;
   208	    if (lf.wagered > 1e11) { lf.spins = 0; lf.wagered = 0; lf.won = 0; }  // hardening #5
   209	  }
   210	  function settle() {
   211	    var m = machine(), res = G.res, b = bet();
   212	    var winAmt = res.mult * b;
   213	    G.bank += winAmt;
   214	    G.session.won += winAmt;
   215	    G.life[m.id].won += winAmt;
   216	    G.spinning = false;
   217	    G.flash = res.mult > 0 ? 1 : 0;
   218	    if (res.mult > 0) {
   219	      Audio.win(Math.log(1 + res.mult) * 1.6);
   220	      var pn = Math.min(60, 8 + res.mult * 2) | 0;
   221	      parts.burst(VW / 2, L.view.y + L.view.h * 0.55, pn, '#ffd76b', 150 + Math.min(250, res.mult * 8), 0.85);
   222	      FX.shake(Math.min(18, 3 + res.mult));
   223	      G.msg = 'WIN ' + U.fmt(winAmt) + '  (' + U.mx(res.mult) + ')';
   224	    } else {
   225	      Audio.lose();
   226	      G.msg = 'No win  (0x)';
   227	    }
   228	    G.msgT = 3.2;
   229	    if (res.mult >= 50) award('big_hit');
   230	    if (res.badges) for (var i = 0; i < res.badges.length; i++) award(res.badges[i]);
   231	    if (G.life[m.id].spins >= 100) award('century');
   232	    if (res.mult * b > (G.best[m.id].big || 0)) G.best[m.id].big = res.mult * b;
   233	
   234	    if (G.bank > G.session.peak) {
   235	      G.session.peak = G.bank;
   236	      if (G.bank > G.best[m.id].peak) G.best[m.id].peak = G.bank;
   237	      if (G.bank > G.bestPeak) G.bestPeak = G.bank;
   238	    }
   239	    if (G.bank < G.session.low) G.session.low = G.bank;
   240	    while (G.session.goal < GOALS.length && G.session.peak >= GOALS[G.session.goal]) {
   241	      G.session.goal++;
   242	      toast('GOAL  ' + U.fmt(GOALS[G.session.goal - 1]));
   243	      Audio.fanfare();
   244	    }
   245	    if (G.session.peak >= 5000) award('ladder_v');
   246	    pushCurve(G.bank);
   247	    save();
   248	  }

   251	  var FX = {
   252	    shake: function (a) { G.shake = Math.max(G.shake, a); G.shakeT = 0.32; },
   253	    burstAt: function (i, n, r, color) {
   254	      var b = V.B.cellRect(L.view, i);
   255	      parts.burst(b.x + b.w / 2, b.y + b.h / 2, n, color, 160, 0.7);
   256	    },
   257	    burstCell: function (idx, n, color) {
   258	      var go = V.C.geo(L.view);
   259	      parts.burst(go.x + (idx % 5) * go.s + go.s / 2, go.y + ((idx / 5) | 0) * go.s + go.s / 2, n, color, 130, 0.55);
   260	    }
   261	  };

   263	  /* ---------------- input actions ---------------- */
   264	  function onAction(id) {
   265	    if (!G.started) return;
   266	    if (id === 'spin') doSpin();
   267	    else if (id === 'betUp') changeBet(1);
   268	    else if (id === 'betDown') changeBet(-1);
   269	    else if (id === 'reset') resetBank(false);
   270	    else if (id === 'mute') { Audio.muted = !Audio.muted; if (!Audio.muted) Audio.click(); save(); }
   271	    else if (id === 'help') { G.hint = !G.hint; }
   272	    else if (id.charAt(0) === 'm' && id.length === 2) selectMachine(+id.charAt(1));
   273	    else if (id.charAt(0) === 'p' && id.length === 2) { G.panel = +id.charAt(1); G.panelScroll = 0; Audio.click(); save(); }
   274	    else if (id === 'panelNext') { G.panelScroll += 30; }
   275	    else if (id === 'panelPrev') { G.panelScroll -= 30; }
   276	  }

   304	  function drawButton(rect, label, opts) {
   305	    opts = opts || {};
   306	    var pressed = input.pressed === opts.id && !opts.disabled;
   307	    var y = rect.y + (pressed ? 2 : 0);
   308	    g.fillStyle = opts.disabled ? '#1a2330' : (opts.active ? (opts.accent || '#2a5f8f') : '#1e2836');

   375	  function drawPanel() {
   376	    var p = L.panel;
   377	    g.fillStyle = '#0e141d';
   378	    D.rr(g, 8, p.y, VW - 16, p.h, 10); g.fill();
   379	    g.strokeStyle = '#223042'; g.lineWidth = 2; g.stroke();
   380	    g.save();
   381	    g.beginPath(); D.rr(g, 8, p.y, VW - 16, p.h, 10); g.clip();
   382	    var y = p.y + 14 - G.panelScroll, h = 0;
   383	    var m = machine(), an = m.an;
   384	
   385	    if (G.panel === 0) {
   386	      var src = an.exact ? ('exact - ' + U.fmt(an.n) + ' outcomes')
   387	        : ('sim ' + U.fmt(an.n) + (an.done ? '' : ' / ' + U.fmt(m.simTarget)) + ' spins');
   388	      D.text(g, 'RTP ' + (an.rtp() * 100).toFixed(2) + '%', 18, y, 15, '#8ef0a8', 'left', '800');
   389	      var se = an.exact ? 0 : an.sd() / Math.sqrt(Math.max(1, an.n));
   390	      D.text(g, an.exact ? src : (src + '  +/-' + (se * 200).toFixed(2) + '%'), VW - 18, y, 9, '#6d829b', 'right');
   391	      y += 18;
   392	      D.text(g, 'House edge ' + ((1 - an.rtp()) * 100).toFixed(2) + '%   volatility SD ' + an.sd().toFixed(1) + 'x',
   393	        18, y, 10, '#9fb4cc', 'left'); y += 15;
   394	      D.text(g, 'Hit any ' + U.pct(an.hitAny / an.n) + '   Hit 1x+ ' + U.pct(an.hit1 / an.n) +
   395	        '   Top ' + U.mx(an.max), 18, y, 10, '#9fb4cc', 'left'); y += 15;
   396	      var lf = G.life[m.id];
   397	      D.text(g, lf.wagered > 0
   398	        ? ('YOU: ' + (lf.won / lf.wagered * 100).toFixed(1) + '% over ' + U.fmt(lf.spins) + (lf.spins === 1 ? ' spin' : ' spins'))
   399	        : 'YOU: no spins yet on this machine', 18, y, 10, '#ffd76b', 'left', '700'); y += 17;
   400	      g.strokeStyle = '#22304a'; g.lineWidth = 1;
   401	      g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(16, y - 7); g.lineTo(VW - 16, y - 7); g.stroke();
   402	      panelRow(y, 'OUTCOME', 'FREQUENCY', 'OF RTP', '#6d829b', 9); y += 15;
   403	      var rows = an.n ? an.rows() : [];
   404	      for (var i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
   405	        var r = rows[i];
   406	        panelRow(y, r.label, U.oneIn(r.p), r.rtp > 0 ? (r.rtp / an.rtp() * 100).toFixed(1) + '%' : '-',
   407	          r.rtp > 0.05 ? '#dfe9f5' : '#93a7bd', 11);
   408	        y += 15;
   409	      }
   410	      h = y + G.panelScroll - p.y + 6;
   411	    } else if (G.panel === 1) {
   412	      var s = G.session;
   413	      D.text(g, 'SESSION CURVE  ' + U.fmt(s.spins) + ' spins', 18, y, 11, '#cfe0f2', 'left', '700');
   414	      D.text(g, (s.wagered > 0 ? (s.won / s.wagered * 100).toFixed(1) + '% returned' : '-'), VW - 18, y, 11, '#ffd76b', 'right', '700');
   415	      y += 16;
   416	      drawChart(16, y, VW - 32, 58);
   417	      y += 64;
   418	      D.text(g, 'peak ' + U.fmt(s.peak) + '   low ' + U.fmt(s.low) +
   419	        '   net ' + (G.bank - START_BANK >= 0 ? '+' : '') + U.fmt(G.bank - START_BANK), 18, y, 10, '#9fb4cc', 'left');
   420	      y += 15;
   421	      var nx = s.goal < GOALS.length ? GOALS[s.goal] : null;
   422	      D.text(g, nx ? ('Goal ladder ' + s.goal + '/' + GOALS.length + '  next ' + U.fmt(nx))
   423	        : ('Goal ladder COMPLETE ' + GOALS.length + '/' + GOALS.length), 18, y, 10, nx ? '#9fb4cc' : '#8ef0a8', 'left');
   424	      y += 15;
   425	      D.text(g, 'Bank resets are free and unlimited (RST).', 18, y, 10, '#6d829b', 'left');
   426	      y += 15;
   427	      h = y + G.panelScroll - p.y + 6;
   428	    } else {
   429	      var got = 0;
   430	      for (var k = 0; k < BADGES.length; k++) if (G.badges[BADGES[k].id]) got++;
   431	      D.text(g, 'ODDITY BADGES  ' + got + '/' + BADGES.length, 18, y, 11, '#cfe0f2', 'left', '700'); y += 17;
   432	      for (var j = 0; j < BADGES.length; j++) {
   433	        var bd = BADGES[j], have = !!G.badges[bd.id];
   434	        var odds = '-';
   435	        if (bd.m >= 0 && bd.tag) {
   436	          var pp = tagProb(bd.m, bd.tag);
   437	          if (pp > 0) odds = U.oneIn(pp);
   438	        }
   439	        g.fillStyle = have ? '#2c3f22' : '#161e2a';
   440	        D.rr(g, 16, y - 8, VW - 32, 17, 5); g.fill();
   441	        D.text(g, (have ? '* ' : '  ') + bd.name, 22, y, 10, have ? '#a8f0a8' : '#7f93ab', 'left', '700');
   442	        D.text(g, bd.desc, 128, y, 9, have ? '#9fc9a0' : '#61748a', 'left');
   443	        D.text(g, odds, VW - 22, y, 9, have ? '#cfe0a8' : '#61748a', 'right');
   444	        y += 19;
   445	      }
   446	      h = y + G.panelScroll - p.y + 6;
   447	    }
   448	    g.restore();
   449	    G.panelMax = Math.max(0, h - p.h);
   450	    if (G.panelMax > 0) {
   451	      var frac = p.h / (p.h + G.panelMax);
   452	      var bh = Math.max(18, p.h * frac);
   453	      var by = p.y + (p.h - bh) * (G.panelScroll / G.panelMax);
   454	      g.fillStyle = 'rgba(120,150,190,0.35)';
   455	      D.rr(g, VW - 13, by, 4, bh, 2); g.fill();
   456	    }
   457	  }

   459	  function drawChart(x, y, w, h) {
   460	    var c = G.session.curve;
   461	    g.fillStyle = '#0a0f16';
   462	    D.rr(g, x, y, w, h, 6); g.fill();
   463	    var lo = Math.min.apply(null, c), hi = Math.max.apply(null, c);
   464	    if (hi - lo < 1) { hi = lo + 1; }
   465	    var pad = (hi - lo) * 0.12; lo -= pad; hi += pad;
   466	    function px(i) { return x + (c.length < 2 ? 0 : i / (c.length - 1) * w); }
   467	    function py(v) { return y + h - (v - lo) / (hi - lo) * h; }
   468	    // start reference
   469	    var sy = py(START_BANK);
   470	    if (sy > y && sy < y + h) {
   471	      g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(140,165,195,0.4)'; g.lineWidth = 1;
   472	      g.setLineDash([3, 3]); g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(x, sy); g.lineTo(x + w, sy); g.stroke();
   473	      g.setLineDash([]);
   474	      D.text(g, U.fmt(START_BANK), x + 3, sy - 6, 8, 'rgba(160,180,205,0.7)', 'left');
   475	    }
   476	    // area + line
   477	    g.beginPath();
   478	    for (var i = 0; i < c.length; i++) { var X = px(i), Y = py(c[i]); if (i) g.lineTo(X, Y); else g.moveTo(X, Y); }
   479	    g.strokeStyle = G.bank >= START_BANK ? '#6fe89a' : '#ff9aa5';
   480	    g.lineWidth = 2; g.lineJoin = 'round'; g.stroke();
   481	    g.lineTo(px(c.length - 1), y + h); g.lineTo(px(0), y + h); g.closePath();
   482	    g.fillStyle = G.bank >= START_BANK ? 'rgba(111,232,154,0.12)' : 'rgba(255,154,165,0.12)';
   483	    g.fill();
   484	    if (c.length > 1) {
   485	      g.fillStyle = '#fff';
   486	      g.beginPath(); g.arc(px(c.length - 1), py(c[c.length - 1]), 2.6, 0, 6.284); g.fill();
   487	    }
   488	    g.strokeStyle = '#22304a'; g.lineWidth = 1; D.rr(g, x, y, w, h, 6); g.stroke();
   489	    D.text(g, U.fmt(hi), x + w - 4, y + 8, 8, '#5d738c', 'right');
   490	    D.text(g, U.fmt(lo < 0 ? 0 : lo), x + w - 4, y + h - 8, 8, '#5d738c', 'right');
   491	  }

   109	  function drawGem(g, tier, cx, cy, s, alpha) {
   110	    g.save(); g.translate(cx, cy);
   111	    g.globalAlpha = alpha === undefined ? 1 : alpha;
   112	    g.fillStyle = GEMC[tier];
   113	    var r = s * 0.42, i, a;
   114	    g.beginPath();
   115	    if (tier === 0) { g.rect(-r * 0.82, -r * 0.82, r * 1.64, r * 1.64); }
   116	    else if (tier === 1) { g.moveTo(0, -r); g.lineTo(r, 0); g.lineTo(0, r); g.lineTo(-r, 0); g.closePath(); }
   117	    else if (tier === 2) {
   118	      for (i = 0; i < 6; i++) { a = i / 6 * 6.2832 - 1.5708; g[i ? 'lineTo' : 'moveTo'](Math.cos(a) * r, Math.sin(a) * r); } g.closePath();
   119	    }
   120	    else if (tier === 3) {
   121	      for (i = 0; i < 3; i++) { a = i / 3 * 6.2832 - 1.5708; g[i ? 'lineTo' : 'moveTo'](Math.cos(a) * r * 1.1, Math.sin(a) * r * 1.1); } g.closePath();
   122	    }
   123	    else if (tier === 4) {
   124	      for (i = 0; i < 8; i++) { a = i / 8 * 6.2832; g[i ? 'lineTo' : 'moveTo'](Math.cos(a) * r, Math.sin(a) * r); } g.closePath();
   125	    }
   126	    else { D.star(g, 0, 0, r * 1.1, 6, 0.5); }
   127	    g.fill();
   128	    g.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,.32)';
   129	    g.beginPath(); g.arc(-r * 0.28, -r * 0.3, r * 0.2, 0, 6.284); g.fill();
   130	    g.restore();
   131	    g.globalAlpha = 1;
   132	  }

   134	  /* ---------------- shared view base ---------------- */
   135	  function base(v) {
   136	    v.done = true; v.t = 0; v.res = null;
   137	    v.reset = v.reset || function () { this.done = true; this.t = 0; this.res = null; };
   138	    return v;
   139	  }
   140	  function panelBG(g, r) {
   141	    g.fillStyle = '#141b26';
   142	    D.rr(g, r.x + 8, r.y + 4, r.w - 16, r.h - 8, 14); g.fill();
   143	    g.strokeStyle = '#26364a'; g.lineWidth = 2; g.stroke();
   144	  }

   146	  /* ================= view A - Orchard Classic ================= */
   147	  var CELL = 76;
   148	  var viewA = base({
   149	    reels: [{ pos: 3.5 }, { pos: 17.2 }, { pos: 29.8 }],
   150	    begin: function (res, fx) {
   151	      this.res = res; this.t = 0; this.done = false; this.fx = fx; this.settled = 0;
   152	      for (var i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
   153	        var r = this.reels[i];
   154	        r.phase = 'spin'; r.vel = 0; r.stopAt = 0.5 + i * 0.34; r.top = 44 + i * 5;
   155	        r.tw = 0; r.startPos = r.pos; r.endPos = 0; r.ticked = false;
   156	      }
   157	      Audio.spinUp();
   158	    },
   159	    reset: function () {
   160	      this.done = true; this.t = 0; this.res = null;
   161	      for (var i = 0; i < 3; i++) { this.reels[i].phase = 'idle'; this.reels[i].vel = 0; }
   162	    },
   163	    update: function (dt) {
   164	      if (this.done) return;
   165	      this.t += dt;
   166	      var N = M.A.strip.length, all = true;
   167	      for (var i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
   168	        var r = this.reels[i];
   169	        if (r.phase === 'spin') {
   170	          all = false;
   171	          r.vel = Math.min(r.top, r.vel + 190 * dt);
   172	          r.pos = (r.pos + r.vel * dt) % N;
   173	          if (this.t >= r.stopAt) {
   174	            var base0 = Math.ceil(r.pos) + 4;
   175	            r.startPos = r.pos;
   176	            r.endPos = base0 + ((this.res.stops[i] - base0) % N + N) % N;
   177	            r.phase = 'stop'; r.tw = 0;
   178	          }
   179	        } else if (r.phase === 'stop') {
   180	          all = false;
   181	          r.tw += dt / 0.52;
   182	          var t = Math.min(1, r.tw), e = U.easeOut(t);
   183	          var over = Math.sin(Math.min(1, t) * Math.PI) * 0.16;
   184	          r.pos = U.lerp(r.startPos, r.endPos, e) + over;
   185	          if (t >= 1) {
   186	            r.pos = r.endPos % N; r.phase = 'idle';
   187	            Audio.tick(i); this.fx.shake(3 + i);
   188	            this.settled++;
   189	          }
   190	        }
   191	      }
   192	      if (all && this.t > 0.4) { this.done = true; }
   193	    },
   194	    draw: function (g, r, flash) {
   195	      panelBG(g, r);
   196	      var N = M.A.strip.length, w = 96, gap = 10;
   197	      var x0 = r.x + (r.w - (w * 3 + gap * 2)) / 2;
   198	      var cy = r.y + r.h / 2 - 6;
   199	      // payline
   200	      g.fillStyle = flash > 0 ? 'rgba(255,220,120,' + (0.1 + flash * 0.25) + ')' : 'rgba(255,220,120,0.07)';
   201	      g.fillRect(x0 - 6, cy - CELL / 2, w * 3 + gap * 2 + 12, CELL);
   202	      for (var i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
   203	        var rx = x0 + i * (w + gap), rr = this.reels[i];
   204	        g.save();
   205	        g.beginPath(); D.rr(g, rx, cy - CELL * 1.5, w, CELL * 3, 10); g.clip();
   206	        g.fillStyle = '#0c121b'; g.fillRect(rx, cy - CELL * 1.5, w, CELL * 3);
   207	        var idx = Math.floor(rr.pos), frac = rr.pos - idx;
   208	        var blur = rr.phase === 'spin' ? Math.min(1, rr.vel / 30) : 0;
   209	        for (var o = -2; o <= 2; o++) {
   210	          var s = M.A.strip[((idx + o) % N + N) % N];
   211	          var y = cy + (o - frac) * CELL;
   212	          if (y < cy - CELL * 2 || y > cy + CELL * 2) continue;
   213	          var isLine = Math.abs(y - cy) < 4;
   214	          g.globalAlpha = blur > 0.3 ? 0.5 : (isLine ? 1 : 0.55);
   215	          drawSym(g, s, rx + w / 2, y, 27 * (blur > 0.3 ? 0.9 : 1));
   216	        }
   217	        g.globalAlpha = 1;
   218	        if (blur > 0.3) {
   219	          g.fillStyle = 'rgba(12,18,27,0.35)';
   220	          for (var b = 0; b < 6; b++) g.fillRect(rx, cy - CELL * 1.5 + b * CELL * 0.5, w, 3);
   221	        }
   222	        g.restore();
   223	        g.strokeStyle = rr.phase === 'idle' ? '#3a5170' : '#26364a';
   224	        g.lineWidth = 2; D.rr(g, rx, cy - CELL * 1.5, w, CELL * 3, 10); g.stroke();
   225	      }
   226	      // win box
   227	      if (flash > 0 && this.res && this.res.mult > 0) {
   228	        g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,214,102,' + (0.4 + flash * 0.6) + ')';
   229	        g.lineWidth = 3;
   230	        D.rr(g, x0 - 5, cy - CELL / 2 - 5, w * 3 + gap * 2 + 10, CELL + 10, 10); g.stroke();
   231	      }
   232	      D.text(g, 'PAYLINE', r.x + r.w / 2, cy + CELL * 1.5 + 16, 10, '#5c7a99', 'center');
   233	    }
   234	  });
