   236	  /* ================= view B - Ghost Train ================= */
   237	  var viewB = base({
   238	    cellState: [],
   239	    ensure: function () {
   240	      if (this.cellState.length === 5) return;
   241	      this.cellState = [];
   242	      for (var i = 0; i < 5; i++)
   243	        this.cellState.push({ pos: 2.5 + i * 3.7, vel: 0, stopAt: 0, phase: 'idle', tw: 0, sp: 0, ep: 0, flash: 0 });
   244	    },
   245	    begin: function (res, fx) {
   246	      this.res = res; this.t = 0; this.done = false; this.fx = fx;
   247	      this.phase = 'spin'; this.round = 0; this.rt = 0; this.shown = null;
   248	      this.cellState = [];
   249	      for (var i = 0; i < 5; i++) this.cellState.push({ pos: 2.5 + i * 3.7 + Math.random() * 3, vel: 0, stopAt: 0.42 + i * 0.2, phase: 'spin', tw: 0, sp: 0, ep: 0, flash: 0 });
   250	      Audio.spinUp();
   251	    },
   252	    reset: function () { this.done = true; this.res = null; this.phase = 'idle'; this.cellState = []; this.ensure(); },
   253	    update: function (dt) {
   254	      if (this.done) return;
   255	      this.t += dt;
   256	      var N = M.B.strip.length, i;
   257	      if (this.phase === 'spin') {
   258	        var all = true;
   259	        for (i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
   260	          var c = this.cellState[i];
   261	          if (c.phase === 'spin') {
   262	            all = false;
   263	            c.vel = Math.min(44, c.vel + 180 * dt);
   264	            c.pos = (c.pos + c.vel * dt) % N;
   265	            if (this.t >= c.stopAt) {
   266	              var b0 = Math.ceil(c.pos) + 3;
   267	              // find a strip index carrying the target symbol
   268	              var target = -1;
   269	              for (var k = 0; k < N; k++) { var q = (b0 + k) % N; if (M.B.strip[q] === this.res.cells[i]) { target = q; break; } }
   270	              if (target < 0) target = b0 % N;
   271	              c.sp = c.pos; c.ep = b0 + ((target - b0) % N + N) % N; c.phase = 'stop'; c.tw = 0;
   272	            }
   273	          } else if (c.phase === 'stop') {
   274	            all = false;
   275	            c.tw += dt / 0.4;
   276	            var t = Math.min(1, c.tw);
   277	            c.pos = U.lerp(c.sp, c.ep, U.easeOut(t));
   278	            if (t >= 1) {
   279	              c.pos = c.ep % N; c.phase = 'idle'; c.flash = 1;
   280	              Audio.tick(i); this.fx.shake(3);
   281	              if (this.res.cells[i] === 'COIN') Audio.coin(i);
   282	            }
   283	          }
   284	          if (c.flash > 0) c.flash = Math.max(0, c.flash - dt * 2.5);
   285	        }
   286	        if (all) {
   287	          if (this.res.bonus && this.res.bonus.rounds && this.res.bonus.rounds.length) {
   288	            this.phase = 'bonus'; this.round = 0; this.rt = 0;
   289	            this.shown = this.res.bonus.rounds[0].vals.slice();
   290	            Audio.fanfare();
   291	            this.fx.shake(10);
   292	          } else if (this.t > 0.3) this.done = true;
   293	        }
   294	      } else if (this.phase === 'bonus') {
   295	        this.rt += dt;
   296	        var dur = this.round === 0 ? 0.9 : 0.75;
   297	        if (this.rt >= dur) {
   298	          this.rt = 0; this.round++;
   299	          var rounds = this.res.bonus.rounds;
   300	          if (this.round >= rounds.length) { this.phase = 'bonusEnd'; this.rt = 0; }
   301	          else {
   302	            var rd = rounds[this.round];
   303	            this.shown = rd.vals.slice();
   304	            for (i = 0; i < rd.gained.length; i++) {
   305	              Audio.coin(i);
   306	              this.cellState[rd.gained[i]].flash = 1;
   307	              this.fx.burstAt(rd.gained[i], 5, 14, '#ffd76b');
   308	            }
   309	            if (rd.gained.length) this.fx.shake(8);
   310	          }
   311	        }
   312	        for (i = 0; i < 5; i++) if (this.cellState[i].flash > 0) this.cellState[i].flash -= dt * 2;
   313	      } else if (this.phase === 'bonusEnd') {
   314	        this.rt += dt;
   315	        if (this.rt > 0.7) this.done = true;
   316	      }
   317	    },
   318	    cellRect: function (r, i) {
   319	      var w = 66, gap = 6, x0 = r.x + (r.w - (w * 5 + gap * 4)) / 2;
   320	      return { x: x0 + i * (w + gap), y: r.y + r.h / 2 - 24, w: w, h: 92 };
   321	    },
   322	    draw: function (g, r, flash) {
   323	      panelBG(g, r);
   324	      this.ensure();
   325	      var N = M.B.strip.length, i;
   326	      var inBonus = this.phase === 'bonus' || this.phase === 'bonusEnd';
   327	      for (i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
   328	        var b = this.cellRect(r, i), c = this.cellState[i] || { pos: 0, phase: 'idle', flash: 0 };
   329	        var locked = inBonus && this.shown && this.shown[i] > 0;
   330	        g.save();
   331	        g.beginPath(); D.rr(g, b.x, b.y, b.w, b.h, 10); g.clip();
   332	        g.fillStyle = locked ? '#2a2010' : '#0c121b';
   333	        g.fillRect(b.x, b.y, b.w, b.h);
   334	        if (locked) {
   335	          drawSym(g, 'COIN', b.x + b.w / 2, b.y + b.h / 2 - 8, 24);
   336	          D.text(g, U.mx(this.shown[i]), b.x + b.w / 2, b.y + b.h - 16, 15, '#ffe9a8', 'center', '800');
   337	        } else if (inBonus) {
   338	          var pulse = 0.35 + 0.25 * Math.sin(this.t * 9 + i);
   339	          g.globalAlpha = pulse;
   340	          drawSym(g, 'COIN', b.x + b.w / 2, b.y + b.h / 2, 22);
   341	          g.globalAlpha = 1;
   342	        } else {
   343	          var idx = Math.floor(c.pos), frac = c.pos - idx;
   344	          var blur = c.phase === 'spin' ? 1 : 0;
   345	          for (var o = -1; o <= 1; o++) {
   346	            var s = M.B.strip[((idx + o) % N + N) % N];
   347	            var y = b.y + b.h / 2 + (o - frac) * b.h;
   348	            g.globalAlpha = blur ? 0.55 : 1;
   349	            drawSym(g, s, b.x + b.w / 2, y, 24);
   350	          }
   351	          g.globalAlpha = 1;
   352	        }
   353	        if (c.flash > 0) {
   354	          g.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,235,170,' + (c.flash * 0.45) + ')';
   355	          g.fillRect(b.x, b.y, b.w, b.h);
   356	        }
   357	        g.restore();
   358	        g.lineWidth = 2;
   359	        g.strokeStyle = locked ? '#ffcf5c' : (c.phase === 'idle' ? '#3a5170' : '#26364a');
   360	        D.rr(g, b.x, b.y, b.w, b.h, 10); g.stroke();
   361	      }
   362	      var top = r.y + 26;
   363	      if (inBonus) {
   364	        var rd = this.res.bonus.rounds[Math.min(this.round, this.res.bonus.rounds.length - 1)];
   365	        D.text(g, 'HOLD & RESPIN', r.x + r.w / 2, top, 15, '#ffcf5c', 'center', '800');
   366	        var lbl = this.phase === 'bonusEnd' ? 'TRAIN COMPLETE  ' + U.mx(this.res.bonus.total) :
   367	          'RESPINS LEFT: ' + rd.left + '   LOCKED ' + this.res.bonus.rounds[Math.min(this.round, this.res.bonus.rounds.length - 1)].vals.filter(function (v) { return v > 0; }).length + '/5';
   368	        D.text(g, lbl, r.x + r.w / 2, top + 20, 12, '#c8d6e6', 'center');
   369	      } else {
   370	        D.text(g, 'PAYS ANYWHERE', r.x + r.w / 2, top, 12, '#5c7a99', 'center');
   371	        D.text(g, '3+ COINS WAKE THE TRAIN', r.x + r.w / 2, top + 18, 11, '#7f93ab', 'center');
   372	      }
   373	      if (flash > 0 && this.res && this.res.mult > 0) {
   374	        g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,214,102,' + (0.3 + flash * 0.6) + ')'; g.lineWidth = 3;
   375	        var b0 = this.cellRect(r, 0), b4 = this.cellRect(r, 4);
   376	        D.rr(g, b0.x - 5, b0.y - 5, (b4.x + b4.w) - b0.x + 10, b0.h + 10, 12); g.stroke();
   377	      }
   378	    }
   379	  });

   381	  /* ================= view C - Gem Cascade ================= */
   382	  var viewC = base({
   383	    begin: function (res, fx) {
   384	      this.res = res; this.t = 0; this.done = false; this.fx = fx;
   385	      this.idx = 0; this.st = 0; this.phase = 'drop';
   386	      this.grid = res.steps[0].grid.slice();
   387	      this.prev = null; this.clusters = []; this.mult = 1; this.run = 0;
   388	      Audio.spinUp();
   389	    },
   390	    reset: function () { this.done = true; this.res = null; this.grid = null; this.clusters = []; },
   391	    update: function (dt) {
   392	      if (this.done) return;
   393	      this.t += dt; this.st += dt;
   394	      var steps = this.res.steps, i;
   395	      if (this.phase === 'drop') {
   396	        if (this.st >= 0.55) {
   397	          this.st = 0; this.idx = 1;
   398	          if (this.idx >= steps.length) { this.phase = 'end'; }
   399	          else { this.phase = 'show'; this.clusters = steps[1].clusters; this.mult = steps[1].mult; }
   400	        }
   401	      } else if (this.phase === 'show') {
   402	        if (this.st >= 0.5) {
   403	          this.st = 0; this.phase = 'pop';
   404	          var s = steps[this.idx];
   405	          this.run += s.win;
   406	          for (i = 0; i < s.clusters.length; i++) {
   407	            var cl = s.clusters[i];
   408	            Audio.pop(cl.cells.length - 5);
   409	            for (var j = 0; j < cl.cells.length; j++) this.fx.burstCell(cl.cells[j], 4, GEMC[cl.tier]);
   410	          }
   411	          this.fx.shake(4 + Math.min(10, s.win));
   412	        }
   413	      } else if (this.phase === 'pop') {
   414	        if (this.st >= 0.22) {
   415	          this.st = 0; this.idx++;
   416	          if (this.idx >= steps.length) { this.phase = 'end'; }
   417	          else {
   418	            this.prev = this.grid;
   419	            this.grid = steps[this.idx].grid.slice();
   420	            this.clusters = [];
   421	            this.mult = steps[this.idx].mult;
   422	            this.phase = 'fall';
   423	          }
   424	        }
   425	      } else if (this.phase === 'fall') {
   426	        if (this.st >= 0.3) {
   427	          this.st = 0; this.idx++;
   428	          if (this.idx >= steps.length) { this.phase = 'end'; }
   429	          else { this.phase = 'show'; this.clusters = steps[this.idx].clusters; this.mult = steps[this.idx].mult; }
   430	        }
   431	      } else if (this.phase === 'end') {
   432	        if (this.st > 0.35) this.done = true;
   433	      }
   434	    },
   435	    geo: function (r) {
   436	      var s = Math.min((r.w - 60) / 5, (r.h - 76) / 5);
   437	      return { s: s, x: r.x + (r.w - s * 5) / 2, y: r.y + 46 };
   438	    },
   439	    draw: function (g, r) {
   440	      panelBG(g, r);
   441	      var go = this.geo(r), s = go.s, i, x, y;
   442	      g.fillStyle = '#0c121b';
   443	      D.rr(g, go.x - 5, go.y - 5, s * 5 + 10, s * 5 + 10, 10); g.fill();
   444	      if (!this.grid) {
   445	        D.text(g, 'TAP SPIN', r.x + r.w / 2, go.y + s * 2.5, 14, '#4d6b8a', 'center');
   446	        return;
   447	      }
   448	      var inCluster = null;
   449	      if (this.clusters && this.clusters.length) {
   450	        inCluster = {};
   451	        for (i = 0; i < this.clusters.length; i++)
   452	          for (var j = 0; j < this.clusters[i].cells.length; j++) inCluster[this.clusters[i].cells[j]] = 1;
   453	      }
   454	      var pulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(this.t * 14);
   455	      g.save();
   456	      g.beginPath(); D.rr(g, go.x - 5, go.y - 5, s * 5 + 10, s * 5 + 10, 10); g.clip();
   457	      for (i = 0; i < 25; i++) {
   458	        x = go.x + (i % 5) * s + s / 2;
   459	        y = go.y + ((i / 5) | 0) * s + s / 2;
   460	        var dy = 0, a = 1, sc = 1;
   461	        if (this.phase === 'drop') {
   462	          var pd = U.clamp((this.st - (i % 5) * 0.045) / 0.34, 0, 1);
   463	          dy = -(1 - U.easeOut(pd)) * (s * 5 + 20); a = pd > 0 ? 1 : 0;
   464	        } else if (this.phase === 'fall') {
   465	          var changed = !this.prev || this.prev[i] !== this.grid[i];
   466	          if (changed) { var pf = U.clamp(this.st / 0.28, 0, 1); dy = -(1 - U.easeOut(pf)) * 90; }
   467	        } else if (this.phase === 'pop' && inCluster && inCluster[i]) {
   468	          continue;
   469	        } else if (this.phase === 'show' && inCluster && inCluster[i]) {
   470	          sc = 1 + pulse * 0.14;
   471	          g.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,' + (0.1 + pulse * 0.18) + ')';
   472	          D.rr(g, go.x + (i % 5) * s + 2, go.y + ((i / 5) | 0) * s + 2, s - 4, s - 4, 6); g.fill();
   473	        }
   474	        drawGem(g, this.grid[i], x, y + dy, s * sc * 0.92, a);
   475	      }
   476	      g.restore();
   477	      g.strokeStyle = '#26364a'; g.lineWidth = 2;
   478	      D.rr(g, go.x - 5, go.y - 5, s * 5 + 10, s * 5 + 10, 10); g.stroke();
   479	      var mi = this.mult || 1;
   480	      D.text(g, 'MULT x' + mi, r.x + 20, r.y + 26, 13, mi > 1 ? '#ffd76b' : '#7f93ab', 'left', '800');
   481	      D.text(g, 'CLUSTERS 5+', r.x + r.w / 2, r.y + 26, 11, '#7f93ab', 'center');
   482	      if (this.run > 0) D.text(g, U.mx(this.run), r.x + r.w - 20, r.y + 26, 14, '#8ef0a8', 'right', '800');
   483	    }
   484	  });

   486	  /* ================= view D - Jackpot Wheel ================= */
   487	  var viewD = base({
   488	    angle: 0,
   489	    begin: function (res, fx) {
   490	      this.res = res; this.t = 0; this.done = false; this.fx = fx;
   491	      var lay = M.D.layout, cands = [], i;
   492	      for (i = 0; i < lay.length; i++) if (lay[i] === res.seg) cands.push(i);
   493	      if (!cands.length) cands = [0];
   494	      var w = cands[(Math.random() * cands.length) | 0];
   495	      var step = Math.PI * 2 / lay.length;
   496	      // pointer at top (-PI/2); we want wedge centre under pointer
   497	      var want = -Math.PI / 2 - (w * step + step / 2);
   498	      var cur = this.angle % (Math.PI * 2);
   499	      var delta = ((want - cur) % (Math.PI * 2) + Math.PI * 2) % (Math.PI * 2);
   500	      this.a0 = this.angle;
   501	      this.a1 = this.angle + Math.PI * 2 * 5 + delta;
   502	      this.dur = 3.0; this.wedge = w; this.lastTick = 0;
   503	      Audio.spinUp();
   504	    },
   505	    reset: function () { this.done = true; this.res = null; },
   506	    update: function (dt) {
   507	      if (this.done) return;
   508	      this.t += dt;
   509	      var p = U.clamp(this.t / this.dur, 0, 1);
   510	      var e = 1 - Math.pow(1 - p, 4);
   511	      this.angle = U.lerp(this.a0, this.a1, e);
   512	      var tick = Math.floor((this.angle) / (Math.PI * 2 / M.D.layout.length));
   513	      if (tick !== this.lastTick) {
   514	        this.lastTick = tick;
   515	        if (p < 0.97) Audio.tone(700 - p * 250, 0.025, 'square', 0.05 * (1 - p * 0.7));
   516	      }
   517	      if (p >= 1) {
   518	        if (this.t > this.dur + 0.45) this.done = true;
   519	        else if (this.t - dt <= this.dur) { this.fx.shake(6); }
   520	      }
   521	    },
   522	    draw: function (g, r, flash) {
   523	      panelBG(g, r);
   524	      var lay = M.D.layout, seg = M.D.segments;
   525	      var cx = r.x + r.w / 2, cy = r.y + r.h / 2 + 6;
   526	      var rad = Math.min(r.w / 2 - 30, r.h / 2 - 30);
   527	      var step = Math.PI * 2 / lay.length;
   528	      var cols = ['#1c2531', '#3f6b8f', '#4f8fbf', '#5fb0a0', '#7fbf5f', '#bfa73f', '#d98a3f', '#e0603c', '#d94fe0', '#ffd24d'];
   529	      g.save(); g.translate(cx, cy); g.rotate(this.angle);
   530	      for (var i = 0; i < lay.length; i++) {
   531	        var s = lay[i], a0 = i * step, a1 = a0 + step;
   532	        g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(0, 0); g.arc(0, 0, rad, a0, a1); g.closePath();
   533	        var hot = (this.done || this.t >= this.dur) && i === this.wedge;
   534	        g.fillStyle = hot ? (0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(this.t * 16) > 0.5 ? '#fff3c4' : cols[s]) : cols[s];
   535	        g.fill();
   536	        g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(8,12,18,0.6)'; g.lineWidth = 1.5; g.stroke();
   537	        if (s > 0) {

   543	          g.restore();
   544	        }
   545	      }

     1	/* Carnival Reels - machine math models.
     2	   Pure logic, no DOM. Each machine exposes spin(lite) -> result:
     3	     { mult:Number (x bet), parts:[{tag,label,pay}], ...visual data }
     4	   Analysis is either EXACT (full enumeration) or SIM (monte-carlo chunks). */
     5	(function (root) {
     6	  'use strict';
     7	
     8	  var R = Math.random;
     9	  function pick(strip) { return strip[(R() * strip.length) | 0]; }
    10	  // Build a reel strip and spread symbols evenly around it, so the physical
    11	  // strip reads like a real reel. Stop selection stays uniform, so the maths
    12	  // in the pay tables is unchanged by the ordering.
    13	  function build(weights) {
    14	    var syms = [], k, N = 0;
    15	    for (k in weights) { syms.push(k); N += weights[k]; }
    16	    syms.sort(function (a, b) { return weights[b] - weights[a]; });
    17	    var out = new Array(N), i, j;
    18	    for (i = 0; i < syms.length; i++) {
    19	      var w = weights[syms[i]], step = N / w, off = i * (N / syms.length / 2);
    20	      for (j = 0; j < w; j++) {
    21	        var idx = Math.round(off + j * step) % N, guard = 0;
    22	        while (out[idx] !== undefined && guard++ < N) idx = (idx + 1) % N;
    23	        out[idx] = syms[i];
    24	      }
    25	    }
    26	    for (i = 0; i < N; i++) if (out[i] === undefined) out[i] = syms[0];
    27	    return out;
    28	  }
    29	  function wpick(table) { // table: [[value, weight], ...] with total
    30	    var t = 0, i;
    31	    for (i = 0; i < table.length; i++) t += table[i][1];
    32	    var r = R() * t;
    33	    for (i = 0; i < table.length; i++) { r -= table[i][1]; if (r < 0) return table[i][0]; }
    34	    return table[table.length - 1][0];
    35	  }
    36	
    37	  /* ---------------- analysis accumulator ---------------- */
    38	  function Analysis(exact) {
    39	    this.exact = !!exact;
    40	    this.n = 0; this.sum = 0; this.sumSq = 0;
    41	    this.hitAny = 0; this.hit1 = 0; this.max = 0;
    42	    this.tags = {};       // tag -> {label, n, sum}
    43	    this.order = [];      // tag order of first appearance
    44	    this.done = false;
    45	  }
    46	  Analysis.prototype.add = function (res, w) {
    47	    w = w || 1;
    48	    this.n += w; this.sum += res.mult * w; this.sumSq += res.mult * res.mult * w;
    49	    if (res.mult > 0) this.hitAny += w;
    50	    if (res.mult >= 1) this.hit1 += w;
    51	    if (res.mult > this.max) this.max = res.mult;
    52	    for (var i = 0; i < res.parts.length; i++) {
    53	      var p = res.parts[i], t = this.tags[p.tag];
    54	      if (!t) { t = this.tags[p.tag] = { label: p.label, n: 0, sum: 0 }; this.order.push(p.tag); }
    55	      t.n += w; t.sum += p.pay * w;
    56	    }
    57	  };
    58	  Analysis.prototype.rtp = function () { return this.n ? this.sum / this.n : 0; };
    59	  Analysis.prototype.sd = function () {
    60	    if (this.n < 2) return 0;
    61	    var m = this.sum / this.n, v = this.sumSq / this.n - m * m;
    62	    return v > 0 ? Math.sqrt(v) : 0;
    63	  };
    64	  Analysis.prototype.rows = function () {
    65	    var out = [], self = this;
    66	    this.order.forEach(function (tag) {
    67	      var t = self.tags[tag];
    68	      out.push({
    69	        tag: tag, label: t.label,
    70	        p: t.n / self.n,
    71	        avg: t.n ? t.sum / t.n : 0,
    72	        rtp: t.sum / self.n
    73	      });
    74	    });
    75	    out.sort(function (a, b) { return b.rtp - a.rtp; });
    76	    return out;
    77	  };

    80	  // 38-stop strip, 3 reels, single centre line.

    82	  var A_STRIP = build(A_W);
    83	  var A_TRIPLE = { SE: 420, ST: 120, BE: 50, PL: 18, LE: 12, CH: 4 };

    86	  function aEval(a, b, c) {
    87	    var parts = [], mult = 0;
    88	    if (a === b && b === c) {

    95	      else if (n === 1) { parts.push({ tag: 'CH1', label: 'One Cherry', pay: 0.2 }); mult = 0.2; }
    96	    }
    97	    return { mult: mult, parts: parts };
    98	  }

   117	        an.add(aEval(A_STRIP[i], A_STRIP[j], A_STRIP[k]), 1);

   123	  // 5 cells, count-anywhere pays, 3+ COIN triggers hold & respin.

   125	  var B_STRIP = build(B_W);
   126	  var B_NAME = { LAN: 'Lantern', KEY: 'Key', SKU: 'Skull', GHO: 'Ghost', COIN: 'Coin' };
   127	  var B_PAY = {   //          3     4     5
   128	    GHO: [0, 0, 0, 4, 28, 200],
   129	    SKU: [0, 0, 0, 2.5, 14, 80],
   130	    KEY: [0, 0, 0, 0.9, 4.7, 30],

   133	  var B_COINV = [[2, 34], [3, 24], [5, 16], [8, 12], [15, 8], [38, 4], [120, 2]];
   134	  var B_Q = 0.11;      // per-empty-cell lock chance per respin

   137	  var B = {
   138	    id: 'ghost', name: 'Ghost Train', tag: 'HOLD & SPIN',
   139	    blurb: '5 cells - pays anywhere - 3 coins trigger',
   140	    exact: false, strip: B_STRIP, symNames: B_NAME, pay: B_PAY,
   141	    spin: function (lite) {

   144	      var parts = [], mult = 0, k;

   172	        if (filled === 5) {

   175	          res.badges.push('full_vault');

   186	  /* ================= C. GEM CASCADE ================= */
   187	  var C_COLS = 5, C_ROWS = 5, C_N = 25;
   188	  var C_W = [24, 21, 18, 15, 12, 10];       // gem weights (index = tier)
   189	  var C_TOT = C_W.reduce(function (a, b) { return a + b; }, 0);
   190	  var C_BASE = [0.8, 1.1, 1.6, 2.4, 3.8, 6.5];
   191	  var C_GNAME = ['Quartz', 'Jade', 'Topaz', 'Coral', 'Cobalt', 'Prism'];
   192	  var C_MULT = [1, 2, 3, 5, 8];             // tumble ladder (index = tumble #)
   193	  function cSizeF(n) {
   194	    if (n < 5) return 0;
   195	    if (n === 5) return 1; if (n === 6) return 1.7; if (n === 7) return 2.8;
   196	    if (n === 8) return 4.5; if (n === 9) return 7;
   197	    if (n <= 11) return 12; if (n <= 14) return 32;
   198	    return 150;
   199	  }
   200	  function cGem() {
   201	    var r = R() * C_TOT;
   202	    for (var i = 0; i < 6; i++) { r -= C_W[i]; if (r < 0) return i; }
   203	    return 5;
   204	  }
   205	  var C_SEEN = new Int8Array(C_N), C_STACK = new Int16Array(C_N);
   206	  function cClusters(g) {
   207	    var out = [], i, n;
   208	    for (i = 0; i < C_N; i++) C_SEEN[i] = 0;
   209	    for (i = 0; i < C_N; i++) {
   210	      if (C_SEEN[i] || g[i] < 0) continue;
   211	      var t = g[i], sp = 0, cells = [];
   212	      C_STACK[sp++] = i; C_SEEN[i] = 1;
   213	      while (sp > 0) {
   214	        var c = C_STACK[--sp]; cells.push(c);
   215	        var x = c % C_COLS, y = (c / C_COLS) | 0;
   216	        if (x > 0) { n = c - 1; if (!C_SEEN[n] && g[n] === t) { C_SEEN[n] = 1; C_STACK[sp++] = n; } }
   217	        if (x < C_COLS - 1) { n = c + 1; if (!C_SEEN[n] && g[n] === t) { C_SEEN[n] = 1; C_STACK[sp++] = n; } }
   218	        if (y > 0) { n = c - C_COLS; if (!C_SEEN[n] && g[n] === t) { C_SEEN[n] = 1; C_STACK[sp++] = n; } }
   219	        if (y < C_ROWS - 1) { n = c + C_COLS; if (!C_SEEN[n] && g[n] === t) { C_SEEN[n] = 1; C_STACK[sp++] = n; } }
   220	      }
   221	      if (cells.length >= 5) out.push({ tier: t, cells: cells });
   222	    }
   223	    return out;
   224	  }

   226	  var C = {
   227	    id: 'cascade', name: 'Gem Cascade', tag: 'TUMBLE',
   228	    blurb: '5x5 clusters of 5+ - tumble multipliers',
   229	    exact: false, cols: C_COLS, rows: C_ROWS, gemNames: C_GNAME, mults: C_MULT,
   230	    sizeF: cSizeF, base: C_BASE,
   231	    spin: function (lite) {
   232	      var g = new Int8Array(C_N), i;

   235	      var mult = 0, parts = [], tumble = 0, best = 0;
   236	      for (; ;) {

   238	        if (!cl.length) break;
   239	        var m = C_MULT[Math.min(tumble, C_MULT.length - 1)];
   240	        var stepWin = 0;
   241	        for (i = 0; i < cl.length; i++) {
   242	          var c = cl[i], sz = c.cells.length;

   244	          var pay = C_BASE[c.tier] * cSizeF(sz) * m;
   245	          stepWin += pay;

   247	          parts.push({ tag: 'c' + band, label: 'Cluster of ' + band, pay: pay });
   248	        }

   250	        if (!lite) steps.push({ grid: Array.prototype.slice.call(g), clusters: cl, mult: m, win: stepWin, clear: true });
   251	        // clear + gravity + refill
   252	        for (i = 0; i < cl.length; i++) for (var j = 0; j < cl[i].cells.length; j++) g[cl[i].cells[j]] = -1;
   253	        for (var x = 0; x < C_COLS; x++) {
   254	          var wp = C_ROWS - 1;
   255	          for (var y = C_ROWS - 1; y >= 0; y--) {
   256	            var v = g[y * C_COLS + x];
   257	            if (v >= 0) { g[wp * C_COLS + x] = v; wp--; }
   258	          }
   259	          for (; wp >= 0; wp--) g[wp * C_COLS + x] = cGem();
   260	        }
   261	        tumble++;
   262	        if (!lite) steps.push({ grid: Array.prototype.slice.call(g), clusters: [], mult: C_MULT[Math.min(tumble, C_MULT.length - 1)], win: 0, fall: true });
   263	        if (tumble > 40) break; // hard safety cap
   264	      }
   265	      var res = { mult: mult, parts: parts, steps: steps, tumbles: tumble, best: best, grid: Array.prototype.slice.call(g), badges: [] };
   266	      if (tumble >= 5) { parts.push({ tag: 'deepChain', label: '5+ tumble chain', pay: 0 }); res.badges.push('deep_chain'); }
   267	      if (best >= 13) { parts.push({ tag: 'megaCluster', label: 'Cluster of 13+', pay: 0 }); res.badges.push('mega_cluster'); }
   268	      return res;
   269	    }

   112	  function analyseChunk(budgetMs) {
   113	    if (budgetMs <= 0) return;
   114	    var t0 = root.performance ? performance.now() : Date.now();
   115	    for (var k = 0; k < M.MACHINES.length; k++) {
   116	      var m = M.MACHINES[k];
   117	      if (m.an.done) continue;
   118	      while (m.an.n < m.simTarget) {
   119	        for (var i = 0; i < 150; i++) m.an.add(m.spin(true), 1);
   120	        var t1 = root.performance ? performance.now() : Date.now();
   121	        if (t1 - t0 > budgetMs) return;
   122	      }
   123	      m.an.done = true;
   124	    }
   125	  }

   187	  function doSpin() {
   188	    if (G.spinning || G.paused) return;
   189	    var b = bet();
   190	    if (G.bank < b) {
   191	      G.msg = 'Bank too small - tap RESET (free)'; G.msgT = 2.6;
   192	      Audio.lose();
   193	      return;
   194	    }
   195	    G.hint = false;
   196	    G.bank -= b;
   197	    var m = machine();
   198	    var res = m.spin(false);
   199	    G.res = res;
   200	    G.spinning = true;
   201	    G.flash = 0;
   202	    G.msg = ''; G.msgT = 0;
   203	    view().begin(res, FX);
   204	    G.session.spins++;
   205	    G.session.wagered += b;
   206	    var lf = G.life[m.id];
   207	    lf.spins++; lf.wagered += b;
   208	    if (lf.wagered > 1e11) { lf.spins = 0; lf.wagered = 0; lf.won = 0; }  // hardening #5
   209	  }
   210	  function settle() {
   211	    var m = machine(), res = G.res, b = bet();
   212	    var winAmt = res.mult * b;
   213	    G.bank += winAmt;
   214	    G.session.won += winAmt;
   215	    G.life[m.id].won += winAmt;
   216	    G.spinning = false;
   217	    G.flash = res.mult > 0 ? 1 : 0;
   218	    if (res.mult > 0) {
   219	      Audio.win(Math.log(1 + res.mult) * 1.6);
   220	      var pn = Math.min(60, 8 + res.mult * 2) | 0;
   221	      parts.burst(VW / 2, L.view.y + L.view.h * 0.55, pn, '#ffd76b', 150 + Math.min(250, res.mult * 8), 0.85);
   222	      FX.shake(Math.min(18, 3 + res.mult));
   223	      G.msg = 'WIN ' + U.fmt(winAmt) + '  (' + U.mx(res.mult) + ')';
   224	    } else {
   225	      Audio.lose();
   226	      G.msg = 'No win  (0x)';
   227	    }
   228	    G.msgT = 3.2;
   229	    if (res.mult >= 50) award('big_hit');
   230	    if (res.badges) for (var i = 0; i < res.badges.length; i++) award(res.badges[i]);
   231	    if (G.life[m.id].spins >= 100) award('century');
   232	    if (res.mult * b > (G.best[m.id].big || 0)) G.best[m.id].big = res.mult * b;
   233	
   234	    if (G.bank > G.session.peak) {
   235	      G.session.peak = G.bank;
   236	      if (G.bank > G.best[m.id].peak) G.best[m.id].peak = G.bank;
   237	      if (G.bank > G.bestPeak) G.bestPeak = G.bank;
   238	    }
   239	    if (G.bank < G.session.low) G.session.low = G.bank;
   240	    while (G.session.goal < GOALS.length && G.session.peak >= GOALS[G.session.goal]) {
   241	      G.session.goal++;
   242	      toast('GOAL  ' + U.fmt(GOALS[G.session.goal - 1]));
   243	      Audio.fanfare();
   244	    }
   245	    if (G.session.peak >= 5000) award('ladder_v');
   246	    pushCurve(G.bank);
   247	    save();
   248	  }

   264	  function onAction(id) {
   265	    if (!G.started) return;
   266	    if (id === 'spin') doSpin();
   267	    else if (id === 'betUp') changeBet(1);
   268	    else if (id === 'betDown') changeBet(-1);
   269	    else if (id === 'reset') resetBank(false);
   270	    else if (id === 'mute') { Audio.muted = !Audio.muted; if (!Audio.muted) Audio.click(); save(); }
   271	    else if (id === 'help') { G.hint = !G.hint; }
   272	    else if (id.charAt(0) === 'm' && id.length === 2) selectMachine(+id.charAt(1));
   273	    else if (id.charAt(0) === 'p' && id.length === 2) { G.panel = +id.charAt(1); G.panelScroll = 0; Audio.click(); save(); }
   274	    else if (id === 'panelNext') { G.panelScroll += 30; }
   275	    else if (id === 'panelPrev') { G.panelScroll -= 30; }
   276	  }

   386	      var src = an.exact ? ('exact - ' + U.fmt(an.n) + ' outcomes')
   387	        : ('sim ' + U.fmt(an.n) + (an.done ? '' : ' / ' + U.fmt(m.simTarget)) + ' spins');
   388	      D.text(g, 'RTP ' + (an.rtp() * 100).toFixed(2) + '%', 18, y, 15, '#8ef0a8', 'left', '800');
   389	      var se = an.exact ? 0 : an.sd() / Math.sqrt(Math.max(1, an.n));
   390	      D.text(g, an.exact ? src : (src + '  +/-' + (se * 200).toFixed(2) + '%'), VW - 18, y, 9, '#6d829b', 'right');
   391	      y += 18;
   392	      D.text(g, 'House edge ' + ((1 - an.rtp()) * 100).toFixed(2) + '%   volatility SD ' + an.sd().toFixed(1) + 'x',
   393	        18, y, 10, '#9fb4cc', 'left'); y += 15;
   394	      D.text(g, 'Hit any ' + U.pct(an.hitAny / an.n) + '   Hit 1x+ ' + U.pct(an.hit1 / an.n) +
   395	        '   Top ' + U.mx(an.max), 18, y, 10, '#9fb4cc', 'left'); y += 15;
   396	      var lf = G.life[m.id];
   397	      D.text(g, lf.wagered > 0
   398	        ? ('YOU: ' + (lf.won / lf.wagered * 100).toFixed(1) + '% over ' + U.fmt(lf.spins) + (lf.spins === 1 ? ' spin' : ' spins'))
   399	        : 'YOU: no spins yet on this machine', 18, y, 10, '#ffd76b', 'left', '700'); y += 17;
   400	      g.strokeStyle = '#22304a'; g.lineWidth = 1;
   401	      g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(16, y - 7); g.lineTo(VW - 16, y - 7); g.stroke();
   402	      panelRow(y, 'OUTCOME', 'FREQUENCY', 'OF RTP', '#6d829b', 9); y += 15;
   403	      var rows = an.n ? an.rows() : [];
   404	      for (var i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
   405	        var r = rows[i];
   406	        panelRow(y, r.label, U.oneIn(r.p), r.rtp > 0 ? (r.rtp / an.rtp() * 100).toFixed(1) + '%' : '-',
   407	          r.rtp > 0.05 ? '#dfe9f5' : '#93a7bd', 11);
   408	        y += 15;
   409	      }
   410	      h = y + G.panelScroll - p.y + 6;
   411	    } else if (G.panel === 1) {
   412	      var s = G.session;
   413	      D.text(g, 'SESSION CURVE  ' + U.fmt(s.spins) + ' spins', 18, y, 11, '#cfe0f2', 'left', '700');
   414	      D.text(g, (s.wagered > 0 ? (s.won / s.wagered * 100).toFixed(1) + '% returned' : '-'), VW - 18, y, 11, '#ffd76b', 'right', '700');
   415	      y += 16;
   416	      drawChart(16, y, VW - 32, 58);

   419	        '   net ' + (G.bank - START_BANK >= 0 ? '+' : '') + U.fmt(G.bank - START_BANK), 18, y, 10, '#9fb4cc', 'left');
   420	      y += 15;
   421	      var nx = s.goal < GOALS.length ? GOALS[s.goal] : null;
   422	      D.text(g, nx ? ('Goal ladder ' + s.goal + '/' + GOALS.length + '  next ' + U.fmt(nx))
   423	        : ('Goal ladder COMPLETE ' + GOALS.length + '/' + GOALS.length), 18, y, 10, nx ? '#9fb4cc' : '#8ef0a8', 'left');
   424	      y += 15;
   425	      D.text(g, 'Bank resets are free and unlimited (RST).', 18, y, 10, '#6d829b', 'left');
   426	      y += 15;
   427	      h = y + G.panelScroll - p.y + 6;
   428	    } else {
   429	      var got = 0;

   431	      D.text(g, 'ODDITY BADGES  ' + got + '/' + BADGES.length, 18, y, 11, '#cfe0f2', 'left', '700'); y += 17;
   432	      for (var j = 0; j < BADGES.length; j++) {

   434	        var odds = '-';
   435	        if (bd.m >= 0 && bd.tag) {
   436	          var pp = tagProb(bd.m, bd.tag);
   437	          if (pp > 0) odds = U.oneIn(pp);

   454	      g.fillStyle = 'rgba(120,150,190,0.35)';

   456	    }

   459	  function drawChart(x, y, w, h) {
   460	    var c = G.session.curve;
   460	    var c = G.session.curve;
   461	    g.fillStyle = '#0a0f16';
   462	    D.rr(g, x, y, w, h, 6); g.fill();
   463	    var lo = Math.min.apply(null, c), hi = Math.max.apply(null, c);
   464	    if (hi - lo < 1) { hi = lo + 1; }
   465	    var pad = (hi - lo) * 0.12; lo -= pad; hi += pad;
   466	    function px(i) { return x + (c.length < 2 ? 0 : i / (c.length - 1) * w); }
   467	    function py(v) { return y + h - (v - lo) / (hi - lo) * h; }
   468	    // start reference
   469	    var sy = py(START_BANK);
   470	    if (sy > y && sy < y + h) {
   471	      g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(140,165,195,0.4)'; g.lineWidth = 1;
   472	      g.setLineDash([3, 3]); g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(x, sy); g.lineTo(x + w, sy); g.stroke();
   473	      g.setLineDash([]);
   474	      D.text(g, U.fmt(START_BANK), x + 3, sy - 6, 8, 'rgba(160,180,205,0.7)', 'left');
   475	    }
   476	    // area + line
   477	    g.beginPath();
   478	    for (var i = 0; i < c.length; i++) { var X = px(i), Y = py(c[i]); if (i) g.lineTo(X, Y); else g.moveTo(X, Y); }
   479	    g.strokeStyle = G.bank >= START_BANK ? '#6fe89a' : '#ff9aa5';
   480	    g.lineWidth = 2; g.lineJoin = 'round'; g.stroke();
   481	    g.lineTo(px(c.length - 1), y + h); g.lineTo(px(0), y + h); g.closePath();
   482	    g.fillStyle = G.bank >= START_BANK ? 'rgba(111,232,154,0.12)' : 'rgba(255,154,165,0.12)';
   483	    g.fill();
   484	    if (c.length > 1) {
   485	      g.fillStyle = '#fff';
   486	      g.beginPath(); g.arc(px(c.length - 1), py(c[c.length - 1]), 2.6, 0, 6.284); g.fill();
   487	    }
   488	    g.strokeStyle = '#22304a'; g.lineWidth = 1; D.rr(g, x, y, w, h, 6); g.stroke();
   489	    D.text(g, U.fmt(hi), x + w - 4, y + 8, 8, '#5d738c', 'right');
   490	    D.text(g, U.fmt(lo < 0 ? 0 : lo), x + w - 4, y + h - 8, 8, '#5d738c', 'right');
   491	  }

   495	    drawButton({ x: 14, y: L.bet.y, w: 76, h: L.bet.h }, '-', { id: 'betDown', size: 22, disabled: G.betIdx === 0 });
   496	    drawButton({ x: VW - 90, y: L.bet.y, w: 76, h: L.bet.h }, '+', { id: 'betUp', size: 22, disabled: G.betIdx === BETS.length - 1 });

   508	      canSpin ? 'rgba(230,255,240,0.7)' : '#4b5a6d', 'center');
   509	  }

   553	  function render() {
   554	    g.setTransform(scale, 0, 0, scale, 0, 0);
   555	    g.fillStyle = '#0b1017';
   556	    g.fillRect(0, 0, VW, VH);
   557	    if (G.rotate) { drawRotate(); return; }
   558	
   559	    var sh = 0;
   560	    if (G.shakeT > 0) {
   561	      sh = G.shake * (G.shakeT / 0.32);
   562	      g.translate((Math.random() - 0.5) * sh, (Math.random() - 0.5) * sh);
   563	    }
   564	    drawTop();
   565	    drawTabs();
   566	    view().draw(g, L.view, G.flash);
   567	    parts.draw(g);
   568	    drawToast();
   569	    if (sh) g.setTransform(scale, 0, 0, scale, 0, 0);
   570	    drawMsg();
   571	    drawPanelTabs();
   572	    drawPanel();
   573	    drawBetAndSpin();
   574	    if (!G.started) drawStart();
   575	  }
   576	
   577	  /* ---------------- loop ---------------- */
   578	  var last = 0, acc = 0;
   579	  function frame(ts) {
   580	    root.requestAnimationFrame(frame);
   581	    if (!last) last = ts;
   582	    var dt = (ts - last) / 1000;
   583	    last = ts;
   584	    if (dt > 0.05) dt = 0.05;      // clamped delta
   585	    if (dt < 0) dt = 0;
   586	
   587	    G.paused = G.rotate || document.hidden;
   588	    buildControls();
   589	    input.drain(onAction);
   590	
   591	    if (!G.paused && G.started) {
   592	      // panel drag-scroll
   593	      var found = null, k;
   594	      for (k in input.pointers) if (input.pointers[k].btn === 'panelScroll') { found = input.pointers[k]; break; }
   595	      if (found) {
   596	        if (dragId === null) { dragId = 1; dragY = found.y; dragMoved = 0; }
   597	        else { var d = found.y - dragY; G.panelScroll -= d; dragMoved += Math.abs(d); dragY = found.y; }
   598	      } else dragId = null;
   599	      G.panelScroll = U.clamp(G.panelScroll, 0, G.panelMax);
   600	
   601	      var v = view();
   602	      if (G.spinning) {
   603	        v.update(dt);
   604	        if (v.done) settle();
   605	      }
   606	      parts.update(dt);
   607	      if (G.flash > 0) G.flash = Math.max(0, G.flash - dt * 1.1);
   608	      if (G.shakeT > 0) { G.shakeT -= dt; if (G.shakeT <= 0) G.shake = 0; }
   609	      if (G.msgT > 0) G.msgT -= dt;
   610	      if (G.toastT > 0) { G.toastT -= dt; if (G.toastT <= 0) G.toast = null; }
   611	      analyseChunk(G.spinning ? 1.2 : 5);
   612	    } else if (!G.paused) {
   613	      analyseChunk(6);
   614	    }
   615	    render();
   616	  }
   617	
   618	  /* ---------------- boot ---------------- */
   619	  function boot() {
   620	    canvas = document.getElementById('c');
   621	    g = canvas.getContext('2d', { alpha: false });
   622	    parts = new CR.Particles(220);
   623	    input = new CR.Input(canvas, toVirtual);
   624	    load();
   625	    analyseBoot();
   626	    resize();
   627	    root.addEventListener('resize', resize);
   628	    root.addEventListener('orientationchange', function () { Timers.set(resize, 120); });
   629	    // first gesture starts the game + unlocks audio
   630	    function start(e) {
   631	      if (G.started) return;
   632	      if (e) e.preventDefault();
   633	      Audio.unlock();
   634	      G.started = true;
   635	      input.releaseAll();
   636	      G.msg = machine().blurb; G.msgT = 2.6;
   637	    }
   638	    canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown', start, { passive: false });
   639	    canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', start, { passive: false });
   640	    canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', start, { passive: false });
   641	    root.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
   642	      if (!G.started) { if (e.key === ' ' || e.key === 'Enter') { e.preventDefault(); start(null); } }
   643	    });
   644	    root.requestAnimationFrame(frame);
   645	  }
   646	  if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', boot);
   647	  else boot();
   648	})(window);

    76	        g.beginPath(); g.arc(0, -r * 0.14, r * 0.62, 0, 6.284); g.fill();
    77	        g.fillRect(-r * 0.38, r * 0.28, r * 0.76, r * 0.42);
    78	        g.fillStyle = '#1b2028';
    79	        g.beginPath(); g.arc(-r * 0.24, -r * 0.2, r * 0.17, 0, 6.284); g.fill();
    80	        g.beginPath(); g.arc(r * 0.24, -r * 0.2, r * 0.17, 0, 6.284); g.fill();
    81	        g.fillRect(-r * 0.16, r * 0.3, r * 0.1, r * 0.4);
    82	        g.fillRect(r * 0.06, r * 0.3, r * 0.1, r * 0.4);
    83	        break;
    84	      case 'GHO':
    85	        g.beginPath();
    86	        g.arc(0, -r * 0.12, r * 0.62, Math.PI, 0);
    87	        g.lineTo(r * 0.62, r * 0.56);
    88	        for (var i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
    89	          g.quadraticCurveTo(r * (0.41 - i * 0.41), r * 0.9, r * (0.21 - i * 0.41), r * 0.56);
    90	        }
    91	        g.lineTo(-r * 0.62, r * 0.56); g.closePath(); g.fill();
    92	        g.fillStyle = '#12303c';
    93	        g.beginPath(); g.arc(-r * 0.22, -r * 0.14, r * 0.13, 0, 6.284); g.fill();
    94	        g.beginPath(); g.arc(r * 0.22, -r * 0.14, r * 0.13, 0, 6.284); g.fill();
    95	        break;
    96	      case 'COIN':
    97	        g.beginPath(); g.arc(0, 0, r * 0.78, 0, 6.284); g.fill();
    98	        g.strokeStyle = '#9a6b12'; g.lineWidth = r * 0.1;
    99	        g.beginPath(); g.arc(0, 0, r * 0.55, 0, 6.284); g.stroke();
   100	        g.fillStyle = '#9a6b12';
   101	        D.text(g, '$', 0, r * 0.02, r * 0.72, '#8a5f10', 'center', '800');
   102	        break;
   103	      default:
   104	        g.fillRect(-r * 0.6, -r * 0.6, r * 1.2, r * 1.2);
   105	    }
   106	    g.restore();
   107	  }
   108	
   109	  function drawGem(g, tier, cx, cy, s, alpha) {
   110	    g.save(); g.translate(cx, cy);
   111	    g.globalAlpha = alpha === undefined ? 1 : alpha;
   112	    g.fillStyle = GEMC[tier];
   113	    var r = s * 0.42, i, a;
   114	    g.beginPath();
   115	    if (tier === 0) { g.rect(-r * 0.82, -r * 0.82, r * 1.64, r * 1.64); }
   116	    else if (tier === 1) { g.moveTo(0, -r); g.lineTo(r, 0); g.lineTo(0, r); g.lineTo(-r, 0); g.closePath(); }
   117	    else if (tier === 2) {
   118	      for (i = 0; i < 6; i++) { a = i / 6 * 6.2832 - 1.5708; g[i ? 'lineTo' : 'moveTo'](Math.cos(a) * r, Math.sin(a) * r); } g.closePath();
   119	    }
   120	    else if (tier === 3) {
   121	      for (i = 0; i < 3; i++) { a = i / 3 * 6.2832 - 1.5708; g[i ? 'lineTo' : 'moveTo'](Math.cos(a) * r * 1.1, Math.sin(a) * r * 1.1); } g.closePath();
   122	    }
   123	    else if (tier === 4) {
   124	      for (i = 0; i < 8; i++) { a = i / 8 * 6.2832; g[i ? 'lineTo' : 'moveTo'](Math.cos(a) * r, Math.sin(a) * r); } g.closePath();
   125	    }
   126	    else { D.star(g, 0, 0, r * 1.1, 6, 0.5); }
   127	    g.fill();
   128	    g.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,.32)';
   129	    g.beginPath(); g.arc(-r * 0.28, -r * 0.3, r * 0.2, 0, 6.284); g.fill();
   130	    g.restore();
   131	    g.globalAlpha = 1;
   132	  }

   134	  /* ---------------- shared view base ---------------- */
   135	  function base(v) {
   136	    v.done = true; v.t = 0; v.res = null;
   137	    v.reset = v.reset || function () { this.done = true; this.t = 0; this.res = null; };
   138	    return v;
   139	  }
   140	  function panelBG(g, r) {
   141	    g.fillStyle = '#141b26';
   142	    D.rr(g, r.x + 8, r.y + 4, r.w - 16, r.h - 8, 14); g.fill();
   143	    g.strokeStyle = '#26364a'; g.lineWidth = 2; g.stroke();
   144	  }

   146	  /* ================= view A - Orchard Classic ================= */
   147	  var CELL = 76;
   148	  var viewA = base({
   149	    reels: [{ pos: 3.5 }, { pos: 17.2 }, { pos: 29.8 }],
   150	    begin: function (res, fx) {
   151	      this.res = res; this.t = 0; this.done = false; this.fx = fx; this.settled = 0;
   152	      for (var i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
   153	        var r = this.reels[i];
   154	        r.phase = 'spin'; r.vel = 0; r.stopAt = 0.5 + i * 0.34; r.top = 44 + i * 5;
   155	        r.tw = 0; r.startPos = r.pos; r.endPos = 0; r.ticked = false;
   156	      }
   157	      Audio.spinUp();
   158	    },
   159	    reset: function () {
   160	      this.done = true; this.t = 0; this.res = null;
   161	      for (var i = 0; i < 3; i++) { this.reels[i].phase = 'idle'; this.reels[i].vel = 0; }
   162	    },
   163	    update: function (dt) {
   164	      if (this.done) return;
   165	      this.t += dt;
   166	      var N = M.A.strip.length, all = true;
   167	      for (var i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
   168	        var r = this.reels[i];
   169	        if (r.phase === 'spin') {
   170	          all = false;
   171	          r.vel = Math.min(r.top, r.vel + 190 * dt);
   172	          r.pos = (r.pos + r.vel * dt) % N;
   173	          if (this.t >= r.stopAt) {
   174	            var base0 = Math.ceil(r.pos) + 4;
   175	            r.startPos = r.pos;
   176	            r.endPos = base0 + ((this.res.stops[i] - base0) % N + N) % N;
   177	            r.phase = 'stop'; r.tw = 0;
   178	          }
   179	        } else if (r.phase === 'stop') {
   180	          all = false;
   181	          r.tw += dt / 0.52;
   182	          var t = Math.min(1, r.tw), e = U.easeOut(t);
   183	          var over = Math.sin(Math.min(1, t) * Math.PI) * 0.16;
   184	          r.pos = U.lerp(r.startPos, r.endPos, e) + over;
   185	          if (t >= 1) {
   186	            r.pos = r.endPos % N; r.phase = 'idle';
   187	            Audio.tick(i); this.fx.shake(3 + i);
   188	            this.settled++;
   189	          }
   190	        }
   191	      }
   192	      if (all && this.t > 0.4) { this.done = true; }
   193	    },
   194	    draw: function (g, r, flash) {
   195	      panelBG(g, r);
   196	      var N = M.A.strip.length, w = 96, gap = 10;
   197	      var x0 = r.x + (r.w - (w * 3 + gap * 2)) / 2;
   198	      var cy = r.y + r.h / 2 - 6;
   199	      // payline
   200	      g.fillStyle = flash > 0 ? 'rgba(255,220,120,' + (0.1 + flash * 0.25) + ')' : 'rgba(255,220,120,0.07)';
   201	      g.fillRect(x0 - 6, cy - CELL / 2, w * 3 + gap * 2 + 12, CELL);
   202	      for (var i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
   203	        var rx = x0 + i * (w + gap), rr = this.reels[i];
   204	        g.save();
   205	        g.beginPath(); D.rr(g, rx, cy - CELL * 1.5, w, CELL * 3, 10); g.clip();
   206	        g.fillStyle = '#0c121b'; g.fillRect(rx, cy - CELL * 1.5, w, CELL * 3);
   207	        var idx = Math.floor(rr.pos), frac = rr.pos - idx;
   208	        var blur = rr.phase === 'spin' ? Math.min(1, rr.vel / 30) : 0;
   209	        for (var o = -2; o <= 2; o++) {
   210	          var s = M.A.strip[((idx + o) % N + N) % N];
   211	          var y = cy + (o - frac) * CELL;
   212	          if (y < cy - CELL * 2 || y > cy + CELL * 2) continue;
   213	          var isLine = Math.abs(y - cy) < 4;
   214	          g.globalAlpha = blur > 0.3 ? 0.5 : (isLine ? 1 : 0.55);
   215	          drawSym(g, s, rx + w / 2, y, 27 * (blur > 0.3 ? 0.9 : 1));
   216	        }
   217	        g.globalAlpha = 1;
   218	        if (blur > 0.3) {
   219	          g.fillStyle = 'rgba(12,18,27,0.35)';
   220	          for (var b = 0; b < 6; b++) g.fillRect(rx, cy - CELL * 1.5 + b * CELL * 0.5, w, 3);
   220	          for (var b = 0; b < 6; b++) g.fillRect(rx, cy - CELL * 1.5 + b * CELL * 0.5, w, 3);
   221	        }
   222	        g.restore();
   223	        g.strokeStyle = rr.phase === 'idle' ? '#3a5170' : '#26364a';
   224	        g.lineWidth = 2; D.rr(g, rx, cy - CELL * 1.5, w, CELL * 3, 10); g.stroke();
   225	      }
   226	      // win box
   227	      if (flash > 0 && this.res && this.res.mult > 0) {
   228	        g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,214,102,' + (0.4 + flash * 0.6) + ')';
   229	        g.lineWidth = 3;
   230	        D.rr(g, x0 - 5, cy - CELL / 2 - 5, w * 3 + gap * 2 + 10, CELL + 10, 10); g.stroke();
   231	      }
   232	      D.text(g, 'PAYLINE', r.x + r.w / 2, cy + CELL * 1.5 + 16, 10, '#5c7a99', 'center');
   233	    }
   234	  });

   236	  /* ================= view B - Ghost Train ================= */
   237	  var viewB = base({
   238	    cellState: [],
   239	    ensure: function () {
   240	      if (this.cellState.length === 5) return;
   241	      this.cellState = [];
   242	      for (var i = 0; i < 5; i++)
   243	        this.cellState.push({ pos: 2.5 + i * 3.7, vel: 0, stopAt: 0, phase: 'idle', tw: 0, sp: 0, ep: 0, flash: 0 });
   244	    },
   245	    begin: function (res, fx) {
   246	      this.res = res; this.t = 0; this.done = false; this.fx = fx;
   247	      this.phase = 'spin'; this.round = 0; this.rt = 0; this.shown = null;
   248	      this.cellState = [];
   249	      for (var i = 0; i < 5; i++) this.cellState.push({ pos: 2.5 + i * 3.7 + Math.random() * 3, vel: 0, stopAt: 0.42 + i * 0.2, phase: 'spin', tw: 0, sp: 0, ep: 0, flash: 0 });
   250	      Audio.spinUp();
   251	    },
   252	    reset: function () { this.done = true; this.res = null; this.phase = 'idle'; this.cellState = []; this.ensure(); },
   253	    update: function (dt) {
   254	      if (this.done) return;
   255	      this.t += dt;
   256	      var N = M.B.strip.length, i;
   257	      if (this.phase === 'spin') {
   258	        var all = true;
   259	        for (i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
   260	          var c = this.cellState[i];
   261	          if (c.phase === 'spin') {
   262	            all = false;
   263	            c.vel = Math.min(44, c.vel + 180 * dt);
   264	            c.pos = (c.pos + c.vel * dt) % N;
   265	            if (this.t >= c.stopAt) {
   266	              var b0 = Math.ceil(c.pos) + 3;
   267	              // find a strip index carrying the target symbol
   268	              var target = -1;
   269	              for (var k = 0; k < N; k++) { var q = (b0 + k) % N; if (M.B.strip[q] === this.res.cells[i]) { target = q; break; } }
   270	              if (target < 0) target = b0 % N;
   271	              c.sp = c.pos; c.ep = b0 + ((target - b0) % N + N) % N; c.phase = 'stop'; c.tw = 0;
   272	            }
   273	          } else if (c.phase === 'stop') {
   274	            all = false;
   275	            c.tw += dt / 0.4;
   276	            var t = Math.min(1, c.tw);
   277	            c.pos = U.lerp(c.sp, c.ep, U.easeOut(t));
   278	            if (t >= 1) {
   279	              c.pos = c.ep % N; c.phase = 'idle'; c.flash = 1;
   280	              Audio.tick(i); this.fx.shake(3);
   281	              if (this.res.cells[i] === 'COIN') Audio.coin(i);
   282	            }
   283	          }
   284	          if (c.flash > 0) c.flash = Math.max(0, c.flash - dt * 2.5);
   285	        }
   286	        if (all) {
   287	          if (this.res.bonus && this.res.bonus.rounds && this.res.bonus.rounds.length) {
   288	            this.phase = 'bonus'; this.round = 0; this.rt = 0;
   289	            this.shown = this.res.bonus.rounds[0].vals.slice();
   290	            Audio.fanfare();
   291	            this.fx.shake(10);
   292	          } else if (this.t > 0.3) this.done = true;
   293	        }
   294	      } else if (this.phase === 'bonus') {
   295	        this.rt += dt;
   296	        var dur = this.round === 0 ? 0.9 : 0.75;
   297	        if (this.rt >= dur) {
   298	          this.rt = 0; this.round++;
   299	          var rounds = this.res.bonus.rounds;
   300	          if (this.round >= rounds.length) { this.phase = 'bonusEnd'; this.rt = 0; }
   301	          else {
   302	            var rd = rounds[this.round];
   303	            this.shown = rd.vals.slice();
   304	            for (i = 0; i < rd.gained.length; i++) {
   305	              Audio.coin(i);
   306	              this.cellState[rd.gained[i]].flash = 1;
   307	              this.fx.burstAt(rd.gained[i], 5, 14, '#ffd76b');
   308	            }
   309	            if (rd.gained.length) this.fx.shake(8);
   310	          }
   311	        }
   312	        for (i = 0; i < 5; i++) if (this.cellState[i].flash > 0) this.cellState[i].flash -= dt * 2;
   313	      } else if (this.phase === 'bonusEnd') {
   314	        this.rt += dt;
   315	        if (this.rt > 0.7) this.done = true;
   316	      }
   317	    },
   318	    cellRect: function (r, i) {
   319	      var w = 66, gap = 6, x0 = r.x + (r.w - (w * 5 + gap * 4)) / 2;
   320	      return { x: x0 + i * (w + gap), y: r.y + r.h / 2 - 24, w: w, h: 92 };
   321	    },
   322	    draw: function (g, r, flash) {
   323	      panelBG(g, r);
   324	      this.ensure();
   325	      var N = M.B.strip.length, i;
   326	      var inBonus = this.phase === 'bonus' || this.phase === 'bonusEnd';
   327	      for (i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
   328	        var b = this.cellRect(r, i), c = this.cellState[i] || { pos: 0, phase: 'idle', flash: 0 };
   329	        var locked = inBonus && this.shown && this.shown[i] > 0;
   330	        g.save();
   331	        g.beginPath(); D.rr(g, b.x, b.y, b.w, b.h, 10); g.clip();
   332	        g.fillStyle = locked ? '#2a2010' : '#0c121b';
   333	        g.fillRect(b.x, b.y, b.w, b.h);
   334	        if (locked) {
   335	          drawSym(g, 'COIN', b.x + b.w / 2, b.y + b.h / 2 - 8, 24);
   336	          D.text(g, U.mx(this.shown[i]), b.x + b.w / 2, b.y + b.h - 16, 15, '#ffe9a8', 'center', '800');
   337	        } else if (inBonus) {
   338	          var pulse = 0.35 + 0.25 * Math.sin(this.t * 9 + i);
   339	          g.globalAlpha = pulse;
   340	          drawSym(g, 'COIN', b.x + b.w / 2, b.y + b.h / 2, 22);
   341	          g.globalAlpha = 1;
   342	        } else {
   343	          var idx = Math.floor(c.pos), frac = c.pos - idx;
   344	          var blur = c.phase === 'spin' ? 1 : 0;
   345	          for (var o = -1; o <= 1; o++) {
   346	            var s = M.B.strip[((idx + o) % N + N) % N];
   347	            var y = b.y + b.h / 2 + (o - frac) * b.h;
   348	            g.globalAlpha = blur ? 0.55 : 1;
   349	            drawSym(g, s, b.x + b.w / 2, y, 24);
   350	          }
   351	          g.globalAlpha = 1;
   352	        }
   353	        if (c.flash > 0) {
   354	          g.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,235,170,' + (c.flash * 0.45) + ')';
   355	          g.fillRect(b.x, b.y, b.w, b.h);
   356	        }
   357	        g.restore();
   358	        g.lineWidth = 2;
   359	        g.strokeStyle = locked ? '#ffcf5c' : (c.phase === 'idle' ? '#3a5170' : '#26364a');
   360	        D.rr(g, b.x, b.y, b.w, b.h, 10); g.stroke();
   361	      }
   362	      var top = r.y + 26;
   363	      if (inBonus) {
   364	        var rd = this.res.bonus.rounds[Math.min(this.round, this.res.bonus.rounds.length - 1)];
   365	        D.text(g, 'HOLD & RESPIN', r.x + r.w / 2, top, 15, '#ffcf5c', 'center', '800');
   366	        var lbl = this.phase === 'bonusEnd' ? 'TRAIN COMPLETE  ' + U.mx(this.res.bonus.total) :
   367	          'RESPINS LEFT: ' + rd.left + '   LOCKED ' + this.res.bonus.rounds[Math.min(this.round, this.res.bonus.rounds.length - 1)].vals.filter(function (v) { return v > 0; }).length + '/5';
   368	        D.text(g, lbl, r.x + r.w / 2, top + 20, 12, '#c8d6e6', 'center');
   369	      } else {
   370	        D.text(g, 'PAYS ANYWHERE', r.x + r.w / 2, top, 12, '#5c7a99', 'center');
   371	        D.text(g, '3+ COINS WAKE THE TRAIN', r.x + r.w / 2, top + 18, 11, '#7f93ab', 'center');
   372	      }
   373	      if (flash > 0 && this.res && this.res.mult > 0) {
   374	        g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,214,102,' + (0.3 + flash * 0.6) + ')'; g.lineWidth = 3;
   375	        var b0 = this.cellRect(r, 0), b4 = this.cellRect(r, 4);
   376	        D.rr(g, b0.x - 5, b0.y - 5, (b4.x + b4.w) - b0.x + 10, b0.h + 10, 12); g.stroke();
   377	      }
   378	    }
   379	  });

   381	  /* ================= view C - Gem Cascade ================= */
   382	  var viewC = base({
   383	    begin: function (res, fx) {
   384	      this.res = res; this.t = 0; this.done = false; this.fx = fx;
   385	      this.idx = 0; this.st = 0; this.phase = 'drop';
   386	      this.grid = res.steps[0].grid.slice();
   387	      this.prev = null; this.clusters = []; this.mult = 1; this.run = 0;
   388	      Audio.spinUp();
   389	    },
   390	    reset: function () { this.done = true; this.res = null; this.grid = null; this.clusters = []; },
   391	    update: function (dt) {
   392	      if (this.done) return;
   393	      this.t += dt; this.st += dt;
   394	      var steps = this.res.steps, i;
   395	      if (this.phase === 'drop') {
   396	        if (this.st >= 0.55) {
   397	          this.st = 0; this.idx = 1;
   398	          if (this.idx >= steps.length) { this.phase = 'end'; }
   399	          else { this.phase = 'show'; this.clusters = steps[1].clusters; this.mult = steps[1].mult; }
   400	        }
   401	      } else if (this.phase === 'show') {
   402	        if (this.st >= 0.5) {
   403	          this.st = 0; this.phase = 'pop';
   404	          var s = steps[this.idx];
   405	          this.run += s.win;
   406	          for (i = 0; i < s.clusters.length; i++) {
   407	            var cl = s.clusters[i];
   408	            Audio.pop(cl.cells.length - 5);
   409	            for (var j = 0; j < cl.cells.length; j++) this.fx.burstCell(cl.cells[j], 4, GEMC[cl.tier]);
   410	          }
   411	          this.fx.shake(4 + Math.min(10, s.win));
   412	        }
   413	      } else if (this.phase === 'pop') {
   414	        if (this.st >= 0.22) {
   415	          this.st = 0; this.idx++;
   416	          if (this.idx >= steps.length) { this.phase = 'end'; }
   417	          else {
   418	            this.prev = this.grid;
   419	            this.grid = steps[this.idx].grid.slice();
   420	            this.clusters = [];
   421	            this.mult = steps[this.idx].mult;
   422	            this.phase = 'fall';
   423	          }
   424	        }
   425	      } else if (this.phase === 'fall') {
   426	        if (this.st >= 0.3) {
   427	          this.st = 0; this.idx++;
   428	          if (this.idx >= steps.length) { this.phase = 'end'; }
   429	          else { this.phase = 'show'; this.clusters = steps[this.idx].clusters; this.mult = steps[this.idx].mult; }
   430	        }
   431	      } else if (this.phase === 'end') {
   432	        if (this.st > 0.35) this.done = true;
   433	      }
   434	    },
   435	    geo: function (r) {
   436	      var s = Math.min((r.w - 60) / 5, (r.h - 76) / 5);
   437	      return { s: s, x: r.x + (r.w - s * 5) / 2, y: r.y + 46 };
   438	    },
   439	    draw: function (g, r) {
   440	      panelBG(g, r);
   441	      var go = this.geo(r), s = go.s, i, x, y;
   442	      g.fillStyle = '#0c121b';
   443	      D.rr(g, go.x - 5, go.y - 5, s * 5 + 10, s * 5 + 10, 10); g.fill();
   444	      if (!this.grid) {
   445	        D.text(g, 'TAP SPIN', r.x + r.w / 2, go.y + s * 2.5, 14, '#4d6b8a', 'center');
   446	        return;
   447	      }
   448	      var inCluster = null;
   449	      if (this.clusters && this.clusters.length) {
   450	        inCluster = {};
   451	        for (i = 0; i < this.clusters.length; i++)
   452	          for (var j = 0; j < this.clusters[i].cells.length; j++) inCluster[this.clusters[i].cells[j]] = 1;
   453	      }
   454	      var pulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(this.t * 14);
   455	      g.save();
   456	      g.beginPath(); D.rr(g, go.x - 5, go.y - 5, s * 5 + 10, s * 5 + 10, 10); g.clip();
   457	      for (i = 0; i < 25; i++) {
   458	        x = go.x + (i % 5) * s + s / 2;
   459	        y = go.y + ((i / 5) | 0) * s + s / 2;
   460	        var dy = 0, a = 1, sc = 1;
   461	        if (this.phase === 'drop') {
   462	          var pd = U.clamp((this.st - (i % 5) * 0.045) / 0.34, 0, 1);
   463	          dy = -(1 - U.easeOut(pd)) * (s * 5 + 20); a = pd > 0 ? 1 : 0;
   464	        } else if (this.phase === 'fall') {
   465	          var changed = !this.prev || this.prev[i] !== this.grid[i];
   466	          if (changed) { var pf = U.clamp(this.st / 0.28, 0, 1); dy = -(1 - U.easeOut(pf)) * 90; }
   467	        } else if (this.phase === 'pop' && inCluster && inCluster[i]) {
   468	          continue;
   469	        } else if (this.phase === 'show' && inCluster && inCluster[i]) {
   470	          sc = 1 + pulse * 0.14;
   471	          g.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,' + (0.1 + pulse * 0.18) + ')';
   472	          D.rr(g, go.x + (i % 5) * s + 2, go.y + ((i / 5) | 0) * s + 2, s - 4, s - 4, 6); g.fill();
   473	        }
   474	        drawGem(g, this.grid[i], x, y + dy, s * sc * 0.92, a);
   475	      }
   476	      g.restore();
   477	      g.strokeStyle = '#26364a'; g.lineWidth = 2;
   478	      D.rr(g, go.x - 5, go.y - 5, s * 5 + 10, s * 5 + 10, 10); g.stroke();
   479	      var mi = this.mult || 1;
   480	      D.text(g, 'MULT x' + mi, r.x + 20, r.y + 26, 13, mi > 1 ? '#ffd76b' : '#7f93ab', 'left', '800');
   481	      D.text(g, 'CLUSTERS 5+', r.x + r.w / 2, r.y + 26, 11, '#7f93ab', 'center');
   482	      if (this.run > 0) D.text(g, U.mx(this.run), r.x + r.w - 20, r.y + 26, 14, '#8ef0a8', 'right', '800');
   483	    }
   484	  });

   486	  /* ================= view D - Jackpot Wheel ================= */
   487	  var viewD = base({
   488	    angle: 0,
   489	    begin: function (res, fx) {
   490	      this.res = res; this.t = 0; this.done = false; this.fx = fx;
   491	      var lay = M.D.layout, cands = [], i;
   492	      for (i = 0; i < lay.length; i++) if (lay[i] === res.seg) cands.push(i);
   493	      if (!cands.length) cands = [0];
   494	      var w = cands[(Math.random() * cands.length) | 0];
   495	      var step = Math.PI * 2 / lay.length;
   496	      // pointer at top (-PI/2); we want wedge centre under pointer
   497	      var want = -Math.PI / 2 - (w * step + step / 2);
   498	      var cur = this.angle % (Math.PI * 2);
   499	      var delta = ((want - cur) % (Math.PI * 2) + Math.PI * 2) % (Math.PI * 2);
   500	      this.a0 = this.angle;
   501	      this.a1 = this.angle + Math.PI * 2 * 5 + delta;
   502	      this.dur = 3.0; this.wedge = w; this.lastTick = 0;
   503	      Audio.spinUp();
   504	    },
   505	    reset: function () { this.done = true; this.res = null; },
   506	    update: function (dt) {
   507	      if (this.done) return;
   508	      this.t += dt;
   509	      var p = U.clamp(this.t / this.dur, 0, 1);
   510	      var e = 1 - Math.pow(1 - p, 4);
   511	      this.angle = U.lerp(this.a0, this.a1, e);
   512	      var tick = Math.floor((this.angle) / (Math.PI * 2 / M.D.layout.length));
   513	      if (tick !== this.lastTick) {
   514	        this.lastTick = tick;
   515	        if (p < 0.97) Audio.tone(700 - p * 250, 0.025, 'square', 0.05 * (1 - p * 0.7));
   516	      }
   517	      if (p >= 1) {
   518	        if (this.t > this.dur + 0.45) this.done = true;
   519	        else if (this.t - dt <= this.dur) { this.fx.shake(6); }
   520	      }
   521	    },
   522	    draw: function (g, r, flash) {
   523	      panelBG(g, r);
   524	      var lay = M.D.layout, seg = M.D.segments;
   525	      var cx = r.x + r.w / 2, cy = r.y + r.h / 2 + 6;
   526	      var rad = Math.min(r.w / 2 - 30, r.h / 2 - 30);
   527	      var step = Math.PI * 2 / lay.length;
   528	      var cols = ['#1c2531', '#3f6b8f', '#4f8fbf', '#5fb0a0', '#7fbf5f', '#bfa73f', '#d98a3f', '#e0603c', '#d94fe0', '#ffd24d'];
   529	      g.save(); g.translate(cx, cy); g.rotate(this.angle);
   530	      for (var i = 0; i < lay.length; i++) {
   531	        var s = lay[i], a0 = i * step, a1 = a0 + step;
   532	        g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(0, 0); g.arc(0, 0, rad, a0, a1); g.closePath();
   533	        var hot = (this.done || this.t >= this.dur) && i === this.wedge;
   534	        g.fillStyle = hot ? (0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(this.t * 16) > 0.5 ? '#fff3c4' : cols[s]) : cols[s];
   535	        g.fill();
   536	        g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(8,12,18,0.6)'; g.lineWidth = 1.5; g.stroke();
   537	        if (s > 0) {
   538	          g.save();
   539	          g.rotate(a0 + step / 2); g.translate(rad * 0.66, 0); g.rotate(Math.PI / 2);
   540	          var up = Math.cos(this.angle + a0 + step / 2);
   541	          if (up < 0) g.rotate(Math.PI);
   542	          D.text(g, s === 9 ? 'GRAND' : seg[s][0], 0, 0, s >= 8 ? 11 : 10, '#0c1119', 'center', '800');
   543	          g.restore();
   544	        }
   545	      }
   546	      g.beginPath(); g.arc(0, 0, rad * 0.24, 0, 6.284);
   547	      g.fillStyle = '#141b26'; g.fill();
   548	      g.strokeStyle = '#3a5170'; g.lineWidth = 3; g.stroke();
   549	      g.restore();
   550	      D.text(g, 'SPIN', cx, cy, 12, '#7f93ab', 'center', '800');
   551	      // pointer
   552	      g.fillStyle = flash > 0 ? '#ffd76b' : '#e8eef6';
   553	      g.beginPath();
   554	      g.moveTo(cx, cy - rad + 16); g.lineTo(cx - 11, cy - rad - 8); g.lineTo(cx + 11, cy - rad - 8);
   555	      g.closePath(); g.fill();
   556	      g.strokeStyle = '#0c1119'; g.lineWidth = 2; g.stroke();
   557	    }
   558	  });

   189	  function unlockAudio() {
   190	    if (audio.unlocked) {
   191	      if (audio.context && audio.context.state === 'suspended') audio.context.resume();
   192	      return;
   193	    }
   194	    try {
   195	      var AudioContext = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
   196	      if (!AudioContext) return;
   197	      audio.context = new AudioContext();
   198	      audio.context.resume();
   199	      audio.unlocked = true;
   200	      tone(392, 0.08, 'sine', 0.022);
   201	    } catch (error) {
   202	      audio.unlocked = false;
   203	    }
   204	  }

   206	  function tone(frequency, duration, type, volume) {
   207	    if (!audio.unlocked || !audio.context) return;
   208	    try {
   209	      var now = audio.context.currentTime;
   210	      var oscillator = audio.context.createOscillator();
   211	      var gain = audio.context.createGain();
   212	      oscillator.type = type || 'sine';
   213	      oscillator.frequency.setValueAtTime(frequency, now);
   214	      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(volume || 0.025, now);
   215	      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, now + duration);
   216	      oscillator.connect(gain);
   217	      gain.connect(audio.context.destination);
   218	      oscillator.start(now);
   219	      oscillator.stop(now + duration);
   220	    } catch (error) {}
   221	  }
