   267	    state.shake = 0;
   268	    state.flash = 0;
   269	  }
   270	
   271	  function startSeason() {
   272	    cancelTimers();
   273	    resetInput();
   274	    state.record = safeRecord();
   275	    state.standings = defaultStandings();
   276	    state.gameStartStandings = [];
   277	    state.seasonGame = 1;
   278	    state.seasonFinished = false;
   279	    state.seasonWon = false;
   280	    state.screen = 'game';
   281	    state.paused = false;
   282	    startGame(1);
   283	  }
   284	
   285	  function startGame(gameNumber) {
   286	    cancelTimers();
   287	    resetInput();
   288	    state.seasonGame = clamp(gameNumber, 1, 9);
   289	    state.opponentIndex = 1 + ((state.seasonGame - 1) % 4);
   290	    state.gameStartStandings = state.standings.map(function (row) {
   291	      return { team: row.team, wins: row.wins, losses: row.losses, runsFor: row.runsFor, runsAgainst: row.runsAgainst };
   292	    });
   293	    resetGameFields();
   294	    state.screen = 'game';
   295	    state.paused = false;
   296	    beginAtBat();
   297	  }
   298	
   299	  function rematch() {
   300	    if (state.seasonFinished) {
   301	      startSeason();
   302	      return;
   303	    }
   304	    cancelTimers();
   305	    resetInput();
   306	    state.standings = state.gameStartStandings.map(function (row) {
   307	      return { team: row.team, wins: row.wins, losses: row.losses, runsFor: row.runsFor, runsAgainst: row.runsAgainst };
   308	    });
   309	    resetGameFields();
   310	    state.screen = 'game';
   311	    state.paused = false;
   312	    beginAtBat();
   313	  }
   314	
   315	  function beginAtBat() {
   316	    state.diveUsed = false;
   317	    state.lastHit = null;
   318	    if (state.gameClock <= 0) {
   319	      finishGame();
   320	      return;
   321	    }
   322	    if (state.half === 'home') beginBatting();
   323	    else beginPitching();
   324	  }
   325	
   326	  function beginBatting() {
   327	    state.phase = 'batPre';
   328	    state.preTimer = 0.78;
   329	    state.pitchProgress = 0;
   330	    state.pitchZone = Math.floor(rand() * 3);
   331	    state.guessZone = 1;
   332	    state.resultText = 'READ THE PITCH';
   333	    state.hint = 'Drag before the pitch to call a zone. Tap SWING at the plate.';
   334	    addEvent('YOU BAT  •  ' + playerName(state.playerBat), COLORS.lime);
   335	  }
   336	
   337	  function beginPitching() {
   338	    state.phase = 'userPitchReady';
   339	    state.preTimer = 0.52;
   340	    state.targetTime = 0;
   341	    state.targetStopped = false;
   342	    state.selectedPitch = 0;
   343	    state.target = { x: 0.5, y: 0.5 };
   344	    state.resultText = 'SET YOUR PITCH';
   345	    state.hint = 'Pick a pitch, then tap STOP when the moving target crosses the zone.';
   346	    addEvent('PITCH TO  •  ' + aiName(state.aiBat), TEAMS[state.opponentIndex].color);
   347	  }
   348	
   349	  function beginUserPitch() {
   350	    state.phase = 'userPitching';
   351	    state.targetTime = 0;
   352	    state.targetStopped = false;
   353	    state.resultText = 'STOP THE TARGET';
   354	  }
   355	
   356	  function playerName(index) {
   357	    return TEAMS[0].lineup[index % TEAMS[0].lineup.length][0];
   358	  }
   359	
   360	  function aiName(index) {
   361	    return TEAMS[state.opponentIndex].lineup[index % TEAMS[state.opponentIndex].lineup.length][0];
   362	  }
   363	
   364	  function playerHitter() { return TEAMS[0].lineup[state.playerBat % TEAMS[0].lineup.length]; }
   365	  function aiHitter() { return TEAMS[state.opponentIndex].lineup[state.aiBat % TEAMS[state.opponentIndex].lineup.length]; }
   366	
   367	  function update(dt) {
   368	    if (state.orientationPaused || state.screen === 'start' || state.screen === 'gameOver' || state.screen === 'seasonComplete') return;
   369	    state.gameClock = Math.max(0, state.gameClock - dt);
   370	    state.shake = Math.max(0, state.shake - dt * 3.8);
   371	    state.flash = Math.max(0, state.flash - dt * 2.4);
   372	    updateParticles(dt);
   373	
   374	    if (state.gameClock <= 0 && state.phase !== 'result' && state.phase !== 'fielding') {
   375	      finishGame();
   376	      return;
   377	    }
   378	
   379	    if (state.phase === 'batPre') {
   380	      state.preTimer -= dt;
   381	      if (state.preTimer <= 0) {
   382	        state.phase = 'batPitch';
   383	        state.pitchProgress = 0;
   384	        state.resultText = 'SWING!';
   385	        tone(220, 0.045, 'triangle', 0.018);
   386	      }
   387	    } else if (state.phase === 'batPitch') {
   388	      state.pitchProgress = clamp(state.pitchProgress + dt / 0.88, 0, 1.2);
   389	      if (state.pitchProgress >= 1) resolveBatting(false);
   390	    } else if (state.phase === 'userPitchReady') {
   391	      state.preTimer -= dt;
   392	      if (state.preTimer <= 0) beginUserPitch();
   393	    } else if (state.phase === 'userPitching') {
   394	      state.targetTime += dt;
   395	      updateTarget();
   396	      if (state.targetTime > 1.85) resolvePitch(false);
   397	    } else if (state.phase === 'fielding') {
   398	      state.fieldTimer -= dt;
   399	      if (state.fieldTimer <= 0) resolveFielding(false);
   400	    } else if (state.phase === 'result') {
   401	      state.resultTimer -= dt;
   402	      if (state.resultTimer <= 0) advanceAfterResult();
   403	    }
   404	  }
   405	
   406	  function updateTarget() {
   407	    var pitch = PITCHES[state.selectedPitch];
   408	    var t = state.targetTime * (1.6 + pitch.speed);
   409	    state.target.x = 0.5 + Math.sin(t * 2.1) * 0.32 * pitch.sway;
   410	    state.target.y = 0.5 + Math.cos(t * 2.65 + 0.7) * 0.27 * pitch.sway;
   411	  }
   412	
   413	  function resolveBatting(swung) {
   414	    if (state.phase !== 'batPitch') return;
   415	    var hitter = playerHitter();
   416	    var progress = state.pitchProgress;
   417	    var timing = clamp(1 - Math.abs(progress - 0.66) / 0.36, 0, 1);
   418	    var zoneBonus = state.guessZone === state.pitchZone ? 0.18 : 0;
   419	    var contact = hitter[1];
   420	    var quality = timing * 0.64 + contact * 0.28 + zoneBonus;
   421	    var hitChance = swung ? clamp(quality - 0.1, 0.03, 0.96) : 0.025;
   422	    var hit = chance(hitChance * 0.76);
   423	    state.playerBat += 1;
   424	    if (hit) {
   425	      var power = hitter[2];
   426	      var outcome = 'SINGLE';
   427	      if (power + timing > 1.45 && chance(0.22)) outcome = 'HOME RUN';
   428	      else if (power + timing > 1.24 && chance(0.22)) outcome = 'DOUBLE';
   429	      else if (hitter[3] > 0.82 && timing > 0.75 && chance(0.11)) outcome = 'TRIPLE';
   430	      recordHit('home', outcome, timing > 0.68 && zoneBonus > 0);
   431	    } else {
   432	      var label = swung && timing > 0.28 ? 'FLY OUT' : 'STRIKEOUT';
   433	      recordOut(label, 'home');
   434	    }
   435	  }
   436	
   437	  function resolvePitch(stopped) {
   438	    if (state.phase !== 'userPitching') return;
   439	    state.targetStopped = stopped;
   440	    var pitch = PITCHES[state.selectedPitch];
   441	    var dx = (state.target.x - 0.5) / 0.42;
   442	    var dy = (state.target.y - 0.5) / 0.37;
   443	    var distance = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
   444	    var accuracy = clamp(1 - distance, 0, 1);
   445	    var inZone = Math.abs(state.target.x - 0.5) < 0.25 && Math.abs(state.target.y - 0.5) < 0.23;
   446	    var hitter = aiHitter();
   447	    var strikePower = accuracy * 0.7 + (inZone ? 0.25 : 0) + pitch.bonus;
   448	    var getsOut = chance(clamp(strikePower - hitter[1] * 0.18 + 0.1, 0.12, 0.96));
   449	    state.aiBat += 1;
   450	    if (getsOut) {
   451	      recordOut(inZone ? 'PAINTED CORNER' : 'CHASED IT', 'away');
   452	    } else {
   453	      var hitChance = clamp((1 - accuracy) * 0.38 + hitter[1] * 0.27 + hitter[2] * 0.13, 0.08, 0.74);
   454	      if (chance(hitChance)) {
   455	        var outcome = hitter[2] > 0.84 && chance(0.2) ? 'HOME RUN' : (hitter[3] > 0.8 && chance(0.18) ? 'TRIPLE' : (chance(0.22) ? 'DOUBLE' : 'SINGLE'));
   456	        state.lastHit = { outcome: outcome, accuracy: accuracy };
   457	        state.fieldTimer = 0.94;
   458	        state.fieldTarget = { x: 0.5 + (rand() - 0.5) * 0.7, y: 0.48 + (rand() - 0.5) * 0.34 };
   459	        state.diveUsed = false;
   460	        state.phase = 'fielding';
   461	        state.resultText = 'BALL IN PLAY';
   462	        state.hint = 'Auto-fielding is active. Tap DIVE as the marker flashes.';
   463	        tone(180, 0.08, 'sawtooth', 0.025);
   464	      } else {
   465	        recordOut('SOFT CONTACT', 'away');
   466	      }
   467	    }
   468	  }
   469	
   470	  function resolveFielding(dived) {
   471	    if (state.phase !== 'fielding') return;
   472	    var success = dived && !state.diveUsed;
   473	    state.diveUsed = true;
   474	    if (success) {
   475	      state.lastHit = null;
   476	      recordOut('DIVING STOP', 'away');
   477	      burst(W * state.fieldTarget.x, H * (0.14 + state.fieldTarget.y * 0.52), COLORS.aqua, 18);
   478	      tone(520, 0.12, 'square', 0.03);
   479	    } else {
   480	      recordHit('away', state.lastHit ? state.lastHit.outcome : 'SINGLE', false);
   481	    }
   482	  }
   483	
   484	  function recordOut(label, side) {
   485	    state.outs += 1;
   486	    state.bases = state.outs >= 3 ? [false, false, false] : state.bases;
   487	    state.shake = 0.08;
   488	    state.flash = 0.3;
   489	    state.resultColor = side === 'home' ? COLORS.lime : TEAMS[state.opponentIndex].color;
   490	    state.resultText = label;
   491	    state.resultSub = state.outs >= 3 ? 'THREE DOWN  •  SWITCH SIDES' : (state.outs + ' OUT' + (state.outs === 1 ? '' : 'S'));
   492	    state.pendingTransition = state.outs >= 3 ? 'half' : 'next';
   493	    state.phase = 'result';
   494	    state.resultTimer = 0.86;
   495	    addEvent(label + '  •  ' + (side === 'home' ? 'N9' : TEAMS[state.opponentIndex].short), state.resultColor);
   496	    burst(W * 0.5, H * 0.47, COLORS.white, label === 'DIVING STOP' ? 16 : 7);
   497	    tone(label === 'STRIKEOUT' ? 150 : 260, 0.08, 'triangle', 0.022);
   498	  }
   499	
   500	  function recordHit(side, outcome, bonus) {
   501	    var sideIndex = side === 'home' ? 1 : 0;
   502	    state.hits[sideIndex] += 1;
   503	    var bases = outcome === 'HOME RUN' ? 4 : (outcome === 'TRIPLE' ? 3 : (outcome === 'DOUBLE' ? 2 : 1));
   504	    var runs = advanceBases(bases, sideIndex);
   505	    if (bonus) {
   506	      state.shake = 0.12;
   507	      state.flash = 0.65;
   508	      burst(W * 0.5, H * 0.42, COLORS.gold, 20);
   509	    } else {
   510	      burst(W * 0.5, H * 0.42, side === 'home' ? COLORS.lime : TEAMS[state.opponentIndex].color, 9);
   511	    }
   512	    state.resultColor = side === 'home' ? COLORS.lime : TEAMS[state.opponentIndex].color;
   513	    state.resultText = outcome;
   514	    state.resultSub = runs > 0 ? (runs + (runs === 1 ? ' RUN' : ' RUNS')) : 'RUNNERS MOVE';
   515	    state.pendingTransition = 'next';
   516	    state.phase = 'result';
   517	    state.resultTimer = 0.92;
   518	    addEvent(outcome + (runs ? '  •  ' + runs + ' RUN' + (runs === 1 ? '' : 'S') : ''), state.resultColor);
   519	    tone(outcome === 'HOME RUN' ? 660 : 420, outcome === 'HOME RUN' ? 0.2 : 0.1, 'sine', 0.03);
   520	  }
   521	
   522	  function advanceBases(distance, sideIndex) {
   523	    var scoreRuns = 0;
   524	    var old = state.bases.slice();
   525	    var next = [false, false, false];
   526	    if (distance >= 4) {
   527	      scoreRuns = 1 + (old[0] ? 1 : 0) + (old[1] ? 1 : 0) + (old[2] ? 1 : 0);
   528	      next = [false, false, false];
   529	    } else {
   530	      for (var i = 2; i >= 0; i -= 1) {
   531	        if (old[i]) {
   532	          var dest = i + distance;
   533	          if (dest >= 3) scoreRuns += 1;
   534	          else next[dest] = true;
   535	        }
   536	      }
   537	      var batterDest = distance - 1;
   538	      if (batterDest >= 3) scoreRuns += 1;
   539	      else next[batterDest] = true;
   540	    }
   541	    state.bases = next;
   542	    state.score[sideIndex] += scoreRuns;
   543	    return scoreRuns;
   544	  }
   545	
   546	  function advanceAfterResult() {
   547	    if (state.pendingTransition === 'half') {
   548	      state.bases = [false, false, false];
   549	      state.outs = 0;
   550	      if (state.half === 'away') {
   551	        state.half = 'home';
   552	      } else {
   553	        state.inning += 1;
   554	        state.half = 'away';
   555	      }
   556	      if (state.inning > 3) {
   557	        finishGame();
   558	        return;
   559	      }
   560	    }
   561	    beginAtBat();
   562	  }
   563	
   564	  function finishGame() {
   565	    if (state.screen !== 'game') return;
   566	    cancelTimers();
   567	    resetInput();
   568	    var player = state.standings[0];
   569	    var opponent = state.standings[state.opponentIndex];
   570	    var playerWon = state.score[1] > state.score[0];
   571	    if (state.score[1] === state.score[0]) playerWon = chance(0.5);
   572	    player.runsFor += state.score[1];
   573	    player.runsAgainst += state.score[0];
   574	    opponent.runsFor += state.score[0];
   575	    opponent.runsAgainst += state.score[1];
   576	    if (playerWon) { player.wins += 1; opponent.losses += 1; }
   577	    else { player.losses += 1; opponent.wins += 1; }
   578	    simulateOtherGames();
   579	    state.record.games += 1;
   580	    state.resultText = playerWon ? 'GAME WON' : 'GAME LOST';
   581	    state.resultSub = state.score[1] + ' — ' + state.score[0] + '  •  ' + TEAMS[state.opponentIndex].name;
   582	    state.resultColor = playerWon ? COLORS.lime : COLORS.coral;
   583	    state.screen = state.seasonFinished ? 'seasonComplete' : 'gameOver';
   584	    state.paused = true;
   585	    state.seasonFinished = state.seasonGame >= 9;
   586	    state.seasonWon = false;
   587	    if (state.seasonFinished) {
   588	      var rank = sortedStandings().findIndex(function (entry) { return entry.team === 0; });
   589	      state.seasonWon = rank === 0;
   590	      state.record.seasons += 1;
   591	      if (state.seasonWon) state.record.pennants += 1;
   592	      state.record.bestWins = Math.max(state.record.bestWins, player.wins);
   593	      saveRecord();
   594	    } else {
   595	      saveRecord();
   596	    }
   597	    addEvent(playerWon ? 'WIN  •  STANDINGS CLIMB' : 'LOSS  •  NEXT GAME', playerWon ? COLORS.lime : COLORS.coral);
   598	    burst(W * 0.5, H * 0.42, playerWon ? COLORS.lime : COLORS.coral, 26);
   599	    tone(playerWon ? 720 : 120, playerWon ? 0.22 : 0.16, playerWon ? 'sine' : 'sawtooth', 0.035);
   600	  }
   601	
   602	  function simulateOtherGames() {
   603	    var pairings = [[1, 2], [3, 4]];
   604	    pairings.forEach(function (pair) {
   605	      var first = state.standings[pair[0]];
   606	      var second = state.standings[pair[1]];
   607	      var firstWins = chance(0.5);
   608	      var firstRuns = 1 + Math.floor(rand() * 7);
   609	      var secondRuns = 1 + Math.floor(rand() * 6);
   610	      if (firstWins) firstRuns = Math.max(firstRuns, secondRuns + 1);
   611	      else secondRuns = Math.max(secondRuns, firstRuns + 1);
   612	      first.runsFor += firstRuns; first.runsAgainst += secondRuns;
   613	      second.runsFor += secondRuns; second.runsAgainst += firstRuns;
   614	      if (firstWins) { first.wins += 1; second.losses += 1; }
   615	      else { second.wins += 1; first.losses += 1; }
   616	    });
   617	  }
   618	
   619	  function sortedStandings() {
   620	    return state.standings.slice().sort(function (a, b) {
   621	      return b.wins - a.wins || (b.runsFor - b.runsAgainst) - (a.runsFor - a.runsAgainst) || a.team - b.team;
   622	    });
   623	  }
   624	
   625	  function spawnParticle(x, y, color, size, life, vx, vy) {
   626	    if (state.particles.length >= 180) state.particles.splice(0, 24);
   627	    state.particles.push({ x: x, y: y, vx: vx, vy: vy, size: size, life: life, max: life, color: color });
   628	  }
   629	
   630	  function burst(x, y, color, amount) {
   631	    var count = Math.min(amount, 30);
   632	    for (var i = 0; i < count; i += 1) {
   633	      var angle = rand() * TAU;
   634	      var speed = 24 + rand() * 75;
   635	      spawnParticle(x, y, color, 2 + rand() * 4, 0.42 + rand() * 0.48, Math.cos(angle) * speed, Math.sin(angle) * speed);
   636	    }
   637	  }
   638	
   639	  function updateParticles(dt) {
   640	    for (var i = state.particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i -= 1) {
   641	      var p = state.particles[i];
   642	      p.life -= dt;
   643	      p.x += p.vx * dt;
   644	      p.y += p.vy * dt;
   645	      p.vy += 34 * dt;
   646	      if (p.life <= 0) state.particles.splice(i, 1);
   647	    }
   648	  }
   649	
   650	  function addEvent(text, color) {
   651	    state.events.unshift({ text: text, color: color || COLORS.text, age: 0 });
   652	    if (state.events.length > 18) state.events.length = 18;
   653	  }
   654	
   655	  function updateEvents(dt) {
   656	    for (var i = state.events.length - 1; i >= 0; i -= 1) {
   657	      state.events[i].age += dt;
   658	      if (state.events[i].age > 12) state.events.splice(i, 1);
   659	    }
   660	  }
   661	
   662	  function roundRect(x, y, w, h, r, fill, stroke, lineWidth) {
   663	    r = Math.min(r, Math.abs(w) / 2, Math.abs(h) / 2);
   664	    ctx.beginPath();
   665	    ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
   666	    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
   667	    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
   668	    ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
   669	    ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
   670	    ctx.closePath();
   671	    if (fill) { ctx.fillStyle = fill; ctx.fill(); }
   672	    if (stroke) { ctx.strokeStyle = stroke; ctx.lineWidth = lineWidth || 1; ctx.stroke(); }
   673	  }
   674	
   675	  function text(value, x, y, size, color, align, weight) {
   676	    ctx.font = (weight || 600) + ' ' + size + 'px Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif';
   677	    ctx.fillStyle = color || COLORS.text;
   678	    ctx.textAlign = align || 'left';
   679	    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
   680	    ctx.fillText(value, x, y);
   681	  }
   682	
   683	  function line(x1, y1, x2, y2, color, width) {
   684	    ctx.beginPath();
   685	    ctx.moveTo(x1, y1); ctx.lineTo(x2, y2);
   686	    ctx.strokeStyle = color; ctx.lineWidth = width || 1; ctx.stroke();
   687	  }
   688	
   689	  function circle(x, y, radius, fill, stroke, width) {
   690	    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y, radius, 0, TAU);
   691	    if (fill) { ctx.fillStyle = fill; ctx.fill(); }
   692	    if (stroke) { ctx.strokeStyle = stroke; ctx.lineWidth = width || 1; ctx.stroke(); }
   693	  }
   694	
   695	  function draw() {
   696	    ctx.save();
   697	    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
   698	    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.night;
   699	    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
   700	    drawBackdrop();
   701	    if (state.screen === 'start') drawStart();
   702	    else {
   703	      drawHud();
   704	      drawArena();
   705	      drawBottomBar();
   706	      drawEvents();
   707	      drawParticles();
   708	      if (state.screen === 'gameOver' || state.screen === 'seasonComplete') drawGameOver();
   709	    }
   710	    if (portrait) drawRotateOverlay();
   711	    ctx.restore();
   712	  }
   713	
   714	  function drawBackdrop() {
   715	    var grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
   716	    grad.addColorStop(0, '#102a32'); grad.addColorStop(0.56, '#0b1c22'); grad.addColorStop(1, '#071116');
   717	    ctx.fillStyle = grad; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
   718	    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.12;
   719	    for (var i = -H; i < W + H; i += 44) line(i, 0, i + H, H, COLORS.aqua, 1);
   720	    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
   721	  }
   722	
   723	  function drawStart() {
   724	    var cx = W / 2;
   725	    var cy = H * 0.42;
   726	    circle(cx, cy - 68, 38, COLORS.lime);
   727	    line(cx - 16, cy - 84, cx + 16, cy - 52, COLORS.ink, 3);
   728	    line(cx - 21, cy - 67, cx + 9, cy - 96, COLORS.ink, 3);
   729	    text('PENNANT', cx, cy - 10, Math.min(42, W * 0.075), COLORS.text, 'center', 800);
   730	    text('NINE', cx, cy + 35, Math.min(64, W * 0.12), COLORS.lime, 'center', 900);
   731	    text('A tiny pennant, a loud swing.', cx, cy + 78, 15, COLORS.muted, 'center', 500);
   732	    var btn = startButton();
   733	    roundRect(btn.x, btn.y, btn.w, btn.h, 16, COLORS.lime);
   734	    text('TAP TO PLAY', cx, btn.y + btn.h / 2, 18, COLORS.ink, 'center', 900);
   735	    text('free forever  •  9 games  •  no luck boxes', cx, btn.y + btn.h + 30, 11, COLORS.muted, 'center', 600);
   736	    var rec = state.record;
   737	    text('PENNANTS ' + rec.pennants + '   BEST WINS ' + rec.bestWins, cx, H - 30, 11, COLORS.aqua, 'center', 700);
   738	  }

   741	    var opponent = TEAMS[state.opponentIndex];

   753	
   754	  function formatTime(seconds) {
   755	    var total = Math.max(0, Math.ceil(seconds));
   756	    var min = Math.floor(total / 60);
   757	    var sec = total % 60;
   758	    return min + ':' + (sec < 10 ? '0' : '') + sec;
   759	  }

   761	  function arenaRect() {
   762	    return { x: Math.max(154, W * 0.2), y: 75, w: W - Math.max(308, W * 0.4), h: H - 172 };
   763	  }

   765	  function drawArena() {
   766	    var ar = arenaRect();
   767	    var x = ar.x, y = ar.y, w = ar.w, h = ar.h;
   768	    roundRect(x - 10, y - 10, w + 20, h + 20, 18, COLORS.panel, COLORS.line, 1);
   769	    ctx.save();
   770	    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.rect(x, y, w, h); ctx.clip();
   771	    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.field; ctx.fillRect(x, y, w, h);
   772	    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.12;
   773	    for (var i = -h; i < w + h; i += 34) {
   774	      ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.white;
   775	      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x + i, y); ctx.lineTo(x + i + h * 0.32, y); ctx.lineTo(x + i + h * 0.32 - h, y + h); ctx.lineTo(x + i - h, y + h); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
   776	    }
   777	    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
   778	    var homeX = x + w / 2, homeY = y + h * 0.79;
   779	    var moundX = homeX, moundY = y + h * 0.42;
   780	    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.dirt;
   781	    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(homeX, homeY); ctx.lineTo(homeX - w * 0.41, y + h * 0.05); ctx.lineTo(x + w * 0.04, y + h * 0.04); ctx.lineTo(x + w * 0.03, y + h * 0.95); ctx.lineTo(homeX - w * 0.41, y + h * 0.95); ctx.closePath(); ctx.globalAlpha = 0.38; ctx.fill();
   782	    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(homeX, homeY); ctx.lineTo(homeX + w * 0.41, y + h * 0.05); ctx.lineTo(x + w * 0.96, y + h * 0.04); ctx.lineTo(x + w * 0.97, y + h * 0.95); ctx.lineTo(homeX + w * 0.41, y + h * 0.95); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
   783	    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
   784	    circle(moundX, moundY, 19, COLORS.dirt, '#e3a16d', 2);
   785	    circle(homeX, homeY, 13, COLORS.white);
   786	    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.white;
   787	    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(homeX - 12, homeY - 7); ctx.lineTo(homeX + 12, homeY - 7); ctx.lineTo(homeX + 8, homeY + 10); ctx.lineTo(homeX, homeY + 14); ctx.lineTo(homeX - 8, homeY + 10); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
   788	    drawBaseDiamond(homeX, homeY - 52, 15);
   789	    drawBaseDiamond(homeX - 52, homeY - 1, 15);
   790	    drawBaseDiamond(homeX + 52, homeY - 1, 15);
   791	    drawPitchZone(ar, homeX, homeY);
   792	    drawPlayers(ar, homeX, homeY, moundX, moundY);
   793	    drawPhaseObject(ar, homeX, homeY);
   794	    ctx.restore();
   795	    drawSideCards();
   796	  }

   798	  function drawBaseDiamond(cx, cy, size) {
   799	    ctx.save(); ctx.translate(cx, cy); ctx.rotate(Math.PI / 4);
   800	    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.white; ctx.fillRect(-size * 0.48, -size * 0.48, size * 0.96, size * 0.96); ctx.restore();
   801	  }

   803	  function drawPitchZone(ar, homeX, homeY) {
   804	    var zone = { x: homeX - Math.min(76, ar.w * 0.28), y: ar.y + ar.h * 0.28, w: Math.min(152, ar.w * 0.56), h: Math.min(112, ar.h * 0.46) };
   805	    ctx.setLineDash([5, 5]);
   806	    roundRect(zone.x, zone.y, zone.w, zone.h, 4, null, COLORS.aqua, 2);
   807	    ctx.setLineDash([]);
   808	    if (state.half === 'home' && (state.phase === 'batPre' || state.phase === 'batPitch')) {
   809	      var colW = zone.w / 3;
   810	      for (var i = 0; i < 3; i += 1) {
   811	        if (i === state.guessZone) roundRect(zone.x + i * colW + 3, zone.y + 3, colW - 6, zone.h - 6, 4, 'rgba(201,255,98,.18)', null);
   812	      }
   813	      line(zone.x + colW, zone.y, zone.x + colW, zone.y + zone.h, 'rgba(134,228,213,.45)', 1);
   814	      line(zone.x + colW * 2, zone.y, zone.x + colW * 2, zone.y + zone.h, 'rgba(134,228,213,.45)', 1);
   815	      if (state.phase === 'batPitch') {
   816	        var bx = zone.x + (state.pitchZone + 0.5) * colW;
   817	        var by = zone.y + zone.h * (0.36 + Math.sin(state.pitchProgress * Math.PI) * 0.18);
   818	        circle(bx, by, 10 + state.pitchProgress * 5, COLORS.white);
   819	        circle(bx, by, 4, COLORS.coral);
   820	      }
   821	      text('GUESS', zone.x + zone.w / 2, zone.y - 13, 10, COLORS.aqua, 'center', 800);
   822	    }
   823	    if (state.half === 'away' && (state.phase === 'userPitching' || state.phase === 'userPitchReady')) {
   824	      if (state.phase === 'userPitching') {
   825	        var tx = zone.x + state.target.x * zone.w;
   826	        var ty = zone.y + state.target.y * zone.h;
   827	        circle(tx, ty, 16, 'rgba(255,255,255,.16)', PITCHES[state.selectedPitch].color, 3);
   828	        circle(tx, ty, 4, PITCHES[state.selectedPitch].color);
   829	        line(tx - 23, ty, tx + 23, ty, PITCHES[state.selectedPitch].color, 1);
   830	        line(tx, ty - 23, tx, ty + 23, PITCHES[state.selectedPitch].color, 1);
   831	      }
   832	      text('STRIKE ZONE', zone.x + zone.w / 2, zone.y - 13, 10, COLORS.aqua, 'center', 800);
   833	    }
   834	  }

   836	  function drawPlayers(ar, homeX, homeY, moundX, moundY) {
   837	    var player = state.half === 'home' ? playerHitter() : aiHitter();
   838	    var batterColor = state.half === 'home' ? COLORS.lime : TEAMS[state.opponentIndex].color;
   839	    circle(homeX - 39, homeY - 38, 13, batterColor);
   840	    line(homeX - 35, homeY - 28, homeX - 27, homeY - 8, batterColor, 7);
   841	    line(homeX - 30, homeY - 23, homeX - 52, homeY - 10, batterColor, 5);
   842	    line(homeX - 29, homeY - 8, homeX - 45, homeY + 9, batterColor, 5);
   843	    line(homeX - 27, homeY - 8, homeX - 13, homeY + 10, batterColor, 5);
   844	    if (state.half === 'home' && state.phase === 'batPitch') line(homeX - 49, homeY - 23, homeX - 8, homeY - 52, COLORS.gold, 5);
   845	    circle(moundX, moundY - 19, 11, TEAMS[state.opponentIndex].color);
   846	    line(moundX, moundY - 8, moundX, moundY + 16, TEAMS[state.opponentIndex].color, 6);
   847	    line(moundX, moundY + 1, moundX - 16, moundY + 12, TEAMS[state.opponentIndex].color, 5);
   848	    line(moundX, moundY + 1, moundX + 16, moundY + 12, TEAMS[state.opponentIndex].color, 5);
   849	    text(player[0].split(' ')[0], homeX, ar.y + ar.h - 11, 10, batterColor, 'center', 800);
   850	  }

   852	  function drawPhaseObject(ar, homeX, homeY) {
   853	    if (state.phase === 'fielding') {
   854	      var fx = ar.x + ar.w * state.fieldTarget.x;
   855	      var fy = ar.y + ar.h * (0.2 + state.fieldTarget.y * 0.6);
   856	      ctx.setLineDash([4, 4]);
   857	      line(homeX, homeY, fx, fy, COLORS.gold, 2);
   858	      ctx.setLineDash([]);
   859	      circle(fx, fy, 15 + Math.sin(state.fieldTimer * 18) * 3, 'rgba(255,211,107,.14)', COLORS.gold, 3);
   860	      circle(fx, fy, 4, COLORS.white);
   861	      if (state.fieldTimer < 0.68) {
   862	        roundRect(fx - 40, fy - 45, 80, 25, 8, COLORS.gold);
   863	        text('DIVE', fx, fy - 32, 12, COLORS.ink, 'center', 900);
   864	      }
   865	    }
   866	    if (state.flash > 0) {
   867	      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,' + (state.flash * 0.16) + ')';
   868	      ctx.fillRect(ar.x, ar.y, ar.w, ar.h);
   869	    }
   870	  }

  1028	  function pointFromEvent(event) {
  1029	    var rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  1030	    return { x: clamp(event.clientX - rect.left, 0, W), y: clamp(event.clientY - rect.top, 0, H) };
  1031	  }

  1033	  function within(point, rect) {

   132	  function safeReadSave() {
   133	    try {
   134	      const raw = localStorage.getItem(SAVE_KEY);
   135	      if (!raw) return null;
   136	      const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
   137	      if (!parsed || typeof parsed !== 'object' || Array.isArray(parsed)) return null;
   138	      return parsed;
   139	    } catch (_) {
   140	      return null;
   141	    }

   144	  function finiteInt(value, fallback, min, max) {
   145	    const number = Number(value);
   146	    if (!Number.isFinite(number)) return fallback;
   147	    return Math.max(min, Math.min(max, Math.round(number)));
   148	  }

   150	  function loadState() {
   151	    const saved = safeReadSave();
   152	    if (!saved) return;
   153	    const fresh = makeNewState();
   154	    if (Array.isArray(saved.board) && saved.board.length === CELL_COUNT) {
   155	      fresh.board = saved.board.map(item => {
   156	        if (!item || typeof item !== 'object') return null;
   157	        const kind = typeof item.kind === 'string' && CHAINS[item.kind] ? item.kind : '';
   158	        const tier = finiteInt(item.tier, -1, 0, 2);
   159	        if (!kind || tier > CHAINS[kind].max) return null;
   160	        return { kind, tier };
   161	      });
   162	      fresh.board.forEach((item, index) => { if (item) fresh.fog[index] = false; });
   163	    }
   164	    if (Array.isArray(saved.fog) && saved.fog.length === CELL_COUNT) {
   165	      fresh.fog = saved.fog.map(value => value === true);
   166	    }
   167	    fresh.board.forEach((item, index) => { if (item) fresh.fog[index] = false; });
   168	    if (Array.isArray(saved.notes) && saved.notes.length === NOTES.length) {
   169	      fresh.notes = saved.notes.map(value => value === true);
   170	    }
   171	    ['tide', 'wreck'].forEach(id => {
   172	      if (!saved.generators || !saved.generators[id] || typeof saved.generators[id] !== 'object') return;
   173	      const g = saved.generators[id];
   174	      fresh.generators[id].uses = finiteInt(g.uses, 5, 0, 5);
   175	      fresh.generators[id].recovery = finiteInt(g.recovery, 0, 0, RECOVERY_MOVES - 1);
   176	    });
   177	    fresh.score = finiteInt(saved.score, 0, 0, 999999);
   178	    fresh.best = finiteInt(saved.best, 0, 0, 999999);
   179	    fresh.merges = finiteInt(saved.merges, 0, 0, 9999);
   180	    fresh.sessionTime = Math.max(0, Math.min(999999, Number.isFinite(Number(saved.sessionTime)) ? Number(saved.sessionTime) : 0));
   181	    fresh.landmarks = finiteInt(saved.landmarks, 0, 0, 3);
   182	    fresh.cursor = finiteInt(saved.cursor, 0, 0, CELL_COUNT - 1);
   183	    fresh.won = saved.won === true && fresh.notes.every(Boolean);
   184	    fresh.finale = fresh.won;
   185	    state = fresh;
   186	    syncProgress(false);
   187	  }

   189	  function safeSave() {
   190	    const payload = {
   191	      board: state.board,
   192	      fog: state.fog,
   193	      notes: state.notes,
   194	      generators: state.generators,
   195	      score: finiteInt(state.score, 0, 0, 999999),
   196	      best: finiteInt(Math.max(state.best, state.score), 0, 0, 999999),
   197	      merges: finiteInt(state.merges, 0, 0, 9999),
   198	      sessionTime: Math.max(0, Math.min(999999, state.sessionTime)),
   199	      landmarks: finiteInt(state.landmarks, 0, 0, 3),
   200	      cursor: finiteInt(state.cursor, 0, 0, CELL_COUNT - 1),
   201	      won: state.won === true
   202	    };
   203	    try {
   204	      localStorage.setItem(SAVE_KEY, JSON.stringify(payload));
   205	    } catch (_) { /* A full or blocked store must not stop play. */ }
   206	  }

   212	  function schedule(callback, delay) {
   213	    if (pendingTimers.size >= MAX_TIMERS) return 0;
   214	    const id = setTimeout(() => {
   215	      pendingTimers.delete(id);
   216	      callback();
   217	    }, delay);
   218	    pendingTimers.add(id);
   219	    return id;
   220	  }

   251	  function unlockAudio() {
   252	    if (audioReady) return;
   253	    try {
   254	      const AudioCtor = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
   255	      if (!AudioCtor) return;
   256	      audioContext = new AudioCtor();
   257	      if (audioContext.state === 'suspended') audioContext.resume();
   258	      audioReady = true;
   259	      playTone(420, .08, 'sine');
   260	    } catch (_) { audioReady = false; }
   261	  }

   263	  function playTone(frequency, duration, type) {
   264	    if (!audioReady || !audioContext) return;
   265	    try {
   266	      const now = audioContext.currentTime;
   267	      const oscillator = audioContext.createOscillator();
   268	      const gain = audioContext.createGain();
   269	      oscillator.type = type || 'sine';
   270	      oscillator.frequency.setValueAtTime(frequency, now);
   271	      oscillator.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(Math.max(80, frequency * .72), now + duration);
   272	      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(.0001, now);
   273	      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.055, now + .01);
   274	      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.0001, now + duration);
   275	      oscillator.connect(gain).connect(audioContext.destination);
   276	      oscillator.start(now);
   277	      oscillator.stop(now + duration + .02);
   278	    } catch (_) { /* Sound is decorative. */ }
   279	  }
   280	
   281	  function showToast(text, life) {
   282	    toastText = text;
   283	    toastLife = life || 3;
   284	  }
   285	
   286	  function currentChapter() {
   287	    const found = state.notes.filter(Boolean).length;
   288	    return found >= 8 ? 3 : found >= 4 ? 2 : 1;
   289	  }
   290	
   291	  function noteUnlocked(index) {
   292	    if (index < 0 || index >= NOTES.length) return false;
   293	    return index === 0 || state.notes[index - 1] === true;
   294	  }
   295	
   296	  function syncProgress(notify) {
   297	    const cleared = state.fog.filter(value => value === false).length;
   298	    const thresholds = [20, 28, 36];
   299	    while (state.landmarks < 3 && cleared >= thresholds[state.landmarks]) {
   300	      const landmarkIndex = state.landmarks;
   301	      state.landmarks += 1;
   302	      const cell = LANDMARK_CELLS[landmarkIndex];
   303	      state.fog[cell] = false;
   304	      burstAtCell(cell, LANDMARKS[landmarkIndex].color, 18);
   305	      if (flashes.length < MAX_FLASHES) flashes.push({ life: .52, max: .52, color: LANDMARKS[landmarkIndex].color });
   306	      showToast(`${LANDMARKS[landmarkIndex].name} restored • a new chapter opens`, 4);
   307	      playTone(520 + landmarkIndex * 90, .2, 'triangle');
   308	    }
   309	    if (notify) safeSave();
   310	  }
   311	
   312	  function clearFogNear(index) {
   313	    const cx = index % COLS;
   314	    const cy = Math.floor(index / COLS);
   315	    const candidates = [];
   316	    for (let y = -1; y <= 1; y += 1) {
   317	      for (let x = -1; x <= 1; x += 1) {
   318	        const nx = cx + x;
   319	        const ny = cy + y;
   320	        if (nx < 0 || nx >= COLS || ny < 0 || ny >= ROWS) continue;
   321	        const cell = ny * COLS + nx;
   322	        if (state.fog[cell]) candidates.push(cell);
   323	      }
   324	    }
   325	    candidates.sort((a, b) => Math.abs(a - index) - Math.abs(b - index));
   326	    candidates.slice(0, 5).forEach(cell => {
   327	      state.fog[cell] = false;
   328	      const point = cellCenter(cell);
   329	      burst(point.x, point.y, COLORS.mist, 3, .55);
   330	    });
   331	    syncProgress(true);
   332	  }
   333	
   334	  function recoverGenerators() {
   335	    ['tide', 'wreck'].forEach(id => {
   336	      const generator = state.generators[id];
   337	      if (generator.uses > 0) return;
   338	      generator.recovery = Math.min(RECOVERY_MOVES, generator.recovery + 1);
   339	      if (generator.recovery >= RECOVERY_MOVES) {
   340	        generator.uses = generator.max;
   341	        generator.recovery = 0;
   342	        showToast(`${id === 'tide' ? 'Tide pool' : 'Wreck crate'} is ready again`, 2.4);
   343	        playTone(id === 'tide' ? 300 : 220, .1, 'sine');
   344	      }
   345	    });
   346	  }
   347	
   348	  function tryMerge(from, to) {
   349	    if (from === to || from < 0 || to < 0) return false;
   350	    const first = state.board[from];
   351	    const second = state.board[to];
   352	    if (!first || !second || first.kind !== second.kind || first.tier !== second.tier) {
   353	      showToast('Only matching pieces can join.', 1.6);
   354	      return false;
   355	    }
   356	    const chain = CHAINS[first.kind];
   357	    if (first.tier >= chain.max) {
   358	      showToast(`${chain.next[first.tier - 1] || chain.label} is a finished link.`, 1.8);
   359	      return false;
   360	    }
   361	    state.board[from] = null;
   362	    state.board[to] = { kind: first.kind, tier: first.tier + 1 };
   363	    state.merges = Math.min(9999, state.merges + 1);
   364	    state.score = Math.min(999999, state.score + 12 * (first.tier + 1));
   365	    state.best = Math.max(state.best, state.score);
   366	    const point = cellCenter(to);
   367	    burst(point.x, point.y, chain.color, 20, 1);
   368	    if (flashes.length < MAX_FLASHES) flashes.push({ life: .32, max: .32, color: chain.accent });
   369	    shake = Math.min(10, shake + 5);
   370	    playTone(260 + first.tier * 100, .12, first.tier ? 'triangle' : 'sine');
   371	    clearFogNear(to);
   372	    recoverGenerators();
   373	    if (state.merges % 3 === 0) showToast('The fog gives way. Keep the chain moving.', 2.5);
   374	    safeSave();
   375	    return true;
   376	  }
   377	
   378	  function generatorKind(id) {
   379	    if (id === 'tide') return state.merges % 2 === 0 ? 'shell' : 'herb';
   380	    return state.merges % 2 === 0 ? 'driftwood' : 'herb';
   381	  }
   382	
   383	  function tapGenerator(id) {
   384	    const generator = state.generators[id];
   385	    if (!generator || generator.uses <= 0) {
   386	      const moves = generator ? RECOVERY_MOVES - generator.recovery : RECOVERY_MOVES;
   387	      showToast(`${id === 'tide' ? 'Tide pool' : 'Wreck crate'} resting • merge ${moves} more elsewhere`, 2.8);
   388	      playTone(120, .07, 'square');
   389	      return;
   390	    }
   391	    const target = findSpawnCell();
   392	    if (target < 0) {
   393	      showToast('The board is full. Merge a pair to make room.', 2.5);
   394	      playTone(120, .07, 'square');
   395	      return;
   396	    }
   397	    const kind = generatorKind(id);
   398	    state.board[target] = { kind, tier: 0 };
   399	    state.fog[target] = false;
   400	    generator.uses -= 1;
   401	    const point = cellCenter(target);
   402	    burst(point.x, point.y, CHAINS[kind].accent, 12, .8);
   403	    showToast(`${kind === 'driftwood' ? 'Driftwood' : kind === 'shell' ? 'A shell' : 'Juniper'} washed ashore.`, 1.8);
   404	    playTone(id === 'tide' ? 350 : 190, .09, 'sine');
   405	    safeSave();
   406	  }
   407	
   408	  function findSpawnCell() {
   409	    const open = [];
   410	    for (let i = 0; i < CELL_COUNT; i += 1) {
   411	      if (!state.board[i] && !state.fog[i] && landmarkAt(i) < 0) open.push(i);
   412	    }
   413	    if (!open.length) return -1;
   414	    return open[Math.floor(Math.random() * open.length)];
   415	  }
   416	
   417	  function landmarkAt(index) {
   418	    for (let i = 0; i < LANDMARK_CELLS.length; i += 1) {
   419	      if (LANDMARK_CELLS[i] === index && state.landmarks > i) return i;
   420	    }
   421	    return -1;
   422	  }
   423	
   424	  function openNote(index) {
   425	    if (index < 0 || index >= NOTES.length || state.notes[index] || !noteUnlocked(index)) return;
   426	    state.notes[index] = true;
   427	    if (index + 1 < NOTE_CELLS.length) state.fog[NOTE_CELLS[index + 1]] = false;
   428	    state.modal = index;
   429	    state.score = Math.min(999999, state.score + 25);
   430	    state.best = Math.max(state.best, state.score);
   431	    state.keyboardPick = -1;
   432	    const point = cellCenter(NOTE_CELLS[index]);
   433	    burst(point.x, point.y, COLORS.gold, 20, .9);
   434	    shake = Math.min(10, shake + 3);
   435	    playTone(480 + NOTES[index].chapter * 80, .2, 'triangle');
   436	    if (state.notes.every(Boolean)) {
   437	      state.modal = null;
   438	      state.finale = true;
   439	      state.won = true;
   440	      showToast('The last note turns the fog into a road home.', 4);
   441	      safeSave();
   442	    } else {
   443	      showToast(`Found note ${String(index + 1).padStart(2, '0')} • read it closely`, 2.4);
   444	      safeSave();
   445	    }
   446	  }
   447	
   448	  function closeModal() {
   449	    if (state.finale) return;
   450	    state.modal = null;
   451	    resetPointerOnly();
   452	  }
   453	
   454	  function resetPointerOnly() {
   455	    activePointers.clear();
   456	    Object.keys(controlPointers).forEach(key => { controlPointers[key] = null; });
   457	    drag = null;
   458	  }
   459	
   460	  function queueAction(action) {
   461	    if (queuedActions.length < 12) queuedActions.push(action);
   462	  }
   463	
   464	  function processActions() {
   465	    while (queuedActions.length) {
   466	      const action = queuedActions.shift();
   467	      if (action === 'space') keyboardSpace();
   468	      if (action === 'left') moveCursor(-1, 0);
   469	      if (action === 'right') moveCursor(1, 0);
   470	      if (action === 'up') moveCursor(0, -1);
   471	      if (action === 'down') moveCursor(0, 1);
   472	    }
   473	  }
   474	
   475	  function moveCursor(dx, dy) {
   476	    const x = state.cursor % COLS;
   477	    const y = Math.floor(state.cursor / COLS);
   478	    const nx = Math.max(0, Math.min(COLS - 1, x + dx));
   479	    const ny = Math.max(0, Math.min(ROWS - 1, y + dy));
   480	    state.cursor = ny * COLS + nx;
   481	  }
   482	
   483	  function keyboardSpace() {
   484	    if (state.finale) { restartGame(); return; }
   485	    if (state.modal !== null) { closeModal(); return; }
   486	    const index = state.cursor;
   487	    if (state.keyboardPick < 0) {
   488	      if (state.board[index]) {
   489	        state.keyboardPick = index;
   490	        showToast('Selected. Move with arrows, then press Space on a match.', 2.2);
   491	        playTone(350, .05, 'sine');
   492	      } else if (noteIndexAtCell(index) >= 0) {
   493	        openNote(noteIndexAtCell(index));
   494	      }
   495	      return;
   496	    }
   497	    if (state.keyboardPick === index) {
   498	      state.keyboardPick = -1;
   499	      return;
   500	    }
   501	    tryMerge(state.keyboardPick, index);
   502	    state.keyboardPick = -1;
   503	  }
   504	
   505	  function noteIndexAtCell(cell) {
   506	    for (let i = 0; i < NOTE_CELLS.length; i += 1) {
   507	      if (NOTE_CELLS[i] === cell && noteUnlocked(i) && !state.notes[i]) return i;
   508	    }
   509	    return -1;
   510	  }
   511	
   512	  function resize() {
   513	    view.w = Math.max(240, window.innerWidth || 390);
   514	    view.h = Math.max(420, window.innerHeight || 700);
   515	    orientationPaused = view.w > view.h;
   516	    rotateOverlay.hidden = !orientationPaused;
   517	    const longAxis = Math.max(view.w, view.h);
   518	    view.dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2, 960 / longAxis);
   519	    canvas.width = Math.max(1, Math.round(view.w * view.dpr));
   520	    canvas.height = Math.max(1, Math.round(view.h * view.dpr));
   521	    ctx.setTransform(view.dpr, 0, 0, view.dpr, 0, 0);
   522	    view.boardW = Math.min(view.w - 24, 380);
   523	    view.cell = (view.boardW - CELL_GAP * (COLS - 1)) / COLS;
   524	    view.boardW = view.cell * COLS + CELL_GAP * (COLS - 1);
   525	    view.boardX = (view.w - view.boardW) / 2;
   526	    view.boardY = view.h < 590 ? 112 : 128;
   527	    view.boardH = view.cell * ROWS + CELL_GAP * (ROWS - 1);
   528	  }
   529	
   530	  function cellRect(index) {
   531	    const x = index % COLS;
   532	    const y = Math.floor(index / COLS);
   533	    return { x: view.boardX + x * (view.cell + CELL_GAP), y: view.boardY + y * (view.cell + CELL_GAP), w: view.cell, h: view.cell };
   534	  }
   535	
   536	  function cellCenter(index) {
   537	    const rect = cellRect(Math.max(0, Math.min(CELL_COUNT - 1, index)));
   538	    return { x: rect.x + rect.w / 2, y: rect.y + rect.h / 2 };
   539	  }
   540	
   541	  function cellAt(x, y) {
   542	    const col = Math.floor((x - view.boardX) / (view.cell + CELL_GAP));
   543	    const row = Math.floor((y - view.boardY) / (view.cell + CELL_GAP));
   544	    if (col < 0 || col >= COLS || row < 0 || row >= ROWS) return -1;
   545	    const rect = cellRect(row * COLS + col);
   546	    if (x > rect.x + rect.w || y > rect.y + rect.h) return -1;
   547	    return row * COLS + col;
   548	  }
   549	
   550	  function generatorRect(id) {
   551	    const margin = 14;
   552	    const gap = 8;
   553	    const width = (view.w - margin * 2 - gap) / 2;
   554	    return { x: margin + (id === 'wreck' ? width + gap : 0), y: view.h - 76, w: width, h: 58 };
   555	  }
   556	
   557	  function restartRect() {
   558	    return { x: view.w - 104, y: 12, w: 90, h: 50 };
   559	  }
   560	
   561	  function modalCloseRect() {
   562	    if (state.finale) {
   563	      const height = Math.min(430, view.h - 170);
   564	      return { x: 18, y: 96 + height - 62, w: view.w - 36, h: 58 };
   565	    }
   566	    const height = Math.min(350, view.h - 210);
   567	    return { x: 18, y: 116 + height - 65, w: view.w - 36, h: 58 };
   568	  }
   569	
   570	  function pointIn(point, rect) {
   571	    return point.x >= rect.x && point.x <= rect.x + rect.w && point.y >= rect.y && point.y <= rect.y + rect.h;
   572	  }
   573	
   574	  function pointerPoint(event) {
   575	    const bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
   576	    return { x: event.clientX - bounds.left, y: event.clientY - bounds.top };
   577	  }
   578	
   579	  function pointerDown(event) {
   580	    event.preventDefault();
   581	    unlockAudio();
   582	    const point = pointerPoint(event);
   583	    const id = event.pointerId;
   584	    if (activePointers.has(id) || activePointers.size >= MAX_POINTERS) return;
   585	    if (orientationPaused) return;
   586	    if (state.finale) {
   587	      if (pointIn(point, modalCloseRect()) && controlPointers.restart === null) {
   588	        controlPointers.restart = id;
   589	        activePointers.set(id, 'restart');
   590	        canvas.setPointerCapture?.(id);
   591	      }
   592	      return;
   593	    }
   594	    if (state.modal !== null) {
   595	      if (pointIn(point, modalCloseRect()) && controlPointers.modal === null) {
   596	        controlPointers.modal = id;
   597	        activePointers.set(id, 'modal');
   598	        canvas.setPointerCapture?.(id);
   599	      }
   600	      return;
   601	    }
   602	    if (pointIn(point, restartRect()) && controlPointers.restart === null) {
   603	      controlPointers.restart = id;
   604	      activePointers.set(id, 'restart');
   605	      canvas.setPointerCapture?.(id);
   606	      return;
   607	    }
   608	    for (const generatorId of ['tide', 'wreck']) {
   609	      if (pointIn(point, generatorRect(generatorId)) && controlPointers[generatorId] === null) {
   610	        controlPointers[generatorId] = id;
   611	        activePointers.set(id, generatorId);
   612	        canvas.setPointerCapture?.(id);
   613	        return;
   614	      }
   615	    }
   616	    const index = cellAt(point.x, point.y);
   617	    if (index >= 0 && controlPointers.board === null) {
   618	      controlPointers.board = id;
   619	      activePointers.set(id, 'board');
   620	      drag = { pointerId: id, start: index, end: index, point };
   621	      state.cursor = index;
   622	      canvas.setPointerCapture?.(id);
   623	    }
   624	  }
   625	
   626	  function pointerMove(event) {
   627	    const kind = activePointers.get(event.pointerId);
   628	    if (kind !== 'board' || !drag || drag.pointerId !== event.pointerId || orientationPaused) return;
   629	    event.preventDefault();
   630	    const point = pointerPoint(event);
   631	    const index = cellAt(point.x, point.y);
   632	    if (index >= 0) drag.end = index;
   633	    drag.point = point;
   634	    state.cursor = index >= 0 ? index : state.cursor;
   635	  }
   636	
   637	  function pointerUp(event, cancelled) {
   638	    const id = event.pointerId;
   639	    const kind = activePointers.get(id);
   640	    if (!kind) return;
   641	    event.preventDefault();
   642	    const point = pointerPoint(event);
   643	    activePointers.delete(id);
   644	    if (controlPointers[kind] === id) controlPointers[kind] = null;
   645	    if (kind === 'restart') {
   646	      if (!cancelled && (state.finale || pointIn(point, restartRect()))) restartGame();
   647	      return;
   648	    }
   649	    if (kind === 'modal') {
   650	      if (!cancelled && pointIn(point, modalCloseRect())) closeModal();
   651	      return;
   652	    }
   653	    if (kind === 'tide' || kind === 'wreck') {
   654	      if (!cancelled && pointIn(point, generatorRect(kind))) tapGenerator(kind);
   655	      return;
   656	    }
   657	    if (kind === 'board') {
   658	      const boardDrag = drag;
   659	      drag = null;
   660	      if (cancelled || !boardDrag) return;
   661	      const end = cellAt(point.x, point.y);
   662	      const finalCell = end >= 0 ? end : boardDrag.end;
   663	      const noteIndex = noteIndexAtCell(finalCell);
   664	      if (noteIndex >= 0 && boardDrag.start === finalCell) {
   665	        openNote(noteIndex);
   666	      } else if (boardDrag.start !== finalCell) {
   667	        tryMerge(boardDrag.start, finalCell);
   668	        state.keyboardPick = -1;
   669	      } else if (state.board[finalCell]) {
   670	        state.keyboardPick = state.keyboardPick === finalCell ? -1 : finalCell;
   671	        showToast('Selected. Drag it onto its match.', 1.6);
   672	      }
   673	    }
   674	  }
   675	
   676	  function clearAllInput() {
   677	    resetInput();
   678	  }

   680	  function drawBackground() {
   681	    const gradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, view.h);
   682	    gradient.addColorStop(0, '#061721');
   683	    gradient.addColorStop(.56, '#0c2b36');
   684	    gradient.addColorStop(1, '#071923');
   685	    ctx.fillStyle = gradient;
   686	    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, view.w, view.h);
   687	    ctx.save();
   688	    ctx.globalAlpha = .18;
   689	    ctx.strokeStyle = COLORS.aqua;
   690	    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
   691	    for (let row = 0; row < 8; row += 1) {
   692	      ctx.beginPath();
   693	      for (let x = -20; x < view.w + 30; x += 18) {
   694	        const y = 75 + row * 90 + Math.sin(x * .035 + row) * 3;
   695	        if (x === -20) ctx.moveTo(x, y); else ctx.lineTo(x, y);
   696	      }
   697	      ctx.stroke();
   698	    }
   699	    ctx.restore();
   700	  }

   711	    ctx.letterSpacing = '0px';

   713	    roundedRect(button.x, button.y, button.w, button.h, 12, '#143b43', '#2b6870');

   721	    drawStat(281, 67, 'BEST', String(Math.max(state.best, state.score)));
   722	    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
   723	    const milestones = [20, 28, 36];
   724	    const cleared = state.fog.filter(value => value === false).length;
   725	    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.muted;
   726	    ctx.font = '700 9px Arial, sans-serif';
   727	    ctx.fillText(`MIST CLEAR  ${Math.min(cleared, 42)}/42`, 16, 93);

   729	      const x = 104 + i * 16;
   730	      ctx.beginPath();
   731	      ctx.arc(x, 90, 4, 0, TAU);
   732	      ctx.fillStyle = state.landmarks > i ? LANDMARKS[i].color : '#244852';
   733	      ctx.fill();
   734	      if (cleared < milestones[i] && state.landmarks === i) {
   735	        ctx.strokeStyle = COLORS.gold;
   736	        ctx.lineWidth = 1;
   737	        ctx.stroke();
   738	      }
   739	    }

   743	    ctx.textAlign = 'left';

   746	    ctx.fillText(label, x, y);

   752	  function drawBoard() {
   753	    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
   754	    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.muted;
   755	    ctx.font = '800 10px Arial, sans-serif';
   756	    ctx.fillText('THE FOGGED BOARD', view.boardX, view.boardY - 11);
   757	    ctx.textAlign = 'right';
   758	    ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.gold;
   759	    ctx.font = '700 10px Arial, sans-serif';
   760	    ctx.fillText(`${state.merges} REPAIRS`, view.boardX + view.boardW, view.boardY - 11);
   761	    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
   762	    for (let i = 0; i < CELL_COUNT; i += 1) drawCell(i);
   763	    if (drag) {
   764	      const targetRect = cellRect(drag.end);
   765	      ctx.save();
   766	      ctx.strokeStyle = COLORS.gold;
   767	      ctx.lineWidth = 3;
   768	      ctx.globalAlpha = .9;
   769	      roundedRect(targetRect.x - 2, targetRect.y - 2, targetRect.w + 4, targetRect.h + 4, 13, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)', COLORS.gold);
   770	      ctx.restore();
   771	    }
   772	    if (state.keyboardPick >= 0) {
   773	      const picked = cellRect(state.keyboardPick);
   774	      ctx.save();
   775	      ctx.strokeStyle = COLORS.coral;
   776	      ctx.lineWidth = 3;
   777	      roundedRect(picked.x - 3, picked.y - 3, picked.w + 6, picked.h + 6, 14, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)', COLORS.coral);
   778	      ctx.restore();
   779	    }
   780	    const cursor = cellRect(state.cursor);
   781	    ctx.save();
   782	    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(245,239,217,.8)';
   783	    ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
   784	    roundedRect(cursor.x - 1, cursor.y - 1, cursor.w + 2, cursor.h + 2, 11, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)', 'rgba(245,239,217,.8)');
   785	    ctx.restore();
   786	  }

   788	  function drawCell(index) {
   789	    const rect = cellRect(index);
   790	    const landmark = landmarkAt(index);
   791	    if (state.fog[index]) {
   792	      roundedRect(rect.x, rect.y, rect.w, rect.h, 12, '#36585a', '#527572');
   793	      ctx.save();

   795	      ctx.fillStyle = COLORS.paper;
   796	      for (let p = 0; p < 3; p += 1) {
   797	        ctx.beginPath();
   798	        ctx.arc(rect.x + rect.w * (.22 + p * .27), rect.y + rect.h * (.36 + (p % 2) * .2), rect.w * .11, 0, TAU);
   799	        ctx.fill();
   800	      }
   801	      ctx.restore();
   802	      ctx.fillStyle = '#80a59c';
   803	      ctx.font = '800 8px Arial, sans-serif';
   804	      ctx.textAlign = 'center';
   805	      ctx.fillText('MIST', rect.x + rect.w / 2, rect.y + rect.h * .82);
   806	      ctx.textAlign = 'left';
   807	      return;
   808	    }
   809	    roundedRect(rect.x, rect.y, rect.w, rect.h, 12, '#123a46', '#255966');
   810	    if (landmark >= 0) drawLandmark(rect, landmark);
   811	    const item = state.board[index];
   812	    if (item) drawItem(rect, item);
   813	    const note = noteIndexAtCell(index);
   814	    if (note >= 0) drawNotePin(rect, note);
   815	  }

   837	  function drawIcon(kind, tier, x, y, scale, accent) {
   838	    ctx.save();
   839	    ctx.strokeStyle = accent;
   840	    ctx.fillStyle = accent;
   841	    ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1.5, 2.2 * scale);
   842	    ctx.lineCap = 'round';
   843	    ctx.lineJoin = 'round';
   844	    if (kind === 'driftwood') {
   845	      if (tier === 0) {
   846	        ctx.rotate(-.14);
   847	        roundedRect(x - 14 * scale, y - 3 * scale, 28 * scale, 7 * scale, 3 * scale, accent, 'rgba(0,0,0,.14)');
   848	        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x - 7 * scale, y - 2 * scale); ctx.lineTo(x - 3 * scale, y + 2 * scale); ctx.moveTo(x + 3 * scale, y - 2 * scale); ctx.lineTo(x + 7 * scale, y + 2 * scale); ctx.stroke();
   849	      } else if (tier === 1) {
   850	        for (let i = -1; i <= 1; i += 1) {
   851	          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x - 13 * scale, y + i * 6 * scale); ctx.lineTo(x + 12 * scale, y + i * 6 * scale); ctx.stroke();
   852	        }
   853	      } else {
   854	        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x - 12 * scale, y + 9 * scale); ctx.lineTo(x - 12 * scale, y - 9 * scale); ctx.lineTo(x + 9 * scale, y - 9 * scale); ctx.lineTo(x + 9 * scale, y + 9 * scale); ctx.moveTo(x - 16 * scale, y + 9 * scale); ctx.lineTo(x + 14 * scale, y + 9 * scale); ctx.stroke();
   855	      }
   856	    } else if (kind === 'shell') {
   857	      ctx.beginPath();
   858	      ctx.arc(x, y + 4 * scale, 13 * scale, Math.PI, TAU);
   859	      ctx.lineTo(x + 13 * scale, y + 4 * scale);
   860	      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y + 14 * scale, x - 13 * scale, y + 4 * scale);
   861	      ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
   862	      for (let i = -1; i <= 1; i += 1) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x, y + 4 * scale); ctx.lineTo(x + i * 8 * scale, y - 7 * scale); ctx.stroke(); }
   863	    } else {
   864	      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x, y + 13 * scale); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x - 11 * scale, y + 1 * scale, x - 5 * scale, y - 10 * scale); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + 10 * scale, y - 6 * scale, x, y + 13 * scale); ctx.fill();
   865	      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x, y + 14 * scale); ctx.lineTo(x + 4 * scale, y - 12 * scale); ctx.stroke();
   866	      if (tier === 1) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x + 10 * scale, y - 7 * scale); ctx.lineTo(x + 16 * scale, y - 7 * scale); ctx.moveTo(x + 13 * scale, y - 10 * scale); ctx.lineTo(x + 13 * scale, y - 4 * scale); ctx.stroke(); }
   867	    }
   868	    ctx.restore();
   869	  }

  1034	  function wrapText(text, x, y, maxWidth, lineHeight, maxLines) {
  1035	    const words = text.split(' ');
  1036	    let line = '';
  1037	    let lines = 0;
  1038	    for (let i = 0; i < words.length; i += 1) {
  1039	      const candidate = line ? `${line} ${words[i]}` : words[i];
  1040	      if (ctx.measureText(candidate).width > maxWidth && line) {
  1041	        ctx.fillText(line, x, y + lines * lineHeight);
  1042	        lines += 1;
  1043	        line = words[i];
  1044	        if (lines >= maxLines - 1) {
  1045	          line = `${line}…`;
  1046	          break;
  1047	        }
  1048	      } else line = candidate;
  1049	    }
  1050	    if (line && lines < maxLines) ctx.fillText(line, x, y + lines * lineHeight);
  1051	  }
  1052	
  1053	  function roundedRect(x, y, w, h, radius, fill, stroke) {
  1054	    ctx.beginPath();
  1055	    ctx.moveTo(x + radius, y);
  1056	    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, radius);
  1057	    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, radius);
  1058	    ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, radius);
  1059	    ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, radius);
  1060	    ctx.closePath();
  1061	    if (fill) { ctx.fillStyle = fill; ctx.fill(); }
  1062	    if (stroke) { ctx.strokeStyle = stroke; ctx.stroke(); }
  1063	  }
  1064	
  1065	  function burst(x, y, color, amount, speed) {
  1066	    const count = Math.min(amount || 8, MAX_PARTICLES - particles.length);
  1067	    for (let i = 0; i < count; i += 1) {
  1068	      const angle = Math.random() * TAU;
  1069	      const velocity = (30 + Math.random() * 70) * (speed || 1);
  1070	      particles.push({ x, y, vx: Math.cos(angle) * velocity, vy: Math.sin(angle) * velocity - 14, life: .45 + Math.random() * .45, max: 1, size: 2 + Math.random() * 3, color });
  1071	    }
  1072	  }
  1073	
  1074	  function burstAtCell(index, color, amount) {
  1075	    const point = cellCenter(index);
  1076	    burst(point.x, point.y, color, amount, 1.1);
  1077	  }
  1078	
  1079	  function updateParticles(dt) {
  1080	    for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i -= 1) {
  1081	      const particle = particles[i];
  1082	      particle.life -= dt;
  1083	      particle.x += particle.vx * dt;
  1084	      particle.y += particle.vy * dt;
  1085	      particle.vy += 70 * dt;
  1086	      if (particle.life <= 0) particles.splice(i, 1);
  1087	    }
  1088	    for (let i = floaters.length - 1; i >= 0; i -= 1) {
  1089	      const floater = floaters[i];
  1090	      floater.life -= dt;
  1091	      floater.y -= 19 * dt;
  1092	      if (floater.life <= 0) floaters.splice(i, 1);
  1093	    }
  1094	    for (let i = flashes.length - 1; i >= 0; i -= 1) {
  1095	      flashes[i].life -= dt;
  1096	      if (flashes[i].life <= 0) flashes.splice(i, 1);
  1097	    }
  1098	  }
  1099	
  1100	  function drawParticles() {
  1101	    particles.forEach(particle => {
  1102	      ctx.save();
  1103	      ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, particle.life / particle.max);
  1104	      ctx.fillStyle = particle.color;
  1105	      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(particle.x, particle.y, particle.size, 0, TAU); ctx.fill();
  1106	      ctx.restore();
  1107	    });
  1108	    floaters.forEach(floater => {
  1109	      ctx.save();
  1110	      ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, floater.life / floater.max);
  1111	      ctx.fillStyle = floater.color;
  1112	      ctx.font = '800 12px Arial, sans-serif';
  1113	      ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  1114	      ctx.fillText(floater.text, floater.x, floater.y);
  1115	      ctx.restore();
  1116	    });
  1117	  }
  1118	
  1119	  function update(dt) {
  1120	    if (orientationPaused) return;
  1121	    processActions();
  1122	    if (state.modal !== null || state.finale) return;
  1123	    state.sessionTime += dt;
  1124	    toastLife = Math.max(0, toastLife - dt);
  1125	    shake = Math.max(0, shake - dt * 16);
  1126	    updateParticles(dt);
  1127	  }
  1128	
  1129	  let shake = 0;
  1130	  function draw() {
  1131	    ctx.save();
  1132	    const offsetX = shake ? (Math.random() - .5) * shake : 0;
  1133	    const offsetY = shake ? (Math.random() - .5) * shake : 0;
  1134	    ctx.translate(offsetX, offsetY);
  1135	    drawBackground();
  1136	    drawHeader();
  1137	    drawBoard();
  1138	    drawGenerators();
  1139	    drawParticles();
  1140	    drawToast();
  1141	    ctx.restore();
  1142	    flashes.forEach(flash => {
  1143	      ctx.save();
  1144	      ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, flash.life / flash.max) * .12;
  1145	      ctx.fillStyle = flash.color;
  1146	      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, view.w, view.h);
  1147	      ctx.restore();
  1148	    });
  1149	    drawModal();
  1150	  }
  1151	
  1152	  function frame(time) {
  1153	    if (!lastFrame) lastFrame = time;
  1154	    const dt = Math.min(.05, Math.max(0, (time - lastFrame) / 1000));
  1155	    lastFrame = time;
  1156	    update(dt);
  1157	    draw();
  1158	    window.requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  1159	  }

  1161	  startButton.addEventListener('pointerdown', event => {

   240	    checkEnd();
   241	  }
   242	  function checkEnd() {
   243	    if (G.mask === 0) {
   244	      var left = G.stock.length - G.si;
   245	      G.score += 250 + left * 10;
   246	      var gamble = DEALS[G.deal][1] === 0;
   247	      var coins = Math.floor(G.score / 22) + 15;
   248	      if (gamble) coins *= 3;
   249	      G.reward = coins;
   250	      G.result = 'win';
   251	      S.coins += coins;
   252	      S.won[G.deal] = 1;
   253	      if (G.score > S.best[G.deal]) S.best[G.deal] = G.score;
   254	      if (G.deal + 1 < DEALS.length) S.current = G.deal + 1;
   255	      save();
   256	      G.flash = 1; shake(10); Sound.win();
   257	      for (var k = 0; k < 5; k++) later(function () { burst(VW * (0.2 + Math.random() * 0.6), 120 + Math.random() * 120, 20, ['#ffd76a', '#9dd06a', '#f0a6c8'][Math.floor(Math.random() * 3)], 220); }, k * 160);
   258	      return;
   259	    }
   260	    if (stuck()) {
   261	      G.result = 'lose';
   262	      if (G.score > S.best[G.deal]) { S.best[G.deal] = G.score; save(); }
   263	      shake(6); Sound.fail();
   264	    }
   265	  }
   266	  function useWild(i) {
   267	    if (S.wilds <= 0) { Sound.deny(); return; }
   268	    doPlay(i, true);
   269	  }
   270	
   271	  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- meadow ops
   272	  function meadowDone() {
   273	    for (var i = 0; i < S.meadow.length; i++) if (S.meadow[i] < 3) return false;
   274	    return true;
   275	  }
   276	  function grow(i) {
   277	    if (i < 0 || i >= S.meadow.length) return;
   278	    var st = S.meadow[i];
   279	    if (st >= 3) { Sound.deny(); return; }
   280	    var c = Meadow.cost(st);
   281	    if (S.coins < c) { Sound.deny(); say('Need ' + (c - S.coins) + ' more coins - win a deal.', 3); return; }
   282	    S.coins -= c;
   283	    S.meadow[i] = st + 1;
   284	    Sound.plant(st);
   285	    save();
   286	    if (meadowDone() && !S.celebrated) {
   287	      S.celebrated = 1; save();
   288	      G.celebrate = 6;
   289	      Sound.bloom();
   290	    }
   291	  }
   292	
   293	  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- drawing
   294	  function rr(x, y, w, h, r) {
   295	    ctx.beginPath();
   296	    ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
   297	    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
   298	    ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
   299	    ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
   300	    ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
   301	    ctx.closePath();
   302	  }
   303	  function txt(s, x, y, size, col, align, bold) {
   304	    ctx.fillStyle = col;
   305	    ctx.font = (bold ? '700 ' : '') + size + 'px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif';
   306	    ctx.textAlign = align || 'left';
   307	    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
   308	    ctx.fillText(s, x, y);
   309	  }
   310	  function drawCard(c, x, y, w, h, state) {
   311	    // state: 'free' | 'blocked' | 'hot' | 'plain'
   312	    var red = suit(c) === 1 || suit(c) === 2;
   313	    ctx.save();
   314	    if (state === 'hot') { ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(255,225,120,0.9)'; ctx.shadowBlur = 12; }
   315	    ctx.fillStyle = state === 'blocked' ? '#8f9a8c' : '#f4f1e2';
   316	    rr(x, y, w, h, 5); ctx.fill();
   317	    ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
   318	    ctx.lineWidth = state === 'hot' ? 2.6 : 1.4;
   319	    ctx.strokeStyle = state === 'hot' ? '#ffdf7a' : (state === 'blocked' ? '#5d6a5a' : '#3d4a3c');
   320	    rr(x, y, w, h, 5); ctx.stroke();
   321	    var col = state === 'blocked' ? (red ? '#7e3b3b' : '#333c33') : (red ? '#c03a3a' : '#232b23');
   322	    var fs = Math.max(13, Math.round(h * 0.34));
   323	    txt(RANKS[rank(c)], x + w * 0.5, y + h * 0.36, fs, col, 'center', true);
   324	    txt(SUITS[suit(c)], x + w * 0.5, y + h * 0.72, Math.round(fs * 0.86), col, 'center', false);
   325	    ctx.restore();
   326	  }
   327	  function drawCardBack(x, y, w, h) {
   328	    ctx.fillStyle = '#2f5a3a'; rr(x, y, w, h, 5); ctx.fill();
   329	    ctx.strokeStyle = '#7fae63'; ctx.lineWidth = 1.6; rr(x + 3, y + 3, w - 6, h - 6, 4); ctx.stroke();
   330	    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(160,205,130,0.55)'; ctx.lineWidth = 2;
   331	    ctx.beginPath();
   332	    ctx.moveTo(x + w / 2, y + h - 12);
   333	    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w / 2, y + h * 0.42, x + w / 2, y + 12);
   334	    ctx.stroke();
   335	    for (var k = -1; k <= 1; k += 2) {
   336	      ctx.beginPath();
   337	      ctx.moveTo(x + w / 2, y + h * 0.55);
   338	      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w / 2 + k * 11, y + h * 0.42, x + w / 2, y + h * 0.3);
   339	      ctx.stroke();
   340	    }
   341	  }
   342	  function button(x, y, w, h, label, on, sub) {
   343	    ctx.fillStyle = on ? '#5c8f43' : '#33422f';
   344	    rr(x, y, w, h, 10); ctx.fill();
   345	    ctx.strokeStyle = on ? '#a9d585' : '#4a5b45'; ctx.lineWidth = 2;
   346	    rr(x, y, w, h, 10); ctx.stroke();
   347	    txt(label, x + w / 2, y + h / 2 - (sub ? 8 : 0), 16, on ? '#f2f8e8' : '#8b9a86', 'center', true);
   348	    if (sub) txt(sub, x + w / 2, y + h / 2 + 12, 12, on ? '#dbeec4' : '#75836f', 'center', false);
   349	    return { x: x, y: y, w: w, h: h };
   350	  }

   352	  // ------------------------------------------------------- play screen render
   353	  function drawPlay(dt) {
   354	    var sx = 0, sy = 0;
   355	    if (G.shake > 0.2) { sx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * G.shake; sy = (Math.random() - 0.5) * G.shake; }
   356	    ctx.save(); ctx.translate(sx, sy);
   357	
   358	    // background
   359	    var g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, 330);
   360	    g.addColorStop(0, '#22331f'); g.addColorStop(1, '#1a2a1c');
   361	    ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, VW, 332);
   362	
   363	    // HUD
   364	    var d = DEALS[G.deal], fair = d[1] === 1;
   365	    ctx.fillStyle = '#2b3a29'; rr(MENUB.x, MENUB.y, MENUB.w, MENUB.h, 9); ctx.fill();
   366	    ctx.strokeStyle = '#5d7554'; ctx.lineWidth = 1.6; rr(MENUB.x, MENUB.y, MENUB.w, MENUB.h, 9); ctx.stroke();
   367	    txt('‹', MENUB.x + MENUB.w / 2, MENUB.y + 15, 18, '#cfe0bd', 'center', true);
   368	    txt('meadow', MENUB.x + MENUB.w / 2, MENUB.y + 32, 9, '#93a68b', 'center', false);
   369	
   370	    txt('DEAL ' + (G.deal + 1) + '/' + DEALS.length, 72, 17, 14, '#cfe0bd', 'left', true);
   371	    ctx.fillStyle = fair ? 'rgba(120,190,90,0.22)' : 'rgba(215,150,60,0.22)';
   372	    var bw = fair ? 92 : 108;
   373	    rr(72, 27, bw, 20, 6); ctx.fill();
   374	    ctx.strokeStyle = fair ? '#78be5a' : '#e2a24a'; ctx.lineWidth = 1.2; rr(72, 27, bw, 20, 6); ctx.stroke();
   375	    txt(fair ? 'FAIR · solvable' : 'GAMBLE deal', 78, 37, 11, fair ? '#b7e295' : '#f0c07a', 'left', true);
   376	    txt(d[2] + '% clear odds', 72, 57, 10, '#93a68b', 'left', false);
   377	
   378	    txt('SCORE', VW - 10, 15, 10, '#8fa287', 'right', false);
   379	    txt('' + G.score, VW - 10, 32, 20, '#f2f8e8', 'right', true);
   380	    txt('best ' + S.best[G.deal], VW - 10, 48, 10, '#8fa287', 'right', false);
   381	    if (G.streak > 1) {
   382	      var mult = Math.min(6, 1 + (G.streak - 1) * 0.5);
   383	      txt('CHAIN x' + mult.toFixed(1) + '  ·  ' + G.streak + ' in a row', 195, 208, 13, '#ffd76a', 'center', true);
   384	    }
   385	
   386	    // tableau
   387	    for (var i = 27; i >= 0; i--) {
   388	      if (!alive(i)) continue;
   389	      var p = cardPos(i);
   390	      var st = free(i) ? (playable(i) || (G.wildArmed) ? 'hot' : 'free') : 'blocked';
   391	      if (G.wildArmed && !free(i)) st = 'blocked';
   392	      drawCard(G.tab[i], p.x, p.y, CW, CH, st);
   393	      if (G.sel === i) {
   394	        ctx.strokeStyle = '#8fd0e8'; ctx.lineWidth = 3;
   395	        rr(p.x - 2, p.y - 2, CW + 4, CH + 4, 6); ctx.stroke();
   396	      }
   397	    }
   398	
   399	    // stock
   400	    var remain = G.stock.length - G.si;
   401	    if (remain > 0) {
   402	      for (var s = Math.min(3, remain) - 1; s >= 0; s--) drawCardBack(STOCK.x - s * 2, STOCK.y - s * 2, STOCK.w, STOCK.h);
   403	    } else {
   404	      ctx.strokeStyle = '#4a5b45'; ctx.lineWidth = 2; ctx.setLineDash([5, 5]);
   405	      rr(STOCK.x, STOCK.y, STOCK.w, STOCK.h, 5); ctx.stroke(); ctx.setLineDash([]);
   406	    }
   407	    txt(remain + ' left', STOCK.x + STOCK.w / 2, STOCK.y + STOCK.h + 14, 12, '#a4b79b', 'center', false);
   408	    txt('DRAW', STOCK.x + STOCK.w / 2, STOCK.y - 12, 11, '#8fa287', 'center', true);
   409	
   410	    // waste
   411	    drawCard(G.wasteCard, WASTE.x, WASTE.y, WASTE.w, WASTE.h, 'plain');
   412	    txt('MATCH ±1', WASTE.x + WASTE.w / 2, WASTE.y - 12, 11, '#cfe0bd', 'center', true);
   413	    txt(cardsLeft() + ' cards on the peaks', WASTE.x + WASTE.w / 2, WASTE.y + WASTE.h + 14, 12, '#a4b79b', 'center', false);
   414	
   415	    // wild button
   416	    var canWild = S.wilds > 0;
   417	    ctx.fillStyle = G.wildArmed ? '#6b4f9c' : (canWild ? '#3e3357' : '#2a3128');
   418	    rr(WILDB.x, WILDB.y, WILDB.w, WILDB.h, 9); ctx.fill();
   419	    ctx.strokeStyle = canWild ? '#c9a6ff' : '#414d3d'; ctx.lineWidth = 2;
   420	    rr(WILDB.x, WILDB.y, WILDB.w, WILDB.h, 9); ctx.stroke();
   421	    txt('WILD', WILDB.x + WILDB.w / 2, WILDB.y + 22, 14, canWild ? '#e2d2ff' : '#6d7a69', 'center', true);
   422	    txt('x' + S.wilds, WILDB.x + WILDB.w / 2, WILDB.y + 46, 20, canWild ? '#fff' : '#6d7a69', 'center', true);
   423	    txt(G.wildArmed ? 'pick card' : 'any card', WILDB.x + WILDB.w / 2, WILDB.y + 68, 10, canWild ? '#bda9e0' : '#6d7a69', 'center', false);
   424	
   425	    // hint line
   426	    txt(G.hint, VW / 2, 318, 12, '#9fb394', 'center', false);
   427	
   428	    // meadow strip
   429	    var mb = Meadow.draw(ctx, 0, 332, VW, VH - 332, S.meadow, G.t, { scale: 0.9 });
   430	    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(10,18,10,0.55)'; ctx.fillRect(0, 332, VW, 26);
   431	    txt('YOUR MEADOW  ·  ' + grown() + '/' + (S.meadow.length * 3) + ' growth', 10, 345, 12, '#cfe0bd', 'left', true);
   432	    txt(S.coins + ' coins', VW - 10, 345, 12, '#ffd76a', 'right', true);
   433	
   434	    // animating cards
   435	    for (var a = 0; a < G.anims.length; a++) {
   436	      var an = G.anims[a], k = Math.min(1, an.t / an.d), e = k * k * (3 - 2 * k);
   437	      var ax = an.x + (an.tx - an.x) * e, ay = an.y + (an.ty - an.y) * e;
   438	      var aw = an.sw + (WASTE.w - an.sw) * e, ah = an.sh + (WASTE.h - an.sh) * e;
   439	      drawCard(an.c, ax, ay, aw, ah, 'plain');
   440	    }
   441	    drawFx();
   442	    ctx.restore();
   443	
   444	    if (G.flash > 0) {
   445	      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,247,210,' + (G.flash * 0.45).toFixed(3) + ')';
   446	      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, VW, VH);
   447	    }
   448	    if (G.result) drawResult();
   449	  }
   450	  function grown() { var n = 0; for (var i = 0; i < S.meadow.length; i++) n += S.meadow[i]; return n; }

   452	  function drawFx() {
   453	    for (var i = 0; i < G.parts.length; i++) {
   454	      var p = G.parts[i];
   455	      ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, p.life));
   456	      ctx.fillStyle = p.c;
   457	      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.r, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
   458	    }
   459	    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
   460	    for (var f = 0; f < G.floats.length; f++) {
   461	      var fl = G.floats[f];
   462	      ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, fl.life));
   463	      txt(fl.t, fl.x, fl.y, 14, fl.c, 'center', true);
   464	    }
   465	    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
   466	  }

   485	    var hasNext = G.deal + 1 < DEALS.length;

   487	    resultBtns.c = button(60, y + 276, 270, 48, win ? 'REPLAY THIS DEAL' : 'PICK ANOTHER DEAL', true, null);
   488	  }
