   571	  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- update
   572	  function update(dt) {
   573	    G.t += dt;
   574	    if (G.shake > 0) G.shake = Math.max(0, G.shake - dt * 26);
   575	    if (G.flash > 0) G.flash = Math.max(0, G.flash - dt * 1.8);
   576	    if (G.celebrate > 0) G.celebrate = Math.max(0, G.celebrate - dt);
   577	    for (var i = G.parts.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
   578	      var p = G.parts[i];
   579	      p.vy += 260 * dt; p.x += p.vx * dt; p.y += p.vy * dt; p.life -= dt * 1.15;
   580	      if (p.life <= 0 || p.y > VH + 30) G.parts.splice(i, 1);
   581	    }
   582	    for (var f = G.floats.length - 1; f >= 0; f--) {
   583	      var fl = G.floats[f]; fl.y -= 26 * dt; fl.life -= dt * 1.1;
   584	      if (fl.life <= 0) G.floats.splice(f, 1);
   585	    }
   586	    for (var a = G.anims.length - 1; a >= 0; a--) {
   587	      G.anims[a].t += dt;
   588	      if (G.anims[a].t >= G.anims[a].d) G.anims.splice(a, 1);
   589	    }
   590	    if (G.hintHold > 0) G.hintHold -= dt;
   591	    if (G.screen === 'play' && !G.result && G.hintHold <= 0) {
   592	      var none = playableList().length === 0, empty = G.si >= G.stock.length;
   593	      if (G.wildArmed) G.hint = 'Wild armed - tap any uncovered card, any rank.';
   594	      else if (none && empty && S.wilds > 0) G.hint = 'No matches left - spend a WILD, or leave the deal.';
   595	      else if (none) G.hint = 'No match - tap DRAW for a new card.';
   596	      else if (G.moves === 0) G.hint = 'Tap a card one rank above or below the big card.';
   597	      else if (G.streak >= 3) G.hint = 'Chain running - keep matching for a bigger multiplier.';
   598	      else G.hint = 'Clear a peak top to earn a WILD.';
   599	    }
   600	  }
   601	
   602	  var last = 0;
   603	  function frame(ts) {
   604	    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
   605	    var dt = (ts - last) / 1000; last = ts;
   606	    if (!isFinite(dt) || dt < 0) dt = 0;
   607	    dt = Math.min(0.05, dt);
   608	    if (!G.started) return;
   609	    if (G.paused) { return; }               // rotate overlay: simulation frozen
   610	    update(dt);
   611	    ctx.setTransform(scale, 0, 0, scale, 0, 0);
   612	    ctx.fillStyle = '#1d2b1f'; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, VW, VH);
   613	    if (G.screen === 'play') drawPlay(dt);
   614	    else if (G.screen === 'meadow') drawMeadow();
   615	    else drawDeals();
   616	  }
   617	
   618	  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- hit tests
   619	  function inBox(b, x, y) { return b && x >= b.x && x <= b.x + b.w && y >= b.y && y <= b.y + b.h; }
   620	
   621	  function tapPlay(x, y) {
   622	    if (G.result) {
   623	      if (inBox(resultBtns.a, x, y)) {
   624	        Sound.tap();
   625	        if (G.result === 'win') { G.screen = 'meadow'; G.hint = 'Tap a planting to grow it.'; clearInput(); }
   626	        else startDeal(G.deal);
   627	        return;
   628	      }
   629	      if (inBox(resultBtns.b, x, y)) {
   630	        Sound.tap();
   631	        if (G.result === 'win' && G.deal + 1 < DEALS.length) startDeal(G.deal + 1);
   632	        else { G.screen = 'meadow'; clearInput(); }
   633	        return;
   634	      }
   635	      if (inBox(resultBtns.c, x, y)) {
   636	        Sound.tap();
   637	        if (G.result === 'win') startDeal(G.deal);
   638	        else { G.screen = 'deals'; clearInput(); }
   639	        return;
   640	      }
   641	      return;
   642	    }
   643	    if (inBox(MENUB, x, y)) { Sound.tap(); G.screen = 'meadow'; clearInput(); return; }
   644	    if (inBox(STOCK, x, y)) { doDraw(); return; }
   645	    if (inBox(WILDB, x, y)) {
   646	      if (S.wilds > 0) { G.wildArmed = !G.wildArmed; Sound.tap(); if (!G.wildArmed) say('Wild cancelled.', 1.4); }
   647	      else { Sound.deny(); say('No wilds banked. Clear a peak top to earn one.', 2.4); }
   648	      return;
   649	    }
   650	    // cards: peaks overlap, so score every card the touch covers and take the
   651	    // best one - playable beats free beats covered, nearest centre breaks ties.
   652	    var bestI = -1, bestScore = -1e9, pad = 4;
   653	    for (var i = 0; i < 28; i++) {
   654	      if (!alive(i)) continue;
   655	      var p = cardPos(i);
   656	      if (x < p.x - pad || x > p.x + CW + pad || y < p.y - pad || y > p.y + CH + pad) continue;
   657	      var dx = x - (p.x + CW / 2), dy = y - (p.y + CH / 2);
   658	      var sc = -Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy) + ROW[i] * 2;
   659	      if (free(i)) sc += 1000;
   660	      if (!G.wildArmed && playable(i)) sc += 4000;
   661	      if (sc > bestScore) { bestScore = sc; bestI = i; }
   662	    }
   663	    if (bestI >= 0) {
   664	      if (G.wildArmed) { if (free(bestI)) useWild(bestI); else Sound.deny(); }
   665	      else doPlay(bestI, false);
   666	      return;
   667	    }
   668	    if (G.wildArmed) { G.wildArmed = false; }
   669	  }
   670	
   671	  function tapMeadow(x, y) {
   672	    if (G.celebrate > 0) { G.celebrate = 0; return; }
   673	    if (inBox(meadowBtns.play, x, y)) { Sound.tap(); startDeal(S.current); return; }
   674	    if (inBox(meadowBtns.deals, x, y)) { Sound.tap(); G.screen = 'deals'; clearInput(); return; }
   675	    if (meadowBtns.grow && inBox(meadowBtns.grow, x, y)) {
   676	      if (G.mSel >= 0) {
   677	        var before = S.meadow[G.mSel];
   678	        grow(G.mSel);
   679	        if (S.meadow[G.mSel] > before) {
   680	          var b = null;
   681	          for (var q = 0; q < meadowBoxes.length; q++) if (meadowBoxes[q].i === G.mSel) b = meadowBoxes[q];
   682	          if (b) { burst(b.cx, b.cy - 10, 18, '#9dd06a', 130); float(b.cx, b.cy - 40, 'GROW', '#b9dc8a'); }
   683	        }
   684	      }
   685	      return;
   686	    }
   687	    for (var k = meadowBoxes.length - 1; k >= 0; k--) {
   688	      if (inBox(meadowBoxes[k], x, y)) { G.mSel = meadowBoxes[k].i; Sound.tap(); G.hint = ''; return; }
   689	    }
   690	    G.mSel = -1;
   691	  }
   692	
   693	  function tapDeals(x, y) {
   694	    if (inBox(dealsBack, x, y)) { Sound.tap(); G.screen = 'meadow'; clearInput(); return; }
   695	    for (var i = 0; i < dealBoxes.length; i++) {
   696	      if (inBox(dealBoxes[i], x, y)) { Sound.tap(); startDeal(dealBoxes[i].i); return; }
   697	    }
   698	  }
   699	
   700	  function onTap(x, y) {
   701	    if (G.paused || !G.started) return;
   702	    if (G.screen === 'play') tapPlay(x, y);
   703	    else if (G.screen === 'meadow') tapMeadow(x, y);
   704	    else tapDeals(x, y);
   705	  }
   706	
   707	  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- events
   708	  function down(ev) {
   709	    ev.preventDefault();
   710	    var id = (ev.pointerId === undefined) ? 'm' : ev.pointerId;
   711	    var v = toVirtual(ev);
   712	    pointers[id] = { x: v.x, y: v.y, sx: v.x, sy: v.y, t: G.t };
   713	    Sound.unlock();
   714	  }
   715	  function move(ev) {
   716	    var id = (ev.pointerId === undefined) ? 'm' : ev.pointerId;
   717	    var p = pointers[id];
   718	    if (!p) return;
   719	    ev.preventDefault();
   720	    var v = toVirtual(ev);
   721	    p.x = v.x; p.y = v.y;
   722	  }
   723	  function up(ev) {
   724	    var id = (ev.pointerId === undefined) ? 'm' : ev.pointerId;
   725	    var p = pointers[id];
   726	    delete pointers[id];
   727	    if (!p) return;
   728	    ev.preventDefault();
   729	    var v = toVirtual(ev);
   730	    var dx = v.x - p.sx, dy = v.y - p.sy;
   731	    if (dx * dx + dy * dy < 26 * 26) onTap(v.x, v.y);   // tap, not a drag
   732	  }
   733	  function cancel(ev) {
   734	    var id = (ev.pointerId === undefined) ? 'm' : ev.pointerId;
   735	    delete pointers[id];
   736	  }
   737	
   738	  if (window.PointerEvent) {
   739	    cv.addEventListener('pointerdown', down, { passive: false });
   740	    cv.addEventListener('pointermove', move, { passive: false });
   741	    window.addEventListener('pointerup', up, { passive: false });
   742	    window.addEventListener('pointercancel', cancel, { passive: false });
   743	  } else {
   744	    cv.addEventListener('touchstart', function (e) { for (var i = 0; i < e.changedTouches.length; i++) { var t = e.changedTouches[i]; t.pointerId = t.identifier; down(t); } e.preventDefault(); }, { passive: false });
   745	    cv.addEventListener('touchmove', function (e) { for (var i = 0; i < e.changedTouches.length; i++) { var t = e.changedTouches[i]; t.pointerId = t.identifier; move(t); } e.preventDefault(); }, { passive: false });
   746	    window.addEventListener('touchend', function (e) { for (var i = 0; i < e.changedTouches.length; i++) { var t = e.changedTouches[i]; t.pointerId = t.identifier; up(t); } }, { passive: false });
   747	    window.addEventListener('touchcancel', function (e) { for (var i = 0; i < e.changedTouches.length; i++) { var t = e.changedTouches[i]; t.pointerId = t.identifier; cancel(t); } }, { passive: false });
   748	    cv.addEventListener('mousedown', function (e) { down(e); });
   749	    window.addEventListener('mousemove', function (e) { move(e); });
   750	    window.addEventListener('mouseup', function (e) { up(e); });
   751	  }
   752	  cv.addEventListener('contextmenu', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); });
   753	  window.addEventListener('blur', function () { clearInput(); });
   754	  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', function () { if (document.hidden) clearInput(); });
   755	
   756	  // keyboard
   757	  function cycleSel(dir) {
   758	    var list = freeList();
   759	    if (!list.length) { G.sel = -1; return; }
   760	    var pos = list.indexOf(G.sel);
   761	    pos = (pos < 0) ? (dir > 0 ? 0 : list.length - 1) : (pos + dir + list.length) % list.length;
   762	    G.sel = list[pos];
   763	    Sound.tap();
   764	  }
   765	  window.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
   766	    var k = e.key;
   767	    if ([' ', 'ArrowLeft', 'ArrowRight', 'ArrowUp', 'ArrowDown', 'Enter'].indexOf(k) >= 0) e.preventDefault();
   768	    if (keys[k]) return;
   769	    keys[k] = 1;
   770	    if (!G.started) { boot(); return; }
   771	    if (G.paused) return;
   772	    if (G.screen !== 'play') {
   773	      if (k === 'Enter' || k === ' ') { Sound.tap(); if (G.screen === 'meadow') startDeal(S.current); else G.screen = 'meadow'; }
   774	      else if (k === 'Escape') { G.screen = 'meadow'; clearInput(); }
   775	      else if (G.screen === 'meadow' && (k === 'ArrowLeft' || k === 'ArrowRight')) {
   776	        G.mSel = (G.mSel + (k === 'ArrowRight' ? 1 : -1) + S.meadow.length) % S.meadow.length;
   777	        Sound.tap();
   778	      } else if (G.screen === 'meadow' && (k === 'ArrowUp' || k === 'g' || k === 'G')) { grow(G.mSel); }
   779	      return;
   780	    }
   781	    if (G.result) {
   782	      if (k === ' ' || k === 'Enter') { if (G.result === 'win') { G.screen = 'meadow'; clearInput(); } else startDeal(G.deal); }
   783	      else if (k === 'n' || k === 'N') startDeal(Math.min(DEALS.length - 1, G.deal + 1));
   784	      else if (k === 'r' || k === 'R') startDeal(G.deal);
   785	      else if (k === 'Escape') { G.screen = 'meadow'; clearInput(); }
   786	      return;
   787	    }
   788	    if (k === 'ArrowLeft') cycleSel(-1);
   789	    else if (k === 'ArrowRight') cycleSel(1);
   790	    else if (k === 'ArrowDown') doDraw();
   791	    else if (k === 'ArrowUp') { if (G.sel >= 0) useWild(G.sel); else Sound.deny(); }
   792	    else if (k === ' ' || k === 'Enter') {
   793	      if (G.sel >= 0) doPlay(G.sel, false);
   794	      else { var pl = playableList(); if (pl.length) doPlay(pl[0], false); else doDraw(); }
   795	    }
   796	    else if (k === 'r' || k === 'R') startDeal(G.deal);
   797	    else if (k === 'Escape') { G.screen = 'meadow'; clearInput(); }
   798	  });
   799	  window.addEventListener('keyup', function (e) { delete keys[e.key]; });
   800	
   801	  window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
   802	  window.addEventListener('orientationchange', function () { later(resize, 60); });
   803	
   804	  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- boot
   805	  function boot() {
   806	    if (G.started) return;
   807	    Sound.unlock();
   808	    G.started = true;
   809	    bootEl.style.display = 'none';
   810	    clearInput();
   811	    resize();
   812	    if (meadowDone()) G.screen = 'meadow';
   813	  }
   814	  bootEl.addEventListener('pointerdown', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); boot(); }, { passive: false });
   815	  bootEl.addEventListener('click', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); boot(); });
   816	  bootEl.addEventListener('touchstart', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); boot(); }, { passive: false });
   817	
   818	  resize();
   819	  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
   820	})();
     1	// Meadow Solitaire - the diorama. 12 plantings, 3 visible growth stages each.
     2	var Meadow = (function () {
     3	
     4	  // slot layout inside a unit box (0..1). Back row sits higher/smaller.
     5	  var SLOTS = [
     6	    { x: 0.10, y: 0.36, s: 0.78, t: 3 }, { x: 0.30, y: 0.31, s: 0.72, t: 1 },
     7	    { x: 0.52, y: 0.33, s: 0.74, t: 3 }, { x: 0.74, y: 0.30, s: 0.70, t: 2 },
     8	    { x: 0.90, y: 0.37, s: 0.78, t: 1 },
     9	    { x: 0.18, y: 0.60, s: 0.92, t: 0 }, { x: 0.40, y: 0.57, s: 0.88, t: 2 },
    10	    { x: 0.62, y: 0.59, s: 0.90, t: 0 }, { x: 0.84, y: 0.62, s: 0.94, t: 3 },
    11	    { x: 0.14, y: 0.85, s: 1.06, t: 2 }, { x: 0.46, y: 0.88, s: 1.10, t: 0 },
    12	    { x: 0.78, y: 0.86, s: 1.08, t: 1 }
    13	  ];
    14	  var COSTS = [14, 26, 44];          // coins to move to stage 1, 2, 3
    15	  var NAMES = ['Sunbell', 'Mossknot', 'Featherreed', 'Whistlepine'];
    16	  var PETAL = ['#f2c14a', '#e88ab6', '#8fd0e8', '#f0f2e0'];
    17	
    18	  function slotCount() { return SLOTS.length; }
    19	  function cost(stage) { return stage >= 3 ? 0 : COSTS[stage]; }
    20	  function totalCost() { var t = 0; for (var i = 0; i < SLOTS.length; i++) t += COSTS[0] + COSTS[1] + COSTS[2]; return t; }
    21	
    22	  function sway(t, seed, amp) { return Math.sin(t * 1.3 + seed * 2.1) * amp + Math.sin(t * 0.47 + seed) * amp * 0.5; }
    23	
    24	  // draw one planting anchored at its base (bx, by), unit scale u
    25	  function plant(ctx, type, stage, bx, by, u, t, seed, glow) {
    26	    ctx.save();
    27	    ctx.translate(bx, by);
    28	    // soil mound
    29	    ctx.fillStyle = '#3c2f22';
    30	    ctx.beginPath();
    31	    ctx.ellipse(0, 0, 13 * u, 4.4 * u, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    32	    ctx.fill();
    33	    if (glow > 0) {
    34	      ctx.globalAlpha = glow;
    35	      ctx.strokeStyle = '#ffe9a8'; ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
    36	      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(0, 0, 15 * u, 6 * u, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
    37	      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    38	    }
    39	    if (stage <= 0) {
    40	      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(150,170,130,0.42)';
    41	      ctx.setLineDash([3, 4]); ctx.lineWidth = 1.6;
    42	      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(0, -6 * u, 8 * u, 8 * u, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
    43	      ctx.setLineDash([]);
    44	      ctx.restore(); return;
    45	    }
    46	    var g = stage / 3;                        // 0.33 .. 1
    47	    var lean = sway(t, seed, 2.2 * g);
    48	    var h = (type === 3 ? 46 : type === 1 ? 22 : 30) * u * (0.34 + 0.66 * g);
    49	
    50	    if (type === 3) {                          // Whistlepine - conifer
    51	      ctx.strokeStyle = '#6a4a2c'; ctx.lineWidth = 3.4 * u * g + 1;
    52	      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0, 0); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(lean * 0.4, -h * 0.5, lean, -h); ctx.stroke();
    53	      var tiers = stage + 1;
    54	      for (var i = 0; i < tiers; i++) {
    55	        var ty = -h * (0.35 + 0.62 * i / tiers), tw = (16 - i * 3.4) * u * (0.5 + 0.5 * g);
    56	        ctx.fillStyle = i % 2 ? '#5d9143' : '#4c7f38';
    57	        ctx.beginPath();
    58	        ctx.moveTo(lean * (ty / -h), ty - 13 * u * g);
    59	        ctx.lineTo(lean * (ty / -h) - tw, ty + 5 * u);
    60	        ctx.lineTo(lean * (ty / -h) + tw, ty + 5 * u);
    61	        ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
    62	      }
    63	    } else if (type === 1) {                   // Mossknot - round bush
    64	      var r = 12 * u * (0.4 + 0.6 * g);
    65	      ctx.fillStyle = '#48793a';
    66	      for (var b = 0; b < 3; b++) {
    67	        ctx.beginPath();
    68	        ctx.ellipse(lean * 0.4 + (b - 1) * r * 0.75, -r * 0.8 - (b === 1 ? r * 0.4 : 0), r * 0.8, r * 0.78, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    69	        ctx.fill();
    70	      }
    71	      ctx.fillStyle = '#63a04b';
    72	      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(lean * 0.4, -r * 1.05, r * 0.72, r * 0.6, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    73	      if (stage === 3) {
    74	        ctx.fillStyle = '#e05a5a';
    75	        for (var q = 0; q < 4; q++) {
    76	          ctx.beginPath();
    77	          ctx.arc(lean * 0.4 + Math.cos(q * 2.3 + seed) * r * 0.8, -r * (0.7 + 0.5 * Math.abs(Math.sin(q + seed))), 2.2 * u, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    78	          ctx.fill();
    79	        }
    80	      }
    81	    } else if (type === 2) {                   // Featherreed - grass tuft
    82	      var blades = 3 + stage * 2;
    83	      ctx.lineCap = 'round';
    84	      for (var k = 0; k < blades; k++) {
    85	        var sp = (k / (blades - 1) - 0.5) * 2;
    86	        ctx.strokeStyle = k % 2 ? '#7fb257' : '#5f9440';
    87	        ctx.lineWidth = 2.3 * u;
    88	        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(sp * 3 * u, 0);
    89	        ctx.quadraticCurveTo(sp * 10 * u + lean * 0.5, -h * 0.6, sp * 15 * u + lean * 1.4, -h * (0.75 + 0.25 * Math.abs(sp)));
    90	        ctx.stroke();
    91	      }
    92	      if (stage === 3) {
    93	        ctx.fillStyle = '#d9c877';
    94	        for (var m = 0; m < 3; m++) {
    95	          ctx.beginPath();
    96	          ctx.ellipse((m - 1) * 8 * u + lean * 1.2, -h * 0.95, 2.4 * u, 5 * u, (m - 1) * 0.3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    97	          ctx.fill();
    98	        }
    99	      }
   100	    } else {                                   // Sunbell - flower stalk
   101	      ctx.strokeStyle = '#5f9440'; ctx.lineWidth = 2.6 * u; ctx.lineCap = 'round';
   102	      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0, 0); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(lean * 0.5, -h * 0.55, lean, -h); ctx.stroke();
   103	      ctx.fillStyle = '#4c8036';
   104	      for (var l = 0; l < stage; l++) {
   105	        var ly = -h * (0.3 + l * 0.22), dir = l % 2 ? 1 : -1;
   106	        ctx.beginPath();
   107	        ctx.ellipse(lean * 0.4 + dir * 7 * u, ly, 7 * u, 3 * u, dir * 0.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
   108	        ctx.fill();
   109	      }
   110	      if (stage >= 2) {
   111	        var pr = (stage === 3 ? 7 : 4.4) * u;
   112	        var col = PETAL[seed % PETAL.length];
   113	        ctx.fillStyle = col;
   114	        var petals = stage === 3 ? 6 : 5;
   115	        for (var p = 0; p < petals; p++) {
   116	          var a = p / petals * Math.PI * 2 + t * 0.2;
   117	          ctx.beginPath();
   118	          ctx.ellipse(lean + Math.cos(a) * pr * 0.85, -h + Math.sin(a) * pr * 0.85, pr * 0.62, pr * 0.42, a, 0, Math.PI * 2);
   119	          ctx.fill();
   120	        }
   121	        ctx.fillStyle = '#f7e6a0';
   122	        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(lean, -h, pr * 0.48, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
   123	      }
   124	    }
   125	    ctx.restore();
   126	  }
   127	
   128	  // returns array of hit boxes {i, x, y, w, h} in canvas space
   129	  function draw(ctx, x, y, w, h, state, t, opts) {
   130	    opts = opts || {};
   131	    ctx.save();
   132	    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.rect(x, y, w, h); ctx.clip();
   133	
   134	    // sky
   135	    var sky = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, y, 0, y + h);
   136	    sky.addColorStop(0, '#2b4a52'); sky.addColorStop(0.45, '#3d6353'); sky.addColorStop(1, '#375c33');
   137	    ctx.fillStyle = sky; ctx.fillRect(x, y, w, h);
   138	
   139	    // sun
   140	    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(240,226,150,0.35)';
   141	    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x + w * 0.82, y + h * 0.12, h * 0.075, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
   142	
   143	    // rolling hills
   144	    var hills = [
   145	      { c: '#31543a', o: 0.30, a: 0.045 }, { c: '#3a6440', o: 0.46, a: 0.06 }, { c: '#436f45', o: 0.68, a: 0.05 }
   146	    ];

   148	      ctx.fillStyle = hills[hh].c;
   149	      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x, y + h);
   150	      for (var px = 0; px <= w; px += 8) {
   151	        var ny = y + h * hills[hh].o + Math.sin(px / w * 5 + hh * 2.1) * h * hills[hh].a;
   152	        ctx.lineTo(x + px, ny);
   153	      }
   154	      ctx.lineTo(x + w, y + h); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
   155	    }
   156	
   157	    // drifting motes
   158	    if (!opts.flat) {
   159	      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(230,240,190,0.30)';
   160	      for (var m = 0; m < 9; m++) {
   161	        var mx = x + ((m * 137 + t * (12 + m * 3)) % w);
   162	        var my = y + h * (0.25 + 0.6 * ((m * 0.17 + Math.sin(t * 0.5 + m) * 0.08) % 1));
   163	        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(mx, my, 1.5, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
   164	      }
   165	    }
   166	
   167	    var boxes = [];
   168	    var order = SLOTS.map(function (s, i) { return i; }).sort(function (a, b) { return SLOTS[a].y - SLOTS[b].y; });
   169	    for (var oi = 0; oi < order.length; oi++) {
   170	      var i = order[oi], s = SLOTS[i];
   171	      var bx = x + s.x * w, by = y + h * (0.30 + s.y * 0.66);
   172	      var u = (w / 390) * s.s * (opts.scale || 1);
   173	      var st = state[i] | 0;
   174	      var glow = (opts.affordable && opts.affordable(i) && st < 3) ? 0.35 + 0.25 * Math.sin(t * 3 + i) : 0;
   175	      if (opts.selected === i) glow = 0.9;
   176	      plant(ctx, s.t, st, bx, by, u, t, i, glow);
   177	      var bw = Math.max(48, 46 * u), bh = Math.max(48, 56 * u);
   178	      boxes.push({ i: i, x: bx - bw / 2, y: by - bh + 10 * u, w: bw, h: bh, cx: bx, cy: by });
   179	    }
   180	    ctx.restore();
   181	    return boxes;
   182	  }
   183	
   184	  return {
   185	    draw: draw, plant: plant, cost: cost, count: slotCount, totalCost: totalCost,
   186	    names: NAMES, slots: SLOTS
   187	  };

   571	  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- update
   572	  function update(dt) {
   573	    G.t += dt;
   574	    if (G.shake > 0) G.shake = Math.max(0, G.shake - dt * 26);
   575	    if (G.flash > 0) G.flash = Math.max(0, G.flash - dt * 1.8);
   576	    if (G.celebrate > 0) G.celebrate = Math.max(0, G.celebrate - dt);
   577	    for (var i = G.parts.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
   578	      var p = G.parts[i];
   579	      p.vy += 260 * dt; p.x += p.vx * dt; p.y += p.vy * dt; p.life -= dt * 1.15;
   580	      if (p.life <= 0 || p.y > VH + 30) G.parts.splice(i, 1);
   581	    }
   582	    for (var f = G.floats.length - 1; f >= 0; f--) {
   583	      var fl = G.floats[f]; fl.y -= 26 * dt; fl.life -= dt * 1.1;
   584	      if (fl.life <= 0) G.floats.splice(f, 1);
   585	    }
   586	    for (var a = G.anims.length - 1; a >= 0; a--) {
   587	      G.anims[a].t += dt;
   588	      if (G.anims[a].t >= G.anims[a].d) G.anims.splice(a, 1);
   589	    }
   590	    if (G.hintHold > 0) G.hintHold -= dt;
   591	    if (G.screen === 'play' && !G.result && G.hintHold <= 0) {
   592	      var none = playableList().length === 0, empty = G.si >= G.stock.length;
   593	      if (G.wildArmed) G.hint = 'Wild armed - tap any uncovered card, any rank.';
   594	      else if (none && empty && S.wilds > 0) G.hint = 'No matches left - spend a WILD, or leave the deal.';
   595	      else if (none) G.hint = 'No match - tap DRAW for a new card.';
   596	      else if (G.moves === 0) G.hint = 'Tap a card one rank above or below the big card.';
   597	      else if (G.streak >= 3) G.hint = 'Chain running - keep matching for a bigger multiplier.';
   598	      else G.hint = 'Clear a peak top to earn a WILD.';
   599	    }
   600	  }

   619	  function inBox(b, x, y) { return b && x >= b.x && x <= b.x + b.w && y >= b.y && y <= b.y + b.h; }

   621	  function tapPlay(x, y) {
   622	    if (G.result) {
   623	      if (inBox(resultBtns.a, x, y)) {
   624	        Sound.tap();
   625	        if (G.result === 'win') { G.screen = 'meadow'; G.hint = 'Tap a planting to grow it.'; clearInput(); }
   626	        else startDeal(G.deal);
   627	        return;
   628	      }
   629	      if (inBox(resultBtns.b, x, y)) {
   630	        Sound.tap();
   631	        if (G.result === 'win' && G.deal + 1 < DEALS.length) startDeal(G.deal + 1);
   632	        else { G.screen = 'meadow'; clearInput(); }
   633	        return;
   634	      }
   635	      if (inBox(resultBtns.c, x, y)) {
   636	        Sound.tap();
   637	        if (G.result === 'win') startDeal(G.deal);
   638	        else { G.screen = 'deals'; clearInput(); }
   639	        return;
   640	      }
   641	      return;
   642	    }
   643	    if (inBox(MENUB, x, y)) { Sound.tap(); G.screen = 'meadow'; clearInput(); return; }
   644	    if (inBox(STOCK, x, y)) { doDraw(); return; }
   645	    if (inBox(WILDB, x, y)) {
   646	      if (S.wilds > 0) { G.wildArmed = !G.wildArmed; Sound.tap(); if (!G.wildArmed) say('Wild cancelled.', 1.4); }
   647	      else { Sound.deny(); say('No wilds banked. Clear a peak top to earn one.', 2.4); }
   648	      return;
   649	    }
   650	    // cards: peaks overlap, so score every card the touch covers and take the
   651	    // best one - playable beats free beats covered, nearest centre breaks ties.
   652	    var bestI = -1, bestScore = -1e9, pad = 4;
   653	    for (var i = 0; i < 28; i++) {
   654	      if (!alive(i)) continue;
   655	      var p = cardPos(i);
   656	      if (x < p.x - pad || x > p.x + CW + pad || y < p.y - pad || y > p.y + CH + pad) continue;
   657	      var dx = x - (p.x + CW / 2), dy = y - (p.y + CH / 2);
   658	      var sc = -Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy) + ROW[i] * 2;
   659	      if (free(i)) sc += 1000;
   660	      if (!G.wildArmed && playable(i)) sc += 4000;
   661	      if (sc > bestScore) { bestScore = sc; bestI = i; }
   662	    }
   663	    if (bestI >= 0) {
   664	      if (G.wildArmed) { if (free(bestI)) useWild(bestI); else Sound.deny(); }
   665	      else doPlay(bestI, false);
   666	      return;
   667	    }
   668	    if (G.wildArmed) { G.wildArmed = false; }
   669	  }

   671	  function tapMeadow(x, y) {
   672	    if (G.celebrate > 0) { G.celebrate = 0; return; }
   673	    if (inBox(meadowBtns.play, x, y)) { Sound.tap(); startDeal(S.current); return; }
   674	    if (inBox(meadowBtns.deals, x, y)) { Sound.tap(); G.screen = 'deals'; clearInput(); return; }
   675	    if (meadowBtns.grow && inBox(meadowBtns.grow, x, y)) {
   676	      if (G.mSel >= 0) {
   677	        var before = S.meadow[G.mSel];
   678	        grow(G.mSel);
   679	        if (S.meadow[G.mSel] > before) {

   162	      this.add(x, y, Math.cos(a) * s, Math.sin(a) * s, rnd(life * 0.6, life), col, rnd(2, 4.5), grav);
   163	    }
   164	  },
   165	  update: function (dt) {
   166	    var l = this.list;
   167	    for (var i = l.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
   168	      var p = l[i];
   169	      p.l -= dt;
   170	      if (p.l <= 0) { l.splice(i, 1); continue; }
   171	      p.x += p.vx * dt; p.y += p.vy * dt; p.vy += p.g * dt;
   172	      p.vx *= (1 - 1.2 * dt);
   173	    }
   174	    if (l.length > PMAX) l.splice(0, l.length - PMAX);
   175	  },

   185	  },

    36	function nodeYield(kind, season, night) {
    37	  var out = [];
    38	  if (kind === 'reeds') { out.push(['reed', 2]); if (Math.random() < 0.3) out.push(['driftwood', 1]); }
    39	  else if (kind === 'clay') { out.push(['clay', 2]); if (Math.random() < 0.25) out.push(['lakestone', 1]); }
    40	  else if (kind === 'rock') { out.push(['lakestone', 2]); if (Math.random() < 0.3) out.push(['clay', 1]); }
    41	  else if (kind === 'log') { out.push(['driftwood', 2]); if (Math.random() < (season ? 0.55 : 0.25)) out.push(['honeycap', 1]); }
    42	  else if (kind === 'pine') { out.push(['pinecone', 2]); if (night && Math.random() < 0.4) out.push(['glowmoss', 1]); }
    43	  else if (kind === 'bush') { out.push(season ? ['amberleaf', 2] : ['berry', 2]); if (Math.random() < 0.3) out.push(season ? ['honeycap', 1] : ['reed', 1]); }
    44	  else if (kind === 'moss') { out.push(['glowmoss', night ? 2 : 1]); if (season && Math.random() < 0.4) out.push(['amberleaf', 1]); }
    45	  return out;
    46	}

    83	function makeNav(w, h, cell, solid, rad) {
    84	  var cols = Math.ceil(w / cell), rows = Math.ceil(h / cell);
    85	  var grid = new Uint8Array(cols * rows);
    86	  for (var y = 0; y < rows; y++) {
    87	    for (var x = 0; x < cols; x++) {
    88	      grid[y * cols + x] = solid((x + 0.5) * cell, (y + 0.5) * cell, rad) ? 1 : 0;
    89	    }
    90	  }
    91	  return {
    92	    cols: cols, rows: rows, cell: cell, grid: grid, solid: solid,
    93	    prev: new Int32Array(cols * rows), q: new Int32Array(cols * rows)
    94	  };

    96	function navClear(nav, x0, y0, x1, y1) {
    97	  var cell = nav.cell, cols = nav.cols, rows = nav.rows, g = nav.grid;
    98	  var dx = x1 - x0, dy = y1 - y0, d = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
    99	  var n = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(d / (cell * 0.5)));
   100	  for (var i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
   101	    var cx = Math.floor((x0 + dx * i / n) / cell), cy = Math.floor((y0 + dy * i / n) / cell);
   102	    if (cx < 0 || cy < 0 || cx >= cols || cy >= rows) return false;
   103	    if (g[cy * cols + cx]) return false;
   104	  }
   105	  return true;
   106	}
   107	function navPath(nav, sx, sy, tx, ty, rad) {
   108	  var cols = nav.cols, rows = nav.rows, cell = nav.cell, g = nav.grid, prev = nav.prev, q = nav.q;
   109	  var scx = clamp(Math.floor(sx / cell), 0, cols - 1), scy = clamp(Math.floor(sy / cell), 0, rows - 1);
   110	  var tcx = clamp(Math.floor(tx / cell), 0, cols - 1), tcy = clamp(Math.floor(ty / cell), 0, rows - 1);
   111	  prev.fill(-2);
   112	  var head = 0, tail = 0, si = scy * cols + scx;
   113	  prev[si] = -1; q[tail++] = si;
   114	  var found = -1, bestAlt = -1, bestAltD = 1e9;
   115	  while (head < tail) {
   116	    var cur = q[head++];
   117	    var cx = cur % cols, cy = (cur / cols) | 0;
   118	    if (cx === tcx && cy === tcy) { found = cur; break; }
   119	    var dd = (cx - tcx) * (cx - tcx) + (cy - tcy) * (cy - tcy);
   120	    if (dd < bestAltD) { bestAltD = dd; bestAlt = cur; }
   121	    for (var k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
   122	      var nx = cx + (k === 0 ? 1 : k === 1 ? -1 : 0), ny = cy + (k === 2 ? 1 : k === 3 ? -1 : 0);
   123	      if (nx < 0 || ny < 0 || nx >= cols || ny >= rows) continue;
   124	      var ni = ny * cols + nx;
   125	      if (prev[ni] !== -2 || g[ni]) continue;
   126	      prev[ni] = cur; q[tail++] = ni;
   127	    }
   128	  }
   129	  if (found < 0) {
   130	    if (bestAlt < 0 || bestAltD > 36) return null;   // nothing near the destination
   131	    found = bestAlt;
   132	  }
   133	  var cells = [];
   134	  for (var c = found; c >= 0 && cells.length < 4096; c = prev[c]) { cells.push(c); if (prev[c] === -1) break; }
   135	  cells.reverse();
   136	  var pts = [];
   137	  for (var i = 0; i < cells.length; i++) pts.push({ x: (cells[i] % cols + 0.5) * cell, y: (((cells[i] / cols) | 0) + 0.5) * cell });
   138	  if (found === (tcy * cols + tcx)) pts.push({ x: tx, y: ty });
   139	  // string-pulling: drop waypoints we can walk straight past (grid line-of-sight, cheap)
   140	  var out = [], px = sx, py = sy, idx = 0;
   141	  while (idx < pts.length && out.length < 64) {
   142	    var far = idx;
   143	    for (var j = idx; j < pts.length; j++) {
   144	      if (navClear(nav, px, py, pts[j].x, pts[j].y)) far = j; else break;
   145	    }
   146	    out.push(pts[far]); px = pts[far].x; py = pts[far].y;
   147	    idx = far + 1;
   148	  }
   149	  if (!out.length) out.push({ x: tx, y: ty });
   150	  return out;
   151	}

   154	function seasonCols(season) {
   155	  return season === 0
   156	    ? { grass: '#5d9a52', grass2: '#528c48', water: '#3d7fa8', water2: '#4f96bd', tree: '#3d7a45', tree2: '#2f6236', path: '#c3aa7c', sand: '#dcc890' }
   157	    : { grass: '#82863f', grass2: '#767a37', water: '#3a6f92', water2: '#4a85a6', tree: '#c06a2a', tree2: '#9a4f22', path: '#bda274', sand: '#d3bd84' };
   158	}

   160	function drawWorld(g, cam, st) {
   161	  var C = seasonCols(st.season), t = st.clock;
   162	  g.save();
   163	  g.translate(-cam.x, -cam.y);
   164	
   165	  // grass
   166	  g.fillStyle = C.grass;
   167	  g.fillRect(cam.x, Math.max(cam.y, WATER_Y - 2), VW, VH);
   168	  // grass texture bands
   169	  g.fillStyle = C.grass2;
   170	  var y0 = Math.floor(Math.max(cam.y, WATER_Y) / 40) * 40;
   171	  for (var gy = y0; gy < cam.y + VH; gy += 40) {
   172	    for (var gx = Math.floor(cam.x / 60) * 60; gx < cam.x + VW; gx += 60) {
   173	      if (((gx / 60 + gy / 40) | 0) % 2 === 0) g.fillRect(gx, gy, 60, 40);
   174	    }
   175	  }
   176	
   177	  // town paths
   178	  g.fillStyle = C.path;
   179	  g.fillRect(360, 380, 60, 640);          // main north-south
   180	  g.fillRect(120, 760, 540, 46);          // square band
   181	  g.fillRect(130, 800, 30, 170);
   182	  g.fillRect(620, 800, 30, 170);
   183	  g.fillRect(150, 700, 480, 20);
   184	  fillRR(g, 336, 742, 108, 82, 12, '#cdb98d'); // square plaza
   185	
   186	  // water
   187	  if (cam.y < WATER_Y + 4) {
   188	    g.fillStyle = C.water;
   189	    g.fillRect(cam.x, 0, VW, WATER_Y);
   190	    g.fillStyle = C.water2;
   191	    for (var w = 0; w < 9; w++) {
   192	      var wy = 26 + w * 34 + Math.sin(t * 0.7 + w) * 4;
   193	      g.globalAlpha = 0.5;
   194	      g.fillRect(cam.x + ((w * 53 + t * 12) % 90) - 40, wy, 70, 4);
   195	      g.fillRect(cam.x + ((w * 91 + t * 8) % 160) + 60, wy + 14, 46, 3);
   196	      g.globalAlpha = 1;
   197	    }
   198	    // shoreline
   199	    g.fillStyle = C.sand;
   200	    g.fillRect(cam.x, WATER_Y - 8, VW, 16);
   201	  }
   202	
   203	  // dock
   204	  g.fillStyle = '#a5844f';
   205	  g.fillRect(DOCK.x, DOCK.y, DOCK.w, DOCK.h);
   206	  g.fillStyle = '#8d6f42';
   207	  for (var d = 0; d < 9; d++) g.fillRect(DOCK.x, DOCK.y + 4 + d * 14, DOCK.w, 3);
   208	  g.fillStyle = '#7a5f38';
   209	  g.fillRect(DOCK.x - 4, DOCK.y + 20, 5, 10); g.fillRect(DOCK.x + DOCK.w - 1, DOCK.y + 20, 5, 10);
   210	
   211	  // buildings
   212	  for (var i = 0; i < BUILDINGS.length; i++) drawBuilding(g, BUILDINGS[i], st);
   213	
   214	  // festival lanterns in the square
   215	  if (st.festival) {
   216	    for (var f = 0; f < 8; f++) {
   217	      var lx = 340 + f * 14, ly = 748 + (f % 2) * 66;
   218	      g.fillStyle = '#ffd77a'; g.beginPath(); g.arc(lx, ly, 5 + Math.sin(t * 2 + f) * 0.8, 0, 6.2832); g.fill();
   219	      g.globalAlpha = 0.25; g.beginPath(); g.arc(lx, ly, 13, 0, 6.2832); g.fill(); g.globalAlpha = 1;
   220	    }
   221	  }
   222	
   223	  // forage nodes
   224	  for (var n = 0; n < NODES.length; n++) {
   225	    var nd = NODES[n];
   226	    if (nd.x < cam.x - 40 || nd.x > cam.x + VW + 40 || nd.y < cam.y - 60 || nd.y > cam.y + VH + 60) continue;
   227	    drawNode(g, nd, st.harvested[n] === st.day, st, n);
   228	  }
   229	
   230	  // trees
   231	  for (var k = 0; k < TREES.length; k++) {
   232	    var tr = TREES[k];
   233	    if (tr.y < cam.y - 60 || tr.y > cam.y + VH + 40) continue;
   234	    g.fillStyle = '#00000022';
   235	    g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(tr.x, tr.y + 14, tr.s * 0.8, tr.s * 0.3, 0, 0, 6.2832); g.fill();
   236	    g.fillStyle = '#6b4a30'; g.fillRect(tr.x - 3, tr.y, 6, 16);
   237	    g.fillStyle = C.tree; g.beginPath(); g.arc(tr.x, tr.y - 4, tr.s, 0, 6.2832); g.fill();
   238	    g.fillStyle = C.tree2; g.beginPath(); g.arc(tr.x - tr.s * 0.3, tr.y - tr.s * 0.4, tr.s * 0.5, 0, 6.2832); g.fill();
   239	  }
   240	  g.restore();
   241	}

   243	function drawBuilding(g, b, st) {
   244	  g.fillStyle = '#00000026';
   245	  g.fillRect(b.x + 5, b.y + b.h - 4, b.w, 10);
   246	  g.fillStyle = b.a; g.fillRect(b.x, b.y + 22, b.w, b.h - 22);
   247	  g.fillStyle = '#00000018'; g.fillRect(b.x, b.y + b.h - 12, b.w, 12);
   248	  // roof
   249	  g.fillStyle = b.b;
   250	  g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(b.x - 8, b.y + 26); g.lineTo(b.x + b.w / 2, b.y - 12); g.lineTo(b.x + b.w + 8, b.y + 26); g.closePath(); g.fill();
   251	  // windows
   252	  var lit = st.night;
   253	  g.fillStyle = lit ? '#ffd98a' : '#7fa3b8';
   254	  g.fillRect(b.x + 18, b.y + 46, 26, 22);
   255	  g.fillRect(b.x + b.w - 44, b.y + 46, 26, 22);
   256	  if (lit) { g.globalAlpha = 0.18; g.fillRect(b.x + 8, b.y + 36, 46, 42); g.fillRect(b.x + b.w - 54, b.y + 36, 46, 42); g.globalAlpha = 1; }
   257	  // door
   258	  g.fillStyle = '#6b4a30';
   259	  g.fillRect(b.door[0] - 15, b.y + b.h - 34, 30, 34);
   260	  g.fillStyle = '#e0c99a'; g.fillRect(b.door[0] + 7, b.y + b.h - 18, 4, 4);
   261	  // sign
   262	  txt(g, b.nm, b.x + b.w / 2, b.y + 34, 11, '#2a2018', 'center', 700);
   263	}

   265	function drawNode(g, nd, spent, st, idx) {
   266	  var info = NODEINFO[nd.k], x = nd.x, y = nd.y;
   267	  g.fillStyle = '#00000022';
   268	  g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(x, y + 10, 14, 5, 0, 0, 6.2832); g.fill();
   269	  if (spent) g.globalAlpha = 0.35;
   270	  var C = seasonCols(st.season);
   271	  if (nd.k === 'reeds') {
   272	    g.strokeStyle = info.c; g.lineWidth = 3;
   273	    for (var i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
   274	      g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(x - 10 + i * 5, y + 8);
   275	      g.quadraticCurveTo(x - 10 + i * 5 + Math.sin(st.clock + i) * 4, y - 6, x - 12 + i * 5 + Math.sin(st.clock + i) * 7, y - 18);
   276	      g.stroke();
   277	    }
   278	  } else if (nd.k === 'rock') {
   279	    g.fillStyle = info.c;
   280	    g.beginPath(); g.arc(x, y, 12, Math.PI, 0); g.closePath(); g.fill();
   281	    g.fillStyle = '#b0bcc7'; g.beginPath(); g.arc(x - 5, y - 2, 6, 0, 6.2832); g.fill();
   282	  } else if (nd.k === 'clay') {
   283	    g.fillStyle = info.c; fillRR(g, x - 14, y - 8, 28, 16, 6, info.c);
   284	    g.fillStyle = '#cf9070'; fillRR(g, x - 8, y - 6, 12, 7, 3, '#cf9070');
   285	  } else if (nd.k === 'log') {
   286	    fillRR(g, x - 18, y - 7, 36, 15, 7, info.c);
   287	    g.fillStyle = '#7d6446'; g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(x + 17, y, 4, 7, 0, 0, 6.2832); g.fill();
   288	  } else if (nd.k === 'pine') {
   289	    g.fillStyle = '#6b4a30'; g.fillRect(x - 3, y - 2, 6, 12);
   290	    g.fillStyle = st.season ? '#5c7a3e' : info.c;
   291	    for (var p = 0; p < 3; p++) {
   292	      g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(x - 14 + p * 2, y - 2 - p * 9); g.lineTo(x, y - 20 - p * 9); g.lineTo(x + 14 - p * 2, y - 2 - p * 9); g.closePath(); g.fill();
   293	    }
   294	  } else if (nd.k === 'bush') {
   295	    g.fillStyle = st.season ? '#8a7a3c' : info.c;
   296	    g.beginPath(); g.arc(x - 7, y, 10, 0, 6.2832); g.arc(x + 7, y, 10, 0, 6.2832); g.arc(x, y - 7, 11, 0, 6.2832); g.fill();
   297	    if (!spent) {
   298	      g.fillStyle = st.season ? '#e5813a' : '#c75f92';
   299	      g.beginPath(); g.arc(x - 5, y - 6, 3, 0, 6.2832); g.arc(x + 6, y - 2, 3, 0, 6.2832); g.arc(x + 1, y + 3, 3, 0, 6.2832); g.fill();
   300	    }
   301	  } else if (nd.k === 'moss') {
   302	    g.fillStyle = info.c;
   303	    g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(x, y, 16, 9, 0, 0, 6.2832); g.fill();
   304	    if (st.night && !spent) {
   305	      g.globalAlpha = 0.35 + Math.sin(st.clock * 2 + idx) * 0.12;
   306	      g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(x, y, 24, 14, 0, 0, 6.2832); g.fill(); g.globalAlpha = spent ? 0.35 : 1;
   307	    }
   308	  }
   309	  g.globalAlpha = 1;
   310	}

   318	function insideBlocked(x, y, r) {
   319	  if (x < ROOM.x + r || x > ROOM.x + ROOM.w - r) return true;
   320	  if (y < ROOM.y + r || y > ROOM.y + ROOM.h - r) return true;
   321	  if (x > BENCH.x - r && x < BENCH.x + BENCH.w + r && y < BENCH.y + BENCH.h + r) return true;
   322	  if (x > BED.x - r && x < BED.x + BED.w + r && y < BED.y + BED.h + r) return true;
   323	  return false;
   324	}

   360	function drawFurnFit(g, f, x, y, box) {
   361	  var s = Math.min(1, box / Math.max(f.w, f.h));
   362	  g.save(); g.translate(x, y); g.scale(s, s);
   363	  drawFurn(g, f, 0, 0, 1, false);
   364	  g.restore();
   365	}

   367	function drawFurn(g, f, x, y, alpha, sel) {
   368	  var w = f.w, h = f.h;
   369	  g.globalAlpha = alpha === undefined ? 1 : alpha;
   370	  g.fillStyle = '#00000026';
   371	  g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(x, y + h / 2 - 2, w * 0.45, 5, 0, 0, 6.2832); g.fill();
   372	  if (f.sh === 'flat') {
   373	    fillRR(g, x - w / 2, y - h / 2, w, h, 6, f.a);
   374	    g.strokeStyle = f.b; g.lineWidth = 3; rr(g, x - w / 2 + 5, y - h / 2 + 5, w - 10, h - 10, 4); g.stroke();
   375	  } else if (f.sh === 'round') {
   376	    g.fillStyle = f.b; g.beginPath(); g.arc(x, y, w / 2, 0, 6.2832); g.fill();
   377	    g.fillStyle = f.a; g.beginPath(); g.arc(x, y - 2, w / 2 - 5, 0, 6.2832); g.fill();
   378	  } else if (f.sh === 'lamp') {
   379	    g.fillStyle = f.a; g.fillRect(x - 5, y - h / 2 + 12, 10, h - 12);
   380	    g.fillStyle = f.b; g.beginPath(); g.arc(x, y - h / 2 + 10, w / 2, 0, 6.2832); g.fill();
   381	    g.globalAlpha = 0.22; g.beginPath(); g.arc(x, y - h / 2 + 10, w, 0, 6.2832); g.fill();
   382	    g.globalAlpha = alpha === undefined ? 1 : alpha;
   383	  } else if (f.sh === 'tall') {
   384	    fillRR(g, x - w / 2, y - h / 2, w, h, 5, f.a);
   385	    g.fillStyle = f.b; g.fillRect(x - w / 2 + 5, y - h / 2 + 6, w - 10, h * 0.4);
   386	  } else {
   387	    fillRR(g, x - w / 2, y - h / 2, w, h, 5, f.a);
   388	    g.fillStyle = f.b; g.fillRect(x - w / 2 + 4, y + h / 2 - 12, w - 8, 8);
   389	    g.fillStyle = '#ffffff22'; g.fillRect(x - w / 2 + 4, y - h / 2 + 4, w - 8, 6);
   390	  }
   391	  if (sel) {
   392	    g.strokeStyle = '#ffe08a'; g.lineWidth = 2.5;
   393	    rr(g, x - w / 2 - 4, y - h / 2 - 4, w + 8, h + 8, 7); g.stroke();
   394	  }
   395	  g.globalAlpha = 1;
   396	}

    21	/* ================= state ================= */
    22	function blankState() {
    23	  var n = {};
    24	  for (var i = 0; i < NPCS.length; i++) n[NPCS[i].id] = { p: 0, s1: false, s2: false, gd: 0, td: 0 };
    25	  return {
    26	    day: 1, tod: 0.02, season: 0, night: false, clock: 0,
    27	    scene: 'world', px: 392, py: 580, fx: 0, fy: 1, anim: 0,
    28	    inv: {}, owned: {}, placed: [],
    29	    style: { wall: 0, floor: 0, uw: [0], uf: [0] },
    30	    npc: n, harvested: {}, festival: false, endShown: false,
    31	    stats: { fish: 0, crafted: 0, gifts: 0 }
    32	  };
    33	}
    34	function serialize() {
    35	  return {
    36	    v: 1, day: st.day, tod: st.tod, scene: st.scene, px: st.px, py: st.py,
    37	    inv: st.inv, owned: st.owned, placed: st.placed, style: st.style,
    38	    npc: st.npc, harvested: st.harvested, festival: st.festival, endShown: st.endShown, stats: st.stats
    39	  };
    40	}
    41	function deserialize(o) {
    42	  var s = blankState();
    43	  if (!o) return s;
    44	  s.day = clamp(int(o.day, 1), 1, 9999);
    45	  s.tod = clamp(num(o.tod, 0.02), 0, 0.999);
    46	  s.scene = (o.scene === 'interior') ? 'interior' : 'world';
    47	  s.px = clamp(num(o.px, 392), 20, MW - 20);
    48	  s.py = clamp(num(o.py, 580), 20, MH - 20);
    49	  if (s.scene === 'interior') { s.px = clamp(num(o.px, 195), ROOM.x + 12, ROOM.x + ROOM.w - 12); s.py = clamp(num(o.py, 560), ROOM.y + 12, ROOM.y + ROOM.h - 12); }
    50	  var inv = obj(o.inv), k;
    51	  for (k in inv) if (ITEMS[k]) s.inv[k] = clamp(int(inv[k], 0), 0, 999);
    52	  var ow = obj(o.owned);
    53	  for (k in ow) if (furnById(k)) s.owned[k] = clamp(int(ow[k], 0), 0, 6);
    54	  var pl = arr(o.placed);
    55	  for (var i = 0; i < pl.length && s.placed.length < 40; i++) {
    56	    var p = obj(pl[i]); var f = furnById(str(p.id, ''));
    57	    if (!f) continue;
    58	    s.placed.push({ id: f.id, x: clamp(num(p.x, 195), ROOM.x, ROOM.x + ROOM.w), y: clamp(num(p.y, 400), ROOM.y, ROOM.y + ROOM.h) });
    59	  }
    60	  var sy = obj(o.style);
    61	  s.style.uw = [0]; s.style.uf = [0];
    62	  var uw = arr(sy.uw); for (var a = 0; a < uw.length; a++) { var v = int(uw[a], -1); if (v >= 0 && v < STYLES.wall.length && s.style.uw.indexOf(v) < 0) s.style.uw.push(v); }
    63	  var uf = arr(sy.uf); for (var b2 = 0; b2 < uf.length; b2++) { var v2 = int(uf[b2], -1); if (v2 >= 0 && v2 < STYLES.floor.length && s.style.uf.indexOf(v2) < 0) s.style.uf.push(v2); }
    64	  s.style.wall = s.style.uw.indexOf(int(sy.wall, 0)) >= 0 ? int(sy.wall, 0) : 0;
    65	  s.style.floor = s.style.uf.indexOf(int(sy.floor, 0)) >= 0 ? int(sy.floor, 0) : 0;
    66	  var np = obj(o.npc);
    67	  for (var j = 0; j < NPCS.length; j++) {
    68	    var id = NPCS[j].id, src = obj(np[id]);
    69	    s.npc[id] = { p: clamp(int(src.p, 0), 0, 30), s1: bool(src.s1), s2: bool(src.s2), gd: int(src.gd, 0), td: int(src.td, 0) };
    70	  }
    71	  var hv = obj(o.harvested);
    72	  for (var h in hv) { var idx = int(h, -1); var d = int(hv[h], 0); if (idx >= 0 && idx < NODES.length && d >= s.day - 1) s.harvested[idx] = d; }
    73	  s.festival = bool(o.festival); s.endShown = bool(o.endShown);
    74	  var stt = obj(o.stats);
    75	  s.stats = { fish: clamp(int(stt.fish, 0), 0, 99999), crafted: clamp(int(stt.crafted, 0), 0, 99999), gifts: clamp(int(stt.gifts, 0), 0, 99999) };
    76	  return s;
    77	}

    80	function newGame() {
    81	  Timers.clearAll(); Input.reset(); Parts.clear();
    82	  Store.wipe();
    83	  st = blankState();
    84	  mode = 'play'; dlg = null; fs = null; drag = null; dragPid = null;
    85	  selFurn = -1; trayPage = 0; confirmNew = false; shake = 0; flash = 0;
    86	  toastT = 0; craftMsgT = 0;
    87	  target = null; path.length = 0; stuckT = 0; repaths = 0;
    88	  refreshTime(); snapNpcs(); centerCam();
    89	  toast('A new season begins in Willowmere.');
    90	  save();
    91	}

    94	function refreshTime() {
    95	  st.season = (Math.floor((st.day - 1) / 5) % 2);
    96	  var h = 6 + st.tod * 18;
    97	  st.night = (h >= 19);
    98	}
    99	function hourStr() {
   100	  var h = 6 + st.tod * 18, hh = Math.floor(h), mm = Math.floor((h - hh) * 60 / 5) * 5;
   101	  var ap = hh >= 12 && hh < 24 ? 'pm' : 'am';
   102	  var d = hh % 12; if (d === 0) d = 12;
   103	  if (hh >= 24) { d = 12; ap = 'am'; }
   104	  return d + ':' + (mm < 10 ? '0' : '') + mm + ap;
   105	}
   106	function advanceDay(slept) {
   107	  st.day++; st.tod = 0.02;
   108	  for (var k in st.harvested) { if (st.harvested[k] < st.day - 1) delete st.harvested[k]; }
   109	  refreshTime(); snapNpcs();
   110	  if (st.scene !== 'interior') { st.scene = 'interior'; }
   111	  st.px = BED.x + BED.w / 2; st.py = BED.y + BED.h + 26;
   112	  target = null; path.length = 0; Parts.clear();
   113	  toast((slept ? 'Day ' : 'You drifted off. Day ') + st.day + ' - ' + (st.season ? 'Autumn' : 'Summer'));
   114	  Snd.tone(330, 0.3, 'sine', 0.12, 440);
   115	  save();
   116	}

   119	function slotIndex() { var h = 6 + st.tod * 18; return h < 11 ? 0 : (h < 16 ? 1 : (h < 20 ? 2 : 3)); }
   120	function snapNpcs() {
   121	  npcPos.length = 0;
   122	  var si = slotIndex();
   123	  for (var i = 0; i < NPCS.length; i++) npcPos.push({ x: NPCS[i].spots[si][0], y: NPCS[i].spots[si][1], t: 0 });
   124	}
   125	function updateNpcs(dt) {
   126	  var si = slotIndex();
   127	  for (var i = 0; i < NPCS.length; i++) {
   128	    var p = npcPos[i], s = NPCS[i].spots[si];
   129	    var dx = s[0] - p.x, dy = s[1] - p.y, d = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
   130	    if (d > 2) { var sp = Math.min(52 * dt, d); p.x += dx / d * sp; p.y += dy / d * sp; p.t += dt * 6; }
   131	    else p.t += dt * 1.2;
   132	  }
   133	}
   134	function hearts(id) { return clamp(Math.floor(st.npc[id].p / 6), 0, 5); }
   135	function storiesDone() { var c = 0; for (var i = 0; i < NPCS.length; i++) if (st.npc[NPCS[i].id].s2) c++; return c; }

   142	function hasItems(r) { for (var k in r) if ((st.inv[k] || 0) < r[k]) return false; return true; }
   143	function invList() {

   155	function worldInteractables() {
   156	  var list = [];
   157	  list.push({ t: 'fish', x: DOCK.x + DOCK.w / 2, y: DOCK.y + 16, r: 46, label: 'Cast a line' });
   158	  list.push({ t: 'door', x: COTTAGE.door[0], y: COTTAGE.door[1], r: 30, label: 'Go inside' });
   159	  for (var i = 0; i < NODES.length; i++) {
   160	    if (st.harvested[i] === st.day) continue;
   161	    list.push({ t: 'node', i: i, x: NODES[i].x, y: NODES[i].y, r: 30, label: 'Gather ' + NODEINFO[NODES[i].k].n });
   162	  }
   163	  for (var j = 0; j < NPCS.length; j++) list.push({ t: 'npc', i: j, x: npcPos[j].x, y: npcPos[j].y, r: 32, label: 'Talk to ' + NPCS[j].n.split(' ')[0] });
   164	  return list;
   165	}
   166	function interiorInteractables() {
   167	  return [
   168	    { t: 'bench', x: BENCH.x + BENCH.w / 2, y: BENCH.y + BENCH.h + 6, r: 40, label: 'Craft' },
   169	    { t: 'bed', x: BED.x + BED.w / 2, y: BED.y + BED.h + 6, r: 40, label: 'Sleep' },
   170	    { t: 'exit', x: IDOOR.x + IDOOR.w / 2, y: IDOOR.y - 6, r: 34, label: 'Go outside' }
   171	  ];

   173	function interactables() { return st.scene === 'world' ? worldInteractables() : interiorInteractables(); }
   174	function nearest(x, y, maxd) {
   175	  var l = interactables(), best = null, bd = maxd * maxd;
   176	  for (var i = 0; i < l.length; i++) {
   177	    var d = dist2(x, y, l[i].x, l[i].y);
   178	    if (d < bd) { bd = d; best = l[i]; }
   179	  }
   180	  return best;
   181	}

   183	function doInteract(o) {
   184	  if (!o) return;
   185	  if (o.t === 'fish') startFishing();
   186	  else if (o.t === 'door') { st.scene = 'interior'; st.px = IDOOR.x + IDOOR.w / 2; st.py = IDOOR.y - 24; target = null; path.length = 0; Snd.tap(); save(); }
   187	  else if (o.t === 'exit') { st.scene = 'world'; st.px = COTTAGE.door[0]; st.py = COTTAGE.door[1] + 26; target = null; path.length = 0; Snd.tap(); save(); }
   188	  else if (o.t === 'node') harvest(o.i);
   189	  else if (o.t === 'npc') openNpc(o.i);
   190	  else if (o.t === 'bench') { mode = 'craft'; Snd.page(); }
   191	  else if (o.t === 'bed') {
   192	    dlg = { name: 'Rest', col: '#9fc4d8', lines: ['Sleep until morning? The lake will still be here.'], idx: 0, npcI: -1, kind: 'sleep' };
   193	    mode = 'dialog';
   194	  }
   195	}

   197	function harvest(i) {
   198	  if (st.harvested[i] === st.day) return;
   199	  st.harvested[i] = st.day;
   200	  var y = nodeYield(NODES[i].k, st.season, st.night), got = [];
   201	  for (var j = 0; j < y.length; j++) { addItem(y[j][0], y[j][1]); got.push(y[j][1] + ' ' + ITEMS[y[j][0]].n); }
   202	  toast('Gathered ' + got.join(', '));
   203	  Parts.burst(NODES[i].x, NODES[i].y - 6, 12, NODEINFO[NODES[i].k].c, 90, 0.6, 120);
   204	  Snd.pickup(); shake = Math.max(shake, 2.2);
   205	  save();
   206	}

   209	function openNpc(i) {
   210	  var d = NPCS[i], s = st.npc[d.id], hp = hearts(d.id);
   211	  if (hp >= 2 && !s.s1) { startStory(i, 1); return; }
   212	  if (hp >= 4 && s.s1 && !s.s2) { startStory(i, 2); return; }
   213	  var line = d.greet[hp >= 4 ? 2 : (hp >= 2 ? 1 : 0)];
   214	  if (s.td !== st.day) { s.p = clamp(s.p + 1, 0, 30); s.td = st.day; checkHeartUp(d, hp); }
   215	  dlg = { name: d.n, col: d.c, lines: [line], idx: 0, npcI: i, kind: 'talk' };
   216	  mode = 'dialog'; Snd.page();
   217	}
   218	function startStory(i, which) {
   219	  var d = NPCS[i];
   220	  var lines = [], src = which === 1 ? d.s1 : d.s2;
   221	  for (var k = 0; k < src.length; k++) lines.push((src[k].w === 'You' ? '▸ ' : '') + src[k].t);
   222	  dlg = { name: d.n + ' - Story ' + which, col: d.c, lines: lines, idx: 0, npcI: i, kind: 'story', which: which, speakers: src };
   223	  mode = 'dialog'; Snd.heart();
   224	}
   225	function finishStory(i, which) {
   226	  var d = NPCS[i], s = st.npc[d.id];
   227	  if (which === 1) { s.s1 = true; toast('Story unlocked: ' + d.n.split(' ')[0]); }
   228	  else {
   229	    s.s2 = true;
   230	    var rw = d.rw;
   231	    if (rw.t === 'furn') {
   232	      st.owned[rw.id] = clamp((st.owned[rw.id] || 0) + 1, 0, 6);
   233	      toast('Gift received: ' + furnById(rw.id).n + ' (free, always)');
   234	    } else {
   235	      var listk = rw.k === 'wall' ? 'uw' : 'uf';
   236	      var arrk = rw.k === 'wall' ? STYLES.wall : STYLES.floor;
   237	      var idx = 0; for (var z = 0; z < arrk.length; z++) if (arrk[z].id === rw.id) idx = z;
   238	      if (st.style[listk].indexOf(idx) < 0) st.style[listk].push(idx);
   239	      toast('Style unlocked: ' + arrk[idx].n);
   240	    }
   241	    Snd.catchFx(); flash = 0.5;
   242	    if (storiesDone() >= NPCS.length && !st.festival) {
   243	      st.festival = true;
   244	      Timers.set(function () { mode = 'ending'; Snd.fanfare(); for (var c = 0; c < 24; c++) Parts.add(rnd(0, VW), rnd(-60, 0), rnd(-30, 30), rnd(40, 110), rnd(2, 4), pick(['#ffd77a', '#ff9ab0', '#9fe0c0', '#a8c0ff']), rnd(3, 5), 30, 1); }, 400);
   245	    }
   246	  }
   247	  save();
   248	}
   249	function advanceDialog() {
   250	  if (!dlg) { mode = 'play'; return; }
   251	  if (dlg.kind === 'sleep') return;   // handled by buttons
   252	  dlg.idx++;
   253	  Snd.page();
   254	  if (dlg.idx >= dlg.lines.length) {
   255	    if (dlg.kind === 'story') { finishStory(dlg.npcI, dlg.which); dlg = null; mode = 'play'; return; }
   256	    if (dlg.kind === 'talk') return;  // buttons stay
   257	    dlg = null; mode = 'play';
   258	  }
   259	}
   260	function giveGift(item) {
   261	  var i = dlg.npcI, d = NPCS[i], s = st.npc[d.id];
   262	  if ((st.inv[item] || 0) <= 0) return;
   263	  st.inv[item]--; if (st.inv[item] <= 0) delete st.inv[item];
   264	  var hp = hearts(d.id), nm = ITEMS[item].n, line, pts;
   265	  if (item === d.loves) { pts = 5; line = 'Oh - ' + nm + '! You remembered. That makes the whole day lighter.'; }
   266	  else if (item === d.likes) { pts = 3; line = 'Good ' + nm + '. That will come in handy, thank you.'; }
   267	  else if (item === d.hates) { pts = -2; line = "Ah... I'll be honest, " + nm + " and I have history. Bad history."; }
   268	  else { pts = 1; line = 'Thank you. I will find a use for ' + nm + '.'; }
   269	  s.p = clamp(s.p + pts, 0, 30); s.gd = st.day; st.stats.gifts++;
   270	  var lines = [line];
   271	  var nh = hearts(d.id);
   272	  if (nh > hp) { lines.push('(' + d.n.split(' ')[0] + ' warms to you - ' + nh + ' heart' + (nh > 1 ? 's' : '') + ')'); }
   273	  if (nh >= 2 && !s.s1) lines.push('(Talk again - they have something to tell you.)');
   274	  else if (nh >= 4 && s.s1 && !s.s2) lines.push('(Talk again - their story continues.)');
   275	  dlg = { name: d.n, col: d.c, lines: lines, idx: 0, npcI: i, kind: 'gifted' };
   276	  mode = 'dialog';
   277	  if (pts >= 3) {
   278	    Snd.heart();
   279	    for (var k = 0; k < 8; k++) Parts.add(npcPos[i].x + rnd(-8, 8), npcPos[i].y - 16, rnd(-16, 16), rnd(-40, -18), rnd(0.6, 1.1), '#ff8fa8', rnd(2.5, 4), -10);
   280	  } else if (pts < 0) Snd.bad(); else Snd.pickup();
   281	  save();
   282	}
   283	function checkHeartUp(d, before) {
   284	  if (hearts(d.id) > before) { Snd.heart(); toast(d.n.split(' ')[0] + ' warms to you.'); }
   285	}

   288	function craft(rec) {
   289	  if ((st.owned[rec.id] || 0) >= 3) { craftMsg = 'You already have plenty of those.'; craftMsgT = 2; Snd.bad(); return; }
   290	  if (!hasItems(rec.r)) { craftMsg = 'Not enough materials.'; craftMsgT = 2; Snd.bad(); return; }
   291	  for (var k in rec.r) { st.inv[k] -= rec.r[k]; if (st.inv[k] <= 0) delete st.inv[k]; }
   292	  st.owned[rec.id] = (st.owned[rec.id] || 0) + 1;
   293	  st.stats.crafted++;
   294	  craftMsg = 'Crafted ' + rec.n + '!'; craftMsgT = 2.2;
   295	  Snd.craft(); flash = 0.25; shake = 3;
   296	  Parts.burst(VW / 2, 120, 14, '#ffd77a', 130, 0.7, 90);
   297	  save();
   298	}

   300	/* ================= fishing ================= */
   301	function startFishing() {
   302	  var pool = fishPool(st.season, st.night);
   303	  var id = pick(pool), f = FISH[id];
   304	  fs = { ph: 'cast', t: 0, id: id, f: f, pos: 0, dir: 1, zc: 0.5, hits: 0, need: f.hits, miss: 0, res: '', wait: rnd(1.1, 3.0) };
   305	  mode = 'fish'; target = null; path.length = 0;
   306	  Snd.tone(420, 0.14, 'sine', 0.12, 620);
   307	}
   308	function fishAction() {
   309	  if (!fs) return;
   310	  if (fs.ph === 'cast') return;
   311	  if (fs.ph === 'wait') { fs.ph = 'done'; fs.res = 'You reeled in too early.'; fs.t = 0; Snd.bad(); return; }
   312	  if (fs.ph === 'bite') { fs.ph = 'reel'; fs.t = 0; fs.pos = 0; fs.dir = 1; fs.zc = rnd(0.25, 0.75); Snd.bite(); return; }
   313	  if (fs.ph === 'reel') {
   314	    if (Math.abs(fs.pos - fs.zc) < fs.f.zone / 2) {
   315	      fs.hits++; Snd.hit(fs.hits); shake = Math.max(shake, 3);
   316	      Parts.burst(VW / 2, 470, 10, '#8fe0c0', 120, 0.5, 60);
   317	      if (fs.hits >= fs.need) { fs.ph = 'done'; fs.t = 0; fs.res = 'caught'; land(); }
   318	      else { fs.zc = rnd(0.18, 0.82); }
   319	    } else {
   320	      fs.miss++; Snd.bad(); shake = Math.max(shake, 4);
   321	      if (fs.miss >= 3) { fs.ph = 'done'; fs.t = 0; fs.res = 'The line went slack. It slipped away.'; }
   322	    }
   323	  }
   324	  if (fs.ph === 'done' && fs.res && fs.t > 0.6) closeFishing();
   325	}
   326	function land() {
   327	  addItem(fs.id, 1); st.stats.fish++;
   328	  Snd.catchFx(); flash = 0.4; shake = 6;
   329	  Parts.burst(VW / 2, 400, 22, ITEMS[fs.id].c, 200, 1.0, 200);
   330	  save();
   331	}
   332	function closeFishing() { fs = null; mode = 'play'; }
   333	function updateFishing(dt) {
   334	  if (!fs) return;
   335	  fs.t += dt;
   336	  if (fs.ph === 'cast') { if (fs.t > 0.5) { fs.ph = 'wait'; fs.t = 0; } }
   337	  else if (fs.ph === 'wait') { if (fs.t > fs.wait) { fs.ph = 'bite'; fs.t = 0; Snd.bite(); shake = 3; } }
   338	  else if (fs.ph === 'bite') { if (fs.t > 0.95) { fs.ph = 'done'; fs.t = 0; fs.res = 'Missed the bite.'; Snd.bad(); } }
   339	  else if (fs.ph === 'reel') {
   340	    fs.pos += fs.dir * fs.f.spd * dt;
   341	    if (fs.pos > 1) { fs.pos = 1; fs.dir = -1; }
   342	    if (fs.pos < 0) { fs.pos = 0; fs.dir = 1; }
   343	  } else if (fs.ph === 'done') { if (fs.t > 2.0) closeFishing(); }
   344	}

   346	/* ================= movement ================= */
   347	var stuckT = 0, repaths = 0, path = [], navW = null, navI = null;
   348	function navFor() { return st.scene === 'world' ? navW : navI; }
   349	function solidFor() { return st.scene === 'world' ? blocked : insideBlocked; }
   350	function setWalk(tx, ty, act) {
   351	  var p = navPath(navFor(), st.px, st.py, tx, ty, PR + 1);
   352	  if (!p || !p.length) { path = []; target = null; toast('No way through from here.'); return false; }
   353	  path = p; target = { x: tx, y: ty, act: act || null }; stuckT = 0;
   354	  return true;
   355	}
   356	function moveWorld(dt) {
   357	  var kx = 0, ky = 0, K = Input.keys;
   358	  if (K['a'] || K['arrowleft']) kx -= 1;
   359	  if (K['d'] || K['arrowright']) kx += 1;
   360	  if (K['w'] || K['arrowup']) ky -= 1;
   361	  if (K['s'] || K['arrowdown']) ky += 1;
   362	  var vx = 0, vy = 0, moved = false;
   363	  var solid = st.scene === 'world' ? blocked : insideBlocked;
   364	  if (kx || ky) {
   365	    target = null; path.length = 0; stuckT = 0;
   366	    var m = Math.hypot(kx, ky) || 1; vx = kx / m * SPD; vy = ky / m * SPD;
   367	    var nx = st.px + vx * dt;
   368	    if (!solid(nx, st.py, PR)) { st.px = nx; moved = true; }
   369	    var ny = st.py + vy * dt;
   370	    if (!solid(st.px, ny, PR)) { st.py = ny; moved = true; }
   371	  } else if (target) {
   372	    var dx = target.x - st.px, dy = target.y - st.py, d = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
   373	    var stopd = target.act ? Math.max(20, target.act.r * 0.7) : 6;
   374	    if (d <= stopd) {
   375	      var a = target.act; target = null; path.length = 0; stuckT = 0;
   376	      if (a) doInteract(a);
   377	    } else {
   378	      while (path.length > 1 && dist2(st.px, st.py, path[0].x, path[0].y) < 100) path.shift();
   379	      var aim = path.length ? path[0] : target;
   380	      var adx = aim.x - st.px, ady = aim.y - st.py, ad = Math.hypot(adx, ady);
   381	      if (ad < 6 && path.length) { path.shift(); ad = 0; }
   382	      if (ad > 0.001) {
   383	        vx = adx / ad * SPD; vy = ady / ad * SPD;
   384	        var ax = st.px + vx * dt;
   385	        if (!solid(ax, st.py, PR)) { st.px = ax; moved = true; }
   386	        var ay = st.py + vy * dt;
   387	        if (!solid(st.px, ay, PR)) { st.py = ay; moved = true; }
   388	      }
   389	      if (moved) { stuckT = 0; repaths = 0; }
   390	      else {
   391	        stuckT += dt;
   392	        if (stuckT > 0.35) {
   393	          stuckT = 0;
   394	          if (++repaths > 4) { repaths = 0; target = null; path.length = 0; toast('No way through from here.'); }
   395	          else if (!setWalk(target.x, target.y, target.act)) { path.length = 0; }
   396	        }
   397	      }
   398	    }
   399	  }
   400	  if (moved) {
   401	    st.fx = vx; st.fy = vy; st.anim += dt * 9;
   402	    if (Math.floor(st.anim) % 4 === 0 && Math.random() < 0.06) Snd.step();
   403	  } else st.anim = 0;
   404	}
   405	function centerCam() {
   406	  cam.x = clamp(st.px - VW / 2, 0, MW - VW);
   407	  cam.y = clamp(st.py - VH / 2, 0, MH - VH);
   408	}

   410	/* ================= loop ================= */
   411	var last = 0;
   412	function frame(ts) {
   413	  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
   414	  var dt = (ts - last) / 1000; last = ts;
   415	  if (!isFinite(dt) || dt < 0) dt = 0;
   416	  dt = Math.min(dt, 0.05);
   417	  if (started && !paused) update(dt);
   418	  render();
   419	}
   420	function update(dt) {
   421	  st.clock += dt;
   422	  if (toastT > 0) toastT -= dt;
   423	  if (craftMsgT > 0) craftMsgT -= dt;
   424	  if (shake > 0) shake = Math.max(0, shake - dt * 14);
   425	  if (flash > 0) flash = Math.max(0, flash - dt * 1.6);
   426	  Parts.update(dt);
   427	  if (mode === 'play' || mode === 'decorate') {
   428	    st.tod += dt / DAYLEN;
   429	    if (st.tod >= 1) { advanceDay(false); mode = 'play'; }
   430	    refreshTime();
   431	    if (mode === 'play') { moveWorld(dt); if (st.scene === 'world') updateNpcs(dt); }
   432	  } else if (mode === 'fish') {
   433	    st.tod += dt / DAYLEN; if (st.tod >= 1) st.tod = 0.999;
   434	    refreshTime(); updateFishing(dt);
   435	  }
   436	  centerCam();
   437	}

   440	function B(id, x, y, w, h, label, style) { return { id: id, x: x, y: y, w: w, h: h, l: label, s: style || 0 }; }
   441	function buttons() {
   442	  var b = [];
   443	  if (mode === 'ending') { b.push(B('endok', 95, 596, 200, 56, 'Keep Playing', 1)); return b; }
   444	  if (mode === 'menu') {
   445	    b.push(B('snd', 55, 250, 280, 56, Snd.on ? 'Sound: On' : 'Sound: Off'));
   446	    b.push(B('newg', 55, 320, 280, 56, confirmNew ? 'Tap again to confirm' : 'New Game', confirmNew ? 2 : 0));
   447	    b.push(B('close', 55, 420, 280, 56, 'Back', 1));
   448	    return b;
   449	  }
   450	  if (mode === 'fish') { b.push(B('act', 312, 610, 66, 66, fs && fs.ph === 'reel' ? 'Hook' : 'Reel', 1)); return b; }
   451	  if (mode === 'craft') { b.push(B('close', 271, 96, 56, 52, 'X')); return b; }
   452	  if (mode === 'bag') { b.push(B('close', 271, 96, 56, 52, 'X')); return b; }
   453	  if (mode === 'gift') { b.push(B('close', 271, 116, 56, 52, 'X')); return b; }
   454	  if (mode === 'dialog' && dlg) {
   455	    if (dlg.kind === 'sleep') {
   456	      b.push(B('sleepy', 30, 606, 160, 54, 'Sleep', 1));
   457	      b.push(B('sleepn', 200, 606, 160, 54, 'Not yet'));
   458	    } else if (dlg.kind === 'talk' && dlg.idx >= dlg.lines.length - 1) {
   459	      var d = NPCS[dlg.npcI];
   460	      var can = st.npc[d.id].gd !== st.day && invList().length > 0;
   461	      b.push(B('gift', 30, 606, 160, 54, can ? 'Give Gift' : 'Gifted today', can ? 1 : 3));
   462	      b.push(B('bye', 200, 606, 160, 54, 'Goodbye'));
   463	    }
   464	    return b;
   465	  }
   466	  if (mode === 'decorate') {
   467	    b.push(B('decdone', 246, 8, 132, 48, 'Done', 1));
   468	    var uw = st.style.uw.length > 1, uf = st.style.uf.length > 1;
   469	    if (uw) b.push(B('wallsty', 12, 8, 104, 48, 'Walls'));
   470	    if (uf) b.push(B('floorsty', 124, 8, 104, 48, 'Floor'));
   471	    if (selFurn >= 0) b.push(B('remove', 12, 470, 120, 50, 'Put Away', 2));
   472	    if (trayItems().length > 6) {
   473	      b.push(B('trayl', 2, 606, 44, 84, '<'));
   474	      b.push(B('trayr', 344, 606, 44, 84, '>'));
   475	    }
   476	    return b;
   477	  }
   478	  // play
   479	  b.push(B('menu', 334, 4, 52, 48, '≡'));
   480	  b.push(B('bag', 12, 616, 60, 60, 'Bag'));
   481	  b.push(B('act', 312, 610, 66, 66, 'Use', 1));
   482	  if (st.scene === 'interior') b.push(B('dec', 138, 620, 116, 52, 'Decorate'));
   483	  return b;
   484	}
   485	function hitBtn(x, y) {
   486	  var b = buttons();
   487	  for (var i = b.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
   488	    var o = b[i];
   489	    if (x >= o.x - 4 && x <= o.x + o.w + 4 && y >= o.y - 4 && y <= o.y + o.h + 4) return o;
   490	  }
   491	  return null;
   492	}
   493	function fireBtn(id) {
   494	  Snd.tap();
   495	  if (id === 'menu') { mode = 'menu'; confirmNew = false; return; }
   496	  if (id === 'close') { mode = 'play'; confirmNew = false; craftMsgT = 0; return; }
   497	  if (id === 'snd') { Snd.on = !Snd.on; return; }
   498	  if (id === 'newg') { if (!confirmNew) { confirmNew = true; } else { newGame(); } return; }
   499	  if (id === 'bag') { mode = 'bag'; return; }
   500	  if (id === 'act') { if (mode === 'fish') fishAction(); else doInteract(nearest(st.px, st.py, 52)); return; }
   501	  if (id === 'dec') { mode = 'decorate'; selFurn = -1; trayPage = 0; return; }
   502	  if (id === 'decdone') { mode = 'play'; selFurn = -1; save(); return; }
   503	  if (id === 'wallsty') { cycleStyle('wall'); return; }
   504	  if (id === 'floorsty') { cycleStyle('floor'); return; }
   505	  if (id === 'remove') { if (selFurn >= 0 && selFurn < st.placed.length) { st.placed.splice(selFurn, 1); selFurn = -1; save(); } return; }
   506	  if (id === 'trayl') { trayPage = Math.max(0, trayPage - 1); return; }
   507	  if (id === 'trayr') { trayPage = Math.min(Math.floor((trayItems().length - 1) / 6), trayPage + 1); return; }
   508	  if (id === 'sleepy') { dlg = null; mode = 'play'; advanceDay(true); return; }
   509	  if (id === 'sleepn') { dlg = null; mode = 'play'; return; }
   510	  if (id === 'bye') { dlg = null; mode = 'play'; return; }
   511	  if (id === 'gift') {
   512	    var d = NPCS[dlg.npcI];
   513	    if (st.npc[d.id].gd === st.day || invList().length === 0) { toast('Nothing to give right now.'); return; }
   514	    mode = 'gift'; return;
   515	  }
   516	  if (id === 'endok') { mode = 'play'; st.endShown = true; save(); return; }
   517	}
   518	function cycleStyle(kind) {
   519	  var listk = kind === 'wall' ? 'uw' : 'uf';
   520	  var av = st.style[listk];
   521	  var cur = av.indexOf(st.style[kind]);
   522	  st.style[kind] = av[(cur + 1) % av.length];
   523	  save();
   524	}

   527	function trayItems() {
   528	  var out = [];
   529	  for (var i = 0; i < FURN.length; i++) if (availCount(FURN[i].id) > 0) out.push(FURN[i]);
   530	  return out;
   531	}
   532	function trayRect(i) { return { x: 54 + (i % 3) * 96, y: 608 + Math.floor(i / 3) * 44, w: 88, h: 40 }; }
   533	function decorateDown(p) {
   534	  // tray?
   535	  var items = trayItems(), pg = items.slice(trayPage * 6, trayPage * 6 + 6);
   536	  for (var i = 0; i < pg.length; i++) {
   537	    var r = trayRect(i);
   538	    if (p.x >= r.x && p.x <= r.x + r.w && p.y >= r.y - 6 && p.y <= r.y + r.h + 6) {
   539	      if (st.placed.length >= 40) { toast('The cottage is full.'); return; }
   540	      st.placed.push({ id: pg[i].id, x: ROOM.x + ROOM.w / 2, y: ROOM.y + ROOM.h / 2 });
   541	      selFurn = st.placed.length - 1; Snd.tap(); save(); return;
   542	    }
   543	  }
   544	  // placed?
   545	  for (var j = st.placed.length - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
   546	    var pl = st.placed[j], f = furnById(pl.id);
   547	    if (!f) continue;
   548	    if (Math.abs(p.x - pl.x) < Math.max(f.w, 44) / 2 && Math.abs(p.y - pl.y) < Math.max(f.h, 44) / 2) {
   549	      selFurn = j; drag = { i: j, dx: pl.x - p.x, dy: pl.y - p.y }; dragPid = p.id; Snd.tap(); return;
   550	    }
   551	  }
   552	  selFurn = -1;
   553	}
   554	function decorateMove(p) {
   555	  if (!drag || dragPid !== p.id) return;
   556	  var pl = st.placed[drag.i]; if (!pl) { drag = null; return; }
   557	  var f = furnById(pl.id);
   558	  pl.x = clamp(Math.round((p.x + drag.dx) / 5) * 5, ROOM.x + f.w / 2 + 2, ROOM.x + ROOM.w - f.w / 2 - 2);
   559	  pl.y = clamp(Math.round((p.y + drag.dy) / 5) * 5, ROOM.y + f.h / 2 + 2, ROOM.y + ROOM.h - f.h / 2 - 2);
   560	}
   561	function decorateUp(p) {
   562	  if (drag && dragPid === p.id) { drag = null; dragPid = null; save(); }
   563	}

   565	/* ================= input ================= */
   566	function toV(e) {
   567	  var r = cv.getBoundingClientRect();
   568	  return { x: (e.clientX - r.left) * VW / Math.max(1, r.width), y: (e.clientY - r.top) * VH / Math.max(1, r.height) };
   569	}
   570	function onDown(e) {
   571	  e.preventDefault();
   572	  if (!started || paused) return;
   573	  Snd.init();
   574	  var v = toV(e), p = Input.add(e.pointerId, v.x, v.y);
   575	  var b = hitBtn(v.x, v.y);
   576	  if (b) { p.btn = b.id; return; }
   577	  if (mode === 'play') { playTap(v.x, v.y); }
   578	  else if (mode === 'fish') { fishAction(); }
   579	  else if (mode === 'dialog') { if (dlg && dlg.kind !== 'sleep') advanceDialog(); }
   580	  else if (mode === 'decorate') { decorateDown(p); }
   581	  else if (mode === 'gift') { giftTap(v.x, v.y); }
   582	  else if (mode === 'craft') { craftTap(v.x, v.y); }
   583	  else if (mode === 'bag' || mode === 'menu') { if (v.y < 80 || v.y > 640) { mode = 'play'; confirmNew = false; } }
   584	}
   585	function onMove(e) {
   586	  if (!started || paused) return;
   587	  var p = Input.get(e.pointerId); if (!p) return;
   588	  var v = toV(e);
   589	  if (Math.abs(v.x - p.ox) > 6 || Math.abs(v.y - p.oy) > 6) p.moved = true;
   590	  p.x = v.x; p.y = v.y;
   591	  if (mode === 'decorate') decorateMove(p);
   592	}
   593	function onUp(e) {
   594	  var p = Input.get(e.pointerId);
   595	  if (!p) return;
   596	  var v = toV(e); p.x = v.x; p.y = v.y;
   597	  if (mode === 'decorate') decorateUp(p);
   598	  if (p.btn) {
   599	    var b = hitBtn(v.x, v.y);
   600	    if (b && b.id === p.btn) fireBtn(b.id);
   601	  }
   602	  Input.del(e.pointerId);
   603	}
   604	function onCancel(e) {
   605	  var p = Input.get(e.pointerId);
   606	  if (p && drag && dragPid === p.id) { drag = null; dragPid = null; }
   607	  Input.del(e.pointerId);
   608	}
   609	function playTap(x, y) {
   610	  if (y < 6 || y > 604) return;       // reserve only the bottom control band
   611	  var wx = x + (st.scene === 'world' ? cam.x : 0), wy = y + (st.scene === 'world' ? cam.y : 0);
   612	  var l = interactables(), best = null, bd = 44 * 44;
   613	  for (var i = 0; i < l.length; i++) {
   614	    var d = dist2(wx, wy, l[i].x, l[i].y);
   615	    if (d < bd) { bd = d; best = l[i]; }
   616	  }
   617	  if (best) {
   618	    if (dist2(st.px, st.py, best.x, best.y) < 46 * 46) { doInteract(best); target = null; path.length = 0; }
   619	    else setWalk(best.x, best.y, best);
   620	  } else if (setWalk(wx, wy, null)) {
   621	    Parts.add(wx, wy, 0, 0, 0.4, '#ffffff', 6, 0);
   622	  }
   623	}
   624	function giftTap(x, y) {
   625	  var items = invList();
   626	  for (var i = 0; i < items.length && i < 16; i++) {
   627	    var r = giftRect(i);
   628	    if (x >= r.x && x <= r.x + r.w && y >= r.y && y <= r.y + r.h) { giveGift(items[i]); return; }
   629	  }
   630	}
   631	function giftRect(i) { return { x: 22 + (i % 4) * 88, y: 190 + Math.floor(i / 4) * 84, w: 82, h: 78 }; }
   632	function craftTap(x, y) {
   633	  for (var i = 0; i < RECIPES.length; i++) {
   634	    var r = craftRect(i);
   635	    if (x >= r.x && x <= r.x + r.w && y >= r.y && y <= r.y + r.h) { craft(RECIPES[i]); return; }
   636	  }
   637	}
   638	function craftRect(i) { return { x: 14 + (i % 2) * 184, y: 162 + Math.floor(i / 2) * 76, w: 178, h: 70 }; }
   639	
   640	function onKey(e, down) {
   641	  var k = (e.key || '').toLowerCase();
   642	  if (!started) { if (down && (k === ' ' || k === 'enter')) begin(); return; }
   643	  if (down) {
   644	    Snd.init();
   645	    if (k === 'e' || k === ' ') {
   646	      if (mode === 'play') doInteract(nearest(st.px, st.py, 52));
   647	      else if (mode === 'fish') fishAction();
   648	      else if (mode === 'dialog') { if (dlg && dlg.kind === 'sleep') fireBtn('sleepy'); else advanceDialog(); }
   649	      else if (mode === 'ending') fireBtn('endok');
   650	      e.preventDefault();
   651	    } else if (k === 'escape') {
   652	      if (mode === 'decorate') fireBtn('decdone');
   653	      else if (mode !== 'play') { mode = 'play'; dlg = null; fs = null; confirmNew = false; }
   654	      else mode = 'menu';
   655	    } else if (k === 'i') { mode = (mode === 'bag') ? 'play' : 'bag'; }
   656	    else if (k === 'c' && st.scene === 'interior') { mode = (mode === 'craft') ? 'play' : 'craft'; }
   657	  }
   658	  if (['w', 'a', 's', 'd', 'arrowup', 'arrowdown', 'arrowleft', 'arrowright'].indexOf(k) >= 0) {
   659	    e.preventDefault();
   660	    Input.keys[k] = down;
   661	    if (down) target = null;
   662	  }
   663	}

   665	/* ================= render ================= */
   666	function render() {
   667	  g.setTransform(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0);
   668	  g.fillStyle = '#0e161d';
   669	  g.fillRect(0, 0, cv.width, cv.height);
   670	  g.setTransform(sc, 0, 0, sc, 0, 0);
   671	  if (!st) return;
   672	  g.save();
   673	  if (shake > 0) g.translate(rnd(-shake, shake), rnd(-shake, shake));
   674	
   675	  if (st.scene === 'world') {
   676	    drawWorld(g, cam, st);
   677	    g.save(); g.translate(-cam.x, -cam.y);
   678	    drawNpcs(g);
   679	    drawPlayer(g, st.px, st.py);
   680	    if (mode === 'fish' && fs) drawBobber(g);
   681	    Parts.draw(g);
   682	    g.restore();
   683	    drawNight(g);
   684	  } else {
   685	    drawInterior(g, st);
   686	    var sorted = st.placed.slice().sort(function (a, b) { return a.y - b.y; });
   687	    for (var i = 0; i < sorted.length; i++) {
   688	      var f = furnById(sorted[i].id); if (!f) continue;
   689	      var isSel = (mode === 'decorate' && selFurn >= 0 && st.placed[selFurn] === sorted[i]);
   690	      drawFurn(g, f, sorted[i].x, sorted[i].y, 1, isSel);
   691	    }
   692	    drawPlayer(g, st.px, st.py);
   693	    Parts.draw(g);
   694	    if (st.night) { g.fillStyle = 'rgba(20,26,48,0.24)'; g.fillRect(0, 0, VW, VH); }
   695	  }
   696	  g.restore();
   697	
   698	  if (flash > 0) { g.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,246,214,' + (flash * 0.5) + ')'; g.fillRect(0, 0, VW, VH); }
   699	
   700	  if (mode === 'decorate') drawDecorateUI(g);
   701	  else drawHUD(g);
   702	
   703	  if (mode === 'fish') drawFishUI(g);
   704	  if (mode === 'dialog') drawDialog(g);
   705	  if (mode === 'gift') drawGift(g);
   706	  if (mode === 'craft') drawCraft(g);
   707	  if (mode === 'bag') drawBag(g);
   708	  if (mode === 'menu') drawMenu(g);
   709	  if (mode === 'ending') drawEnding(g);
   710	
   711	  drawButtons(g);
   712	  if (toastT > 0) drawToast(g);
   713	}

   715	function drawPlayer(g2, x, y) {
   716	  var bob = Math.abs(Math.sin(st.anim)) * 2.5;
   717	  g2.fillStyle = '#00000030';
   718	  g2.beginPath(); g2.ellipse(x, y + 11, 9, 4, 0, 0, 6.2832); g2.fill();
   719	  fillRR(g2, x - 8, y - 12 - bob, 16, 20, 6, '#5f8fbf');
   720	  g2.fillStyle = '#f0cba8';
   721	  g2.beginPath(); g2.arc(x, y - 18 - bob, 8, 0, 6.2832); g2.fill();
   722	  g2.fillStyle = '#4a3526';
   723	  g2.beginPath(); g2.arc(x, y - 21 - bob, 8, Math.PI, 0); g2.fill();
   724	  g2.fillStyle = '#22303c';
   725	  var fx = st.fx, fy = st.fy;
   726	  if (Math.abs(fx) > Math.abs(fy)) { g2.fillRect(x + (fx > 0 ? 2 : -5), y - 20 - bob, 3, 3); }
   727	  else if (fy < 0) { } else { g2.fillRect(x - 4, y - 19 - bob, 2.5, 3); g2.fillRect(x + 2, y - 19 - bob, 2.5, 3); }
   728	}
   729	function drawNpcs(g2) {
   730	  for (var i = 0; i < NPCS.length; i++) {
   731	    var d = NPCS[i], p = npcPos[i];
   732	    if (p.x < cam.x - 40 || p.x > cam.x + VW + 40 || p.y < cam.y - 60 || p.y > cam.y + VH + 40) continue;
   733	    var bob = Math.abs(Math.sin(p.t)) * 2;
   734	    g2.fillStyle = '#00000030';
   735	    g2.beginPath(); g2.ellipse(p.x, p.y + 11, 9, 4, 0, 0, 6.2832); g2.fill();
   736	    fillRR(g2, p.x - 8, p.y - 12 - bob, 16, 20, 6, d.c);
   737	    g2.fillStyle = '#f0cba8';
   738	    g2.beginPath(); g2.arc(p.x, p.y - 18 - bob, 8, 0, 6.2832); g2.fill();
   739	    g2.fillStyle = d.h;
   740	    g2.beginPath(); g2.arc(p.x, p.y - 20 - bob, 8, Math.PI, 0); g2.fill();
   741	    var hp = hearts(d.id), s = st.npc[d.id];
   742	    if (dist2(st.px, st.py, p.x, p.y) < 90 * 90) {
   743	      txt(g2, d.n.split(' ')[0], p.x, p.y - 36, 11, '#ffffff', 'center', 700);
   744	      for (var k = 0; k < hp; k++) drawHeart(g2, p.x - (hp - 1) * 5 + k * 10, p.y - 48, 4, '#ff8fa8');
   745	      if ((hp >= 2 && !s.s1) || (hp >= 4 && s.s1 && !s.s2)) {
   746	        txt(g2, '!', p.x + 14, p.y - 34 + Math.sin(st.clock * 5) * 2, 18, '#ffe08a', 'center', 800);
   747	      }
   748	    }
   749	  }
   750	}
   751	function drawHeart(g2, x, y, r, col) {
   752	  g2.fillStyle = col;
   753	  g2.beginPath();
   754	  g2.arc(x - r * 0.5, y, r * 0.6, 0, 6.2832); g2.arc(x + r * 0.5, y, r * 0.6, 0, 6.2832);
   755	  g2.moveTo(x - r, y + 0.2); g2.lineTo(x, y + r * 1.3); g2.lineTo(x + r, y + 0.2);
   756	  g2.closePath(); g2.fill();
   757	}
   758	function drawNight(g2) {
   759	  var h = 6 + st.tod * 18, a = 0;
   760	  if (h > 16.5) a = clamp((h - 16.5) / 3.5, 0, 1) * 0.52;
   761	  if (h < 7.5) a = clamp((7.5 - h) / 2, 0, 1) * 0.3;
   762	  if (a <= 0) return;
   763	  g2.fillStyle = 'rgba(18,24,54,' + a.toFixed(3) + ')';
   764	  g2.fillRect(0, 0, VW, VH);
   765	}
   766	function drawBobber(g2) {
   767	  var bx = DOCK.x + DOCK.w / 2, by = DOCK.y - 40;
   768	  var dip = (fs.ph === 'bite') ? Math.sin(fs.t * 30) * 4 : Math.sin(st.clock * 2) * 2;
   769	  g2.strokeStyle = '#e8e0c8'; g2.lineWidth = 1.5;
   770	  g2.beginPath(); g2.moveTo(st.px, st.py - 12); g2.lineTo(bx, by + dip); g2.stroke();
   771	  g2.fillStyle = '#e05a5a'; g2.beginPath(); g2.arc(bx, by + dip, 6, Math.PI, 0); g2.fill();
   772	  g2.fillStyle = '#f0f0f0'; g2.beginPath(); g2.arc(bx, by + dip, 6, 0, Math.PI); g2.fill();

    99	function hourStr() {
   100	  var h = 6 + st.tod * 18, hh = Math.floor(h), mm = Math.floor((h - hh) * 60 / 5) * 5;
   101	  var ap = hh >= 12 && hh < 24 ? 'pm' : 'am';
   102	  var d = hh % 12; if (d === 0) d = 12;
   103	  if (hh >= 24) { d = 12; ap = 'am'; }
   104	  return d + ':' + (mm < 10 ? '0' : '') + mm + ap;
   105	}
