   308	function fishAction() {
   309	  if (!fs) return;
   310	  if (fs.ph === 'cast') return;
   311	  if (fs.ph === 'wait') { fs.ph = 'done'; fs.res = 'You reeled in too early.'; fs.t = 0; Snd.bad(); return; }
   312	  if (fs.ph === 'bite') { fs.ph = 'reel'; fs.t = 0; fs.pos = 0; fs.dir = 1; fs.zc = rnd(0.25, 0.75); Snd.bite(); return; }
   313	  if (fs.ph === 'reel') {
   314	    if (Math.abs(fs.pos - fs.zc) < fs.f.zone / 2) {
   315	      fs.hits++; Snd.hit(fs.hits); shake = Math.max(shake, 3);
   316	      Parts.burst(VW / 2, 470, 10, '#8fe0c0', 120, 0.5, 60);
   317	      if (fs.hits >= fs.need) { fs.ph = 'done'; fs.t = 0; fs.res = 'caught'; land(); }
   318	      else { fs.zc = rnd(0.18, 0.82); }
   319	    } else {
   320	      fs.miss++; Snd.bad(); shake = Math.max(shake, 4);
   321	      if (fs.miss >= 3) { fs.ph = 'done'; fs.t = 0; fs.res = 'The line went slack. It slipped away.'; }
   322	    }
   323	  }
   324	  if (fs.ph === 'done' && fs.res && fs.t > 0.6) closeFishing();
   325	}
   326	function land() {
   327	  addItem(fs.id, 1); st.stats.fish++;
   328	  Snd.catchFx(); flash = 0.4; shake = 6;
   329	  Parts.burst(VW / 2, 400, 22, ITEMS[fs.id].c, 200, 1.0, 200);
   330	  save();
   331	}
   332	function closeFishing() { fs = null; mode = 'play'; }
   333	function updateFishing(dt) {
   334	  if (!fs) return;
   335	  fs.t += dt;
   336	  if (fs.ph === 'cast') { if (fs.t > 0.5) { fs.ph = 'wait'; fs.t = 0; } }
   337	  else if (fs.ph === 'wait') { if (fs.t > fs.wait) { fs.ph = 'bite'; fs.t = 0; Snd.bite(); shake = 3; } }
   338	  else if (fs.ph === 'bite') { if (fs.t > 0.95) { fs.ph = 'done'; fs.t = 0; fs.res = 'Missed the bite.'; Snd.bad(); } }
   339	  else if (fs.ph === 'reel') {
   340	    fs.pos += fs.dir * fs.f.spd * dt;
   341	    if (fs.pos > 1) { fs.pos = 1; fs.dir = -1; }
   342	    if (fs.pos < 0) { fs.pos = 0; fs.dir = 1; }
   343	  } else if (fs.ph === 'done') { if (fs.t > 2.0) closeFishing(); }
   344	}

   346	/* ================= movement ================= */
   347	var stuckT = 0, repaths = 0, path = [], navW = null, navI = null;
   348	function navFor() { return st.scene === 'world' ? navW : navI; }
   349	function solidFor() { return st.scene === 'world' ? blocked : insideBlocked; }
   350	function setWalk(tx, ty, act) {
   351	  var p = navPath(navFor(), st.px, st.py, tx, ty, PR + 1);
   352	  if (!p || !p.length) { path = []; target = null; toast('No way through from here.'); return false; }
   353	  path = p; target = { x: tx, y: ty, act: act || null }; stuckT = 0;
   354	  return true;
   355	}
   356	function moveWorld(dt) {
   357	  var kx = 0, ky = 0, K = Input.keys;
   358	  if (K['a'] || K['arrowleft']) kx -= 1;
   359	  if (K['d'] || K['arrowright']) kx += 1;
   360	  if (K['w'] || K['arrowup']) ky -= 1;
   361	  if (K['s'] || K['arrowdown']) ky += 1;
   362	  var vx = 0, vy = 0, moved = false;
   363	  var solid = st.scene === 'world' ? blocked : insideBlocked;
   364	  if (kx || ky) {
   365	    target = null; path.length = 0; stuckT = 0;
   366	    var m = Math.hypot(kx, ky) || 1; vx = kx / m * SPD; vy = ky / m * SPD;
   367	    var nx = st.px + vx * dt;
   368	    if (!solid(nx, st.py, PR)) { st.px = nx; moved = true; }
   369	    var ny = st.py + vy * dt;
   370	    if (!solid(st.px, ny, PR)) { st.py = ny; moved = true; }
   370	    if (!solid(st.px, ny, PR)) { st.py = ny; moved = true; }
   371	  } else if (target) {
   372	    var dx = target.x - st.px, dy = target.y - st.py, d = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
   373	    var stopd = target.act ? Math.max(20, target.act.r * 0.7) : 6;
   374	    if (d <= stopd) {
   375	      var a = target.act; target = null; path.length = 0; stuckT = 0;
   376	      if (a) doInteract(a);
   377	    } else {
   378	      while (path.length > 1 && dist2(st.px, st.py, path[0].x, path[0].y) < 100) path.shift();
   379	      var aim = path.length ? path[0] : target;
   380	      var adx = aim.x - st.px, ady = aim.y - st.py, ad = Math.hypot(adx, ady);
   381	      if (ad < 6 && path.length) { path.shift(); ad = 0; }
   382	      if (ad > 0.001) {
   383	        vx = adx / ad * SPD; vy = ady / ad * SPD;
   384	        var ax = st.px + vx * dt;
   385	        if (!solid(ax, st.py, PR)) { st.px = ax; moved = true; }
   386	        var ay = st.py + vy * dt;
   387	        if (!solid(st.px, ay, PR)) { st.py = ay; moved = true; }
   388	      }
   389	      if (moved) { stuckT = 0; repaths = 0; }
   390	      else {
   391	        stuckT += dt;
   392	        if (stuckT > 0.35) {
   393	          stuckT = 0;
   394	          if (++repaths > 4) { repaths = 0; target = null; path.length = 0; toast('No way through from here.'); }
   395	          else if (!setWalk(target.x, target.y, target.act)) { path.length = 0; }
   396	        }
   397	      }
   398	    }
   399	  }
   400	  if (moved) {
   401	    st.fx = vx; st.fy = vy; st.anim += dt * 9;
   402	    if (Math.floor(st.anim) % 4 === 0 && Math.random() < 0.06) Snd.step();
   403	  } else st.anim = 0;
   404	}
   405	function centerCam() {
   406	  cam.x = clamp(st.px - VW / 2, 0, MW - VW);
   407	  cam.y = clamp(st.py - VH / 2, 0, MH - VH);
   408	}

   411	var last = 0;
   412	function frame(ts) {
   413	  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
   414	  var dt = (ts - last) / 1000; last = ts;
   415	  if (!isFinite(dt) || dt < 0) dt = 0;
   416	  dt = Math.min(dt, 0.05);
   417	  if (started && !paused) update(dt);
   418	  render();
   419	}
   420	function update(dt) {
   421	  st.clock += dt;
   422	  if (toastT > 0) toastT -= dt;
   423	  if (craftMsgT > 0) craftMsgT -= dt;
   424	  if (shake > 0) shake = Math.max(0, shake - dt * 14);
   425	  if (flash > 0) flash = Math.max(0, flash - dt * 1.6);
   426	  Parts.update(dt);
   427	  if (mode === 'play' || mode === 'decorate') {
   428	    st.tod += dt / DAYLEN;
   429	    if (st.tod >= 1) { advanceDay(false); mode = 'play'; }
   430	    refreshTime();
   431	    if (mode === 'play') { moveWorld(dt); if (st.scene === 'world') updateNpcs(dt); }
   432	  } else if (mode === 'fish') {
   433	    st.tod += dt / DAYLEN; if (st.tod >= 1) st.tod = 0.999;
   434	    refreshTime(); updateFishing(dt);
   435	  }
   436	  centerCam();
   437	}

   493	function fireBtn(id) {
   494	  Snd.tap();
   495	  if (id === 'menu') { mode = 'menu'; confirmNew = false; return; }
   496	  if (id === 'close') { mode = 'play'; confirmNew = false; craftMsgT = 0; return; }
   497	  if (id === 'snd') { Snd.on = !Snd.on; return; }
   498	  if (id === 'newg') { if (!confirmNew) { confirmNew = true; } else { newGame(); } return; }
   499	  if (id === 'bag') { mode = 'bag'; return; }
   500	  if (id === 'act') { if (mode === 'fish') fishAction(); else doInteract(nearest(st.px, st.py, 52)); return; }
   501	  if (id === 'dec') { mode = 'decorate'; selFurn = -1; trayPage = 0; return; }
   502	  if (id === 'decdone') { mode = 'play'; selFurn = -1; save(); return; }
   503	  if (id === 'wallsty') { cycleStyle('wall'); return; }
   504	  if (id === 'floorsty') { cycleStyle('floor'); return; }
   505	  if (id === 'remove') { if (selFurn >= 0 && selFurn < st.placed.length) { st.placed.splice(selFurn, 1); selFurn = -1; save(); } return; }
   506	  if (id === 'trayl') { trayPage = Math.max(0, trayPage - 1); return; }
   507	  if (id === 'trayr') { trayPage = Math.min(Math.floor((trayItems().length - 1) / 6), trayPage + 1); return; }
   508	  if (id === 'sleepy') { dlg = null; mode = 'play'; advanceDay(true); return; }
   509	  if (id === 'sleepn') { dlg = null; mode = 'play'; return; }
   510	  if (id === 'bye') { dlg = null; mode = 'play'; return; }
   511	  if (id === 'gift') {
   512	    var d = NPCS[dlg.npcI];
   513	    if (st.npc[d.id].gd === st.day || invList().length === 0) { toast('Nothing to give right now.'); return; }
   514	    mode = 'gift'; return;
   515	  }
   516	  if (id === 'endok') { mode = 'play'; st.endShown = true; save(); return; }
   517	}

   692	    drawPlayer(g, st.px, st.py);
   693	    Parts.draw(g);
   694	    if (st.night) { g.fillStyle = 'rgba(20,26,48,0.24)'; g.fillRect(0, 0, VW, VH); }
   695	  }
   696	  g.restore();
   697	
   698	  if (flash > 0) { g.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,246,214,' + (flash * 0.5) + ')'; g.fillRect(0, 0, VW, VH); }
   699	
   700	  if (mode === 'decorate') drawDecorateUI(g);
   701	  else drawHUD(g);
   702	
   703	  if (mode === 'fish') drawFishUI(g);
   704	  if (mode === 'dialog') drawDialog(g);
   705	  if (mode === 'gift') drawGift(g);
   706	  if (mode === 'craft') drawCraft(g);
   707	  if (mode === 'bag') drawBag(g);
   708	  if (mode === 'menu') drawMenu(g);
   709	  if (mode === 'ending') drawEnding(g);
   710	
   711	  drawButtons(g);
   712	  if (toastT > 0) drawToast(g);
   713	}

   715	function drawPlayer(g2, x, y) {
   716	  var bob = Math.abs(Math.sin(st.anim)) * 2.5;
   717	  g2.fillStyle = '#00000030';
   718	  g2.beginPath(); g2.ellipse(x, y + 11, 9, 4, 0, 0, 6.2832); g2.fill();
   719	  fillRR(g2, x - 8, y - 12 - bob, 16, 20, 6, '#5f8fbf');
   720	  g2.fillStyle = '#f0cba8';
   721	  g2.beginPath(); g2.arc(x, y - 18 - bob, 8, 0, 6.2832); g2.fill();
   722	  g2.fillStyle = '#4a3526';
   723	  g2.beginPath(); g2.arc(x, y - 21 - bob, 8, Math.PI, 0); g2.fill();
   724	  g2.fillStyle = '#22303c';
   725	  var fx = st.fx, fy = st.fy;
   726	  if (Math.abs(fx) > Math.abs(fy)) { g2.fillRect(x + (fx > 0 ? 2 : -5), y - 20 - bob, 3, 3); }
   727	  else if (fy < 0) { } else { g2.fillRect(x - 4, y - 19 - bob, 2.5, 3); g2.fillRect(x + 2, y - 19 - bob, 2.5, 3); }
   728	}
   729	function drawNpcs(g2) {
   730	  for (var i = 0; i < NPCS.length; i++) {
   731	    var d = NPCS[i], p = npcPos[i];
   732	    if (p.x < cam.x - 40 || p.x > cam.x + VW + 40 || p.y < cam.y - 60 || p.y > cam.y + VH + 40) continue;
   733	    var bob = Math.abs(Math.sin(p.t)) * 2;
   734	    g2.fillStyle = '#00000030';
   735	    g2.beginPath(); g2.ellipse(p.x, p.y + 11, 9, 4, 0, 0, 6.2832); g2.fill();
   736	    fillRR(g2, p.x - 8, p.y - 12 - bob, 16, 20, 6, d.c);
   737	    g2.fillStyle = '#f0cba8';
   738	    g2.beginPath(); g2.arc(p.x, p.y - 18 - bob, 8, 0, 6.2832); g2.fill();
   739	    g2.fillStyle = d.h;
   740	    g2.beginPath(); g2.arc(p.x, p.y - 20 - bob, 8, Math.PI, 0); g2.fill();
   741	    var hp = hearts(d.id), s = st.npc[d.id];
   742	    if (dist2(st.px, st.py, p.x, p.y) < 90 * 90) {
   743	      txt(g2, d.n.split(' ')[0], p.x, p.y - 36, 11, '#ffffff', 'center', 700);
   744	      for (var k = 0; k < hp; k++) drawHeart(g2, p.x - (hp - 1) * 5 + k * 10, p.y - 48, 4, '#ff8fa8');
   745	      if ((hp >= 2 && !s.s1) || (hp >= 4 && s.s1 && !s.s2)) {
   746	        txt(g2, '!', p.x + 14, p.y - 34 + Math.sin(st.clock * 5) * 2, 18, '#ffe08a', 'center', 800);
   747	      }
   748	    }
   749	  }
   750	}
   751	function drawHeart(g2, x, y, r, col) {
   752	  g2.fillStyle = col;
   753	  g2.beginPath();
   754	  g2.arc(x - r * 0.5, y, r * 0.6, 0, 6.2832); g2.arc(x + r * 0.5, y, r * 0.6, 0, 6.2832);
   755	  g2.moveTo(x - r, y + 0.2); g2.lineTo(x, y + r * 1.3); g2.lineTo(x + r, y + 0.2);
   756	  g2.closePath(); g2.fill();
   757	}
   758	function drawNight(g2) {
   759	  var h = 6 + st.tod * 18, a = 0;
   760	  if (h > 16.5) a = clamp((h - 16.5) / 3.5, 0, 1) * 0.52;
   761	  if (h < 7.5) a = clamp((7.5 - h) / 2, 0, 1) * 0.3;
   762	  if (a <= 0) return;
   763	  g2.fillStyle = 'rgba(18,24,54,' + a.toFixed(3) + ')';
   764	  g2.fillRect(0, 0, VW, VH);
   765	}
   766	function drawBobber(g2) {
   767	  var bx = DOCK.x + DOCK.w / 2, by = DOCK.y - 40;
   768	  var dip = (fs.ph === 'bite') ? Math.sin(fs.t * 30) * 4 : Math.sin(st.clock * 2) * 2;
   769	  g2.strokeStyle = '#e8e0c8'; g2.lineWidth = 1.5;
   770	  g2.beginPath(); g2.moveTo(st.px, st.py - 12); g2.lineTo(bx, by + dip); g2.stroke();
   771	  g2.fillStyle = '#e05a5a'; g2.beginPath(); g2.arc(bx, by + dip, 6, Math.PI, 0); g2.fill();
   772	  g2.fillStyle = '#f0f0f0'; g2.beginPath(); g2.arc(bx, by + dip, 6, 0, Math.PI); g2.fill();
   773	  g2.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.5)'; g2.lineWidth = 2;
   774	  var rr2 = 10 + (st.clock * 22 % 24);
   775	  g2.beginPath(); g2.ellipse(bx, by + dip + 6, rr2, rr2 * 0.35, 0, 0, 6.2832); g2.stroke();
   776	  if (fs.ph === 'bite') txt(g2, '!', bx, by - 22, 26, '#ffe08a', 'center', 800);
   777	}

   797	function drawToast(g2) {

   805	function drawButtons(g2) {
   806	  var b = buttons();
   807	  for (var i = 0; i < b.length; i++) {
   808	    var o = b[i];
   809	    var held = false;
   810	    for (var k in Input.pointers) if (Input.pointers[k].btn === o.id) held = true;
   811	    var col = o.s === 1 ? '#63a86c' : (o.s === 2 ? '#c05a5a' : (o.s === 3 ? '#3a4650' : '#2c3a45'));
   812	    fillRR(g2, o.x, o.y, o.w, o.h, 12, held ? '#8fd08f' : col);
   813	    g2.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.16)'; g2.lineWidth = 1.5;
   814	    rr(g2, o.x + 1, o.y + 1, o.w - 2, o.h - 2, 11); g2.stroke();
   815	    txt(g2, o.l, o.x + o.w / 2, o.y + o.h / 2, o.l.length > 12 ? 12 : 14, o.s === 3 ? '#8894a0' : '#f2f7f0', 'center', 700);
   816	  }
   817	}

   857	      txt(g2, 'Tap to continue', VW / 2, 522, 12, '#a9bcb2', 'center', 600);
   858	    }
   859	  } else {
   860	    txt(g2, 'Tap anywhere to react', VW / 2, 500, 12, '#a9bcb2', 'center', 600);
   861	  }
   862	}

   921	      ci++;

   924	    if (own) txt(g2, 'x' + own, r.x + r.w - 10, r.y + 16, 11, '#ffd98a', 'right', 700);
   925	  }
   926	  if (craftMsgT > 0) { g2.globalAlpha = clamp(craftMsgT, 0, 1); txt(g2, craftMsg, VW / 2, 604, 13, '#ffd98a', 'center', 700); g2.globalAlpha = 1; }
   927	}

   981	function drawEnding(g2) {
   982	  g2.fillStyle = 'rgba(10,14,26,0.88)'; g2.fillRect(0, 0, VW, VH);
   983	  for (var i = 0; i < 14; i++) {
   984	    var a = st.clock * 0.6 + i;
   985	    g2.fillStyle = ['#ffd77a', '#ff9ab0', '#9fe0c0', '#a8c0ff'][i % 4];

   987	    g2.beginPath(); g2.arc(30 + i * 25, 120 + Math.sin(a) * 26, 5, 0, 6.2832); g2.fill();

   128	var Input = {
   129	  pointers: {},        // id -> {x,y,ox,oy,btn,claim}
   130	  keys: {},

   133	    this.pointers = {}; this.keys = {}; this.order.length = 0;
   134	  },
   135	  releaseKeys: function () { this.keys = {}; },
   136	  add: function (id, x, y) {
   137	    this.pointers[id] = { id: id, x: x, y: y, ox: x, oy: y, btn: null, claim: null, moved: false, t: 0 };
   138	    this.order.push(id);
   139	    if (this.order.length > 12) { var d = this.order.shift(); delete this.pointers[d]; }
   140	    return this.pointers[id];
   141	  },
   142	  get: function (id) { return this.pointers[id] || null; },
   143	  del: function (id) {
   144	    delete this.pointers[id];
   145	    var i = this.order.indexOf(id); if (i >= 0) this.order.splice(i, 1);
   146	  },

   150	/* ---------- particles (hardening #5) ---------- */
   151	var PMAX = 170;
   152	var Parts = {
   153	  list: [],
   154	  add: function (x, y, vx, vy, life, col, size, grav, kind) {
   155	    if (this.list.length >= PMAX) this.list.shift();
   156	    this.list.push({ x: x, y: y, vx: vx, vy: vy, l: life, ml: life, c: col, s: size || 3, g: grav === undefined ? 40 : grav, k: kind || 0 });
   157	  },
   158	  burst: function (x, y, n, col, spd, life, grav) {
   159	    n = Math.min(n, 26);
   160	    for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) {
   161	      var a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2, s = rnd(spd * 0.3, spd);
   162	      this.add(x, y, Math.cos(a) * s, Math.sin(a) * s, rnd(life * 0.6, life), col, rnd(2, 4.5), grav);
   163	    }
   164	  },
   165	  update: function (dt) {
   166	    var l = this.list;
   167	    for (var i = l.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
   168	      var p = l[i];
   169	      p.l -= dt;
   170	      if (p.l <= 0) { l.splice(i, 1); continue; }
   171	      p.x += p.vx * dt; p.y += p.vy * dt; p.vy += p.g * dt;
   172	      p.vx *= (1 - 1.2 * dt);
   173	    }
   174	    if (l.length > PMAX) l.splice(0, l.length - PMAX);
   175	  },
   176	  draw: function (g) {
   177	    var l = this.list;
   178	    for (var i = 0; i < l.length; i++) {
   179	      var p = l[i], a = clamp(p.l / p.ml, 0, 1);
   180	      g.globalAlpha = a; g.fillStyle = p.c;
   181	      if (p.k === 1) { g.fillRect(p.x - p.s, p.y - p.s * 0.6, p.s * 2, p.s * 1.2); }
   182	      else { g.beginPath(); g.arc(p.x, p.y, p.s * (0.4 + a * 0.6), 0, 6.2832); g.fill(); }
   183	    }
   184	    g.globalAlpha = 1;
   185	  },
   186	  clear: function () { this.list.length = 0; }
   187	};
   188	
    45	  return out;
    46	}

    63	function inRect(x, y, r) { return x > r.x && x < r.x + r.w && y > r.y && y < r.y + r.h; }

    65	function blocked(x, y, rad) {
    66	  if (x < rad + 10 || x > MW - rad - 10 || y > MH - rad - 10 || y < rad + 6) return true;
    67	  // lake (walkable only on the dock)
    68	  if (y < WATER_Y + rad) {
    69	    if (!(x > DOCK.x + rad - 2 && x < DOCK.x + DOCK.w - rad + 2 && y > DOCK.y + rad)) return true;
    70	  }
    71	  for (var i = 0; i < BUILDINGS.length; i++) {
    72	    var b = BUILDINGS[i];
    73	    if (x > b.x - rad && x < b.x + b.w + rad && y > b.y - rad && y < b.y + b.h + rad) return true;
    74	  }
    75	  for (var j = 0; j < TREES.length; j++) {
    76	    var t = TREES[j];
    77	    if (dist2(x, y, t.x, t.y + 6) < (rad + 9) * (rad + 9)) return true;
    78	  }
    79	  return false;
    80	}

    82	/* ---------- navigation (static grid + BFS, built once) ---------- */
    83	function makeNav(w, h, cell, solid, rad) {
    84	  var cols = Math.ceil(w / cell), rows = Math.ceil(h / cell);
    85	  var grid = new Uint8Array(cols * rows);
    86	  for (var y = 0; y < rows; y++) {
    87	    for (var x = 0; x < cols; x++) {
    88	      grid[y * cols + x] = solid((x + 0.5) * cell, (y + 0.5) * cell, rad) ? 1 : 0;
    89	    }
    90	  }
    91	  return {
    92	    cols: cols, rows: rows, cell: cell, grid: grid, solid: solid,
    93	    prev: new Int32Array(cols * rows), q: new Int32Array(cols * rows)
    94	  };
    95	}
    96	function navClear(nav, x0, y0, x1, y1) {
    97	  var cell = nav.cell, cols = nav.cols, rows = nav.rows, g = nav.grid;
    98	  var dx = x1 - x0, dy = y1 - y0, d = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
    99	  var n = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(d / (cell * 0.5)));
   100	  for (var i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
   101	    var cx = Math.floor((x0 + dx * i / n) / cell), cy = Math.floor((y0 + dy * i / n) / cell);
   102	    if (cx < 0 || cy < 0 || cx >= cols || cy >= rows) return false;
   103	    if (g[cy * cols + cx]) return false;
   104	  }
   105	  return true;
   106	}
   107	function navPath(nav, sx, sy, tx, ty, rad) {
   108	  var cols = nav.cols, rows = nav.rows, cell = nav.cell, g = nav.grid, prev = nav.prev, q = nav.q;
   109	  var scx = clamp(Math.floor(sx / cell), 0, cols - 1), scy = clamp(Math.floor(sy / cell), 0, rows - 1);
   110	  var tcx = clamp(Math.floor(tx / cell), 0, cols - 1), tcy = clamp(Math.floor(ty / cell), 0, rows - 1);
   111	  prev.fill(-2);
   112	  var head = 0, tail = 0, si = scy * cols + scx;
   113	  prev[si] = -1; q[tail++] = si;
   114	  var found = -1, bestAlt = -1, bestAltD = 1e9;
   115	  while (head < tail) {
   116	    var cur = q[head++];
   117	    var cx = cur % cols, cy = (cur / cols) | 0;
   118	    if (cx === tcx && cy === tcy) { found = cur; break; }
   119	    var dd = (cx - tcx) * (cx - tcx) + (cy - tcy) * (cy - tcy);
   120	    if (dd < bestAltD) { bestAltD = dd; bestAlt = cur; }
   121	    for (var k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
   122	      var nx = cx + (k === 0 ? 1 : k === 1 ? -1 : 0), ny = cy + (k === 2 ? 1 : k === 3 ? -1 : 0);
   123	      if (nx < 0 || ny < 0 || nx >= cols || ny >= rows) continue;
   124	      var ni = ny * cols + nx;
   125	      if (prev[ni] !== -2 || g[ni]) continue;
   126	      prev[ni] = cur; q[tail++] = ni;
   127	    }
   128	  }
   129	  if (found < 0) {
   130	    if (bestAlt < 0 || bestAltD > 36) return null;   // nothing near the destination
   131	    found = bestAlt;
   132	  }
   133	  var cells = [];
   134	  for (var c = found; c >= 0 && cells.length < 4096; c = prev[c]) { cells.push(c); if (prev[c] === -1) break; }
   135	  cells.reverse();
   136	  var pts = [];
   137	  for (var i = 0; i < cells.length; i++) pts.push({ x: (cells[i] % cols + 0.5) * cell, y: (((cells[i] / cols) | 0) + 0.5) * cell });
   138	  if (found === (tcy * cols + tcx)) pts.push({ x: tx, y: ty });
   139	  // string-pulling: drop waypoints we can walk straight past (grid line-of-sight, cheap)
   140	  var out = [], px = sx, py = sy, idx = 0;
   141	  while (idx < pts.length && out.length < 64) {
   142	    var far = idx;
   143	    for (var j = idx; j < pts.length; j++) {
   144	      if (navClear(nav, px, py, pts[j].x, pts[j].y)) far = j; else break;
   145	    }
   146	    out.push(pts[far]); px = pts[far].x; py = pts[far].y;
   147	    idx = far + 1;
   148	  }
   149	  if (!out.length) out.push({ x: tx, y: ty });
   150	  return out;

   265	function drawNode(g, nd, spent, st, idx) {
   266	  var info = NODEINFO[nd.k], x = nd.x, y = nd.y;
   267	  g.fillStyle = '#00000022';
   268	  g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(x, y + 10, 14, 5, 0, 0, 6.2832); g.fill();
   269	  if (spent) g.globalAlpha = 0.35;
   270	  var C = seasonCols(st.season);
   271	  if (nd.k === 'reeds') {
   272	    g.strokeStyle = info.c; g.lineWidth = 3;
   273	    for (var i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
   274	      g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(x - 10 + i * 5, y + 8);
   275	      g.quadraticCurveTo(x - 10 + i * 5 + Math.sin(st.clock + i) * 4, y - 6, x - 12 + i * 5 + Math.sin(st.clock + i) * 7, y - 18);
   276	      g.stroke();
   277	    }
   278	  } else if (nd.k === 'rock') {
   279	    g.fillStyle = info.c;
   280	    g.beginPath(); g.arc(x, y, 12, Math.PI, 0); g.closePath(); g.fill();
   281	    g.fillStyle = '#b0bcc7'; g.beginPath(); g.arc(x - 5, y - 2, 6, 0, 6.2832); g.fill();
   282	  } else if (nd.k === 'clay') {
   283	    g.fillStyle = info.c; fillRR(g, x - 14, y - 8, 28, 16, 6, info.c);
   284	    g.fillStyle = '#cf9070'; fillRR(g, x - 8, y - 6, 12, 7, 3, '#cf9070');
   285	  } else if (nd.k === 'log') {
   286	    fillRR(g, x - 18, y - 7, 36, 15, 7, info.c);
   287	    g.fillStyle = '#7d6446'; g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(x + 17, y, 4, 7, 0, 0, 6.2832); g.fill();
   288	  } else if (nd.k === 'pine') {
   289	    g.fillStyle = '#6b4a30'; g.fillRect(x - 3, y - 2, 6, 12);
   290	    g.fillStyle = st.season ? '#5c7a3e' : info.c;
   291	    for (var p = 0; p < 3; p++) {
   292	      g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(x - 14 + p * 2, y - 2 - p * 9); g.lineTo(x, y - 20 - p * 9); g.lineTo(x + 14 - p * 2, y - 2 - p * 9); g.closePath(); g.fill();
   293	    }
   294	  } else if (nd.k === 'bush') {
   295	    g.fillStyle = st.season ? '#8a7a3c' : info.c;
   296	    g.beginPath(); g.arc(x - 7, y, 10, 0, 6.2832); g.arc(x + 7, y, 10, 0, 6.2832); g.arc(x, y - 7, 11, 0, 6.2832); g.fill();
   297	    if (!spent) {
   298	      g.fillStyle = st.season ? '#e5813a' : '#c75f92';
   299	      g.beginPath(); g.arc(x - 5, y - 6, 3, 0, 6.2832); g.arc(x + 6, y - 2, 3, 0, 6.2832); g.arc(x + 1, y + 3, 3, 0, 6.2832); g.fill();
   300	    }
   301	  } else if (nd.k === 'moss') {
   302	    g.fillStyle = info.c;
   303	    g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(x, y, 16, 9, 0, 0, 6.2832); g.fill();
   304	    if (st.night && !spent) {
   305	      g.globalAlpha = 0.35 + Math.sin(st.clock * 2 + idx) * 0.12;
   306	      g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(x, y, 24, 14, 0, 0, 6.2832); g.fill(); g.globalAlpha = spent ? 0.35 : 1;
   307	    }
   308	  }
   309	  g.globalAlpha = 1;
   310	}

   318	function insideBlocked(x, y, r) {
   319	  if (x < ROOM.x + r || x > ROOM.x + ROOM.w - r) return true;
   320	  if (y < ROOM.y + r || y > ROOM.y + ROOM.h - r) return true;
   321	  if (x > BENCH.x - r && x < BENCH.x + BENCH.w + r && y < BENCH.y + BENCH.h + r) return true;
   322	  if (x > BED.x - r && x < BED.x + BED.w + r && y < BED.y + BED.h + r) return true;
   323	  return false;
   324	}

   360	function drawFurnFit(g, f, x, y, box) {
   361	  var s = Math.min(1, box / Math.max(f.w, f.h));
   362	  g.save(); g.translate(x, y); g.scale(s, s);
   363	  drawFurn(g, f, 0, 0, 1, false);
   364	  g.restore();
   365	}

   378	  } else if (f.sh === 'lamp') {

   381	    g.globalAlpha = 0.22; g.beginPath(); g.arc(x, y - h / 2 + 10, w, 0, 6.2832); g.fill();
   382	    g.globalAlpha = alpha === undefined ? 1 : alpha;
   383	  } else if (f.sh === 'tall') {
   384	    fillRR(g, x - w / 2, y - h / 2, w, h, 5, f.a);
   385	    g.fillStyle = f.b; g.fillRect(x - w / 2 + 5, y - h / 2 + 6, w - 10, h * 0.4);

   577	  /* ---------------- loop ---------------- */
   578	  var last = 0, acc = 0;
   579	  function frame(ts) {
   580	    root.requestAnimationFrame(frame);
   581	    if (!last) last = ts;
   582	    var dt = (ts - last) / 1000;
   583	    last = ts;
   584	    if (dt > 0.05) dt = 0.05;      // clamped delta
   585	    if (dt < 0) dt = 0;
   586	
   587	    G.paused = G.rotate || document.hidden;
   588	    buildControls();
   589	    input.drain(onAction);
   590	
   591	    if (!G.paused && G.started) {
   592	      // panel drag-scroll
   593	      var found = null, k;
   594	      for (k in input.pointers) if (input.pointers[k].btn === 'panelScroll') { found = input.pointers[k]; break; }
   595	      if (found) {
   596	        if (dragId === null) { dragId = 1; dragY = found.y; dragMoved = 0; }
   597	        else { var d = found.y - dragY; G.panelScroll -= d; dragMoved += Math.abs(d); dragY = found.y; }
   598	      } else dragId = null;
   599	      G.panelScroll = U.clamp(G.panelScroll, 0, G.panelMax);
   600	
   601	      var v = view();
   602	      if (G.spinning) {
   603	        v.update(dt);
   604	        if (v.done) settle();
   605	      }
   606	      parts.update(dt);
   607	      if (G.flash > 0) G.flash = Math.max(0, G.flash - dt * 1.1);
   608	      if (G.shakeT > 0) { G.shakeT -= dt; if (G.shakeT <= 0) G.shake = 0; }
   609	      if (G.msgT > 0) G.msgT -= dt;
   610	      if (G.toastT > 0) { G.toastT -= dt; if (G.toastT <= 0) G.toast = null; }
   611	      analyseChunk(G.spinning ? 1.2 : 5);
   612	    } else if (!G.paused) {
   613	      analyseChunk(6);
   614	    }
   615	    render();
   616	  }

   147	  /* ---------------- input (hardening #2 and #3) ---------------- */
   148	  function Input(canvas, toVirtual) {
   149	    this.canvas = canvas; this.toVirtual = toVirtual;
   150	    this.keys = Object.create(null);
   151	    this.pointers = Object.create(null);   // pointerId -> {x,y,btn}
   152	    this.pressed = null;                   // currently visually-pressed control id
   153	    this.queue = [];                       // action queue
   154	    this.controls = [];                    // hit rects, rebuilt per frame
   155	    this.onAction = null;
   156	    this.enabled = true;
   157	    var self = this;
   158	
   159	    function down(e) {
   160	      if (!self.enabled) return;
   161	      e.preventDefault();
   162	      var pts = e.changedTouches ? e.changedTouches : [e];
   163	      for (var i = 0; i < pts.length; i++) {
   164	        var p = pts[i], id = p.identifier !== undefined ? 't' + p.identifier : 'p' + (p.pointerId || 0);
   165	        var v = self.toVirtual(p.clientX, p.clientY);
   166	        var btn = self.hit(v.x, v.y);
   167	        self.pointers[id] = { x: v.x, y: v.y, btn: btn ? btn.id : null };
   168	        if (btn) self.pressed = btn.id;
   169	      }
   170	    }
   171	    function move(e) {
   172	      if (!self.enabled) return;
   173	      e.preventDefault();
   174	      var pts = e.changedTouches ? e.changedTouches : [e];
   175	      for (var i = 0; i < pts.length; i++) {
   176	        var p = pts[i], id = p.identifier !== undefined ? 't' + p.identifier : 'p' + (p.pointerId || 0);
   177	        var rec = self.pointers[id]; if (!rec) continue;
   178	        var v = self.toVirtual(p.clientX, p.clientY);
   179	        rec.x = v.x; rec.y = v.y;
   180	        var btn = self.hit(v.x, v.y);
   181	        if (!btn || btn.id !== rec.btn) { if (self.pressed === rec.btn) self.pressed = null; }
   182	        else self.pressed = rec.btn;
   183	      }
   184	    }
   185	    function up(e, cancel) {
   186	      if (!self.enabled) { self.releaseAll(); return; }
   187	      if (e.preventDefault) e.preventDefault();
   188	      var pts = e.changedTouches ? e.changedTouches : [e];
   189	      for (var i = 0; i < pts.length; i++) {
   190	        var p = pts[i], id = p.identifier !== undefined ? 't' + p.identifier : 'p' + (p.pointerId || 0);
   191	        var rec = self.pointers[id]; if (!rec) continue;
   192	        delete self.pointers[id];
   193	        if (self.pressed === rec.btn) self.pressed = null;
   194	        if (!cancel && rec.btn) {
   195	          var v = self.toVirtual(p.clientX, p.clientY);
   196	          var btn = self.hit(v.x, v.y);
   197	          if (btn && btn.id === rec.btn) self.fire(rec.btn);
   198	        }
   199	      }
   200	    }
   201	    this._handlers = [];
   202	    function on(t, ev, fn, opt) { t.addEventListener(ev, fn, opt); self._handlers.push([t, ev, fn]); }
   203	
   204	    if (root.PointerEvent) {
   205	      on(canvas, 'pointerdown', down, { passive: false });
   206	      on(canvas, 'pointermove', move, { passive: false });
   207	      on(root, 'pointerup', function (e) { up(e, false); }, { passive: false });
   208	      on(root, 'pointercancel', function (e) { up(e, true); }, { passive: false });
   209	    } else {
   210	      on(canvas, 'touchstart', down, { passive: false });
   211	      on(canvas, 'touchmove', move, { passive: false });
   212	      on(root, 'touchend', function (e) { up(e, false); }, { passive: false });
   213	      on(root, 'touchcancel', function (e) { up(e, true); }, { passive: false });
   214	      on(canvas, 'mousedown', down, { passive: false });
   215	      on(canvas, 'mousemove', move, { passive: false });
   216	      on(root, 'mouseup', function (e) { up(e, false); }, { passive: false });
   217	    }
   218	    on(canvas, 'contextmenu', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); });
   219	
   220	    on(root, 'keydown', function (e) {
   221	      if (!self.enabled) return;
   222	      var k = e.key;
   223	      if (k === ' ' || k === 'Spacebar' || k === 'ArrowLeft' || k === 'ArrowRight' ||
   224	        k === 'ArrowUp' || k === 'ArrowDown' || k === 'Enter') e.preventDefault();
   225	      if (self.keys[k]) return;
   226	      self.keys[k] = 1;
   227	      var a = self.keyMap(k);
   228	      if (a) self.fire(a);
   229	    });
   230	    on(root, 'keyup', function (e) { delete self.keys[e.key]; });
   231	    on(root, 'blur', function () { self.releaseAll(); });
   232	    on(document, 'visibilitychange', function () { if (document.hidden) self.releaseAll(); });
   233	  }
   234	  Input.prototype.keyMap = function (k) {
   235	    if (k === ' ' || k === 'Spacebar' || k === 'Enter') return 'spin';
   236	    if (k === 'ArrowRight' || k === '+' || k === '=') return 'betUp';
   237	    if (k === 'ArrowLeft' || k === '-' || k === '_') return 'betDown';
   238	    if (k === '1') return 'm0'; if (k === '2') return 'm1';
   239	    if (k === '3') return 'm2'; if (k === '4') return 'm3';
   240	    if (k === 'ArrowDown') return 'panelNext';
   241	    if (k === 'ArrowUp') return 'panelPrev';
   242	    if (k === 'r' || k === 'R') return 'reset';
   243	    if (k === 'm' || k === 'M') return 'mute';
   244	    if (k === 'h' || k === 'H' || k === '?') return 'help';
   245	    return null;
   246	  };
   247	  Input.prototype.hit = function (x, y) {
   248	    for (var i = this.controls.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
   249	      var c = this.controls[i];
   250	      if (c.disabled) continue;
   251	      if (x >= c.x && x <= c.x + c.w && y >= c.y && y <= c.y + c.h) return c;
   252	    }
   253	    return null;
   254	  };
   255	  Input.prototype.fire = function (id) {
   256	    if (this.queue.length > 12) return;
   257	    this.queue.push(id);
   258	  };
   259	  Input.prototype.drain = function (fn) {
   260	    var q = this.queue; this.queue = [];
   261	    for (var i = 0; i < q.length; i++) fn(q[i]);
   262	  };
   263	  Input.prototype.releaseAll = function () {
   264	    this.pointers = Object.create(null);
   265	    this.keys = Object.create(null);
   266	    this.pressed = null;
   267	    this.queue.length = 0;
   268	  };
   269	  Input.prototype.reset = function () { this.releaseAll(); this.controls.length = 0; };

   623	  function update(dt) {
   624	    /* HARDENING 1: rotate overlay freezes the whole simulation */
   625	    if (G.rotate) return;
   626	    G.shake = Math.max(0, G.shake - dt * 0.045);
   627	    G.flash = Math.max(0, G.flash - dt * 0.004);
   628	    G.bannerT = Math.max(0, G.bannerT - dt);
   629	    for (var i = parts.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
   630	      var p = parts[i]; p.l -= dt;
   631	      if (p.l <= 0) { parts.splice(i, 1); continue; }
   632	      p.x += p.vx * dt * 0.001; p.y += p.vy * dt * 0.001;
   633	      if (p.k !== 'ring') { p.vy += dt * 0.35; }
   634	    }
   635	    if (parts.length > MAXP) parts.splice(0, parts.length - MAXP);
   636	
   637	    if (G.phase !== 'fight' || G.paused) return;
   638	
   639	    rangeV += (range - rangeV) * Math.min(1, dt * 0.009);
   640	
   641	    if (G.over > 0) {
   642	      G.over -= dt;
   643	      if (G.over <= 0) { G.over = 0; afterRound(); }
   644	      return;
   645	    }
   646	    if (G.freeze > 0) { G.freeze -= dt; return; }
   647	    if (G.hitstop > 0) { G.hitstop -= dt; return; }
   648	
   649	    G.time = Math.max(0, G.time - dt * 0.001);
   650	
   651	    P.breath = Math.min(100, P.breath + dt * 0.006);
   652	    elBurst.classList.toggle('off', P.breath < BURST_COST);
   653	
   654	    stepFighter(P, dt, true);
   655	    stepFighter(E, dt, false);
   656	
   657	    /* hold-to-grab */
   658	    if (pt.id !== null && !pt.fired) {
   659	      var dx = pt.x - pt.x0, dy = pt.y - pt.y0;
   660	      if (dx * dx + dy * dy < 26 * 26 && performance.now() - pt.t0 >= 300) { pt.fired = true; doGrab(); }

   847	  function hitTest(point) {
   848	    if (state.orientationLocked) return null;
   849	    if (state.botView) {
   850	      var close = { x: width - 80, y: 72, w: 66, h: 58 };
   851	      return inside(point, close) ? { kind: "closeBots" } : null;
   852	    }
   853	    if (!state.started) return inside(point, layout.start) ? { kind: "start" } : null;
   854	    if (state.ended) return inside(point, layout.end) ? { kind: "end" } : null;
   855	    if (inside(point, layout.bot)) return { kind: "bots" };
   856	    for (var i = 0; i < layout.chips.length; i++) if (inside(point, layout.chips[i])) return { kind: "chip", index: i };
   857	    for (var c = 0; c < layout.cells.length; c++) {
   858	      var cell = layout.cells[c];
   859	      if (inside(point, cell)) return { kind: "cell", card: cell.card, index: cell.index };
   860	    }
   861	    return null;

   571	  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- update
   572	  function update(dt) {
   573	    G.t += dt;
   574	    if (G.shake > 0) G.shake = Math.max(0, G.shake - dt * 26);
   575	    if (G.flash > 0) G.flash = Math.max(0, G.flash - dt * 1.8);
   576	    if (G.celebrate > 0) G.celebrate = Math.max(0, G.celebrate - dt);
   577	    for (var i = G.parts.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
   578	      var p = G.parts[i];
   579	      p.vy += 260 * dt; p.x += p.vx * dt; p.y += p.vy * dt; p.life -= dt * 1.15;
   580	      if (p.life <= 0 || p.y > VH + 30) G.parts.splice(i, 1);
   581	    }
   582	    for (var f = G.floats.length - 1; f >= 0; f--) {
   583	      var fl = G.floats[f]; fl.y -= 26 * dt; fl.life -= dt * 1.1;
   584	      if (fl.life <= 0) G.floats.splice(f, 1);
   585	    }
   586	    for (var a = G.anims.length - 1; a >= 0; a--) {
   587	      G.anims[a].t += dt;
   588	      if (G.anims[a].t >= G.anims[a].d) G.anims.splice(a, 1);
   589	    }
   590	    if (G.hintHold > 0) G.hintHold -= dt;
   591	    if (G.screen === 'play' && !G.result && G.hintHold <= 0) {
   592	      var none = playableList().length === 0, empty = G.si >= G.stock.length;
   593	      if (G.wildArmed) G.hint = 'Wild armed - tap any uncovered card, any rank.';
   594	      else if (none && empty && S.wilds > 0) G.hint = 'No matches left - spend a WILD, or leave the deal.';
   595	      else if (none) G.hint = 'No match - tap DRAW for a new card.';
   596	      else if (G.moves === 0) G.hint = 'Tap a card one rank above or below the big card.';
   597	      else if (G.streak >= 3) G.hint = 'Chain running - keep matching for a bigger multiplier.';
   598	      else G.hint = 'Clear a peak top to earn a WILD.';
   599	    }
   600	  }

   603	  function frame(ts) {
   604	    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
   605	    var dt = (ts - last) / 1000; last = ts;
   606	    if (!isFinite(dt) || dt < 0) dt = 0;
   607	    dt = Math.min(0.05, dt);

   619	  function inBox(b, x, y) { return b && x >= b.x && x <= b.x + b.w && y >= b.y && y <= b.y + b.h; }
   620	
   621	  function tapPlay(x, y) {
   622	    if (G.result) {
   623	      if (inBox(resultBtns.a, x, y)) {
   624	        Sound.tap();
   625	        if (G.result === 'win') { G.screen = 'meadow'; G.hint = 'Tap a planting to grow it.'; clearInput(); }
   626	        else startDeal(G.deal);
   627	        return;
   628	      }
   629	      if (inBox(resultBtns.b, x, y)) {
   630	        Sound.tap();
   631	        if (G.result === 'win' && G.deal + 1 < DEALS.length) startDeal(G.deal + 1);
   632	        else { G.screen = 'meadow'; clearInput(); }
   633	        return;
   634	      }
   635	      if (inBox(resultBtns.c, x, y)) {
   636	        Sound.tap();
   637	        if (G.result === 'win') startDeal(G.deal);
   638	        else { G.screen = 'deals'; clearInput(); }
   639	        return;
   640	      }
   641	      return;
   642	    }
   643	    if (inBox(MENUB, x, y)) { Sound.tap(); G.screen = 'meadow'; clearInput(); return; }
   644	    if (inBox(STOCK, x, y)) { doDraw(); return; }
   645	    if (inBox(WILDB, x, y)) {
   646	      if (S.wilds > 0) { G.wildArmed = !G.wildArmed; Sound.tap(); if (!G.wildArmed) say('Wild cancelled.', 1.4); }
   647	      else { Sound.deny(); say('No wilds banked. Clear a peak top to earn one.', 2.4); }
   648	      return;
   649	    }
   650	    // cards: peaks overlap, so score every card the touch covers and take the
   651	    // best one - playable beats free beats covered, nearest centre breaks ties.
   652	    var bestI = -1, bestScore = -1e9, pad = 4;
   653	    for (var i = 0; i < 28; i++) {
   654	      if (!alive(i)) continue;
   655	      var p = cardPos(i);
   656	      if (x < p.x - pad || x > p.x + CW + pad || y < p.y - pad || y > p.y + CH + pad) continue;
   657	      var dx = x - (p.x + CW / 2), dy = y - (p.y + CH / 2);
   658	      var sc = -Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy) + ROW[i] * 2;
   659	      if (free(i)) sc += 1000;
   660	      if (!G.wildArmed && playable(i)) sc += 4000;
   661	      if (sc > bestScore) { bestScore = sc; bestI = i; }
   662	    }
   663	    if (bestI >= 0) {
   664	      if (G.wildArmed) { if (free(bestI)) useWild(bestI); else Sound.deny(); }
   665	      else doPlay(bestI, false);
   666	      return;
   667	    }
   668	    if (G.wildArmed) { G.wildArmed = false; }
   669	  }
   670	
   671	  function tapMeadow(x, y) {
   672	    if (G.celebrate > 0) { G.celebrate = 0; return; }
   673	    if (inBox(meadowBtns.play, x, y)) { Sound.tap(); startDeal(S.current); return; }
   674	    if (inBox(meadowBtns.deals, x, y)) { Sound.tap(); G.screen = 'deals'; clearInput(); return; }
   675	    if (meadowBtns.grow && inBox(meadowBtns.grow, x, y)) {

   682	          if (b) { burst(b.cx, b.cy - 10, 18, '#9dd06a', 130); float(b.cx, b.cy - 40, 'GROW', '#b9dc8a'); }
   683	        }

   689	    }
   690	    G.mSel = -1;
   691	  }

   708	  function down(ev) {
   709	    ev.preventDefault();
   710	    var id = (ev.pointerId === undefined) ? 'm' : ev.pointerId;
   711	    var v = toVirtual(ev);
   712	    pointers[id] = { x: v.x, y: v.y, sx: v.x, sy: v.y, t: G.t };
   713	    Sound.unlock();
   714	  }
   715	  function move(ev) {
   716	    var id = (ev.pointerId === undefined) ? 'm' : ev.pointerId;
   717	    var p = pointers[id];
   718	    if (!p) return;
   719	    ev.preventDefault();
   720	    var v = toVirtual(ev);
   721	    p.x = v.x; p.y = v.y;
   722	  }
   723	  function up(ev) {
   724	    var id = (ev.pointerId === undefined) ? 'm' : ev.pointerId;
   725	    var p = pointers[id];
   726	    delete pointers[id];
   727	    if (!p) return;
   728	    ev.preventDefault();
   729	    var v = toVirtual(ev);
   730	    var dx = v.x - p.sx, dy = v.y - p.sy;
   731	    if (dx * dx + dy * dy < 26 * 26) onTap(v.x, v.y);   // tap, not a drag
   732	  }
   733	  function cancel(ev) {
   734	    var id = (ev.pointerId === undefined) ? 'm' : ev.pointerId;
   735	    delete pointers[id];
   736	  }

     6	  var parts = [], PART_CAP = 180;
     7	  var floats = [], FLOAT_CAP = 20;
     8	  var shake = 0, flash = 0, flashCol = '#fff';
     9	  var anims = [], ANIM_CAP = 12;

    12	  function init(canvas) {
    13	    cv = canvas; ctx = cv.getContext('2d', { alpha: false });
    14	    resize();
    15	  }
    16	  function resize() {
    17	    if (!cv) return;
    18	    var rect = cv.getBoundingClientRect();
    19	    var cssW = Math.max(1, rect.width), cssH = Math.max(1, rect.height);
    20	    dpr = Math.min(2, window.devicePixelRatio || 1);
    21	    var longCss = Math.max(cssW, cssH);
    22	    var scale = Math.min(dpr, 960 / Math.max(1, longCss));
    23	    if (scale < 0.5) scale = 0.5;
    24	    W = Math.round(cssW * scale); H = Math.round(cssH * scale);
    25	    cv.width = W; cv.height = H;
    26	    cv.__scale = scale; cv.__cssW = cssW; cv.__cssH = cssH;
    27	  }
    28	  function sc() { return (cv && cv.__scale) || 1; }
    29	
    30	  function fit() {
    31	    var S = G.state;
    32	    if (!S) return;
    33	    var minX = 1e9, maxX = -1e9, minY = 1e9, maxY = -1e9;
    34	    for (var i = 0; i < S.list.length; i++) {
    35	      var p = HEX.toPix(S.list[i].q, S.list[i].r, HS);
    36	      if (p.x < minX) minX = p.x; if (p.x > maxX) maxX = p.x;
    37	      if (p.y < minY) minY = p.y; if (p.y > maxY) maxY = p.y;
    38	    }
    39	    cam.x = (minX + maxX) / 2; cam.y = (minY + maxY) / 2;
    40	    var mw = (maxX - minX) + HS * 2.4, mh = (maxY - minY) + HS * 2.6;
    41	    var z = Math.min(W / mw, H / mh);
    42	    cam.minZ = z * 0.8; cam.maxZ = z * 3.0;
    43	    cam.z = z;
    44	    clampCam();
    45	  }
    46	  function clampCam() {
    47	    var S = G.state;
    48	    if (!S) return;
    49	    if (cam.z < cam.minZ) cam.z = cam.minZ;
    50	    if (cam.z > cam.maxZ) cam.z = cam.maxZ;
    51	    var lim = HS * 6.4;
    52	    if (cam.x < -lim) cam.x = -lim; if (cam.x > lim) cam.x = lim;
    53	    if (cam.y < -lim) cam.y = -lim; if (cam.y > lim) cam.y = lim;
    54	  }
    55	  function w2s(x, y) { return { x: (x - cam.x) * cam.z + W / 2, y: (y - cam.y) * cam.z + H / 2 }; }
    56	  function s2w(x, y) { return { x: (x - W / 2) / cam.z + cam.x, y: (y - H / 2) / cam.z + cam.y }; }
    57	  // css px -> hex
    58	  function pick(cssX, cssY) {
    59	    var s = sc(), w = s2w(cssX * s, cssY * s);
    60	    return HEX.fromPix(w.x, w.y, HS);
    61	  }
    62	  function panBy(dxCss, dyCss) {
    63	    var s = sc();
    64	    cam.x -= dxCss * s / cam.z; cam.y -= dyCss * s / cam.z; clampCam();
    65	  }
    66	  function zoomAt(mul, cssX, cssY) {
    67	    var s = sc(), bx = cssX * s, by = cssY * s;
    68	    var before = s2w(bx, by);
    69	    cam.z *= mul; clampCam();
    70	    var after = s2w(bx, by);
     1	// Warring Banners - axial pointy-top hex geometry + seeded RNG.
     2	var HEX = (function () {
     3	  var DIRS = [[1,0],[1,-1],[0,-1],[-1,0],[-1,1],[0,1]];
     4	
     5	  function key(q, r) { return q + ',' + r; }
     6	  function dist(aq, ar, bq, br) {
     7	    var dq = aq - bq, dr = ar - br;
     8	    return (Math.abs(dq) + Math.abs(dq + dr) + Math.abs(dr)) / 2;
     9	  }
    10	  function neighbors(q, r) {
    11	    var o = [];
    12	    for (var i = 0; i < 6; i++) o.push([q + DIRS[i][0], r + DIRS[i][1]]);
    13	    return o;
    14	  }
    15	  // pointy-top layout
    16	  function toPix(q, r, s) {
    17	    return { x: s * Math.sqrt(3) * (q + r / 2), y: s * 1.5 * r };
    18	  }
    19	  function fromPix(x, y, s) {
    20	    var q = (Math.sqrt(3) / 3 * x - y / 3) / s;
    21	    var r = (2 / 3 * y) / s;
    22	    return round(q, r);
    23	  }
    24	  function round(q, r) {
    25	    var x = q, z = r, y = -x - z;
    26	    var rx = Math.round(x), ry = Math.round(y), rz = Math.round(z);
    27	    var dx = Math.abs(rx - x), dy = Math.abs(ry - y), dz = Math.abs(rz - z);
    28	    if (dx > dy && dx > dz) rx = -ry - rz;
    29	    else if (dy > dz) ry = -rx - rz;
    30	    else rz = -rx - ry;
    31	    return { q: rx, r: rz };
    32	  }
    33	  function corners(cx, cy, s) {
    34	    var pts = [];
    35	    for (var i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
    36	      var a = Math.PI / 180 * (60 * i - 30);
    37	      pts.push([cx + s * Math.cos(a), cy + s * Math.sin(a)]);
    38	    }
    39	    return pts;
    40	  }
    41	
    42	  // deterministic PRNG (mulberry32)
    43	  function rng(seed) {
    44	    var a = (seed >>> 0) || 1;
    45	    return function () {
    46	      a |= 0; a = (a + 0x6D2B79F5) | 0;
    47	      var t = Math.imul(a ^ (a >>> 15), 1 | a);
    48	      t = (t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), 61 | t)) ^ t;
    49	      return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
    50	    };
    51	  }
    52	
    53	  return { DIRS: DIRS, key: key, dist: dist, neighbors: neighbors,
    54	           toPix: toPix, fromPix: fromPix, corners: corners, rng: rng };
    55	})();

    25	  function drop(t) { var i = TIMERS.indexOf(t); if (i >= 0) TIMERS.splice(i, 1); }
    26	  function clearTimers() { for (var i = 0; i < TIMERS.length; i++) clearTimeout(TIMERS[i]); TIMERS.length = 0; }
    27	  function clearInput() {

   378	  // ---------- pointer input (own id per pointer, hardening #3) ----------
   379	  function cssPos(e) {
   380	    var r = cv.getBoundingClientRect();
   381	    return { x: e.clientX - r.left, y: e.clientY - r.top };
   382	  }
   383	  function down(e) {
   384	    if (paused || !started) return;
   385	    e.preventDefault();
   386	    var p = cssPos(e);
   387	    pointers[e.pointerId] = { x: p.x, y: p.y, sx: p.x, sy: p.y, moved: false };
   388	    if (pointerOrder.indexOf(e.pointerId) < 0) pointerOrder.push(e.pointerId);
   389	    if (pointerOrder.length === 2) startPinch();
   390	    try { cv.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId); } catch (err) {}
   391	  }
   392	  function move(e) {
   393	    var pt = pointers[e.pointerId];
   394	    if (!pt) return;
   395	    e.preventDefault();
   396	    var p = cssPos(e);
   397	    var dx = p.x - pt.x, dy = p.y - pt.y;
   398	    pt.x = p.x; pt.y = p.y;
   399	    if (Math.abs(p.x - pt.sx) > 10 || Math.abs(p.y - pt.sy) > 10) pt.moved = true;
   400	    if (pointerOrder.length >= 2) { updatePinch(); return; }
   401	    if (pt.moved) R.panBy(dx, dy);
   402	  }
   403	  function up(e) {
   404	    var pt = pointers[e.pointerId];
   405	    if (!pt) return;
   406	    e.preventDefault();
   407	    var wasPinch = pointerOrder.length >= 2;
   408	    release(e.pointerId);
   409	    if (!wasPinch && !pt.moved) {
   410	      showCursor = false;
   411	      var h = R.pick(pt.x, pt.y);
   412	      onHex(h.q, h.r);
   413	    }
   414	    if (pointerOrder.length === 2) startPinch();
   415	  }
   416	  function cancel(e) { release(e.pointerId); }
   417	  function release(id) {
   418	    delete pointers[id];
   419	    var i = pointerOrder.indexOf(id);
   420	    if (i >= 0) pointerOrder.splice(i, 1);
   421	    if (pointerOrder.length < 2) { pinchDist = 0; pinchMid = null; }
   422	    try { cv.releasePointerCapture(id); } catch (err) {}
   423	  }
   424	  function startPinch() {
   425	    var a = pointers[pointerOrder[0]], b = pointers[pointerOrder[1]];
   426	    if (!a || !b) return;
   427	    pinchDist = Math.hypot(a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y) || 1;
   428	    pinchMid = { x: (a.x + b.x) / 2, y: (a.y + b.y) / 2 };
   429	  }
   430	  function updatePinch() {
   431	    var a = pointers[pointerOrder[0]], b = pointers[pointerOrder[1]];
   432	    if (!a || !b || !pinchMid) return;
   433	    var d = Math.hypot(a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y) || 1;
   434	    var mid = { x: (a.x + b.x) / 2, y: (a.y + b.y) / 2 };
   435	    if (pinchDist > 0) R.zoomAt(d / pinchDist, mid.x, mid.y);
   436	    R.panBy(mid.x - pinchMid.x, mid.y - pinchMid.y);
   437	    pinchDist = d; pinchMid = mid;
   438	  }

   453	  // ---------- keyboard ----------
   454	  var ARROW = { ArrowLeft: [-1, 0], ArrowRight: [1, 0], ArrowUp: [0, -1], ArrowDown: [0, 1] };
   455	  window.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
   456	    if (!started) {
   457	      if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') { e.preventDefault(); start(); }
   458	      return;
   459	    }
   460	    keys[e.key] = 1;
   461	    if (ovAttack.classList.contains('on')) {
   462	      if (e.key === 'Enter') { e.preventDefault(); doAttack(); }
   463	      if (e.key === 'Escape') { e.preventDefault(); pendingAttack = null; ovAttack.classList.remove('on'); }
   464	      return;
   465	    }
   466	    if (ovEnd.classList.contains('on')) {
   467	      if (e.key === 'Enter') { e.preventDefault(); $('btnNext').click(); }
   468	      return;
   469	    }
   470	    if (paused) return;
   471	    var S = G.state;
   472	    if (!S) return;
   473	    if (ARROW[e.key]) {
   474	      e.preventDefault();
   475	      showCursor = true;
   476	      var d = ARROW[e.key], nq = S.cursor.q + d[0], nr = S.cursor.r + d[1];
   477	      if (G.hexAt(nq, nr)) { S.cursor = { q: nq, r: nr }; SFX.tap(); }
   478	      else {
   479	        // slide along the hex diagonal so every cell is reachable with 4 keys
   480	        var alt = e.key === 'ArrowUp' ? [1, -1] : e.key === 'ArrowDown' ? [-1, 1] : null;
   481	        if (alt && G.hexAt(S.cursor.q + alt[0], S.cursor.r + alt[1])) {
   482	          S.cursor = { q: S.cursor.q + alt[0], r: S.cursor.r + alt[1] }; SFX.tap();
   483	        }
   484	      }
   485	      return;
   486	    }
   487	    if (e.key === 'Enter') { e.preventDefault(); showCursor = true; onHex(S.cursor.q, S.cursor.r); return; }
   488	    if (e.key === 'Escape') { deselect(); return; }
   489	    if (e.key === ' ') { e.preventDefault(); endTurn(); return; }
   490	    if (e.key === '1') { tryRecruit('spear'); return; }
   491	    if (e.key === '2') { tryRecruit('cav'); return; }
   492	    if (e.key === '3') { tryRecruit('bow'); return; }
   493	    if (e.key === '+' || e.key === '=') { R.zoomAt(1.15, cv.clientWidth / 2, cv.clientHeight / 2); return; }
   494	    if (e.key === '-' || e.key === '_') { R.zoomAt(0.87, cv.clientWidth / 2, cv.clientHeight / 2); return; }
   495	    if (e.key === 'f' || e.key === 'F') { R.fit(); return; }
   496	  });
   497	  window.addEventListener('keyup', function (e) { delete keys[e.key]; });
   498	  window.addEventListener('blur', function () {
   499	    clearInput();
   500	    for (var k in keys) delete keys[k];

   514	        : 'No free space at your keep.');
   515	      return;

   114	  function repairConnectivity(hexes, list) {
   115	    for (var guard = 0; guard < 40; guard++) {

   124	          seen[k] = 1; stack.push([h.q, h.r]);
   125	        }
   126	      }

   128	      for (var j = 0; j < list.length; j++) {
   129	        var t = list[j];

   131	        if (!seen[K(t.q, t.r)]) { bad = t; break; }
   132	      }
   133	      if (!bad) return;
   134	      // convert the water hex nearest the disconnected region into a ford
   135	      var best = null, bd = 1e9;
   136	      for (j = 0; j < list.length; j++) {
   137	        var w = list[j];

   143	          if (seen[kk]) touchesIn = true; else touchesOut = true;
   144	        }

   396	    if (state.bots.some(function (bot) { return bot.finished; })) finish("fail", "A bot lantern solved the room first.");
   397	  }
   398	
   399	  function update(dt) {
   400	    if (state.orientationLocked || !state.started || state.ended) {
   401	      lastFrame = performance.now();
   402	      return;
   403	    }
   404	    state.timer += dt;
   405	    state.callElapsed += dt;
   406	    if (state.callElapsed >= state.callInterval) nextCall();
   407	    else if (state.callElapsed >= state.callInterval * 0.78) state.callLive = false;
   408	    state.doubleTimer = Math.max(0, state.doubleTimer - dt);
   409	    state.peekTimer = Math.max(0, state.peekTimer - dt);
   410	    state.feedbackTimer = Math.max(0, state.feedbackTimer - dt);
   411	    state.flash = Math.max(0, state.flash - dt * 0.9);
   412	    state.shake = Math.max(0, state.shake - dt * 10);
   413	    updateBots();
   414	    for (var i = state.particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
   415	      var particle = state.particles[i];
   416	      particle.life -= dt;
   417	      particle.x += particle.vx * dt;
   418	      particle.y += particle.vy * dt;
   419	      particle.vy += 28 * dt;
   420	      if (particle.life <= 0) state.particles.splice(i, 1);
   421	    }
   422	    processQueuedActions();
   423	  }
   424	
   425	  function processQueuedActions() {
   426	    var count = Math.min(queuedActions.length, 12);
   427	    for (var i = 0; i < count; i++) {
   428	      var action = queuedActions.shift();
   429	      if (action.type === "card" && action.card < state.cards.length) {
   430	        var match = -1;
   450	    var count = Math.min(amount, Math.max(0, room));
   451	    for (var i = 0; i < count; i++) {
   452	      var angle = Math.random() * TAU;
   453	      var speed = 20 + Math.random() * 95;
   454	      state.particles.push({ x: x, y: y, vx: Math.cos(angle) * speed, vy: Math.sin(angle) * speed - 18, life: 0.45 + Math.random() * 0.55, size: 2 + Math.random() * 3, color: color });
   455	    }
   456	  }
   457	
   458	  function later(callback, delay) {
   459	    if (pendingTimeouts.size >= 16) {
   460	      pendingTimeouts.forEach(function (timer) { clearTimeout(timer); });
   461	      pendingTimeouts.clear();
   462	    }
   463	    var timer = setTimeout(function () {
   464	      pendingTimeouts.delete(timer);
   465	      callback();
   466	    }, delay);
   467	    pendingTimeouts.add(timer);
   468	    return timer;
   469	  }
   470	
   471	  function clearInput() {
   472	    pointerMap.clear();
   473	    heldKeys.clear();
   474	    queuedActions.length = 0;
   475	    pendingTimeouts.forEach(function (timer) { clearTimeout(timer); });
   476	    pendingTimeouts.clear();
   477	  }

   479	  function unlockAudio() {
   480	    try {
   481	      if (!audioContext) {
   482	        var AudioCtor = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
   483	        if (AudioCtor) audioContext = new AudioCtor();
   484	      }
   485	      if (audioContext && audioContext.state === "suspended") audioContext.resume();
   486	    } catch (error) {
   487	      audioContext = null;
   488	    }
   489	  }

     1	/* Carnival Reels - machine math models.
     2	   Pure logic, no DOM. Each machine exposes spin(lite) -> result:
     3	     { mult:Number (x bet), parts:[{tag,label,pay}], ...visual data }
     4	   Analysis is either EXACT (full enumeration) or SIM (monte-carlo chunks). */
     5	(function (root) {
     6	  'use strict';
     7	
     8	  var R = Math.random;
     9	  function pick(strip) { return strip[(R() * strip.length) | 0]; }
    10	  // Build a reel strip and spread symbols evenly around it, so the physical
    11	  // strip reads like a real reel. Stop selection stays uniform, so the maths
    12	  // in the pay tables is unchanged by the ordering.
    13	  function build(weights) {
    14	    var syms = [], k, N = 0;
    15	    for (k in weights) { syms.push(k); N += weights[k]; }
    16	    syms.sort(function (a, b) { return weights[b] - weights[a]; });
    17	    var out = new Array(N), i, j;
    18	    for (i = 0; i < syms.length; i++) {
    19	      var w = weights[syms[i]], step = N / w, off = i * (N / syms.length / 2);
    20	      for (j = 0; j < w; j++) {
    21	        var idx = Math.round(off + j * step) % N, guard = 0;
    22	        while (out[idx] !== undefined && guard++ < N) idx = (idx + 1) % N;
    23	        out[idx] = syms[i];
    24	      }
    25	    }
    26	    for (i = 0; i < N; i++) if (out[i] === undefined) out[i] = syms[0];
    27	    return out;
    28	  }
    29	  function wpick(table) { // table: [[value, weight], ...] with total
    30	    var t = 0, i;
    31	    for (i = 0; i < table.length; i++) t += table[i][1];
    32	    var r = R() * t;
    33	    for (i = 0; i < table.length; i++) { r -= table[i][1]; if (r < 0) return table[i][0]; }
    34	    return table[table.length - 1][0];
    35	  }

    38	  function Analysis(exact) {
    39	    this.exact = !!exact;
    40	    this.n = 0; this.sum = 0; this.sumSq = 0;
    41	    this.hitAny = 0; this.hit1 = 0; this.max = 0;
    42	    this.tags = {};       // tag -> {label, n, sum}
    43	    this.order = [];      // tag order of first appearance
    44	    this.done = false;
    45	  }
    46	  Analysis.prototype.add = function (res, w) {
    47	    w = w || 1;
    48	    this.n += w; this.sum += res.mult * w; this.sumSq += res.mult * res.mult * w;
    49	    if (res.mult > 0) this.hitAny += w;
    50	    if (res.mult >= 1) this.hit1 += w;
    51	    if (res.mult > this.max) this.max = res.mult;
    52	    for (var i = 0; i < res.parts.length; i++) {
    53	      var p = res.parts[i], t = this.tags[p.tag];
    54	      if (!t) { t = this.tags[p.tag] = { label: p.label, n: 0, sum: 0 }; this.order.push(p.tag); }
    55	      t.n += w; t.sum += p.pay * w;
    56	    }
    57	  };
    58	  Analysis.prototype.rtp = function () { return this.n ? this.sum / this.n : 0; };
    59	  Analysis.prototype.sd = function () {
    60	    if (this.n < 2) return 0;
    61	    var m = this.sum / this.n, v = this.sumSq / this.n - m * m;
    62	    return v > 0 ? Math.sqrt(v) : 0;
    63	  };
    64	  Analysis.prototype.rows = function () {
    65	    var out = [], self = this;
    66	    this.order.forEach(function (tag) {
    67	      var t = self.tags[tag];
    68	      out.push({
    69	        tag: tag, label: t.label,
    70	        p: t.n / self.n,
    71	        avg: t.n ? t.sum / t.n : 0,
    72	        rtp: t.sum / self.n
    73	      });
    74	    });
    75	    out.sort(function (a, b) { return b.rtp - a.rtp; });
    76	    return out;
    77	  };

   316	  function matchup(at, dt) {
   317	    if (UNITS[at].beats === dt) return 1.5;
   318	    if (UNITS[dt].beats === at) return 0.75;
   319	    return 1.0;

   321	  function preview(a, d) {
   322	    var dh = hexAt(d.q, d.r);
   323	    var m = matchup(a.type, d.type);
   324	    var supA = a.sup ? 1.0 : 0.7, supD = d.sup ? 1.0 : 0.7;
   325	    var terr = TERR[dh.terr].def;
   326	    var keepB = (dh.keep === d.owner) ? 1.9 : 1.0;
   327	    var A = a.str * m * supA;
   328	    var D = d.str * terr * supD * keepB;
   329	    var win = A > D;
   330	    var surv = win ? Math.max(1, Math.round(a.str * (1 - D / A)))
   331	                   : Math.max(1, Math.round(d.str * (1 - A / D)));
   332	    return {
   333	      atk: a, def: d, hex: dh, m: m, supA: supA, supD: supD,
   334	      terr: terr, keepB: keepB, A: A, D: D, win: win, surv: surv
   335	    };
   336	  }
